title: VOA 核心词汇
subtitle: 源自 VOA Learning English 官方 Word Book（美国国际媒体署），约 1500 核心词

defsEn: one
any
each
zh: 第一个字母 A; 一个; 第一的

defsEn: having the power to do something
zh: a. 能干的, 能够的
examples: Would you be able to take a picture of us?
Would you be able to do it?
exampleZh: 您能好好给我们照一张相吗？
你能做到吗？

defsEn: almost (“about half”)
of or having a relation to (“We talk about the weather.”)
zh: prep. 在...周围, 大约, 有关, 关于
adv. 大约, 四处, 在附近, 周围
examples: How about we go to the library together to study?
How about a drink after the game?
exampleZh: 咱们一起去图书馆学习，你觉得怎么样？
比赛结束后喝一杯怎么样？

defsEn: at a higher place
zh: prep. 在上方, 超出
adv. 在上面
a. 上述的, 上面的
examples: Above all, you must take good care of yourself.
Jim is above any of his classmates in English.
exampleZh: 最重要的是你要好好照顾自己。
杰米的英语比他班上任何一个同学的都好。

defsEn: bad treatment causing harm or injury
zh: n. 滥用, 虐待, 恶习, 辱骂
vt. 滥用, 辱骂, 虐待
examples: Abuse of power is only possible because we let people have power.
The abuse of alcohol among young people is a serious problem.

defsEn: to agree to receive
zh: vt. 接受, 承认, 同意, 相信, 赞成, 承担, 承兑, 采纳, 接纳, 容忍
vi. 同意
examples: We accept all major credit cards.
He did not accept their invitation.
exampleZh: 我们接受所有主要的信用卡。
他没有接受他们的邀请。

defsEn: something that happens by chance or mistake
an unplanned event
zh: n. 意外事件, 机遇, 事故, 次要方面
examples: The accident almost cost him his life.
An accident delayed us for half an hour.
exampleZh: 事故差点让他丢了性命。
事故耽误了我们半小时。

defsEn: to say a person is responsible for an act or crime
to make a statement against someone
zh: vt. 指责, 控告, 归咎于
vi. 指责, 控告
examples: They accused him of being part of the plot.
She accused me of being a liar.
exampleZh: 人们指控他参与了这场阴谋。
她骂我是个骗子。

defsEn: from side to side
to the other side
zh: prep. 越过, 穿过, 与...相交叉, 在...的对面
adv. 交叉, 到另一边, 在对面, 成十字
examples: He came across this old coin in an antique shop.
I ran across an old friend near the bank.
exampleZh: 他偶然在古董店里发现了这个旧硬币。
我在银行附近碰见老朋友。

defsEn: to do something
zh: n. 行动, 行为, 幕, 法案
vi. 行动, 表演, 假装, 见效, 表现, 担当
vt. 扮演, 装作
examples: I'll act as a guide for you.
Her acting is on the level of a professional.
exampleZh: 我为你充当导游。
她的演技堪比专业人士。

defsEn: one who seeks change through action
zh: n. 激进主义分子
examples: Cyber activists want to meet with the Supreme Leader.
Tom is an activist in his community.
exampleZh: 网络积极分子想跟最高领袖见面。
汤姆是社群中的积极分子。

defsEn: someone acting in a play or show
zh: n. 男演员, 行动者
examples: The actor made his character sound like an idiot to make people laugh.
The actor is nowhere near as popular as he used to be.

defsEn: to put (something) with another to make it larger
to say more
zh: vt. 增加, 添加, 附带说明, 计算...总和
vi. 做加法, 积累而成, 增添
examples: This adds a new dimension of complexity to the problem.
That adds a new dimension to our problem.

defsEn: the executive part of a government, usually headed by a president or prime minister
zh: n. 行政, 管理, 政府机关
examples: They sent us to the administration office of the factory.
The administration of a new drug curbed the epidemic.

defsEn: to accept (“admitted to the United Nations”)
to express one’s guilt or responsibility (“He admitted that what he did was wrong.”)
zh: vt. 承认, 接受, 允许进入, 容许
vi. 开向, 容许, 承认
examples: I admit that this may not be the best way of doing it.
I admit this may not be the best way of doing it.
exampleZh: 我承认这可能不是最好的方法。
我承认这可能不是最好的方法。

defsEn: a grown person
zh: n. 成人, 成虫
a. 成年的, 成熟的
examples: Two adult tickets and three children's tickets to London, please.
I'm not an adult. I just look like one.
exampleZh: 请给我两张到伦敦的成人票，三张儿童票。

defsEn: to show or present the qualities of a product to increase sales
zh: vt. 做广告, 通知, 公布
vi. 做广告
examples: I advertised my house in the newspaper.
I advertised my car for sale.
exampleZh: 我在报纸上刊登了我的房子的广告。
我登广告卖我的车。

defsEn: to help with information, knowledge or ideas in making a decision
zh: vt. 劝告, 给...出主意, 通知, 建议
vi. 提意见, 商量
examples: I advise you never to live beyond your income.
I advise you to give up drinking.
exampleZh: 我建议你永远不要入不敷出。
我劝你戒酒。

defsEn: to produce an effect on
to influence (“A lack of sleep affected the singer’s performance.”)
zh: vt. 影响, 感动, 假装, 模仿, 爱好, 倾向于
n. 自觉感情
examples: She is affected with the gout.
It affects us to a great extent.
exampleZh: 她得了痛风。

defsEn: feeling fear
zh: a. 害怕的, 恐怕的, 遗憾的
examples: I'm afraid that I differ with you on this point.
He said that he was afraid it would be rainy.
exampleZh: 恐怕就这点上，我和你持不同意见。
他说他怕天会下雨。

defsEn: later
behind
zh: prep. 在...之后, 由于
conj. 在...之后
adv. 后来
examples: After you have read it, give the book back to me.
After work I go straight home.
exampleZh: 在你读完后，把书还给我。
工作之后我直接回家。

defsEn: another time
as before
zh: adv. 再一次, 又, 到原处

defsEn: opposed to
not agreeing with something
zh: prep. 反对, 对着, 倚靠
examples: It's against the rules to smoke at the office.
Discriminating against people because of their race is a mistake.
exampleZh: 在办公室吸烟违背我们的原则。
因为人的种族而歧视他们是一种错误。

defsEn: how old a person or thing is
zh: n. 年龄, 老年, 成年, 寿命, 时代, 时期
v. 变老, 成熟
examples: By what age would you like to get married?
At what age do you want to get married?
exampleZh: 你想到几岁才结婚呢？
你想到几岁才结婚呢？

defsEn: an organization that is part of a larger group (“an agency of the United Nations”)
zh: n. 代理机构, 经销商, 中介
examples: The agency is the size of a city.
The surveillance agency found him by spotting his idiolect on an Internet forum.

defsEn: an attack against a person or country
the violation of a country’s borders
zh: n. 侵犯, 侵略
examples: Aggression is a sign of fear.
Is aggression natural, or is it learned?

defsEn: of time past
before now
zh: adv. 以前
examples: Sami met Layla two Halloweens ago.

defsEn: to have the same belief as someone
to be willing to do something
zh: vi. 同意, 赞成, 应允, 适合
vt. 承认, 认定, 同意
examples: I agree with what you say to some extent.
I agree with you on this issue.
exampleZh: 在某种程度上，我认同你所说的。
我同意你对这问题的看法。

defsEn: farming
zh: n. 农业
examples: Agriculture consumes a great amount of water.
Agriculture and industry are limited due to the small size of the island.
exampleZh: 农业需要消耗大量的水。

defsEn: to help
to support
n. help, assistance
zh: n. 帮助, 外援, 助手
vt. 援助, 帮助, 有助于
vi. 帮助
examples: She aided her daughter in dressing.
I was aided by a dear friend.
exampleZh: 她帮她女儿穿好衣服。
我获得了好友的帮助。

defsEn: to point a gun at
n. a goal or purpose
zh: n. 目标, 瞄准, 击中目标的能力
vi. 对准目标, 致力, 打算
vt. 瞄准
应用接口模块, 医学人工智能, 相联索引法, 异步接口模块
自动化信息管理, 自动化综合制造, 自动化库存管理
examples: I aim to be a doctor when I grow up.
I aimed at a sparrow, but shot down a goose.
exampleZh: 我长大了想当医生。
瞄准麻雀, 击中鹅。

defsEn: the mixture of gases around the earth, mostly nitrogen and oxygen, that we breathe
zh: n. 空气, 旋律, 态度
vt. 晾, 使通风, 夸耀
examples: Air pollution will be a threat to our survival.
The air is bad here. Will you open the window?
exampleZh: 空气污染将会威胁我们的生存。
这里的空气不是很好。你可以打开窗户吗？

defsEn: a vehicle with wings that flies airplane
zh: n. 飞机
examples: The airplane took off on time.
The airplane made a safe landing.
exampleZh: 这班飞机准时起飞。
这架飞机安全着陆了。

defsEn: a place where airplanes take off and land
zh: n. 飞机场
examples: The airport is close at hand.
I went to the airport by taxi.
exampleZh: 机场很近。
我搭计程车去的机场。

defsEn: a collection of recorded music
zh: n. 粘贴簿, 唱片套
examples: There is an album on the shelf.
In this album all the sounds that you hear are really elaborate computer voices.
exampleZh: 架上放着一本相簿。
在这张专辑里, 所有你听到的声音都是用电脑精密制作出的声音。

defsEn: a strong, colorless liquid, usually made from grain, used in drinks or in industrial products
zh: n. 酒精, 酒
examples: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.
Alcohol consumption is higher in Eastern Europe than in Western Europe.
exampleZh: 酒的消费每年都在上升。
东欧的酒精消耗量比西欧高。

defsEn: having life
not dead
zh: a. 活着的, 活泼的, 敏感的, 热闹的
examples: If Tom is really alive, where is he?
Alive or dead, I'll always love you.
exampleZh: 如果汤姆真的活着，他在哪里？

defsEn: everything
everyone
the complete amount
zh: a. 所有的, 全部的, 一切的
adv. 全部, 全然
pron. 全部
n. 全部
examples: Would you all like to drink fruit juice or water?
All of his family work on a farm.
exampleZh: 各位想喝果汁还是水？
他全家都在农场工作。

defsEn: a nation or person joined with another for a special purpose
zh: n. 同盟者, 同盟国, 助手
vt. 使联盟, 使联合, 使有关系
vi. 结盟
examples: Ally loves playing with her twin sister Anne.
Are you an ally or an enemy?
exampleZh: Ally喜欢和她的双胞胎妹妹Anne一起玩。

defsEn: a little less than completely
zh: adv. 几乎, 差不多
examples: I almost always play baseball after school.
I almost never watch TV nowadays.
exampleZh: 我几乎总是在放学后打棒球。
现在我几乎不看电视。

defsEn: separated from others
zh: a. 孤独的, 单独的, 独自的
adv. 独自地
examples: You alone can do it, but you can't do it alone.
He was alone at the time.
exampleZh: 只有你一个人能做到，但你独自一个人是做不到的。
他孤身一人。

defsEn: near or on (“along the road”)
zh: adv. 平行地, 向前
prep. 沿着
examples: Are you coming along with us?
They went along the street singing the song.
exampleZh: 你要跟我们一起来吗？
他们一边唱歌一边走路。

defsEn: before now
even now
zh: adv. 已经, 早已
examples: I already want to read them.
I already know what you want!
exampleZh: 我已经想要读一读了。
我已经知道你想要什么！

defsEn: added to
too
zh: adv. 也, 并且, 同样地
examples: I also know how to cook.
We also have to cast off the evil eye from her every so often.
exampleZh: 我也会做饭。
我们也得时不时替她驱除邪眼。

defsEn: even if it is true that
zh: conj. 虽然, 尽管
examples: Although her house is nearby, I seldom see her.
Although he may be clever, he is not wise.
exampleZh: 虽然我住在她家附近，可是也很少见到她。
他只不过是有点小聪明。

defsEn: at all times
every time
zh: adv. 总是, 始终
examples: I always have a look at the newspaper before breakfast.
I always rest for an hour after dinner.
exampleZh: 我经常在早饭前看一眼报纸。
晚饭后，我总要休息一个小时。

defsEn: a nation’s highest diplomatic representative (to another government)
zh: n. 大使
examples: The English ambassador demanded to meet with the President directly.
The ambassador was recalled from Warsaw.
exampleZh: 英国大使要求直接会见总统。
大使被从华沙召回。

defsEn: to add to or to change. (a proposal or law)
zh: vt. 修改, 改善, 改良
vi. 改过自新
examples: He amended his way of living.
He made amends for his mistakes.

defsEn: the bullets or shells fired from guns
zh: n. 军火, 弹药
examples: This ammunition is much more effective.
Gustavo drove to the ammunition shop.

defsEn: in or part of (a group)
zh: prep. 在...之中
examples: She's not among the regular employees of this company.
She is among the best artists of today.
exampleZh: 她不是这间公司正式的职员。
她是现今最优秀的艺术家之一。

defsEn: the number, size or weight of anything
zh: n. 总数, 总额
vi. 总计, 等同
examples: The amount of time spent asleep can vary from person to person.
No amount of training can prepare you for this.
exampleZh: 睡眠时间的长短可因人而异。

defsEn: a lack of order
lawlessness
zh: n. 无政府状态, 政治混乱
examples: Anarchy is the mother of order.
Anarchy isn't a lack of rules; it's a lack of rulers.

defsEn: a family member from the past
zh: n. 祖先, 祖宗
examples: Our ancestor was right about delight in ancient times.
Our ancestors did not think about our fate.

defsEn: very old
long ago
zh: a. 古代的, 古老的, 年老的, 旧的
examples: Champollion deciphered the Ancient Egyptian language.
Ancient people liked to tell stories of bravery.
exampleZh: 商博良破译了古埃及语。
古人喜欢讲关于勇气的故事。

defsEn: also
in addition to
with
zh: conj. 和, 与

defsEn: a strong emotion against someone or something
zh: n. 忿怒
vt. 激怒, 使发怒
vi. 发怒
examples: Anger me again, I might just peel your skin off.
Anger is a type of madness.
exampleZh: 再惹我生气，小心我扒了你的皮！
生气是一种疯狂的形态。

defsEn: a living creature that moves, such as a dog or cat
zh: n. 动物
examples: It's the animal in me that wants it.
Animals can't distinguish between true and false.
exampleZh: 是我内在的兽性想要它。
动物没有区分真假的能力。

defsEn: a yearly celebration or observance of an event that happened in the past
zh: n. 周年纪念
examples: It's the anniversary of the end of the war.
It's an anniversary coin from my personal collection.

defsEn: to make known publicly
to declare officially
zh: vt. 宣布, 声称, 显示, 预告
vi. 当报幕员, 宣布参加竞选
examples: He announced that he would come at once and investigate the matter.
He announced his engagement to her.
exampleZh: 他宣布他将立刻来调查此事。
他宣布与她订婚。

defsEn: one more
a different one
zh: a. 另外的, 再一的, 不同的
pron. 又一个, 另一个, 类似的另一个
examples: In another two weeks you will be able to get out of the hospital.
Another war, and we will be ruined.
exampleZh: 再过两周你就可以出院了。
再来一场战争，我们就完蛋了。

defsEn: a statement produced by a question
v. to make a statement after being asked a question
zh: n. 答案, 回答, 回报, 答辩
vt. 回答, 反驳, 适应, 响应, 符合
vi. 回答, 答应, 负责, 符合, 成功
examples: He could not answer that question.
The answer leads us to a vicious circle.
exampleZh: 他无法回答这个问题。
回答把我们带入了一个恶性循环。

defsEn: special proteins produced in the blood that kill harmful bacteria
zh: n. 抗体（antibody的复数）
examples: Antibodies give a new lease of life.
Antibodies are a key part of the immune system.

defsEn: one or more of no special kind
zh: a. 任何的
pron. 任何
examples: In any event, I will do my best.
In any case, I must finish this work by tomorrow.
exampleZh: 不管怎样，我尽力。
无论如何我一定要在明天前完成这工作。

defsEn: to express regret for a mistake or accident for which one accepts responsibility
zh: vi. 道歉, 辩解
examples: I apologize for the methods used to get you here.
Pinocchio, apologize for that, or look out!
exampleZh: 我很抱歉用这种方式把你请来。
匹诺曹，快道歉，不然就小心！

defsEn: to take to a higher court, person or group for a decision
to call on somebody for help
zh: n. 恳求, 诉请, 上诉, 吸引力
vi. 呼吁, 诉请, 要求, 上诉, 有吸引力
vt. 将...上诉
examples: We made an appeal for support.
Tom appealed to his mother to buy a new toy for him.
exampleZh: 我们提出了请求支持的呼吁。
汤姆请求妈妈给他买新玩具。

defsEn: to show oneself
to come into sight
to seem
zh: vi. 出现, 显得, 来到
examples: Why would you appear in my unit?
There appears to be a party in that house.
exampleZh: 你为什么会出现在我工作单位？
这房子里似乎在办派对。

defsEn: to name
to choose. (“appoint a judge”)
zh: vt. 任命, 指定, 下令
examples: They appointed him as a director.
He was appointed ambassador to Britain.
exampleZh: 他们任命他为经理。
他被任命为驻英国大使。

defsEn: to agree with
to agree to support
zh: vt. 赞同, 核准, 为...提供证据
vi. 赞许
examples: I cannot approve of your going out with him.
I don't approve of his conduct.
exampleZh: 我不能让你和他出去。
我不认可他的行为。

defsEn: the scientific study of past human life and activities
zh: 考古学
examples: Archeology is the science that studies the remnants of human civilization.
Archeology reveals the secrets of the past.

defsEn: any place or part of it
zh: n. 区域, 面积, 范围, 空地
examples: This area is still underdeveloped because of a lack of interest from the government.
This area is famous for its handcraft business.
exampleZh: 因为缺乏的政府的关注，这个区域还不发达。
该地区因它的手工业而出名。

defsEn: to offer reasons for or against something
to dispute
to disagree
zh: vi. 提出理由, 争论, 辩论
vt. 主张, 辩论, 证明, 说服
examples: Tom and Mary argue with each other all the time.
I argued with Yoko a little bit.
exampleZh: 汤姆和玛丽无时无刻不在辩论。
我和洋子有了一点争执。

defsEn: military equipment
weapons
zh: n. 武器, 军事行动
examples: He slid his arms around her and kissed her.
When I'm in his arms, I feel good.
exampleZh: 他垂下手臂环绕住她然后亲吻。

defsEn: military ground forces
zh: n. 军队, 陆军
examples: An army marches on its stomach.
The army forced him to resign.
exampleZh: 胃里如同千军万马开过。
军队强迫他辞职。

defsEn: on every side (of)
zh: prep. 包围, 在...周围, 四处
adv. 兜着圈子, 在附近, 到处
examples: It was around noon when he reached the town.
As we went around the corner, the lake came into view.
exampleZh: 他中午时分才抵达小镇。
当我们走到转角处，湖就映入了眼帘。

defsEn: to seize a person for legal action
to take as a prisoner
zh: n. 逮捕, 监禁
vt. 拘捕, 抑制, 吸引, 阻止
examples: She was arrested by the police.
Tom was arrested for driving without a licence.
exampleZh: 她被警方逮捕了。
汤姆因无证驾驶而被逮捕。

defsEn: to come to a place, especially at the end of a trip
zh: vi. 到达, 抵达
examples: We arrived to find a huge meal ready for us.
When you arrive in Osaka, please contact me.
exampleZh: 我们到达后发现一顿大餐已经为我们准备好了。
你来到大坂的时候请跟我联络。

defsEn: expressions or creations by humans, such as paintings, music, writing or statues art
zh: n. 艺术, 人文科学, 技术, 巧妙, 诡计, 美术
examples: I took an art class last year.
His martial arts prowess has already reached a level of sublime perfection.
exampleZh: 我去年上了一堂艺术课。
他的武功已经达到了出神入化的境界。

defsEn: big guns
zh: n. 火炮, 炮兵, 炮术
examples: The artillery is placed in a clearing.
A volley of artillery fire completely destroyed the buildings.

defsEn: equally (“as fast as”)
when
while
zh: adv. 同样地, 例如
prep. 做为, 当作
conj. 当...之时, 以...的方式, 像...一样, 因为

defsEn: the part left after something burns
zh: n. 灰, 灰烬
examples: He shook the ash from the cigarette out of the car.
The volcanic ash brought air traffic to a halt.

defsEn: to question
to say something is wanted (“We ask the teacher questions every day.”)
zh: vi. 问, 要求
vt. 问, 要求, 邀请, 需要
examples: I asked the boy to throw the ball back.
She asked me to continue writing to your father.
exampleZh: 我请这个男孩把球扔回来。
她叫我继续写信给你的父亲。

defsEn: to help
zh: n. 帮助, 协助
vt. 帮助, 促进
vi. 协助, 参加
examples: If you could assist me, it would be a great help.
Could you assist with the operation?

defsEn: a person who travels in space
zh: n. 太空旅行者, 宇航员
examples: The astronaut found an intelligent organism.
An astronaut can float in space.

defsEn: the scientific study of stars and the universe astronaut
zh: n. 天文学
examples: Astronomy is at the same time the most ancient and the most modern science.
Astronomy involves the study of stars and planets.
exampleZh: 天文学同时是最古老也最现代的科学。
天文学涉及恒星和行星的研究。

defsEn: political protection given by a government to a person from another country
zh: n. 庇护, 收容所
examples: They built an asylum for the blind.
The asylum seeker was finally able to speak to a lawyer.

defsEn: in or near (“at the edge”)
where (“look at”)
when (“at noon”)
zh: prep. 在, 向, 对

defsEn: the gases surrounding any star or planet
zh: n. 大气, 空气, 气氛
examples: The atmosphere is always extremely lively when eating hot pot.
The atmosphere is much better today than yesterday.
exampleZh: 吃火锅的时候 ,气氛往往是非常热闹的.

defsEn: a very small part of all things
the smallest part of an element that can join with parts of other elements
zh: n. 原子, 核能, 微粒, 微量
examples: The atom bomb is an awful weapon.
In the atom, in the cell, in the cosmos, Transcendent Intelligence is perceptible.

defsEn: to tie together
to connect
zh: vt. 附上, 使依附, 使附属, 使喜爱, 系, 缚
vi. 附属, 归属, 联系在一起
examples: I attached my signature to the document.
I attached my name-tag to my baggage, but it soon came off.
exampleZh: 我签署了文件。
我在我的行李上附上了有我名字的标签, 但是它很快就剥落了。

defsEn: a violent attempt to damage, injure or kill
v. to start a fight
zh: n. 攻击, 抨击
vt. 攻击, 抨击, 动手干
vi. 攻击
examples: Attack is the best form of defense.
We were attacked from both sides.
exampleZh: 进攻是最好的防御。
我们被两面夹击了。

defsEn: to work toward something
to try
to make an effort
zh: n. 尝试, 企图
vt. 尝试, 企图
examples: What would you attempt to do if you knew you could not fail?
They attempted to break through the enemy line.
exampleZh: 如果你有一次绝对不会失败的机会，你会选择做什么事情呢？
他们试图冲破敌军防线。

defsEn: to be present at
zh: vt. 参加, 照料, 伴随
vi. 专心于, 照顾, 服侍, 出席
examples: Tom and I attend the same secondary school.
I attend the same secondary school as Tom.
exampleZh: 我和汤姆上同一所中学。
我和汤姆上同一所中学。

defsEn: close or careful observing of, or listening to, someone or something (“The student paid attention to his teacher.”)
zh: n. 注意, 注意力
examples: She paid no attention to him.
He paid no attention to her.
exampleZh: 她没有注意他。
他没有注意她。

defsEn: a vehicle with wheels used to carry people
a car
zh: n. 汽车
examples: Automobile sales suffered a setback at the end of the financial year.
The automobile is of great use in our life.

defsEn: the time of the year between summer and winter
zh: n. 秋天, 成熟期
examples: In autumn, some animals store food away for the winter.
In the autumn, swallows will fly south.
exampleZh: 有些动物会在秋天为冬季储藏食物。
秋天的时候，燕子会往南飞。

defsEn: present and ready for use
willing to serve or help. (“There was a list of available candidates.”)
zh: a. 可利用的, 可获得的, 有效的
examples: Sir, that CD is available only by special order.
He wouldn't be available until four.
exampleZh: 先生，那盘CD需要预定才有。
他到了四时以后才有空。

defsEn: something (a number) representing the middle
ad. common
normal
zh: n. 平均, 平均数, 一般水平, 海损
a. 平均的, 中等的, 平常的
vt. 算出...平均数, 平均做, 均分, 使平衡
vi. 平均为, 呈中间色
examples: On average, I watch two films a month.
What is the average height of the players?
exampleZh: 我平均每月看两部电影。
选手们的平均身高是多少？

defsEn: to stay away from
zh: vt. 避免, 防止, 撤消
examples: Avoid sudden movements around the rabbit, they can startle them.
So as to avoid being late, we went by car.
exampleZh: 避免在兔子旁边突然做出动作，以免吓到牠们。
我们乘车去以免迟到

defsEn: not sleeping
zh: a. 醒着的
vt. 唤醒, 唤起, 使意识到
vi. 醒来, 被唤起, 意识到
examples: I've been awake for a while.
Being awake is the opposite of being asleep.
exampleZh: 我已经醒了一会儿了。

defsEn: an honor or prize for an act or service
zh: n. 奖品, 裁定, 判决
vt. 授予, 给予
examples: They awarded her first prize at the art exhibition.
He was awarded a grant to study in Germany.
exampleZh: 他们在画展上授予了她一等奖。
他获得了一份去德国留学的奖学金。

defsEn: not near
zh: adv. 离去
examples: He ran away with the money.
I ran away in a hurry.
exampleZh: 他携款潜逃。
我赶快跑走了。

defsEn: a newly born creature
zh: n. 婴孩
examples: The baby fell asleep in the cradle.
The baby seemed to be in a deep sleep.
exampleZh: 宝宝在摇篮里入睡了。
那个婴儿似乎在熟睡中。

defsEn: the part behind the front
ad. the other way from forward
zh: a. 后面的
vt. 使后退, 支持
vi. 倒退, 背靠
adv. 向后地
n. 背部, 后面
examples: She said that she had to be back before dawn.
I came back home to eat a meal.
exampleZh: 她说她黄昏之前必须回来。
我走回家来吃饭。

defsEn: living things that are one cell and can be seen only through a microscope
some cause disease
zh: pl. 细菌
examples: Bacteria are so small that they cannot be seen with the naked eye.
Bacteria do not reproduce in alcohol.
exampleZh: 细菌微小到无法用肉眼看到。

defsEn: wrong
acting against the law
not good
zh: a. 坏的
n. 坏
adv. 坏地
examples: I made a bad mistake on the test.
I had a bad dream last night.
exampleZh: 考试的时候我犯了很严重的错误。
我昨晚做了一个恶梦。

defsEn: to make two sides or forces equal
zh: n. 平衡, 差额
vi. 平衡, 相等
vt. 称, 权衡, 比较, 使平衡, 结算, 抵消
examples: The balance of public opinion remains in his favor.
He lost his balance and fell off his bicycle.
exampleZh: 公众意见的平衡仍是他的关切。
他失去了平衡，从自行车上摔了下来。

defsEn: something round ball
zh: n. 球, 舞会, 球状物
v. 捏成球形
examples: This ball is the treasure of that boy.
He threw the ball against the wall.
exampleZh: 这个球是那个男孩的宝贝。
他把球掷向墙上。

defsEn: a device of strong, light material that rises when filled with gas lighter than air
zh: n. 气球
vt. 使成气球状
vi. 膨胀如气球, 激增
examples: The balloon was caught in the tree.
The balloon burst with a loud noise.
exampleZh: 这颗气球被树绊住了。

defsEn: a piece of paper used for voting
zh: n. 投票, 投票用纸, 抽签
vi. 投票, 抽签
vt. 投票选出, 拉选票
examples: The ballot paper must be put into an envelope.

defsEn: to not permit
to stop
n. an official restriction
zh: n. 禁令
vt. 禁止, 取缔
examples: There's a band at my school.
The band will play their latest song for you now. Take it away, guys!
exampleZh: 我的学校里有个乐队。
乐团现在将为大家演奏他们的最新歌曲。开始吧，伙计们！

defsEn: an organization that keeps and lends money
zh: n. 银行, 堤, 岸
examples: There is a bank in front of the station.
There's a bank in front of the station.
exampleZh: 车站前有个银行。
车站前有个银行。

defsEn: to prevent or block
zh: n. 条, 棒, 酒吧, 栅, 障碍物
vt. 禁止, 阻挡, 妨碍
examples: I bared my soul to her.
They're at the bar drinking beer.
exampleZh: 我跟她说了心里话。
他们在酒吧喝酒。

defsEn: anything that blocks or makes an action difficult
zh: n. 障碍, 栅栏
examples: There is no barrier between both of us.
There is no barrier between us both.

defsEn: a military center
v. to establish as a fact (“Her research was based on experiments.”)
zh: n. 底部, 垒, 基础, 基地
vt. 以...作基础
a. 卑鄙的, 低劣的
examples: He based his report on the available statistics.
This base is now under our control.

defsEn: a fight between opposing armed forces
zh: n. 战役
v. 战斗
examples: My battles make me who I am.
This battle left Napoleon master of Europe.
exampleZh: 风风雨雨造就了我。
这场战役让拿破仑称霸了整个欧洲。

defsEn: to live
to happen
to exist
zh: v. 是, 表示, 在

defsEn: to hit again and again
zh: n. 心跳(声), 打, 敲打声, 拍子
v. 打, 拍打, 打败
a. 疲乏的, 颓废的
beat的过去式
examples: We beat about for a solution to the problem.
She beat him to death with a golf club.

defsEn: that which pleases the eye, ear or spirit
zh: n. 美, 美人
examples: Her beauty will fade in time.
The beauty of that country is beyond description.
exampleZh: 她的美貌会随着时间而流逝。
那个国家的美是语言无法形容的。

defsEn: for the reason that (“He left because he was sick.”)
zh: conj. 因为
examples: Because of his wealth, he was able to become a member of that club.
Because of the storm, we had no choice but to stay at home.
exampleZh: 由于他的财富，他能够成为这个具乐部的成员。
因为暴风雨的关系，所以我们必须待在家里。

defsEn: to come to be
zh: vi. 变成, 变得
vt. 适合
examples: How did you become a police officer?
What has become of her son?
exampleZh: 你是怎么成为一名警察的？
她儿子怎么样了？

defsEn: a sleeping place
zh: n. 床, 睡眠处, 河床, 底座, 路基, 一层
vt. 提供宿处, 栽种, 安装
vi. 睡, 形成坚实的一层
examples: Which bed do you want to use?
The bed took up a lot of space.
exampleZh: 你想睡哪张床?
床占了很多空间。

defsEn: earlier
zh: prep. 在...之前
conj. 在...之前
adv. 在前
examples: Before I leave, I would like to see you.
As I told you before, you have to do that by yourself.
exampleZh: 离开之前，我想见见你。
我之前跟你说过，那个你必须自己做。

defsEn: to do the first part of an action
to start
zh: v. 开始
examples: If we begin early, we can finish by lunch.
To begin with, we must tackle the problem.
exampleZh: 如果我们早点开始的话，就能在午饭时间之前完成。
首先我们必须处理这个问题。

defsEn: the way in which a person or animal acts (“The child’s behavior was bad because he fought with other children.”)
zh: 作，行为；性能，特性，品质；状态，工况，运行情况
examples: This behavior shows a lack of respect for the performance.
His behavior never ceases to surprise me.
exampleZh: 这种行为是对演出的不尊重。
他的所作所为总是让我惊讶。

defsEn: at the back of
in back of
zh: adv. 在后地
prep. 在...背后
examples: Why are we so behind on this?
He hid it behind the door.
exampleZh: 为什么我们进度这么落后?
他把它藏在了门后。

defsEn: to think
to feel sure of
to accept as true
to trust
zh: v. 相信
examples: I believe it my duty to protect these children.
I believe the medium size will fit you better.
exampleZh: 我认为我有义务保护这些孩子。
我认为中号会更适合您。

defsEn: to be owned by
to be a member of
zh: vi. 属于, 合适
examples: I belong to the drama club.
I belong to a tennis club.
exampleZh: 我参加戏剧社。
我是网球具乐部的会员。

defsEn: lower than
zh: prep. 在下面
adv. 在下面
examples: It's below her to say such a thing.
It was below zero at the time.

defsEn: the most good
zh: a. 最好的
adv. 最好地
n. 最好的人
examples: At best he may take third place.
It's best to stay in than to go out in that weather.
exampleZh: 他最多能拿到第三名。
这种天气下最好待在家里不要外出。

defsEn: to turn against
to be false to
zh: vt. 出卖, 背叛, 辜负, 暴露
examples: He betrayed her secret to his friends.
He betrayed his friends for money.
exampleZh: 他把她的秘密告诉了他的朋友。
他为了钱背叛了他的朋友们。

defsEn: more good than
zh: a. 较好的
adv. 比较好
examples: It would be better if you would eat more.
It would be better for you to stay in bed today.
exampleZh: 如果你吃的多一点，你将会比现在好一点
你最好今天待在家休息。

defsEn: in the space or time that separates
from one to the other (“talks between two nations”)
zh: prep. 在...之间
examples: Between you and me, the fat ugly man is on a diet.
Between you and me, he has a shallow way of thinking.
exampleZh: 那个丑男人在节食，这个我们知道就好。
他思考的方式缺乏深度，这个我们知道就好。

defsEn: of great size
not small
zh: a. 大的, 重要的
adv. 大量地
examples: A big tree fell during the storm.
A big tree fell in the storm.
exampleZh: 一棵大树在风暴中倒下了。
一棵大树在暴风中倒下。

defsEn: a legislative proposal
zh: n. 帐单, 清单, 钞票, 鸟嘴, 广告, 法案, 票据
vt. 开帐单, (用招贴)宣布
examples: The bill will never go through.
Bill got up early in order that he might catch the first train.
exampleZh: 该法案将永远不会通过。
为了能够赶上第一班火车, 比尔很早就起床了。

defsEn: the scientific study of life or living things in all their forms
zh: n. 生物学
examples: I got into biology because of my partner.
In biology, there is no third sex.

defsEn: a creature that flies
zh: n. 鸟, 羽毛球
vi. 打鸟
examples: A bird in the hand is better than two in the bush.
A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
exampleZh: 一鸟在手胜过二鸟在林。
一鸟在手胜过二鸟在林。

defsEn: to cut with the teeth
zh: n. 咬, 一口
v. 咬, 刺痛, 穿透
examples: If you bite me, then I'll bite you, too.
If you bite me, I'll bite you back.
exampleZh: 你如果咬我，我也要咬你。
如果你咬我，我就咬回来。

defsEn: dark
having the color like that of the night sky
zh: n. 黑色, 黑颜料
a. 黑色的
examples: The black telephone costs more than the white.
It's written in black and white. How can you be in doubt?
exampleZh: 黑的电话比白的花钱多。
这是白纸黑字写在这儿的你怎么还怀疑？

defsEn: to accuse
to hold responsible
zh: n. 过失, 责备
vt. 责备, 归咎于
examples: Who is to blame for the accident?
He is to blame for the failure.
exampleZh: 谁该为这次事故负责？
失败的责任在他。

defsEn: to lose blood
zh: vi. 流血, 悲痛, 渗出
vt. 使出血, 榨取
examples: I bleed when I make love.
You're bleeding everywhere; I'll help you up.
exampleZh: 我性交的时候会出血。
你看都出血了，我扶你起来吧。

defsEn: not able to see
zh: n. 蒙蔽物, 窗帘
a. 盲目的, 瞎的, 不加思考的
vt. 使失明, 蒙蔽, 遮暗
adv. 盲目地
examples: I am blind in the right eye.
I'm blind in the right eye.
exampleZh: 我的右眼瞎了。
我的右眼瞎了。

defsEn: to stop something from being done
to prevent movement
zh: n. 街区, 木块, 石块, 块
vt. 阻塞, 封锁, 使成块状
examples: They block you, and you can do nothing about that.
They blocked the flow of water from the burst pipe.

defsEn: red fluid in the body
zh: n. 血, 血统, 流血, 气质, 生命
vt. 使出血, 用血涂
examples: It made my blood boil to hear that.
We gave blood to help the child.
exampleZh: 听到这个让我感觉热血沸腾。
我们捐血来帮助这个孩子。

defsEn: to move with force, as in air (“The wind blows.”)
zh: n. 吹, 打击, 殴打, 花开
v. 吹, 风吹, 吹响, 开花
examples: Blow out all the candles on the birthday cake at once.
A blizzard was blowing that day, and the snow was falling heavily.
exampleZh: 一口气吹灭生日蛋糕上所有的蜡烛。
这天刮着暴风雪，雪下得很大。

defsEn: having the color like that of a clear sky
zh: n. 蓝色
a. 蓝色的, 下流的, 忧郁的
vt. 染成蓝色
vi. 变蓝
examples: Her blue shoes go well with that skirt.
My blue dress appeared with a blood stain.
exampleZh: 她那双蓝鞋子和这个裙子很搭配。
我的蓝色洋装上出现了血迹。

defsEn: something built to travel on water that carries people or goods
zh: n. 船
vi. 乘船
vt. 以船运
examples: A boat suddenly appeared out of the mist.
The boat passed under the bridge.
exampleZh: 一艘船突然从雾中出现。
船从桥下通过。

defsEn: all of a person or animal
the remains of a person or animal
zh: n. 身体, 人, 尸体, 主要部分, 团体
vt. 赋以形体
examples: There's a body in the trunk of the car.
Your body was always very healthy; why are you suddenly in the hospital?
exampleZh: 后备箱内有具尸体。
你身体一直非常好，怎么突然间住医院了？

defsEn: to heat a liquid until it becomes very hot
zh: n. 煮沸, 沸腾, 疖
v. 煮沸, 激动
examples: I'll boil the potatoes for you.
Boiling water evaporates and turns into a gas.
exampleZh: 我为你煮马铃薯。
沸水蒸发成气体。

defsEn: a device that explodes with great force
v. to attack or destroy with bombs
zh: n. 炸弹
vt. 轰炸, 投弹于
vi. 失败
examples: This bomb can kill a lot of people.
This bomb can kill many people.
exampleZh: 这个炸弹可以炸死很多人。
这个炸弹可以炸死很多人。

defsEn: the hard material in the body
zh: n. 骨头, 骨, 骨制品
vt. 剔骨
vi. 专心致志
examples: He is bone of my bone, flesh of my flesh.
She gave a bone to the dog.

defsEn: a long written work for reading book
zh: n. 书, 书籍, 帐簿, 名册, 工作簿
v. 登记, 预订
examples: This book will be of great use to us.
This book will be of great use to you.
exampleZh: 这本书会对我们有很大用处。
这本书会对你有很大的用处。

defsEn: a dividing line between nations
zh: n. 边缘, 边境, 边界, 花坛
vt. 在...上镶边, 接近
vi. 接界, 近似
examples: On the border, there is a stretch of agricultural land.
California and Nevada border on each other.
exampleZh: 边境上有一片农业区。
加利福尼亚州和内华达州相互接界。

defsEn: to come to life
to come into existence
zh: a. 天生的
bear的过去分词
examples: He was born in this very room.
He who is born for a dime, will never be worth a quarter.
exampleZh: 他就是在这间屋子里出生的。
出生是一分钱，永远不会变成一角钱。

defsEn: to take as a loan
zh: vt. 借, 借入, 借用
vi. 借
examples: Could I borrow your gray suit?
He borrowed money from the bank in order to buy a car.
exampleZh: 我可以借你的灰色西装吗？
他为了买车向银行借款。

defsEn: not just one of two, but the two together
zh: a. 两者的
adv. 两者都
pron. 两者
examples: They both fell in love with the same man.
They both fell in love with the same woman.
exampleZh: 她们俩同时爱上了同一个男人。
他们俩爱上了同一个女的。

defsEn: a container, usually made of glass, to hold liquid
zh: n. 瓶子, 酒瓶
vt. 装瓶, 抑制, 围困
examples: A bottle of red wine, please.
There's a bottle of white wine in the refrigerator.
exampleZh: 请来瓶红酒。
冰箱里有一瓶白葡萄酒。

defsEn: the lowest part of something
zh: n. 底部
a. 底部的
vt. 给...装底, 查明真相
vi. 到达底部, 建立基础
examples: He took off the bottom piece of his pyjamas while remaining in his underwear.
At the bottom of my garden grows a tree.

defsEn: something to put things into
a container, usually made of paper or wood
zh: n. 盒子, 箱, 方框, 一巴掌
vt. 装...入盒中, 装箱, 打耳光
vi. 拳击
examples: This box is not as big as that one.
There's a box at the door.
exampleZh: 这个盒子没那个盒子大。
门口有一个纸箱。

defsEn: a young male person
zh: n. 男孩
examples: As a boy, I used to swim in the pond.
That boy used to drop in on me.
exampleZh: 我还是个小男孩时常去池塘游泳。
那男孩儿来访过我家。

defsEn: to refuse to take part in or deal with
zh: n. 联合抵制
vt. 联合抵制
examples: The boycott lasted a little more than a year.
The boycott lasted little more than a year.

defsEn: the control center of thought, emotions and body activity of all creatures
zh: n. 脑
vt. 打碎脑部
examples: The brain is just a complicated machine.
His brain is still very active.
exampleZh: 大脑只是个复杂的机器。
他的大脑仍然很活跃。

defsEn: having no fear
zh: a. 勇敢的, 美好的, 华丽的
n. 勇敢者
vt. 勇敢地面对
examples: His brave deed earned him respect.
John is brave in appearance, but is in reality a coward.
exampleZh: 他的英勇行为使他赢得了尊重。
约翰看起来很勇敢，但其实是个胆小鬼。

defsEn: a food made from grain
zh: n. 面包, 生计, 食物
vt. 裹以面包屑
examples: I ate bread and butter this morning.
Bread is made from flour, water, and often yeast.
exampleZh: 今天早上，我吃了面包夹黄油。
面包是用面粉和水做的，有时还会加入发酵粉。

defsEn: to divide into parts by force
to destroy
zh: n. 休息, 中断, 破裂处, 绝交, 破晓, 突变
vt. 打破, 弄破, 弄坏, 破坏, 违反, 打断, 削弱, 放弃
vi. 破碎, 决裂, 破晓, 突变, 变弱, 暂停
n. 分隔符
examples: You are not to break the law.
When did she break the window?
exampleZh: 你不许犯法。
她什么时候打破了窗户？

defsEn: to take air into the body and let it out again
zh: vi. 呼吸, 生存, 低语
vt. 呼吸, 使喘息, 发散, 低声说
examples: Breathe through your nose, not your mouth.
We breathe, eat, and speak with our mouth.
exampleZh: 你不要用嘴呼吸，用鼻呼吸。

defsEn: a structure built over a waterway, valley or road so people and vehicles can cross from one side to the other bridge
zh: n. 桥, 舰桥, 桥梁, 桥牌
vt. 架桥于, 跨越
examples: The bridge will be completed by the end of this year.
The bridge saved us a lot of time.
exampleZh: 大桥将在年底完工。
那条桥为我们节省了不少时间。

defsEn: short
not long
zh: n. 摘要, 简报
a. 简短的, 短暂的
vt. 对...作简报, 摘要, 节录
examples: In brief, I need money. Please lend it to me!
Be brief and direct in your speech.

defsEn: giving much light
strong and clear in color
zh: a. 明亮的, 聪明的, 鲜明的, 欢快的
adv. 明亮地, 欢快地
examples: Bright ideas never occur to me.
Edison was not a bright student.
exampleZh: 我总想不出什么好点子。
爱迪生不是个优秀的学生。

defsEn: to come with something
zh: vt. 带来, 产生, 促使, 提出
vi. 生产
examples: Bring me a glass of tea with lemon.
Bring me a sheet of paper, please.
exampleZh: 给我泡杯柠檬茶。
请带一张纸给我。

defsEn: to send information, stories or music by radio or television
n. a radio or television program
zh: n. 广播, 传播
a. 广播的
v. 广播
adv. 经广播, 四散地
examples: We broadcast news on the hour.
He broadcast the fact that he had won the lottery.
exampleZh: 我们正点播报新闻。

defsEn: a male with the same father or mother as another person
zh: n. 兄弟
examples: My brother will often sit up all night.
My brother can drive a car.
exampleZh: 我弟弟会经常彻夜不睡。
我哥哥会开车。

defsEn: having the color like that of coffee
zh: n. 褐色
a. 褐色的
v. (使)变褐色
examples: Mr. Brown, a friend from Oregon, will visit us tomorrow.
She was a Brown before her marriage.
exampleZh: 一个从俄勒冈州来的朋友，布朗先生明天会来拜访我们。
她婚前是布朗家的。

defsEn: a spending plan
zh: n. 预算
vi. 编预算
vt. 编入预算, 安排
a. 廉价的
examples: A budget deficit will occur because of a revenue shortfall.
The budget is bound to fluctuate due to the economy.

defsEn: to join materials together to make something
zh: v. 建立, 建筑
n. 构造, 体格
examples: Building a new house cost a lot of money.
The building on the hill is our school.
exampleZh: 建新家花了很多钱。
山上的那栋建筑物就是我们的学校了。

defsEn: anything built for use as a house, factory, office, school, store or place of entertainment
zh: n. 建筑物, 建筑
examples: The buildings shook in the earthquake.
The buildings look pretty ragged now, but they still have charm.
exampleZh: 建筑物在地震中摇晃。

defsEn: a small piece of metal shot from a gun
zh: n. 子弹
examples: He had three bullet wounds in his chest.
The bullet hit him in the back.
exampleZh: 他胸口中了三枪。

defsEn: to be on fire
to destroy or damage by fire
zh: vt. 烧, 烧毁, 烧伤
vi. 燃烧, 发热, 烧毁
n. 烧伤, 烙印
examples: Burn this letter after you finish reading it.
Burn that bridge when one comes to it.
exampleZh: 看完这封信请把它烧掉。
过河拆桥。

defsEn: to break open suddenly
zh: n. 破裂, 突发, 爆发
v. 爆裂, 突发, 充满
examples: He burst a blood vessel in the brain.
They burst out into a storm of abuse.

defsEn: to put into the ground and cover with earth
zh: vt. 埋葬, 埋藏
examples: They buried him in the graveyard by the church.
They were buried in a mass grave.
exampleZh: 他们把他埋葬在教堂旁的墓园。
他们被埋在一座大坟墓里。

defsEn: a public vehicle to carry people
zh: n. 公共汽车
examples: When in a bus, I always sit at the front.
This bus will take you to the museum.
exampleZh: 在巴士里，我总是坐在前面。
这辆公车会载你去博物馆。

defsEn: one’s work
buying and selling to earn money
trade
zh: n. 生意, 事情, 业务, 商业, 商行, 职责
examples: It is your business to take care of them.
The business is in the red.
exampleZh: 照顾他们是你自己的事儿。
这场生意正面临着赤字。

defsEn: doing something
very active
zh: a. 忙碌的, 热闹的, 没空的
vt. 使忙
vi. 忙碌
examples: If you're not busy, could you please help me?
If I am busy then I may arrive late.
exampleZh: 你要是不忙的话可以帮我吗？
要是我很忙，我可能就会迟到。

defsEn: however
other than
yet
zh: prep. 除了
conj. 但是
adv. 仅仅

defsEn: to get by paying something, usually money
zh: vt. 买, 获得
vi. 买
n. 购买, 买得的东西
examples: Buy some milk on your way home.
Buy milk on your way home.
exampleZh: 回来的路上买点牛奶。
回来的路上买点牛奶。

defsEn: near
at
next to (“by the road”)
from (“a play by William Shakespeare”)
not later than (“by midnight”)
zh: prep. 被, 经, 由, 在...之旁
adv. 经过, 在近处

defsEn: a group of ministers that helps lead a government
zh: n. 橱柜, 内阁
a. 内阁的, 细木工做的
examples: The tablecloth is in the cabinet.
The cabinet asked the army to send a disaster relief mission to Okinawa.
exampleZh: 桌布在橱柜里。

defsEn: to give a name to (“I call myself John.”)
to ask for or request (“They called for an end to the fighting.”)
zh: n. 呼叫, 访问, 打电话, 号召, 召集, 要求
vt. 呼叫, 召集, 打电话
vi. 叫喊, 访问, 叫牌
examples: Could you call me back a bit later?
I call on him every other day.
exampleZh: 你可以稍后回电给我吗?
我每隔一天拜访他。

defsEn: quiet
peaceful
opposite tense
zh: n. 平稳, 风平浪静
a. 平静的, 冷静的
vi. 平静下来, 镇静
vt. 使平静
examples: Calm down, and listen to me speak from the beginning.
Calm down and explain it from the beginning.
exampleZh: 你们冷静下来，从头开始跟我说。
你冷静下来，从头开始跟我说。

defsEn: a device for taking pictures
zh: n. 照相机, 摄影机, 密谈室, 暗箱
examples: My camera can shoot high-definition video.
Your camera is only half the size of mine.
exampleZh: 我的录像机可以拍高清视频。
你的照相机只有我那台的一半大小。

defsEn: a place with temporary housing camera
zh: n. 露营, 帐篷
vi. 露营, 扎营
vt. 使扎营
examples: I went camping with my family.
The camp counselors are supposed to provide guidance and mentorship to the students.
exampleZh: 我和家人去露营。
营辅员应负责为学生提供指引和辅导。

defsEn: a competition by opposing political candidates seeking support from voters
a connected series of military actions during a war
zh: n. 战役, 运动, 竞选运动
vi. 参加运动, 作战
examples: It is a campaign to encourage young people to vote.
The campaign seems to be going like a bomb.

defsEn: to be able to
to have the right to
n. a container used to hold liquid or food, usually made of metal
zh: vt. 装罐
n. 罐头, 容器
aux. 能, 可以
examples: Can I get to know you for a bit?
Can you give me a pillow and a blanket?
exampleZh: 我能认识一下你吗？
给我一个枕头和毛毯好吗？

defsEn: to end
to stop
zh: n. 取消, 撤消, 盖销(邮票)
vt. 取消, 删去, 抵销, 盖销
vi. 相互抵销
examples: He canceled the appointment at the last moment.
I had to cancel the order because we didn't have enough money.
exampleZh: 他到了最后的一刻才取消了约会。
我们的钱不够，所以我只好把订单取消了。

defsEn: a disease in which dangerous cells grow quickly and destroy parts of the body
zh: n. 癌, 恶性肿瘤
examples: The cancer has spread to her stomach.
Cancer is a great enemy of humanity.
exampleZh: 癌细胞已经扩散到她的胃。
癌症是人类的大敌。

defsEn: a person who seeks or is nominated for an office or an honor
zh: n. 候选人, 投考者
examples: He was the strongest candidate for the position.
Which candidate do you like most?
exampleZh: 他是那个职位最有希望的候选人。

defsEn: the official center of a government
the city where a country’s government is
zh: n. 首都, 大写字母, 资本
a. 首都的, 重要的
examples: A capital letter is used at the beginning of a sentence.
What is the capital of France?
exampleZh: 一个句子以一个大写字母开始。
法国的首都是哪里？

defsEn: to make a person or animal a prisoner
to seize or take by force
to get control of
zh: 袭夺
examples: They would capture as many people as possible.
The hunters captured the wild animal with a strong rope net.
exampleZh: 他们会尽可能地抓更多的人。
猎人们用坚韧的绳网把野生动物捉住了。

defsEn: a vehicle with wheels used to carry people
an automobile
a part of a train
zh: n. 汽车, 客车
examples: This car came to a stop in front of the bank.
This car pulled up in front of the bank.
exampleZh: 这辆车在银行前面停下来了。
这辆车在银行前面停下来了。

defsEn: to like
to protect
to feel worry or interest
zh: n. 小心, 照料, 忧虑
vi. 关心, 介意
vt. 在意, 喜欢
examples: Would you care for a cup of tea?
Would you care for another cup of coffee?
exampleZh: 你想不想喝点儿茶？
再来一杯咖啡怎么样？

defsEn: a chosen profession
a person’s working life (“The actor’s career lasted for thirty years.”)
zh: n. 事业, 生涯, 成功
examples: She is certainly a career woman.
Which career do you truly wish to pursue?
exampleZh: 她真是个女强人。

defsEn: acting safely
with much thought
zh: a. 小心的, 谨慎的
examples: Be careful when working with a hoe.
Be careful not to catch a cold.
exampleZh: 用锄头的时候小心一些
小心着凉啊！

defsEn: to take something or someone from one place to another
zh: n. 进位, 射程, 运载
vt. 携带, 运送, 支持, 传送, 包含
vi. 被携带, 能达到
examples: Would you carry my luggage upstairs?
He carried off the first prize at the chess tournament.
exampleZh: 你可以把我的行李拿到楼上吗?
他在国际象棋比赛中取得了冠军。

defsEn: a legal action
zh: n. 情形, 情况, 箱, 容器, 事实, 病例, 案例, 框子
vt. 装箱, 包盖
examples: In case of fire, do not use the lift.
In that case, I think you should come in today.
exampleZh: 如有火警，切勿使用升降机。
在这种情况下，我认为你今天应该来。

defsEn: a small animal that often lives with humans
zh: n. 猫, 恶妇
vi. 呕吐
计算机辅助教育, 计算机辅助测试, 计算机辅助翻译, 计算机辅助排版
examples: This cat here is almost as fat as that one.
Is the cat on the chair or under the chair?
exampleZh: 这里这只猫跟那里那只差不多一样灵敏。
猫在椅子上面，还是在椅子下面呢？

defsEn: to seize after a chase
to stop and seize with the hands
zh: 捕获量；渔获量
examples: He ran to catch up to his brother.
You'll catch cold in such thin clothing.
exampleZh: 他跑着追上他哥哥。
穿那么薄会感冒的。

defsEn: to make happen
n. the thing or person that produces a result
zh: n. 原因, 目标
vt. 引起, 使产生, 使遭受
examples: The cause of his death still remains a mystery.
The cause of this fire was a microwave oven.
exampleZh: 他的死因仍然是一个谜。
这场火灾的起因是一个微波炉。

defsEn: a halt in fighting, usually by agreement
zh: n. （通常指永久性的）停火, 停战; 停火命令
examples: A ceasefire began a few hours later.
It's not a ceasefire if you didn't stop firing.

defsEn: to honor a person or event with special activities
zh: v. 庆祝, 祝贺, 举行
examples: In China, they celebrate New Year by the lunar calendar.
How did you celebrate your birthday?
exampleZh: 中国按阴历过新年。
你是怎样庆祝生日的？

defsEn: a small mass of living material that is part of all plants and animals
zh: n. 单元, 细胞, 电池
examples: The cells have the capacity to convert food into energy.
My cell phone has a built-in digital camera.
exampleZh: 细胞具有将食物转化为能量的能力。
我的手机有内建的数位相机。

defsEn: the middle of something
the place in the middle
a place that is the main point of an activity
zh: n. 中心, 中心点, 中锋
a. 中央的, 位在正中的
vt. 集中, 定中心
vi. 居中
examples: In the center of the university campus stands the statue of the founder.
We sat in the center of the room.
exampleZh: 创校人的雕像在大学校园的中心矗立着。
我们坐在房间的正中间。

defsEn: one hundred years
zh: n. 世纪, 百年
examples: A century is one hundred years.
What century do we live in?
exampleZh: 一个世纪就是一百年。

defsEn: an act or series of acts done in a special way established by tradition
zh: n. 典礼, 仪式, 礼节
examples: The ceremony will take place tomorrow.
The ceremony began with his speech.
exampleZh: 明天举行典礼。
仪式以他的讲话开始。

defsEn: a person leading a meeting or an organized group
zh: n. 主席, 会长
examples: They made him the chairman of a club.
He's the chairman of the committee.
exampleZh: 他们选他做具乐部主席。
他是委员会主席。

defsEn: the best
the winner
zh: n. 冠军, 拥护者, 战士
vt. 保卫, 拥护
a. 优胜的
examples: I am the champion of my town.
I'm the champion of my province.

defsEn: a possibility of winning or losing or that something will happen
zh: n. 机会, 意外, 可能性
vi. 偶然发生
vt. 冒险
examples: By chance, I met my professor at a restaurant last night.
I met him by chance on the train this morning.
exampleZh: 很巧， 昨天在饭馆里碰到了我的教授。
今天早上我在火车上偶遇他。

defsEn: to make different
to become different
zh: n. 变化, 找回的零钱, 找头, 更换
vt. 改变, 更换, 兑换
examples: A change of air will do you a lot of good.
I changed my address last month.
exampleZh: 改变环境将对你有很多好处。
上个月我换了我的地址。

defsEn: to accuse someone of something, usually a crime
n. a statement in which someone is accused of something
zh: n. 指控, 费用, 冲锋, 电荷, 炸药, 主管, 被托管人, 命令
vt. 控诉, 加罪于, 使充满, 使充电, 使承担
vi. 冲锋, 要价, 收费
examples: Who's in charge of the sales section?
He's in charge of the department.
exampleZh: 谁负责销售部门？
他负责这个部门。

defsEn: to run or go after someone or something
zh: n. 追求, 狩猎, 追逐
vt. 追捕, 追逐, 雕刻, 在...上镶嵌宝石
vi. 追赶, 奔跑
examples: The hunter chases the rabbit in the fields.
Chase the cat out of the kitchen.
exampleZh: 猎人在田野追兔子

defsEn: to get by a trick
to steal from
zh: n. 欺骗, 作弊, 骗子
v. 欺骗, 逃脱, 骗取
examples: He cheated on the biology exam.
Tom is cheating on his wife.
exampleZh: 他在生物学考试时作弊。
汤姆对他的妻子不忠。

defsEn: to shout approval or praise
zh: n. 愉快, 振奋, 欢呼
vi. 欢呼, 喝彩, 快活起来
vt. 使振奋, 欢呼
examples: I cheered myself up by listening to music.
Cheer up! It will soon come out all right.
exampleZh: 我借由听音乐来鼓舞我自己。

defsEn: elements found in nature or made by people
substances used in the science of chemistry
zh: n. 化学品, 化学制品；化学药品；化工产品（chemical的复数）
examples: We need to dispose of these chemicals properly.
Chemicals could kill both the ivy and the tree.

defsEn: the scientific study of substances, what they are made of, how they act under different conditions, and how they form other substances
zh: n. 化学, 化学过程
examples: This is a chemistry laboratory in an ordinary secondary school.
In chemistry, can nitrogen form a single bond?
exampleZh: 这里是普通中学的化学实验室。

defsEn: the head or leader of a group
ad. leading
most important
zh: n. 领袖, 酋长, 长官, 主要部分
a. 主要的, 首位的
examples: He is the chief of my department.
The chief justice will swear in the president.
exampleZh: 他是我部门的主管。

defsEn: a baby
a boy or girl
zh: n. 孩子, 产物, 追随者
examples: The child almost hurt the small dog.
When I was a child, I used to swim in that pond.
exampleZh: 小孩差点伤到了小狗。
当我还是个孩子的时候，我在这个泳池里游过泳。

defsEn: more than one child
zh: pl. 孩子, 孩子们
examples: The children go to school in the morning.
Children all leave the nest one day.
exampleZh: 孩子们早上去学校。
总有一天孩子们会离开自己的小窝。

defsEn: to decide between two or more
zh: vt. 选择, 宁愿, 欲
vi. 作出选择, 愿意
examples: Choose a suitable satellite image as the base map.
Choose the color you like the best.
exampleZh: 选择合适的卫星图做为底图。
选你最喜欢的颜色。

defsEn: a line of genes
most human cells contain 46 chromosomes
zh: n. 染色体
examples: Your chromosome can undoubtedly show what kind of human you are!
The chromosomes in our cells contain the whole of our genetic material.

defsEn: a closed shape that has all its points equally distant from the center, like an “O”
zh: n. 圆周, 社交圈, 循环, 范围
vt. 围着, 环绕
vi. 盘旋, 循环
examples: She drew a circle on a piece of paper with a pencil.
I'm glad you're not in my circle of friends.
exampleZh: 她用铅笔在纸上画了一个圈。
我很开心你不在我朋友卷里。

defsEn: a person who is a member of a country by birth or by law city
zh: n. 市民, 公民
examples: I'm a citizen of the world.
I am a citizen of Sapporo.
exampleZh: 我是世界公民。
我是札幌的市民。

defsEn: any important large town
zh: n. 城市, 市
examples: Our city used to be a village.
In our city, we carefully separate and collect garbage.
exampleZh: 以前我们的城市还是一个村庄。
在我们的城市那，我们非常谨慎地分类收集垃圾。

defsEn: not military
zh: n. 平民, 民法专家
a. 平民的, 百姓的, 民用的
examples: There wasn't a civilian in sight.
Ziri has been with a civilian search-and-rescue unit for four years.

defsEn: to say something as a fact
zh: n. 要求, 要求权, 断言, 权利
vt. 要求, 认领, 主张
vi. 提出要求, 主张, 断言
examples: He claimed to be an expert in finance.
His claim is that there is a close relation between birth order and personality.
exampleZh: 他自称为金融专家。
他主张的是出生的先后次序和个性有很密切的关系。

defsEn: a battle
v. to fight or oppose
zh: n. 冲突, 撞击声, 抵触
vi. 冲突, 抵触
vt. 使发出撞击声
examples: Protesters clashed with police at the demonstration.
Clashes of ideas can promote better awareness.

defsEn: a group of students who meet to study the same subject
also a social or economic group. (“They were members of the middle class.”)
zh: n. 班级, 阶级, 种类, 课
vt. 分类
examples: My class tomorrow is very early in the day.
I farted in class, and the teacher threw me out.
exampleZh: 我明天的课很早。
我上课的时候放屁，被老师赶出了班房。

defsEn: to make pure
ad. free from dirt or harmful substances (“clean water”)
zh: a. 干净的, 清白的, 简洁的
adv. 清洁地, 完全地
vt. 清理, 使干净, 出空
vi. 被搞干净
n. 打扫
examples: Clean the stove and oven after cooking.
Clean the window with a damp cloth.
exampleZh: 烹饪结束后请清洁炉灶和烤箱。
用湿布清洁窗户。

defsEn: easy to see or see through
easily understood
zh: a. 清楚的, 明确的, 澄清的
adv. 清晰地
vt. 澄清, 清除障碍
vi. 放晴, 变清澈
n. 空隙
examples: In clear weather one can see Mount Fuji from here.
A clear conscience is an extraordinarily soft pillow.
exampleZh: 在晴朗的日子里，可以从这看见富士山。
问心无愧是一个非常柔软的枕头。

defsEn: a body of officials within a religious organization
zh: n. 牧师, 僧侣, 神职人员
examples: All the clergy are against the new law.
People who work for a given faith are called clergy.

defsEn: the normal weather conditions of a place
zh: n. 气候, 社会趋势, 气候区
examples: What is the climate on the island like?
The climate here is very similar to that in England.
exampleZh: 岛上气候怎么样？
这里的气候和英国十分相似。

defsEn: to go up or down something by using the feet and sometimes the hands
zh: v. 攀登, 上升, 爬
n. 攀登, 爬升
examples: They climbed to the top of a cliff.
We climbed the mountain last year.
exampleZh: 他们一直爬到悬崖顶上。
我们去年爬上了这座山。

defsEn: a device that measures and shows time
zh: n. 时钟, 计时器, (袜子上的)绣花边花
vt. 绣花样, 记时, 记录
vi. 记录时间
examples: A clock must be above all correct.
There is no clock in my room.
exampleZh: 一个时钟最重要的是准确。
我的房间里没有时钟。

defsEn: to make something not open
ad. near to
zh: n. 结束, 完结
a. 靠近的, 亲近的, 亲密的, 严密的, 关闭的, 狭窄的, 秘密的
vt. 关, 结束, 使靠近, 封闭, 使接近
vi. 关闭, 结束, 靠近
adv. 接近地, 紧密地
examples: Close the door and open the window!
Close the door on your way out.
exampleZh: 关上门，打开窗！
出去的时候把门关上。

defsEn: a material made from plants, chemicals, animal hair and other substances
zh: n. 布料, 织品, 布
examples: He had his clothes on inside out.
I gave them clothing and some food.
exampleZh: 他把衣服里外穿反了。
我给了他们衣服和一些食物。

defsEn: what people wear clothes
zh: n. 衣服

defsEn: a mass of fog high in the sky
zh: n. 云, 阴暗, 烟雾, 疑团
vt. 以云遮敝, 笼罩, 使黯然
vi. 乌云密布, 阴沉
examples: That cloud is in the shape of a fish.
There was not a cloud in the sky.
exampleZh: 那片云是鱼的形状。
天上没有一片云。

defsEn: a solid black substance used as fuel
zh: n. 煤, 木炭
v. 加煤
examples: Coal and natural gas are natural fuels.
This is the canary in the coal mine.
exampleZh: 煤和天然气是天然燃料。

defsEn: forces, groups or nations joined together
zh: n. 结合体, 结合, 联合
examples: The coalition talks in Berlin have broken down.
The coalition force fired at her car at the checkpoint in Baghdad.

defsEn: land on the edge of the ocean
zh: n. 海岸, 滑坡
v. 沿海岸而行
examples: It took a coast-to-coast investigation to find the murderer.
We went to the coast for our summer vacation.

defsEn: a drink made from the plant of the same name coffee
zh: n. 咖啡, 咖啡色
examples: The coffee enabled me to stay awake during the dull concert.
We met in a coffee shop near the campus.
exampleZh: 咖啡让我在沉闷的音乐会中保持清醒。
我们在校园附近的咖啡厅碰面。

defsEn: not warm
having or feeling great coolness or a low temperature
zh: n. 感冒, 寒冷
a. 寒冷的, 冷淡的, 冷静的
adv. 完全地
examples: Cold and dry, splendid sunshine, what beautiful winter weather!
A cold wave of fear hit me like a brick.
exampleZh: 寒冷干燥，灿烂的阳光，多么美丽的冬日天气!
一阵寒意像砖头一样击中了我。

defsEn: to fall down or inward suddenly
to break down or fail suddenly in strength, health or power. (“The building collapsed in the earthquake.” “The government collapsed after a vote in parliament.”)
zh: n. 崩溃, 倒塌, 虚脱
vi. 倒塌, 崩溃, 瓦解
vt. 使倒塌, 折叠
examples: Was the collapse of the Soviet Union a good or a bad thing?
She collapsed at the announcement of the news.

defsEn: to bring or gather together in one place
to demand and receive (“collect taxes”)
zh: v. 收集, 聚集, 集中, 搜集
a. 由收到者付款的
adv. 由收到者付款地
examples: Collect your thoughts before you begin your work.
He collected an entire bucket of water.
exampleZh: 工作之前先收好思绪。
他打了一整桶水。

defsEn: a small university
zh: n. 学院, 大学, 学会
examples: College is the time to enjoy yourself to the fullest!
I've got my college interview tomorrow. Hopefully I'll pass.
exampleZh: 大学生活就是你尽量享受自己的时候！
明天就要去入学面试了，希望可以通过。

defsEn: land controlled by another country or government
zh: 蜂群
examples: Taiwan was once a colony of Japan.
Zimbabwe was once a colony of Britain.
exampleZh: 台湾曾经是日本的殖民地。
津巴布韦曾经是英国的殖民地。

defsEn: the different effects of light on the eye, making blue, red, brown, black, yellow and others
zh: 颜色，色料，色素
examples: The color of her dress and that of her shoes go well together.
The color of gold is very similar to brass.
exampleZh: 她裙子和鞋子的颜色很配。
金的颜色和黄铜很相似。

defsEn: to mix or bring together
zh: v. (使)联合, (使)结合
n. (企业的)联合, 联合收割机
examples: Their combined weight was too much and caused the truck to break down.
I combined black-eyed beans with corn.
exampleZh: 总重量过大，导致卡车抛锚。
我用玉米搭配豇豆。

defsEn: to move toward
to arrive
zh: vi. 过来, 来, 到达, 出现, 开始
interj. 喂
examples: He could not come because of his serious illness.
How come you know so much about Japanese history?
exampleZh: 他因为生重病不能来。
你为什么知道这么多的日本历史?

defsEn: to order
to have power over something
zh: n. 命令, 指挥, 控制, 部队, 司令部
v. 命令, 指挥, 控制
examples: He commanded me to leave the room immediately.
He commands the respect of a king.
exampleZh: 他命令我立刻离开这个房间。
他尊贵如国王。

defsEn: to say something about
to express an opinion about something I think.. comment
zh: n. 注解, 批评, 评论, 备注
vi. 评论, 注解
examples: My comment sparked off an argument in the group.
His comment was concise and to the point.
exampleZh: 我的评论引起了小组内的争论。
他的评论简洁且击中要害。

defsEn: a group of people given special work
zh: n. 委员会
examples: The committee inquired into the cause of the accident.
The committee meets twice a month.
exampleZh: 委员会调查了事故的原因。
委员会一个月召开两次。

defsEn: usual
same for all. (“a common purpose”)
zh: a. 通常的, 共同的, 通俗的, 公共的
examples: Their common aim was to make the project successful.
Is a common European identity possible?
exampleZh: 这些人共同的目标是把这个项目做成功。
欧洲人统一有可能吗？

defsEn: to tell
to give or exchange information
zh: vt. 显露, 传达, 感染
vi. 通讯
examples: They communicate with each other by gesture.
Those two communicate a lot with each other at work, often rubbing shoulders.
exampleZh: 她们用手势沟通。
他们俩工作上联系多，经常打交道。

defsEn: a group of people living together in one place or area
zh: n. 社区, 公众, 共有, 共同体
examples: Is this community safe? Are there lighting installations for the night?
The community is made up of individuals.
exampleZh: 小区安全吗？夜晚有照明设施吗？
社会是由个人组成的。

defsEn: a business organized for trade, industrial or other purposes
zh: n. 公司, 友伴, 交往, 连队, 朋友, 一群
vt. 陪伴
vi. 交往
examples: The company will soon go bankrupt.
Our company and its affiliates may share your personal information with each other.
exampleZh: 公司很快就要倒闭了。
我们公司与其分公司会共享你的个人信息。

defsEn: to examine what is different or similar
zh: vt. 比较, 比喻, 对照
vi. 相比
n. 比较
examples: Compare the two carefully, and you will see the difference.
Compare your sentence with the one on the blackboard.
exampleZh: 仔细的比较一下，就会发现两者之间的分别了。
比较一下你写的句子和黑板上的句子。

defsEn: to try to do as well as, or better than, another or others
zh: vi. 竞争, 对抗
examples: I competed with him for the championship.
They compete against each other in the game.
exampleZh: 我和他竞争冠军。

defsEn: having all parts
ended or finished
zh: a. 完全的, 十足的, 完成的
vt. 完成, 完工, 使圆满
examples: She's a complete stranger to me.
A complete intransitive verb takes neither complement nor object.
exampleZh: 她对我来说是一个完全陌生的人。
一个完完全全的不及物动词既没有补语，又没有宾语。

defsEn: of or having many parts that are difficult to understand
not simple
zh: n. 综合体, 情结, 络合物
a. 复杂的, 组合的
examples: He has a complex about his weight.
Complex numbers have an imaginary part.

defsEn: a substance containing two or more elements
zh: n. 混合物, 复合词, 化合物, 院子
a. 复合的, 混合的, 化合的
vi. 化合, 和解, 妥协
vt. 使复合, 使化合
examples: Compound interest is the most powerful force in the universe.
Compound transforms the form of word.

defsEn: the settlement of an argument where each side agrees to accept less than first demanded
zh: n. 妥协, 折中, 折中方案, 和解
vi. 妥协处理
vt. 危害
examples: Giraffes compromise their safety every time they bow down for a drink.
A compromise seems unlikely in the near future.

defsEn: an electronic machine for storing and organizing information, and for communicating with others
zh: n. 电脑, 电子计算机
examples: Is your computer more important to you than your girlfriend?
That's the computer he used to write the article.
exampleZh: 电脑对你来说比女朋友还重要吗？
那就是那台他用来写文章的电脑。

defsEn: interest, worry (“express concern about”)
v. to fear (“to be concerned”)
zh: n. 关心, 忧虑
vt. 与...有关, 使担心, 使挂念
examples: Concerning this issue, I feel that the trash media only report biased information.
Concerning this word, each expert has a different point of view.
exampleZh: 关于这个问题，我觉得垃圾媒体只报道了很片面的信息。
对这个词，专家们各有不同的看法。

defsEn: to say a person or action is wrong or bad
zh: vt. 判刑, 责备, 谴责
examples: Would you condemn your friend for the same thing?
He condemned the court and, by implication, the entire legal system.

defsEn: something declared necessary to complete an agreement
a person’s health
zh: n. 情况, 条件
vt. 使健康, 以...为条件, 决定, 使适应
examples: What conditions must a child meet to be able to learn the piano?
His condition got worse every day.
exampleZh: 孩子学钢琴要具备哪些条件？
他的身体状况每况愈下。

defsEn: a meeting
zh: n. 会议
examples: The conference will take place in Tokyo.
The conference will be held in a specially selected church.
exampleZh: 会议将在东京举行。
会议将会在特意安排的礼堂里举行。

defsEn: to approve
to say that something is true
zh: vt. 证实, 确定, 批准, 使巩固
examples: They confirmed to me that there weren't any goods left.
I confirm that you're definitely not pregnant.
exampleZh: 他们向我保证没有任何物品剩下。

defsEn: a fight
a battle, especially a long one
zh: n. 战斗, 冲突, 矛盾, 争执
vi. 争执, 战斗, 冲突, 抵触
examples: The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.
This conflict between us is too much for me to handle.
exampleZh: 在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。

defsEn: to praise a person or to express pleasure for success or good luck
zh: vt. 祝贺, 庆贺
examples: I congratulate you on your engagement.
He congratulated me on my success.
exampleZh: 我为你的订婚祝贺。
他为我的成功恭贺我。

defsEn: the organization of people elected to make the laws of the United States (the House of Representatives and the Senate)
a similar organization in other countries
zh: n. 国会, 会议, 讨论会
examples: We went to the congress by bus.
Congress is split over the issue.

defsEn: to join one thing to another
to unite
to link
zh: v. 连接, 联合, 联系
examples: I am not connected to this crime in any way.
Connecting a PC to the internet is not rocket science.
exampleZh: 我与这起犯罪没有任何关系。
将电脑连线到网际网路并不是什么难事。

defsEn: one who usually supports tradition and opposes great change
zh: a. 保守的, 守旧的, 有保存力的
examples: A conservative is not always a reactionary.
Conservative people always tell us to act within our station.
exampleZh: 保守分子不一定是反动分子。

defsEn: to give thought to
to think about carefully
zh: v. 考虑, 思考, 认为
examples: They consider him the best doctor in town.
I consider him a great writer.
exampleZh: 他们把他视为城里最好的医生。
我觉得他是一个优秀的作家。

defsEn: the written general laws and ideas that form a nation’s system of government
zh: n. 构成, 宪法, 体格
examples: The U.S. Constitution was poorly written.
The constitution of the country is very democratic.
exampleZh: 美国宪法写得很烂。

defsEn: the act of touching or being close to a person or thing (“He was in contact with animals that had the disease.”) v. to meet or communicate with (“He wanted to contact his local official.”)
zh: n. 联系, 交际, 熟人, 接触
vi. 接触, 联系
vt. 使接触
examples: We'll contact you by phone as soon as we arrive.
Contact the appropriate customer service helpline if the device does not operate properly.
exampleZh: 我们到了就打电话跟您联系。
如果装置无法正常运作，请联络对应的客服专线。

defsEn: to hold
to include
zh: vt. 包含, 容纳, 控制
vi. 自制
examples: He could no longer contain his anger.
Oranges contain a large amount of vitamin C.
exampleZh: 他再也忍不住气了。
柳丁含有大量的维生素 C。

defsEn: a box, bottle or can used to hold something
zh: n. 容器, 集装箱
examples: This container can hold two litres of hot water.
The container ship kept station outside the harbor until the pilot boat arrived.

defsEn: any of the seven great land areas of the world
zh: n. 大陆, 洲
a. 自制的
examples: There are seven continents on the earth.
What is the continent with the most people living on it in the world?
exampleZh: 地球上有七大洲。

defsEn: to go on doing or being
zh: vi. 继续, 延续, 延长
vt. 使继续, 使延长
examples: She continued that you should keep your promise.
You continue making the same mistakes time after time.
exampleZh: 她接下来说你应该遵守你的承诺。
你每次都继续犯同样的错误。

defsEn: to direct
to have power over
zh: n. 控制, 管理, 克制, 控制器, 操纵装置
vt. 控制, 操纵, 抑制
examples: I could not control my anger.
He is out of control when drunk.
exampleZh: 我气坏了。
他会酒后失控。

defsEn: a large meeting for a special purpose
zh: n. 大会, 协定, 惯例, 约定
examples: The convention will draw many of the top physicists in the globe.
There was a convention last month.

defsEn: to heat food before eating it cook
zh: n. 厨子, 厨师
vt. 烹调, 煮饭, 加热
vi. 在煮着
examples: Could you cook this meat a little more?
She was cooking dinner at that time.
exampleZh: 你能多烧一点这个肉吗?
那时她正在做饭。

defsEn: almost cold
zh: n. 凉爽, 凉爽的空气
a. 凉爽的, 冷淡的, 冷静的
vi. 冷却, 平息
vt. 使冷却, 使平静
examples: Cool the burned finger in running water.
It's cool this morning, isn't it?
exampleZh: 用水冲洗灼伤的手指。
今天上午很凉爽，不是吗？

defsEn: to act or work together
zh: vi. 合作, 协力, 配合
examples: We had to cooperate with each other.
I cooperated with him in the task.

defsEn: to make something exactly like another
n. something made to look exactly like another
zh: n. 副本, 摹仿, 一册
v. 复印, 抄袭, 复制
将几个文件合并成一个文件, 以及将文件传至外设或在设备之间传送
examples: Copy. I read you. Over and out.
Copy this program on your computer.

defsEn: a food grain
zh: n. 玉蜀黍, 谷类, 谷粒, 鸡眼
vt. 使成颗粒, 腌
examples: I bought a bag of frozen corn.
Corn cobs can be used to kindle a fire.
exampleZh: 我买了一包冰冻玉米。

defsEn: true
free from mistakes
v. to change to what is right
zh: a. 正确的, 合适的
vt. 改正, 订正
examples: Correct the mistake and return the file to Mr Luxemburg.
Correct my spelling if it's wrong.
exampleZh: 请把错误改正过来，然后把文件夹还给 Luxemburg 先生。
如果我拼错了的话，请你纠正。

defsEn: actions corn taken to gain money or power that are legally or morally wrong
zh: n. 腐败, 堕落, 贪污
examples: Corruption and red tape continue to permeate the business environment.
Corruption at the government level is a disgrace to democracy.

defsEn: the price or value of something (“The cost of the book is five dollars.”)
v. to be valued at
zh: n. 代价, 价值, 费用
vi. 花费
vt. 使失去, 值, 使花费
examples: It cost me a thousand yen to get my bicycle fixed.
It cost me ten thousand yen to have my television set repaired.
exampleZh: 我花了一千日圆修理脚踏车。
把我的电视机修好花了我一万日元。

defsEn: a material made from a plant of the same name
zh: n. 棉花
vi. 和谐, 有好感, 理解
examples: Cotton was the most important cash crop in the American south.
We ate cotton candy at the state fair.

defsEn: to speak or add numbers
zh: vt. 计算, 视为
vi. 计数
n. 计算, 合计, 计数, 伯爵
examples: I count the sparkle of constellations to foretell the future of my love.
You could count to ten when you were two.
exampleZh: 我数着星宿的星光来预测我爱情的未来。
在你两岁时, 你可以数到十。

defsEn: a nation
the territory of a nation
land away from cities
zh: n. 国家, 乡村, 地区, 故乡
a. 乡下的, 农村的
examples: What country has the absolute advantage in the production of corn?
Country life is very peaceful in comparison with city life.
exampleZh: 哪一个国家拥有生产玉米的绝对优势？
和都市生活相比，乡村生活和谐多了。

defsEn: where trials take place
where judges make decisions about law
zh: n. 法院, 庭院, 奉承
vt. 献殷勤, 追求, 招致
vi. 求爱
examples: The court declared him innocent on the charge of murder.
The court acquitted him of the charge of murder.
exampleZh: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。
法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。

defsEn: to put something over a person or thing
n. anything that is put over a person or thing
zh: n. 盖子, 封面, 藉口
vt. 覆盖, 掩饰, 保护, 掩护, 包括
vi. 覆盖
examples: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
Cover your head when you are in the sun.
exampleZh: 你咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠的时候要捂住你的嘴。
当你在阳光下的时候，遮住你的头。

defsEn: a farm animal used for its milk
zh: n. 母牛, 母兽
vt. 威胁
examples: There is a cow in the village.
Cows provide us with good milk.
exampleZh: 村里有一头母牛。
牛供给我们好奶。

defsEn: to fall violently
to hit with great force
zh: n. 哗啦声, 猛撞, 崩溃, 粗布
v. 撞碎, 破碎, (使)...坠毁
a. 速成的
examples: The crash was and remains to date the deadliest airplane accident on Canadian soil.
He crashed his car because someone tampered with the brakes.
exampleZh: 这起空难是迄今为止加拿大境内最严重的空难。
他撞车是因为有人在刹车上做了手脚。

defsEn: to make
to give life or form to
zh: vt. 创造, 建造, 引起, 任命
examples: I created a shortcut on the desktop.
I created an archive of my emails.
exampleZh: 我在桌面上建了一个快捷方式。
我给自己的邮件做了一份档案。

defsEn: any living being
any animal or human
zh: n. 人, 动物, 创造物, 生物
examples: No creature whatsoever can live in space.
The creature let out a growl.

defsEn: an agreement that payments will be made at a later time
zh: n. 信用, 信任, 荣誉, 贷款, 学分
vt. 归功于, 赞颂, 信任, 相信
examples: Which credit cards can I use?
My credit card was stolen on the subway.
exampleZh: 我可以用哪些信用卡？
我的信用卡在地铁上被扒了。

defsEn: a group of people working together
zh: n. 全体人员, 一群人, 全体队员
crow的过去式
examples: The crew prepared for the voyage across the Pacific Ocean.
The crew prepared for the voyage to outer space.

defsEn: an act that violates a law
zh: n. 犯罪, 罪行, 罪恶
examples: It's no crime to skip breakfast once in a while.
In Singapore, it is a crime to spit on the ground.
exampleZh: 偶尔不吃早餐也不会如何不好呀。
随地吐痰在新加坡算是犯罪行为。

defsEn: a person who is responsible for a crime
zh: n. 罪犯, 犯人, 刑事
a. 犯了罪的, 刑事的, 有罪的
examples: The criminal is still at large.
The criminal came out of the house with arms raised.
exampleZh: 那个犯人还没被抓到。
犯人手举在空中走出了房子。

defsEn: an extremely important time when something may become much better or worse
a dangerous situation
zh: n. 危机, 危险期, 紧要关头
examples: In a crisis, you must get in touch with your teacher.
The crisis could start a revolution in economic ideology.
exampleZh: 在危险的时候你必须跟你的老师联系。

defsEn: to say what is wrong with something or someone
to condemn
to judge
zh: v. 批评, 吹毛求疵, 非难
examples: Tom criticized Mary in front of everyone.
I criticize by creation, not by finding fault.
exampleZh: 汤姆在所有人面前批评了玛丽。

defsEn: plants that are grown and gathered for food, such as grains, fruits and vegetables
zh: 分批出现(疹)
examples: In the fall we harvest our summer crops.
We need to learn how to grow crops on Mars.

defsEn: to go from one side to another
to go across
zh: n. 十字架, 十字架形物件, 交叉, 十字标, 交叉路, 磨难, 杂交
a. 生气的, 交叉的, 相反的
v. 交叉, 横过, 越过
examples: We'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
Once you cross the river, you'll be safe.
exampleZh: 船到桥头自然直。
一旦过了河, 你就安全了。

defsEn: a large number of people gathered in one place
zh: n. 群众, 一伙人
vt. 拥挤, 挤满, 挤进
examples: We were crowded into the small room.
He crowded the books into the shelves.
exampleZh: 我们挤进了那间小房间里。
他在书架上塞满了书。

defsEn: to damage or destroy by great weight
to defeat completely
zh: n. 压碎, 粉碎, 群众, 迷恋
vt. 压破, 征服, 塞, 弄皱, 榨出
vi. 被压碎, 起皱, 挤
examples: She has a crush on the boy next door.
He has had a crush on her.
exampleZh: 她看上了隔壁的那个男孩。
他一直暗恋着她。

defsEn: to express or show sorrow or pain
zh: n. 叫声, 哭声, 大叫
vi. 哭, 叫, 喊
vt. 叫喊, 大声说, 哭出
examples: I cry every time I watch this movie.
She began to cry at the sight of my face.
exampleZh: 我每次看这部电影都会哭。
她看到我的脸就开始哭。

defsEn: all the beliefs, traditions and arts of a group or population
zh: n. 文化, 修养, 耕种
vt. 耕种, 培养
examples: Cultures of the East and the West meet together in this country.
They had a culture of their own.
exampleZh: 东西方文化在这个国家融合。
他们有他们自己的文化。

defsEn: to improve health
to make well (“The doctor can cure the disease.”)
n. something that makes a sick person well (“Antibiotics are a cure for infection.”)
zh: n. 治疗, 治愈, 治疗法
vt. 治疗, 治愈, 改正, 腌制, 加工处理, 使硫化
vi. 受治疗, 被加工处理, 被硫化
examples: There is no cure for birth and death save to enjoy the interval.
There is no cure for the common cold.

defsEn: an order to people to stay off the streets or to close their businesses
zh: n. 晚钟, 打晚钟时刻, 宵禁
examples: There is a curfew in effect from dusk to dawn.
A curfew was imposed on the city.

defsEn: movement of air, water or electricity
ad. belonging to the present time (“She found the report in a current publication.”)
zh: n. 涌流, 趋势, 流
a. 流通的, 现在的, 当前的, 流行的
examples: Our current crisis is no mere economic crisis.
Who is the current representative from France?
exampleZh: 我们当前的危机绝非单纯的经济危机。
这个年级的法方代表是谁？

defsEn: a long-established belief or activity of a people
zh: n. 习惯, 风俗, 海关, 自定义
a. 定制的
examples: It's my custom to go for a walk before breakfast.
As was the custom in those days, he married young.
exampleZh: 我习惯早餐之前出去散步。
如当时的习惯，他很年轻便成婚了。

defsEn: taxes on imports
zh: n. 海关, 关卡, 关税
examples: We should do away with out-of-date customs.
A customs official asked me to open my suitcase.

defsEn: to divide or injure with a sharp tool
to make less
to reduce
zh: n. 切口, 割伤, 降低, 切, 割, 砍, 削, 伤口, 削减, 缩短, 删节, 通路
a. 经切割的, 缩减的
vt. 切, 割, 减少, 刺痛, 开辟, 雕刻, 删节, 缩短, 停止, 排斥, 切断, 关, 显出
vi. 切, 割, 砍, 刺痛, 相交, 抄近路, 剪辑
examples: He cut down a tree in his garden.
He cut the meat with a knife.
exampleZh: 他在花园里砍了一棵树。
他用刀切了肉。

defsEn: a wall built across a river to hold back flowing water dam
zh: n. 水坝, 障碍
v. 控制, 筑坝
examples: This dam supplies us with water and electricity.
The dam burst owing to the heavy rain.
exampleZh: 这个水坝给我们提供水和电。

defsEn: to cause injury or destruction
n. harm
hurt or injury, usually to things
zh: n. 损害, 伤害
v. 损害
examples: The damage will cost us a lot of money.
The damage here is more severe than on the other side of town.
exampleZh: 这破坏会花费我们很多钱。

defsEn: to move the body and feet to music
n. a series of steps, usually to music
zh: n. 跳舞, 舞蹈, 舞会
v. 跳舞
examples: She said that she would dance with me if I brought her red roses.
Who taught you how to dance?
exampleZh: 她说，若我送她红玫瑰，她将与我跳舞。
谁教你跳舞的?

defsEn: a strong chance of suffering injury, damage or loss
zh: n. 危险, 威胁
examples: The danger past and God forgotten.
They are in danger of extinction.
exampleZh: 遇难求上帝，过后全忘记。
牠们正面临绝种的危机。

defsEn: having little or no light (“The room was dark.”)
zh: n. 黑暗, 夜, 黄昏, 模糊
a. 黑暗的, 暗的, 深色的, 隐密的, 模糊的, 无知的
examples: It was a dark night, with no moon.
Dark bread is popular in Germany.
exampleZh: 那是个漆黑的没有月光的夜晚。
黑面包在德国很受欢迎。

defsEn: an expression of time
a day, month and year
zh: n. 日期, 约会, 枣椰树
vt. 约会, 定日期
vi. 注明日期, 过时
examples: I forgot the date of the meeting.
What is your date of birth?
exampleZh: 我忘了会议的日期。
你的生日是几号？

defsEn: a person’s female child
zh: n. 女儿
a. 女儿的
examples: He who would the daughter win, with the mother must begin.
My daughter often comes to visit me.
exampleZh: 想要得到女儿，就必须从她母亲那儿开始努力。
我女儿常来看我。

defsEn: twenty–four hours
the hours of sunlight
zh: n. 天, 日子, 白天, 工作日
examples: The day will come when you will realize it.
That day left a deep impression on me.
exampleZh: 有一天你会意识到它。
我对那天的印象很深刻。

defsEn: not living
zh: a. 死的, 不活泼的, 麻木的, 熄灭的
n. 死者
adv. 完全地, 直接地
examples: A dead leaf fell to the ground.
When I'm dead, who will be celebrating?
exampleZh: 一片枯叶落到了地上。
当我死去的时候，谁将庆祝呢？

defsEn: not able to hear
zh: a. 聋的
examples: Deaf-mute people talk using sign language.
Deaf-mute people can use sign language to communicate.
exampleZh: 聋哑的人用手语说话。

defsEn: to have to do with (“The talks will deal with the problem of pollution.”)
to buy or sell (“Her company deals in plastic.”) n. an agreement
zh: n. 交易, 协定, 数量, 买卖, 松木板
vi. 处理, 应付, 做生意
vt. 分配, 发牌, 给予
examples: I'll deal with this problem as soon as I can.
Deal with a man as he deals with you.
exampleZh: 我会尽快处理这问题。
以眼还眼，以牙还牙。

defsEn: to argue for or against something
n. a public discussion or argument
zh: n. 辩论, 讨论
v. 争论, 辩论
examples: We debated on the question of world population.
Tatoeba: Where debates are hotter than two rabbits making babies in a sock!
exampleZh: 我们在世界人口问题上争辩了一番。
Tatoeba：这里的辩论比两只兔子在袜子里做爱还要激烈！

defsEn: something that is owed
the condition of owing
zh: n. 债务, 罪过
examples: He is up to his ears in debt.
His debts amount to more than he can pay.
exampleZh: 他浑身是债。

defsEn: to choose
to settle
to judge
zh: v. 决定, 判决
examples: It is up to you to decide whether we will go there or not.
I decided to take the opportunity to go and visit him.
exampleZh: 我们去不去那儿由你来决定。
我决定顺便去看望看望他。

defsEn: to say
to make a statement
zh: v. 宣布, 声明, 申报, 断言
examples: She declared that she was not guilty.
Declare your position in a debate.
exampleZh: 她声称自己没罪。

defsEn: to make less in size or amount
zh: n. 减少, 减少量
v. 减少
examples: He decreased the price for her.
This could decrease productivity in Algeria.

defsEn: going far down
a long way from top to bottom
zh: a. 深的
adv. 深入地
n. 深渊, 深处
examples: He took a deep breath before entering his boss's office.
The deep layers of the ocean are still almost unexplored.
exampleZh: 他在进老板办公室前深吸了一口气。
海洋的深层仍然几乎未被探索。

defsEn: to cause to lose in a battle or struggle
n. a loss
the condition of having lost
zh: n. 败北, 失败
vt. 击败, 使落空
examples: Those who are defeated are always wrong. History only remembers their failure.
That would be to defeat the object.
exampleZh: 被征服的人永远是错的。历史只记得他们的失败。

defsEn: to guard or fight against attack
to protect
zh: vt. 防护, 辩护, 防卫
examples: To defend ourselves, we had to tell a lie.
They defended their country against the invaders.
exampleZh: 为了保护自己，我们只好说谎。
他们抵御入侵者，保卫了国家。

defsEn: a shortage that results when spending is greater than earnings, or imports are greater than exports
zh: n. 赤字, 不足额
examples: Eliminating the deficit will be a hard nut to crack.
Eliminating the deficit will be a very difficult job.

defsEn: to give the meaning of
to explain
zh: vt. 定义, 规定, 使明确
examples: How would you define a successful marriage?
Could you define the word and say what you understand by it?

defsEn: a measure of temperature
zh: n. 程度, 度数, 学位, 度
examples: To what degree can we trust him?
To what degree are you interested in baseball?
exampleZh: 我们可以有多相信他？
你喜欢棒球到什么程度？

defsEn: to decide to do something at a later time
to postpone
to cause to be late
zh: n. 耽搁, 迟滞
v. 耽搁, 延迟
examples: We delayed our departure because of the storm.
I was delayed by a traffic jam.
exampleZh: 我们因为风暴推迟了起程。
我被交通堵塞耽搁了。

defsEn: one sent to act for another
one who represents another
zh: n. 代表
vt. 委派...为代表
examples: Delegates from many countries participated in the conference.
He delegated his authority to his competent assistant.
exampleZh: 许多国家的代表出席了会议。

defsEn: to ask by ordering
to ask with force
zh: n. 要求, 需求, 需要
v. 要求, 查询
examples: I demand an explanation for this mistake.
He demanded that I should pay the money at once.
exampleZh: 我要求说明这个错误。
他要求我马上付钱。

defsEn: the system of government in which citizens vote to choose leaders or to make other important decisions
zh: n. 民主政治, 民主主义
examples: In a democracy, it's important for the press to be independent.
In a democracy, it is important that the press be independent.
exampleZh: 在民主国家，报刊的独立是很重要的。
在民主国家，报刊的独立是很重要的。

defsEn: to make a public show of opinions or feelings (“The crowd demonstrated in support of human rights.”)
to explain by using examples (“The teacher demonstrated the idea with an experiment.”)
zh: vt. 示范, 证明
vi. 示威
examples: Would you demonstrate the next problem at the board?
He went on to demonstrate how to use the machine.

defsEn: close together
thick
zh: a. 密集的, 浓厚的
examples: There is a dense population of young people around here.
The dense fog made the building invisible.

defsEn: to accuse of being wrong or evil
to criticize severely
zh: vt. 告发, 抨击, 谴责
examples: She denounced him to the police as a murderer.
Denounce Hindutva and support religious tolerance in India.

defsEn: to declare that something is not true
to refuse a request
zh: v. 否认, 拒绝
examples: It cannot be denied that Chinese is the most spoken language in the world.
There is no denying that she is very efficient.
exampleZh: 不能忽视的是，汉语是世界上使用人数最多的母语。
无可否认她非常有能力。

defsEn: to need help and support
zh: vi. 靠, 视...而定, 信赖
examples: I depend on the alarm clock to wake up on time every morning.
It depends what you mean by "believe" in God.
exampleZh: 每天早上我都要靠闹钟来按时叫醒我。
这取决于你所说的”相信“上帝是什么意思。

defsEn: to regret strongly
to express sadness
zh: vt. 悲悼, 哀叹, 对...深感遗憾
examples: We deplore your cruelty to animals.
He deplored the fact that Silesia was no longer Prussian.

defsEn: to move forces or weapons into positions for action
zh: v. 展开, 配置
examples: The US deployed its own troops to Iraq.
Yanni was deployed to a remote area in southern Algeria.

defsEn: severe unhappiness
a period of reduced business and economic activity during which many people lose their jobs
zh: 俯角
examples: His depression came to an end when she kissed him.
My depression trailed away when I saw the lovely and ample young Muslim woman.

defsEn: to give a word picture of something
to give details of something
zh: vt. 描述, 描绘, 画
examples: She described him as a detective.
He described the incident in detail.
exampleZh: 她把他形容为侦探。
他详细地描述了事故状况。

defsEn: a dry area of land desert
zh: n. 沙漠, 应得的赏罚, 功劳
a. 沙漠的, 不毛的
vt. 放弃, 遗弃, 擅离
vi. 逃掉
examples: They were marooned on a desert isle.
There is an oasis in the desert.
exampleZh: 她们被抛弃在一座荒岛上。
沙漠中有绿洲。

defsEn: to plan or create plans for
zh: n. 设计, 图样, 方案, 企图
v. 设计, 计划
examples: Tom's designs didn't impress me much.
Could you design a new emotion?
exampleZh: 汤姆的设计没有给我留下多少印象。

defsEn: to want very much
to wish for
zh: n. 欲望, 要求
vt. 想要, 请求
vi. 渴望
examples: Desire for food and sex is part of human nature.
They desire to remove a weight from the heart.
exampleZh: 食色性也（孔子）。

defsEn: to break into pieces
to end the existence of
zh: vt. 破坏, 毁坏, 消灭
examples: Destroy one's bridges after one has crossed the river.
This could destroy her entire life.
exampleZh: 过河拆桥。

defsEn: a small part of something
a small piece of information
zh: n. 细节, 详情
vt. 详述, 选派
vi. 画详图
examples: He gave a detailed description of the accident.
He gave us a detailed account of his experiences in Africa.
exampleZh: 他详细地敍述了那场意外的经过。
他把他在非洲的所见所闻一五一十地告诉了我们。

defsEn: to keep or hold (“The police detained several suspects for questioning.”)
zh: vt. 扣留, 扣押, 耽搁
examples: He was detained at the border for a passport check.
I got detained at the airport.

defsEn: to grow
to create
to experience progress
zh: vt. 发展, 使发达, 进步, 洗印, 显影
vi. 发展, 生长
examples: As China develops, more and more countries want to have good relations with it.
I developed a tumor in my stomach, which required surgery.
exampleZh: 越来越多国家随着中国的发展而希望跟中国有好的关系。
我得了胃肿瘤，必须动手术切除。

defsEn: a piece of equipment made for a special purpose
zh: n. 装置, 设计, 策略, 发明物, 设备
examples: This device made it possible to turn sea-water into fresh water easily.
A GPS device can pinpoint your location anywhere in the world.
exampleZh: 有了这个装置，把海水净化成淡水就不是难事了。
无论你在世界的哪一个角落，你都可以使用全球定位仪来找出你的所在。

defsEn: a ruler with complete power
zh: n. 命令者, 独裁者
examples: The dictator forced the tribe to agree on the terms of surrender.
The dictator tried in vain to get out of the awkward situation.

defsEn: to become dead
to stop living
to end
zh: vi. 死亡, 消逝, 平息, 熄灭, 漠然, 渴望
vt. 死
n. 骰子, 冲模
examples: Were I to die, who would look after my children?
If I were to die, what would my family do?
exampleZh: 要是我死了，谁来照顾我的孩子们？
我死了，我家人怎么办。

defsEn: usual daily food and drink
zh: n. 日常饮食, 议会
vt. 照规定饮食
vi. 忌食
examples: She is on a diet for fear that she will put on weight.
The Diet will meet on Tuesday.
exampleZh: 她因为担心发胖而节食。
国会将在周二开会。

defsEn: not the same
zh: a. 不同的
examples: There was a different kind of atmosphere in the headquarters.
He is different from what he used to be.
exampleZh: 总部里有另外一种气氛。
他和从前不一样。

defsEn: not easy
hard to do, make or carry out
zh: a. 困难的
examples: It was difficult for him to hide his pride in his success.
It's difficult to catch a rabbit by hand.
exampleZh: 他很难掩饰对自己成功的骄傲。
徒手逮兔挺难。

defsEn: to make a hole in the ground
zh: vt. 挖, 翻土, 发掘
vi. 挖掘
n. 挖掘
examples: He who digs a hole for his brother will fall inside.
I cannot dig a hole in the middle of the street.
