defsEn: the main amount of food eaten at a usual time (“The family had its dinner at noon.”)
a special event that includes food (“The official dinner took place at the White House.”)
zh: n. 晚餐, 正餐, 宴会
examples: Dinner is ready, so we can eat whenever we want.
Dinner is probably ready, so we had better hurry home.
exampleZh: 晚餐已经准备好了，我们可以随时开始吃。
晚饭大概已经准备好了，我们还是快点回家吧。

defsEn: a person who represents his or her government in dealing with another government
zh: n. 外交官, 有外交手腕的人
examples: He is a diplomat at the American Embassy.
The diplomat was shot at the embassy.
exampleZh: 他是美国大使馆的外交官。

defsEn: to lead
to aim or show the way (“He directed me to the theater.”)
ad. straight to something
not through some other person or thing (“The path is direct.”)
zh: a. 直接的, 坦白的
vt. 指示, 指挥, 命令, 导演
vi. 指导, 指挥
adv. 直接地
examples: Is this the direct way to the Prado?
Could you direct me to the bus stop?
exampleZh: 这条路是不是直接通往普拉多博物馆？

defsEn: the way (east, west, north, south)
where someone or something came dirt from or went to
zh: n. 方向, 指导, 趋势
examples: In which direction is Central Park?
I'm sorry I've mistaken the direction.
exampleZh: 中央公园在哪个方向？
不好意思，我把方向搞错了。

defsEn: earth or soil
zh: n. 污垢, 泥土
examples: She swept the dirt from the porch.
He brushed the dirt off his jeans.

defsEn: to become unseen
to no longer exist
zh: vi. 消失, 不见
examples: I could disappear at any time.
We disappear together in the forest.
exampleZh: 我随时可以消失。

defsEn: to take away weapons
to no longer keep weapons
to make a bomb harmless by removing its exploding device
zh: vt. 解除武装, 裁军, 缓和
vi. 放下武器
examples: Ziri forgot to disarm his alarm.
Her smile disarms her parents whenever they are cross with her.

defsEn: an event causing widespread destruction or loss of life, such as an earthquake or plane crash
zh: n. 灾祸, 不幸, 彻底失败
examples: It would be a disaster if they ever got a majority in the parliament.
Disaster was just a matter of time.

defsEn: to find or learn something
zh: vt. 发现, 找到, 暴露
vi. 发现
examples: He was discovered unconscious on the floor of the kitchen.
She discovered that she had run out of salt.
exampleZh: 他被人发现倒在厨房的地板上，不省人事。
她发现她已经断盐了。

defsEn: unfair treatment or consideration based on opinions about a whole group instead of on the qualities of an individual. (“He was accused of discrimination against people from other countries.”)
zh: n. 差别, 岐视, 辨别力
examples: Discrimination made it difficult for me to rent an apartment.
Discrimination made it difficult for me to find a job.

defsEn: to talk about
to exchange ideas
zh: vt. 讨论, 论述
examples: We discussed the problem for a long time.
We discussed gun control in social studies class.
exampleZh: 我们讨论那个问题讨论了很久。
我们上社会课的时候谈到了枪械管制的问题。

defsEn: a sickness in living things, often caused by viruses, germs or bacteria
zh: n. 疾病, 弊病
examples: I got a disease from listening to that band.
This disease mainly affects the central nervous system.
exampleZh: 光是听那个乐团的歌就会染病。

defsEn: to send away
to refuse to consider
zh: vt. 解散, 开除, 解职
vi. 解散
examples: He was dismissed by the boss of the factory.
He dismisses the importance of mental health.
exampleZh: 他被工厂的老板解雇。

defsEn: to oppose strongly by argument
n. an angry debate
zh: n. 争论
v. 争论
examples: We disputed for hours about what to write.
I disputed with him about world peace for an hour.
exampleZh: 我们为该写些什么而争论了好几个小时。

defsEn: a person who strongly disagrees with his or her government
zh: a. 意见不同的, 持不同政见的
n. 意见不同的人, 持不同政见者
examples: The political dissident has spent nearly a decade under house arrest.
All political dissidents were purged under the former regime.

defsEn: the amount of space between two places or objects (“The distance from my house to your house is two kilometers.”)
zh: n. 距离, 远方, 遥远
examples: Seen at a distance, the rock looks like a human face.
In the distance I hear the sound of softly murmuring roads.
exampleZh: 从远处看，岩石像一张人的脸。
我听到轻柔的沙沙声从远方的路上传来。

defsEn: to jump into water head first
zh: n. 潜水, 跳水
vi. 跳水, 俯冲, 猛冲
vt. 把...突然伸入
examples: He dived into the water and came up for air.
She dived into the swimming pool.
exampleZh: 他潜进水里，然后又浮上水来换气。
她跳入了游泳池。

defsEn: to separate into two or more parts
zh: vi. 分开, 分配, 分裂
vt. 分, 分开, 分裂, 除
n. 分配, 分水岭
examples: We divided the money between us.
Divide this line into twenty equal parts.
exampleZh: 我们平分这笔钱。
把这条线分成二十个等分。

defsEn: to act
to make an effort
zh: v. 做, 进行, 完成
examples: Do you want me to give you a ride?
Do you know the difference between good and bad?
exampleZh: 要不要我载你一程？
你知道分辨好坏吗？

defsEn: a person trained in medicine to treat sick people
zh: n. 医生, 博士
vt. 授以博士学位, 诊断, 修改
vi. 行医
examples: The doctor told her that she should take a rest.
The doctor will be here in a minute.
exampleZh: 医生告诉她要静养。
医生马上就来。

defsEn: an official piece of paper with facts written on it, used as proof or support of something
zh: n. 文件, 公文, 文档
vt. 证明, 为...引证
examples: This document was actually written by Tom.
The document could destroy the authority of the modern church.
exampleZh: 这文件其实是汤姆写的。

defsEn: a small animal that often lives with humans
zh: n. 狗, 坏蛋
vt. 跟踪, 尾随
examples: The dog fell asleep on top of the blanket.
A dog runs after a cat, and the cat after a mouse.
exampleZh: 狗在毯子上睡着了。
狗追猫，猫追鼠。

defsEn: United States money, one hundred cents dollar
zh: n. 美元, 元(加、澳等国货币单位)
examples: I paid five dollars for the book.
I paid ten dollars for this cap.
exampleZh: 我花了五元买这本书。
我付了十美元买这顶帽子。

defsEn: to present something as a gift to an organization, country or cause. (“She donated money to the Red Cross to help survivors of the earthquake.”)
zh: v. 捐赠
examples: He anonymously donated a large sum of money to the Red Cross.
He donated a large pile of items to the museum.
exampleZh: 他匿名向红十字捐了大笔钱。
他将一大堆东西捐赠给博物馆。

defsEn: an opening for entering or leaving a building or room
zh: n. 门
examples: The doors on the left side will open.
She gave the door a gentle push.
exampleZh: 左边的车门将会打开。
她轻轻地推了门。

defsEn: to increase two times as much in size, strength or number.
zh: n. 两倍
a. 两倍的, 双重的
vt. 使加倍
vi. 加倍, 代替, 快步走
examples: Tom doubled his investment in a year.
There are no double-decker buses in Algiers.
exampleZh: 汤姆一年内增加了一倍的投资。
阿尔及尔没有双层巴士。

defsEn: from higher to lower
in a low place
zh: a. 向下的
adv. 下, 下去, 降下
prep. 往下, 沿着
n. 丘陵, 软毛, 开阔的高地

defsEn: to have a picture or story in the mind during sleep
n. a picture or story in the mind during sleep
a happy idea about the future
zh: n. 梦, 空想, 愿望
v. 做梦, 想象, 梦想
examples: I dream about her a lot.
My dream is to be a baseball player.
exampleZh: 我经常梦见她。
我的梦想是成为一名棒球运动员。

defsEn: to take liquid into the body through the mouth
zh: n. 饮料, 酒
v. 喝, 喝酒
examples: If you drink instant coffee you do not need a coffee pot.
I drink coffee in a cafe.
exampleZh: 如果你喝速溶咖啡，就不需要咖啡壶了。
我在咖啡厅里喝咖啡。

defsEn: to control a moving vehicle
zh: n. 驾车, 快车道, 推进力, 驱动, 动力, 击球, 驱动器
vt. 开车, 驱使, 推动, 驾驶
vi. 开车, 猛击, 飞跑
examples: Could you drive to the station?
I'll drive you to the airport.
exampleZh: 你能开车去车站吗？
我载你去机场吖。

defsEn: to fall or let fall
to go lower
zh: n. 滴, 微量, 落下, 空投
vi. 放下, 掉下, 下降
vt. 使滴下, 放下, 丢失, 遗漏
examples: Drop me off at the front door, please.
Drop me a line as soon as you get there.
exampleZh: 请把我送到家门口。
到了那儿之后跟我说一声儿。

defsEn: to die under water
zh: vi. 淹死
vt. 把...淹死, 淹没
examples: The drowning man grasped at the rope.
Somebody had drowned her in the bathtub.
exampleZh: 那个溺水的男人抓紧了绳子。
有人把她淹死在浴缸里。

defsEn: anything used as a medicine or in making medicine
a chemical substance used to ease pain or to affect the mind
zh: n. 药, 麻药, 麻醉药
vi. 吸毒
vt. 使服麻醉药, 使麻木
examples: When taking drugs, follow the directions on the bottle carefully.
This drug will keep you up all night.
exampleZh: 吃药之前一定要仔细看说明书。

defsEn: not wet
without rain
zh: a. 干的, 无酒的, 枯燥无味的, 干燥的
vt. 把...弄干
vi. 变干
n. 干, 干涸
examples: He dried his wet clothes by the fire.
There wasn't a dry eye in the house.
exampleZh: 他在火旁烘干他的湿衣服。
房间里的人无一不泪流满面。

defsEn: through the whole time
while (something is happening)
zh: prep. 在...的时候
examples: During the Dragon Boat Festival, there needs to be a dragon boat race.
During the blizzard, I have to ride my bicycle back to the apartment.
exampleZh: 端午节要赛龙舟。
暴风雪的时候，我要骑自行车回公寓。

defsEn: pieces of matter so small that they can float in the air
zh: n. 灰尘, 尘埃, 粉末, 花粉, 土, 骚乱
vt. 拂去灰尘, 撒, 弄成粉末
vi. 拂去灰尘, 化为粉末
examples: She dusts the furniture every day.
Dust in the gears gummed up the machine.
exampleZh: 她每天擦拭家具的灰尘。
齿轮里的灰尘把机器卡住了。

defsEn: one’s job or responsibility
what one must do because it is right and just
zh: n. 责任, 关税, 职务, 尊敬
examples: It is the duty of every patriot to protect his country from its government.
It is our duty to obey the law.
exampleZh: 爱国者的责任就是保护国家不受政府侵犯。
遵守法律是我们的义务。

defsEn: every one by itself
zh: a. 每个, 每一
adv. 每个
pron. 每个, 个人, 各自
examples: Each movement of the dancer was perfect.
Each and every person is unique.
exampleZh: 这舞者的每一个动作都是完美的。
每一个人都是独一无二的。

defsEn: at or near the beginning, especially the beginning of the day
opposite late
zh: a. 早的, 早熟的
adv. 很早, 初
examples: I got up early, so that I could catch the first train.
I got up early to be in time for the train.
exampleZh: 我为了赶上第一列火车很早就起床了。
为了赶上那趟火车，我特意起了个大早。

defsEn: to be paid in return for work done
zh: vt. 赚得, 获得, 博得
examples: He earns more money than he can spend.
He earned as much money as possible.
exampleZh: 他赚那么多钱，根本用不完。
他能赚多少就赚多少。

defsEn: the planet we all live on
the ground or soil earth
zh: n. 地球, 泥土, 世界, 尘世
vt. 埋入土中, 赶入洞内
vi. 躲入洞内
examples: If the Earth went into an Ice Age next month, how would you prepare?
The earth is not a star, but a planet.
exampleZh: 如果地球下个月将进入冰河期，你将如何准备？
地球不是恒星，而是行星。

defsEn: a sudden, violent shaking of the earth’s surface
zh: n. 地震
examples: An earthquake can take place at any time.
An earthquake can happen at any time.
exampleZh: 地震随时都可能发生。
地震随时都可能发生。

defsEn: to reduce
to make less difficult
zh: n. 安乐, 安逸, 悠闲
vt. 使安乐, 使安心, 减轻, 放松
vi. 减轻, 放松, 灵活地移动
examples: Tom is ill at ease among strangers.
I am not at ease in a crowd.
exampleZh: 周围全是陌生人，这让汤姆感到很不自在。

defsEn: the direction from which the sun rises
zh: n. 东方, 东
a. 东方的, 向东的
adv. 向东方, 朝东方
examples: Nagoya is to the east of Kyoto.
In the east of the city, there is a big store.
exampleZh: 名古屋在京都的东方。

defsEn: not difficult
not hard to do
zh: a. 容易的, 缓缓的, 舒适的, 从容的, 宽容的, 流畅的, 随便的, 自在的, 疲软的
adv. 容易地, 慢慢地
examples: It was not easy to put out the fire at once.
It's not as easy to do that as people think.
exampleZh: 要即时扑灭那火灾并不容易。
这并不像一般人觉得的那么容易。

defsEn: to take food into the body through the mouth
zh: v. 吃, 腐蚀
examples: I eat and read at the same time.
Eat not only fish, but also meat.
exampleZh: 我边吃饭边看书。
不只吃鱼，也吃肉。

defsEn: the scientific study of the environment and links among living and material things
zh: n. 生态学, 社会生态学
examples: Ecology is very important to keep our world safe.
Ecology is the study of living things all around us.

defsEn: the system by which money, industry and trade are organized
zh: n. 经济, 理财, 节约
examples: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
Japan has an economy that is supported by hard-working company employees in big cities.
exampleZh: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。
日本的经济是由一群勤奋工作的大城市上班族支撑起的。

defsEn: the line where something ends or begins
zh: n. 边缘, 尖锐, 刀刃, 优势
vt. 使锐利, 挤进, 镶边
vi. 缓缓移动
examples: On the edge of the cliff bloom the most beautiful flowers.
At the edge of the road lay a dead shrew.

defsEn: the act of teaching
zh: n. 教育, 训练, 教育学
examples: Education in this world disappoints me.
Education is the path to happiness, peace, righteousness, and success.
exampleZh: 世界上的教育都让我失望。
教育是通往幸福、和平、正义与成功的道路。

defsEn: the result or change caused by something (“The storm had a serious effect on the economy.”)
zh: n. 结果, 影响, 效果, 印象
vt. 实行, 引起, 完成
examples: The effects of the atmosphere and ocean on the environment are very important.
It has had no effect on him.
exampleZh: 大气与海洋对于地球环境的影响十分重大。
这对他没有影响。

defsEn: an attempt
the work necessary to do something
zh: n. 努力, 成就
examples: Amy made an effort to stand up.
Tom's efforts to open a clothing store went up in smoke.
exampleZh: 艾美努力地站起来。
汤姆为了开一家服装店所花费的努力已经成为了泡影。

defsEn: the rounded object containing unborn young produced by female birds, fish or reptiles
a single cell in a female person or animal that can develop into a baby
zh: n. 蛋, 卵
vt. 挑唆, 煽动, 调蛋黄
examples: Mary took an egg and cracked it open on the rim of the bowl.
Mary took out the eggs one by one.
exampleZh: 玛丽娅拿了一个鸡蛋，并将它在碗沿上敲开。
玛丽把鸡蛋一颗一颗地取了出来。

defsEn: one of two, but not the other
zh: a. (两者之中)任一的, (两者之中)各一的
pron. (两者之中)任一
conj. 或, 要么
examples: Either you or I must attend the meeting.
Either you go, or I go.
exampleZh: 你和我其中一个要出席这次的会议。
要么你去，要么我去。

defsEn: to choose by voting
zh: n. 当选人, 被选的人
a. 被选的, 选出的
vt. 选举, 选择
vi. 作选择
examples: We elected her captain of our team.
He was elected mayor of the city.
exampleZh: 我们选她为我们队的队长。
他被选为市长。

defsEn: a small part of an atom that has an electrical force
zh: n. 电子
examples: Electrons orbit around the nucleus of the atom.
Electrons have a negative electrical charge.

defsEn: a form of energy that flows through wires to provide heat and light, and power to machines
zh: n. 电, 电流, 电学, 热情, 电力供应
examples: The electricity failed during the storm.
Electricity made candles of little use in our life.
exampleZh: 暴风雨中，停电了。
电使蜡烛在我们的生活中变得没什么用了。

defsEn: one of more than 100 substances known to science that cannot be separated into other substances
zh: n. 元件, 元素, 要素
examples: This element can be found in nature extremely rarely.
He's in his element when working on the farm.

defsEn: the offices of an ambassador and his or her assistants
zh: n. 大使馆, 大使馆全体人员
examples: The embassy is located next to the Supreme Court.
The Russian embassy might contact your employer to verify your employment.
exampleZh: 大使馆就在最高法院旁边。

defsEn: a human or animal in the earliest stages of its development
zh: n. 胚胎, 胎儿, 胚芽
examples: The embryo's cells respond differently depending on how many morphogens reach them.
The embryos and fetuses of all mammals look quite similar.

defsEn: an unexpected and dangerous situation demanding quick action
zh: n. 紧急状况, 紧急事件, 紧急需要
examples: In an emergency, use the stairway, not the elevator.
If there's an emergency, you must run out of the house through this exit.
exampleZh: 事故发生时，敬勿使用电梯，请使用楼梯。
有紧急情况时，必须通过这个出口跑出房子。

defsEn: a strong feeling such as love, hate, fear or sadness
zh: n. 情绪, 激动, 强烈的情感
examples: He hid his emotions and pretended to be enthusiastic.
Emotion counts above vocabulary in verbal communication.
exampleZh: 他把情感藏进了心底，装出热心的样子。

defsEn: to give work in return for wages
zh: n. 雇用
vt. 雇用, 使用, 使从事于
examples: She employed a private detective to keep a watch on her husband.
She employed him as a programmer.
exampleZh: 她雇了一个私人侦探看守她的丈夫。
她雇用他作程式设计师。

defsEn: having nothing inside
v. to remove everything
zh: a. 空的, 空虚的, 空腹的, 空洞的
n. 空的东西, 空车
vt. 倒空, 使变空, 使排出
vi. 流空
examples: In an empty place, an emperor has no power.
Empty the drawer of its contents.
exampleZh: 在空无一物的地方, 皇帝再大的权力也无用。
把抽屉清空。

defsEn: to stop
to finish
n. the part which comes last
zh: n. 结束, 终点, 目标, 末端, 梢, 死亡, 残余
v. 结束, 终结, 终止
examples: At the end of the ceremony, the new couple kissed.
In the end, what must I really believe in?
exampleZh: 典礼结束时，新人接了吻。
毕竟，我应认真相信些什么？

defsEn: a person opposing or hating another
a person or people of the other side in a war
zh: n. 敌人, 仇敌, 敌军
a. 敌人的
examples: The enemy made a strong attack on that building.
The enemy of my enemy is my friend.
exampleZh: 敌人对那栋建筑物使出了强力攻击。
敌人的敌人是朋友。

defsEn: power used to do work, usually with machines
the ability and willingness to be active
zh: n. 精力, 精神, 活力, 能量
examples: Energy will go wherever we direct it.
Energy is a word of Greek origin that means "activity".

defsEn: to make something be done
zh: vt. 强迫, 执行, 坚持
examples: Those who enforce the law must obey the law.
I enforce the rules even though I don't agree with them all.

defsEn: a machine that uses energy to cause movement or to do work
zh: n. 引擎, 发动机, 机车
vt. 安装发动机于
examples: This engine consumes the most oil.
The engine will stop when you push the button.
exampleZh: 这个引擎耗用最多的油。

defsEn: a person who designs engines, machines, roads, bridges or railroads
zh: n. 工程师, 工兵
vt. 设计, 监造, 精明地处理, 策划
examples: The engineer told us how to use the machine.
He grew up to be an engineer.
exampleZh: 工程师告诉我们如何使用机器。
他长大后成为了一名工程师。

defsEn: to be pleased or satisfied by something
zh: vt. 享受, 喜欢, 欣赏
examples: I enjoy the history of literature.
If you enjoy the work you do, you have something worth more than money.
exampleZh: 我挺喜欢文学史的。
如果你喜欢你做的工作，你就有比金钱更有价值的东西。

defsEn: as much as necessary
zh: n. 充足, 够, 很多
a. 充足的, 足够
adv. 足够
interj. 够了
examples: It is not enough to do good; one must also do it well.
It is not enough to study the language of a foreign country.
exampleZh: 做好事是不够的，还必须做得很好。
学习一种外国的语言不够了。

defsEn: to come or go into
zh: vt. 进入, 参加, 开始, 输入, 回车
vi. 进去, 参加
examples: On entering a dark tunnel, we could see nothing.
He entered the hall of fame.
exampleZh: 走进了漆黑的隧道后，我们什么也看不见。
他进入了名人堂。

defsEn: all surrounding things, conditions and influences that affect life
the natural world of land, sea, air, plants and animals
zh: n. 环境, 外界, 围绕
examples: The environment benefits from every small effort we make.
In the US, the environment is hostile to Islam.

defsEn: a special kind of protein
it produces changes in other substances without being changed itself
zh: n. 酶
examples: An enzyme is a protein that functions as a catalyst for a chemical reaction.
This enzyme is produced in the stomach.

defsEn: the same in amount, size, weight or value
having the same rights
zh: n. 对手, 匹敌, 同辈
a. 相等的, 平等的, 胜任的, 合适的, 平静的, 不相上下的
vt. 等于, 比得上
examples: Is she equal to a long journey?
He was equal to the job.
exampleZh: 她受得了长途旅行吗？
他胜任这份工作。

defsEn: things, tools or machines needed for a purpose or activity
zh: n. 装备, 设备, 才能
examples: What equipment do you need for your favorite sport?
Our equipment should be arriving soon.

defsEn: to get free
to get away from
to get out of
zh: n. 逃亡, 避难设备, 逃跑
vi. 逃脱, 避开, 溜走
vt. 逃避, 避免, 被...忘掉
examples: To escape the storm, we took shelter in a nearby barn.
They went to Edinburgh to escape from the summer heat.
exampleZh: 为躲避风暴，我们躲到了附近的一个谷仓内。
他们去了爱丁堡避暑。

defsEn: more than others (“We liked the food, especially the fish.”)
zh: adv. 尤其, 特别, 格外
examples: I especially like the flavour of the mushroom.
I especially love painting in watercolour.
exampleZh: 我特别喜欢蘑菇的味道。
我特别喜欢画水彩画。

defsEn: to bring into existence
to create
zh: vt. 建立, 确立, 制定
vi. 移植生长
examples: You establish the property right by paying for it.
They were established to celebrate a certain event or to tell an age-old legend.

defsEn: to form an opinion about a value, size or amount using less than complete information
zh: n. 估计, 判断
vt. 估计, 评价, 判断
vi. 估计
examples: We estimate that we could be there in a fortnight.
This estimate should be pretty accurate.

defsEn: of or concerning people belonging to a large group because of their race, religion, language, tribe or where their ancestors lived
zh: a. 人种的, 种族的
examples: If you are an ethnic writer, you have a burden of representation.
Ethnic minorities struggle against prejudice, poverty and so on.

defsEn: to change from a liquid into a gas
zh: 蒸
examples: The puddles evaporate quickly in the heat of the sun.
The rainwater evaporates on a hot day.

defsEn: in a way not thought possible (“They survived, even though the building was destroyed.”)
zh: a. 平坦的, 相等的, 连贯的, 均等的, 公平的, 偶数的, 平均的, 平衡的, 恰好的
vt. 使平坦, 使相等
vi. 变平, 成为相等
adv. 甚至, 实际上, 完全, 十分
n. 偶数, 偶校验
examples: Even a child can read this.
Even a child can understand that.
exampleZh: 这个连小孩都能读。
即使是一个小孩子都能理解。

defsEn: that which happens, especially something of importance
zh: n. 事件, 结果, 事情的进程, 竞赛项目
examples: The event is still fresh in our memory.
This event suddenly happened on its own.
exampleZh: 那件事在我们的脑海中还记忆犹新。
这件事突然自己发生的。

defsEn: at any time
zh: adv. 曾经, 究竟, 永远
examples: If you ever come back to me, I'll never treat you badly again.
Be it ever so humble, there's no place like home.
exampleZh: 如果你肯回到我的身边，我一定会永远好好待你。
金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝。

defsEn: each one
all
zh: a. 每一, 所有的
examples: Every day I take the tram to the office.
Every day I come to university by bus.
exampleZh: 我每天乘电车去办公室。
我每天坐公车来大学。

defsEn: material or facts that prove something
a reason for believing
zh: n. 根据, 证据, 迹象
examples: The evidence was in his favor.
What evidence of this do you have?
exampleZh: 证据对他有利。

defsEn: not good
extremely bad
zh: n. 邪恶, 不幸, 罪恶
a. 邪恶的, 不幸的, 有害的, 讨厌的
examples: That has been an evil rabbit.
He told me an evil word.
exampleZh: 那是一只有恶意的兔子。

defsEn: having no mistakes
correct in every detail
zh: a. 精确的, 准确的, 精密的
vt. 强求, 急需
examples: The exact time is three now.
What she told me was the exact opposite of what they told me yesterday.
exampleZh: 确切地说，现在三点了。

defsEn: to study closely
zh: v. 检查, 调查, 考试
examples: I had my teeth examined at the dentist's.
Examine the car before you drive it.
exampleZh: 我在牙医那儿检查了牙齿。

defsEn: a part that shows what the rest of a thing or group is like
zh: n. 例子, 样本, 实例
examples: The examples in this dictionary are easy to understand.
An example should make this clear.
exampleZh: 这本字典的例句十分浅白易懂。

defsEn: extremely good
zh: a. 优良的, 杰出的, 出色的
examples: He was an excellent scientist, and what is more, was a great poet.
He is an excellent fixer, and has always been regarded as such.
exampleZh: 他是一位优秀的科学家，更是一位伟大的诗人。
他是一个出色的调停者，并一直被人认为如此。

defsEn: but for
zh: vt. 除, 除外
vi. 反对
prep. 除了...之外, 若不是, 除非
conj. 只是
examples: Except for one person, everybody went home.
Except for cats, I like animals.
exampleZh: 除了一人，大家都回家了。
我喜欢动物，除了猫。

defsEn: to trade
to give or receive one thing for another
zh: n. 交换, (电话)交换局, 交换机, 汇兑, 交易所
v. 交换, 交易, 兑换
examples: The exchange rates for foreign currency change daily.
He exchanges money at the bank.
exampleZh: 外币的汇率天天都变。
他在银行换钱。

defsEn: to take away blame
to pardon
to forgive
n. a reason (sometimes false) for an action
zh: vt. 原谅, 申辩, 做为...的托辞
n. 致歉, 理由, 饶恕, 借口
examples: Excuse me, could you pass me the sugar?
Excuse me, but may I open the window?
exampleZh: 打扰一下，你能把糖递给我吗？
不好意思，请问我可以开窗吗？

defsEn: to kill
zh: vt. 执行, 实行, 完成, 处死, 制成
examples: He could not execute his plan.
He'll execute the plan tomorrow at noon.

defsEn: an activity or effort for the purpose of improving the body or to stay in good health
zh: n. 行使, 执行, 运动, 练习, 作业
vt. 运用, 练习, 运动
vi. 练习, 锻炼
examples: I exercise for one hour every day.
This exercise is good for the lower back.
exampleZh: 我每天运动一小时。
这项运动对下背部有益。

defsEn: to force a person to leave his or her country
to expel
n. a person who is forced to leave his or her country
zh: n. 放逐, 流放, 被放逐者
vt. 放逐, 流放, 使背井离乡
examples: He became an exile in his own country.
He went into exile in France.

defsEn: to be
to live
zh: vi. 存在, 生存, 发生
examples: If you're not on Facebook, you don't exist!
If you exist, please give me a sign.
exampleZh: 要是脸书上没有你，你就不存在！

defsEn: to make larger
to grow larger
zh: vt. 使膨胀, 详述, 扩张
vi. 张开, 发展
vt. 展开
vi. 展开
examples: I expand my knowledge by reading books.
Detours expand your knowledge of the surroundings.

defsEn: to think or believe that something will happen
to wait for an event
zh: vt. 预期, 盼望, 期待
examples: We expect him to come back soon.
I expect that he will help us.
exampleZh: 我们觉得他一会儿就回来了。
我期望他会帮助我们。

defsEn: to force out
to remove from
to send away
zh: vt. 驱逐, 逐出, 排出, 开除
examples: I got expelled from school during my senior year.
Why did they expel Tom from that school?

defsEn: to live through an event, situation or condition (“She experienced great pain.”)
n. something that one has done or lived through (“The experience caused her great pain.”)
zh: n. 经历, 经验, 体验
vt. 经历, 经验, 体验
examples: With my experience, I can easily find a job.
That experience left a bad taste in my mouth.

defsEn: to test
n. a test or trial carried out to prove if an idea is true or false, or to discover something
zh: n. 实验, 试验, 实验仪器
vi. 实验, 尝试
examples: This experiment should answer that question.
The experiment eventually failed due to a lack of support.

defsEn: a person with special knowledge or training
zh: n. 专家, 行家
a. 老练的, 内行的, 专门的
examples: He is an expert in the area of city planning.
She said that she's no expert.
exampleZh: 他是个城市规划的专家。
她说她并非专家。

defsEn: to give reasons for
to make clear
to tell about
to tell the meaning
zh: v. 解释, 说明
examples: I'll explain to you how to use it when I come back.
He explained his plan both to my son and to me.
exampleZh: ­我回来就解释给你听怎么用。
他把他的打算解释了给我和我的儿子两个人听。

defsEn: to break apart violently with a loud noise, like a bomb
zh: vi. 爆炸, 爆发, 激增
vt. 使爆炸
examples: It exploded with a loud noise.
Meteors explode when they reach the Earth's atmosphere.
exampleZh: 它发出巨响爆炸了。

defsEn: to travel in a place that is not well known to learn more about it
to make a careful search
to examine closely
zh: v. 探险, 探测, 探究
examples: They explored every avenue in an attempt to avoid war.
They explore the impact of music on society.
exampleZh: 他们尽一切手段避免战争。

defsEn: to send to another country
n. something sent to another country, usually for sale
zh: n. 输出品, 输出
vt. 输出, 出口
vi. 输出物资
examples: Export of the product will start soon.
We export a lot of automobiles to that country.

defsEn: to say clearly
zh: n. 快车, 快递, 专使
a. 明确的, 丝毫不差的, 专门的, 快的
vt. 表达, 表示, 表露
examples: We expressed the hope that they could go abroad again to study geography.
Express yourself as clearly as possible.
exampleZh: 我们表示希望他们能再次出国学习地理。
尽可能明确地表达你自己。

defsEn: to stretch out in area or length
to continue for a longer time
zh: v. 扩充, 延伸, 伸展, 扩大
examples: The Alps extend across eight European countries.
She extended her stay by five days.
exampleZh: 阿尔卑斯山地跨欧洲八国。
她延长停留五天。

defsEn: more than normal, expected or necessary
zh: n. 额外的事物, 另外的收费
a. 额外的, 特别的
adv. 额外地, 特别地, 非常地
examples: Extra! Extra! Read all about it!
There's an extra charge at the hotel for Internet access.

defsEn: far greater or better than the usual or normal
zh: a. 非常的, 特别的, 非凡的
examples: The iPhone is an extraordinary cell phone.
Rosa Montero is an extraordinary woman.
exampleZh: 苹果是非凡的手机。
Rosa Montero是个不同寻常的女人。

defsEn: more than the usual or accepted
zh: n. 极端, 末端
a. 极端的, 尽头的, 极度的, 偏激的
examples: She is extreme in her taste in clothes.
Extreme evil needs an extreme remedy.

defsEn: a person with strong religious or political beliefs who acts in an extreme or violent way
zh: 偏激份子
examples: Zionist extremists reject the name "West Bank."
He is not a Muslim extremist.

defsEn: the front of the head: eyes, nose, mouth
v. to look toward
to turn toward
to have before you, such as a problem or danger
zh: n. 脸, 面容, 正面, 外观
vt. 面对, 朝, 正视, 面临
vi. 朝, 向
examples: He has a face only a mother could love.
A face with too much make up looks strange.
exampleZh: 他有一张只有母亲爱的脸。
化妆太浓的话脸会看着很奇怪。

defsEn: something known or proved to be true
zh: n. 事实, 真实性, 真相, 细节, 论据
examples: The fact is, I think, very important.
In fact, he too loved her.
exampleZh: 我认为这个事实很重要。
其实，他也爱着她。

defsEn: a building or group of buildings where goods are made
zh: n. 工厂, 产生地, 代理店
examples: The factory waste gave rise to serious environmental pollution.
There is no factory in this village.
exampleZh: 工厂的废料导致了严重的环境污染。
这座村里没有工厂。

defsEn: to not succeed
to not reach a goal
zh: vi. 失败, 缺乏, 中断, 衰退, 失灵
vt. 忘记, 使...失望, 缺乏, 不及格
n. 不及格
examples: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.
He failed in the examination for lack of preparation.
exampleZh: 他试图游过河，但是失败了。
他因为准备太少考试不及格了。

defsEn: just
honest
what is right
zh: n. 展览会, 市集, 美好的事物
a. 公平的, 按规则进行的, 不好不坏的, 晴朗的, 美丽的
adv. 公平地, 正面地, 有教养地, 清楚地
vi. 转晴
examples: It's not fair! I have to do the hard work!
This is not fair. She can go but I can't go.
exampleZh: 这不公平！凭什么我必须做艰苦的工作。
这不公平, 她能去我却不能去。

defsEn: to go down quickly
to come down
to drop to the ground or a lower position
zh: n. 落下, 瀑布, 采伐量, 下降, 落差, 降低, 堕落, 秋天
vi. 倒下, 落下, 来临, 失守, 阵亡, 下跌, 减弱, 倾斜, 垮台, 轮到, 变成, 降低
a. 秋天的
examples: A fall into a pit, a gain in your wit.
Did you fall in love with her at first sight?
exampleZh: 吃一堑长一智。
你对她是不是一见钟情？

defsEn: not true
not correct
zh: a. 错误的, 虚伪的, 假的, 不老实的
adv. 不准确地, 欺诈地
examples: It lulls us into a false sense of security.
He made a false statement to the police.

defsEn: the group that includes children and their parents
zh: n. 家庭, 家人, 族
a. 家庭的
examples: My family live in that house.
The family was highly doubtful of the statement from the military.
exampleZh: 我的家人住在那间房子。
家属对军方的说法高度置疑。

defsEn: known very well to many people
zh: a. 出名的, 极好的
examples: She's famous as a singer but not as a poet.
He is a famous baseball player.
exampleZh: 她是一个有名的歌手，但却没有多少人知道她也有写诗。
他是一位著名的棒球选手。

defsEn: a person who actively supports a sport, activity or performer (“The baseball fan attended every game his team played.”)
zh: n. 风扇, 迷, 狂热者, 爱好者
vt. 煽动, 刺激, 吹拂
vi. 飘动, 成扇形散开
examples: The fans all hope the club will change the manager.
She's a fan of Italian opera.
exampleZh: 球迷们都希望球队能换个教练。
她是意大利歌剧的粉丝。

defsEn: at, to or from a great distance
zh: a. 远的, 久远的, 遥远的
adv. 甚远地, 很, 到很深的程度, 到很远的距离
examples: How far do you want to go?
Far from eye, far from heart.
exampleZh: 你要走多远？
眼不见，心不烦。

defsEn: land used to grow crops and animals for food
zh: n. 农场, 农田
vt. 耕种
vi. 种田
examples: The farm-girl would be his lady.
Farm work requires a lot of physical strength.

defsEn: moving or working at great speed
quick
zh: a. 快速的, 紧的
adv. 很快地, 紧紧地, 彻底地
n. 绝食, 斋戒
vi. 绝食, 斋戒
examples: I ran as fast as possible to catch up with him.
I ran as fast as possible to catch up with her.
exampleZh: 我尽力追赶他。
我尽快跑以赶上她。

defsEn: tissue in the bodies of humans and animals used to store energy and to keep warm
ad. thick
heavy
zh: n. 脂肪, 脂油, 肥肉
a. 肥的, 胖的, 油腻的
n. 文件分配表
examples: Were you fat when you were in high school?
That fat girl consumes too much sugary food.
exampleZh: 你在高中的时候胖吗？
那个胖女孩吃了太多含高糖份的饮食。

defsEn: the male parent
a man who has a child or children
zh: n. 父亲, 祖先, 长辈, 神父, 创始者
vt. 当...的父亲, 保护, 创作, 发明, 培养
examples: My father asked me to go to the concert.
My father will retire at the age of sixty.
exampleZh: 父亲让我去演唱会。
我父亲六十岁就要退休了。

defsEn: liked more than others (“Ice cream was her favorite food.”)
zh: n. 喜欢的事物, 幸运儿
a. 特别受喜爱的, 喜爱的, 宠爱的, 中意的
examples: My favorite word in German is the word for "glove".
What's your favorite season of the year?
exampleZh: 我最喜欢的德文字是「手套」。
一年之中，你最喜欢哪个季节？

defsEn: to be afraid
to worry that something bad is near or may happen (“He feared falling down.”)
n. a strong emotion when there is danger or trouble (“He had a fear that he would fall down.”)
zh: n. 恐怖, 害怕, 担心
v. 害怕, 恐惧, 为...担心, 敬畏
examples: I fear this work will take up most of my time.
There's a fear that the snow will strengthen amid the strong winter pressure pattern.
exampleZh: 我怕这项工作会占用我大部份的时间。
人们担心在强劲的冬季气压模式下，降雪量会增加。

defsEn: of or having to do with a national or central government
zh: a. 联邦的, 联合的, 同盟的
examples: Federal, state, and community officials immediately pledged to rebuild it.
Federal grants have also contributed to economic growth and stability.
exampleZh: 联邦、州及地方官员立即承诺将其重建。

defsEn: to give food to
zh: n. 饲料, 一餐, 饲养
vt. 喂, 饲养, 放牧, 靠...为生
vi. 吃东西, 用餐, 流入
examples: She feeds her dog a meat-free diet.
Tom feeds his dog at the same time every day.

defsEn: to have or experience an emotion
to know by touching
zh: vt. 感觉, 觉得, 触摸, 以为
vi. 有知觉, 摸索, 同情
n. 感觉, 觉得, 触摸
examples: How would you feel if your wife left you?
I feel that the German language can be very difficult.
exampleZh: 如果你的妻子离开了你，你会怎么想？
我觉得德语很难。

defsEn: a woman or girl
the sex that gives birth
ad. of or about women
zh: n. 女性, 女人, 雌性动物
a. 女性的, 女子的
examples: A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.
The female police officer was in fear for her life.
exampleZh: 我的一个女性朋友喜欢跟我一起去同志酒吧。

defsEn: something around an area of land to keep animals or people in or out
zh: n. 围墙, 栅栏, 买卖赃物的人, 剑术
vt. 用篱笆围住, 练习剑术, 防护
vi. 击剑, 搪塞
examples: There is a fence around the house.
There is a fence marking the boundary between our yard and the neighbor's.
exampleZh: 这栋房子的周围有篱笆。
我家和邻居家以院子之间的篱笆为分界线。

defsEn: rich in production of plants or animals
producing much
zh: a. 可繁殖的, 肥沃的, 生产多的
examples: It's fertile land inhabited by diverse nations.
Fertile soil is indispensable for a good harvest.
exampleZh: 这是一片肥沃的土地，居住着不同的民族。

defsEn: unborn young
zh: 胎儿；胚胎
examples: A fetus is not a baby.
A fetus is not a person.

defsEn: not many
a small number of
zh: a. 很少的, 不多的, 少数的
n. 少数
examples: Few people know how to do it.
Few, if any, will criticize him.
exampleZh: 很少有人知道怎么做。
很少有人会批评他，即使有也不多。

defsEn: an area of open land, usually used to grow crops or to raise animals
zh: n. 领域, 田地, 场地, 战场, 场, 域
vt. 使...晒在场上, 使上场
a. 田间的, 野生的, 野外的, 田赛的
examples: Field hockey is not very popular in China.
What is your field of study, your domain of inquiry, your major interest?
exampleZh: 曲棍球在中国不是很流行。

defsEn: extremely strong
violent
angry
zh: a. 凶猛的, 猛烈的, 热烈的, 暴躁的
examples: The fierce repression left the country in shock.
On Thursday a fierce hurricane will reach our country.

defsEn: to use violence or force
to attempt to defeat or destroy an enemy
n. the use of force
a battle
zh: n. 打架, 争吵, 斗志
v. 对抗, 打架
examples: I fight in the cause of justice.
I am fighting for my future.
exampleZh: 我为正义而战。
我为我前途奋斗。

defsEn: to put or pour something into a container until there is space for no more
zh: vt. 装满, 填充, 弥漫, 供给, 满足, 供应
vi. 充满, 变得沉重
n. 满足, 装满, 充分, 填方
vt. 填充
vi. 填充
examples: Fill in your name and address.
I filled up the vase with water.
exampleZh: 填上你的姓名和地址。
我倒水进去花瓶里。

defsEn: to record something so it can be seen again
to make a motion picture or movie
n. a thin piece of material for making pictures with a camera
a movie
zh: n. 软片, 薄膜, 胶卷, 电影
vt. 覆以薄膜, 拍摄
vi. 生薄膜, 拍电影
examples: Which film do you like most?
This film is very nice to look at.
exampleZh: 你最喜欢的电影是哪部？
这部电影很好看。

defsEn: at the end
last
zh: n. 期末考试, 结局, 决赛
a. 最后的, 终极的, 决定性的
examples: The final exams will probably carry over into next month.
The final situation has value in the development of the event.
exampleZh: 期末考试也许要持续到下个月吧。

defsEn: of or about the system that includes the use of money, credit, investments and banks
zh: a. 财政的, 金融的
examples: A financial collapse in Algeria could be a major disaster.
A financial issue threw the project off course.

defsEn: to discover or learn something by searching or by accident
to decide a court case (“The jury finds the man guilty of murder.”)
zh: vt. 发现, 感到, 找到, 认为, 得到
vi. 裁决
n. 发现
寻找指定的字符串, 将符合条件的行或行数输出到标准输出设备上
examples: We find it difficult to decide which one to buy.
Find a mall near the school.
exampleZh: 我们觉得很难决定买哪一个。
找个学校附近的商场。

defsEn: a payment ordered by a court to punish someone for a crime
ad. very good
very small or thin
zh: n. 罚款, 罚金, 晴天, 精细
a. 好的, 晴朗的, 健康的, 细小的, 精细的
vt. 罚款, 精炼, 澄清
vi. 变清, 变细
adv. 很好
examples: If it is fine tomorrow, we will play baseball.
I had a fine old time.
exampleZh: 如果明天天气好，我们就去打棒球。
我有一段美好的旧时光。

defsEn: to complete
to end
zh: n. 完成, 结束, 末道漆, 磨光, 完美
vt. 完成, 结束, 用完, 毁掉
vi. 结束
examples: I finished the work in less than an hour.
She finished her work an hour in advance.
exampleZh: 我用不到一小时就完成了这个工作。
她提前一小时完成了工作。

defsEn: to shoot a gun
n. the heat and light produced by something burning fire
zh: n. 火, 炉火, 电炉, 火灾, 闪光体, 炮火, 热情
vt. 点燃, 烧制, 使发光, 激动, 放枪, 解雇
vi. 着火, 烧火, 开枪, 射击, 激动
examples: The fire spread out in a fan-shape.
A fire broke out in my neighborhood last night.
exampleZh: 火势以扇形迅速蔓延。
昨晚我邻居家着火了。

defsEn: rockets producing bright fire in the sky, used in holiday celebrations
zh: n. 烟火, 激烈争论
examples: They set off fireworks to celebrate the holiday.
They set off fireworks with a great bang.

defsEn: not easily moved or changed (“She is firm in her opinion.”)
zh: n. 公司, 商号
a. 坚定的, 坚强的, 牢固的, 结实的, 坚硬的, 坚挺的, 严格的, 确定的
vt. 使牢固, 使坚定
vi. 变稳固, 变坚实
adv. 稳固地
examples: With a firm goal in mind, you will do well.
The firm went under due to lack of capital.
exampleZh: 有了坚定的目标，你会做得很好。
公司由于缺乏资本倒闭了。

defsEn: coming before all others
zh: adv. 首先, 第一, 优先
a. 第一的
num. 第一
n. 开始, 第一
examples: First they laugh at you, then they fight you, and then you win.
First off, I'd like you to come with me to a department store sale.
exampleZh: 首先他们嘲笑你，其次他们和你争执，然后你赢了。
首先，我要你跟我一起去百货公司的特价活动。

defsEn: a creature that lives and can breathe in water fish
zh: n. 鱼, 鱼肉, 鱼类, 接合板
vt. 钓, 钓鱼, 查出, 用接合板连接
vi. 捕鱼, 钓鱼, 用钩捞取, 摸索寻找
examples: Fish have stopped living in this river.
This fish is not fit to eat.
exampleZh: 这条河里已经没有鱼了。
这条鱼不能吃了。

defsEn: a splitting
in atomic fission, the nucleus of an atom is split to produce nuclear energy
zh: n. 裂开, 分裂, 分体
examples: Nuclear power plants rely upon the fission of uranium to generate heat.
What's the difference between fission and fusion?

defsEn: to be of the correct size or shape (“These shoes fit my feet.”)
zh: n. 适宜, 合身, 发作, 痉挛
a. 适宜的, 对的, 准备好的
vt. 适合, 安装, 使合身, 使适应, 使合格
vi. 适合, 符合, 合身
examples: I'm not fit for physical labor.
We fit together perfectly and complete each other.
exampleZh: 我不能做体力劳动。

defsEn: to make good or right again
zh: vt. 使固定, 修理, 准备, 安装, 凝视, 牢记, 确定, 整理
vi. 固定, 注视, 确定
n. 困境, 方位, 维修, 贿赂
examples: I got him to fix my bicycle.
I'm fixing the radio which I found on my way home.
exampleZh: 我让他修理了我的脚踏车。
我在修理回家路上捡到的收音机。

defsEn: a piece of colored cloth used to represent a nation, government or organization
zh: n. 标志, 旗标, 旗子, 信号旗, 菖蒲
vt. 悬旗, 打旗号, 铺石板
vi. 无力地下垂
examples: A flag is a national symbol.
This is the flag of Japan.
exampleZh: 旗帜是国家象征。
这是日本国旗。

defsEn: smooth
having no high places
zh: a. 平坦的, 单调的, 无力的, 浅的, 萧条的, 干脆的, 无聊的
adv. 平直地, 断然地
n. 扁平物, 平面, 平地, 平原, 平板车
v. (使)变平
examples: He flat out asked you, "Step up!".
He told me flat out that I should never do it again.

defsEn: to run away from
zh: vt. 逃避, 逃跑, 逃走
vi. 逃, 消失
examples: If you flee this battle, you will lose some gold.
Flee to Egypt and stay there until I tell you otherwise.

defsEn: to be on water without sinking
to move or be moved gently on water or through air
zh: n. 漂流物, 浮舟, 漂浮, 浮萍, 彩车
vi. 浮动, 飘动, 散播, 摇摆, 动摇, 浮动
vt. 使漂浮, 容纳, 淹没, 发行, 实行
examples: The petals are floating on the water.
Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee.
exampleZh: 花瓣浮在水面上。

defsEn: to cover with water
n. the movement of water out of a river, lake or ocean onto land
zh: n. 洪水, 大量之水, 涨潮
vt. 淹没, 使泛滥, 注满
vi. 被淹, 溢出, 涌进
examples: The flood caused a lot of damage.
The flood water reached the level of the windows.
exampleZh: 洪水造成了很大的损害。
洪水涌到了窗户的高度。

defsEn: the bottom part of a room for walking on (“The book fell to the floor.”)
the level of a building (“The fire was on the first floor.”)
zh: n. 地板, 楼层, 底部, 底价
vt. 铺地板, 打倒
n. 地面, 地板, 基底
examples: What floor do you live on?
Which floor do you live on?
exampleZh: 你住在哪层楼？
你住在哪层楼？

defsEn: to move like a liquid
zh: n. 流程, 流动, 流量, 洋溢, 泛滥, 涨潮
vi. 流动, 流泄, 畅流, 川流不息, 飘扬, 涌出
vt. 使流动, 淹没, 流出
examples: The flow of the water was strong enough to wash away the bridge.
The Rhine flows between France and Germany.
exampleZh: 水流的强力把桥给冲垮了。
莱茵河流经法国和德国国界。

defsEn: the colored part of plants that carry seeds
zh: n. 花, 开花植物, 精华, 盛时
vi. 开花, 发育, 旺盛, 成熟
vt. 用花装饰, 使开花
examples: The flowers will look more beautiful in the vase.
Flower arrangement is a part of Japanese culture.
exampleZh: 把这些花插在花瓶里会更好看。
花道是日本文化的一部分。

defsEn: any substance that can flow, such as a liquid flower
zh: n. 液体, 分泌液, 流体
a. 流动的, 可改变的
examples: This fluid can be substituted for glue.
Martino took a fluid sample from the meteor.

defsEn: to move through the air with wings, like a bird or airplane
to travel in an airplane or flying vehicle
zh: n. 苍蝇, 两翼昆虫, 飞行
vi. 飞, 飞翔, 飘扬, 逃走
vt. 飞, 飞越, 使飘扬, 逃出
a. 敏捷的
examples: A fly can walk on the ceiling.
There is a fly on the ceiling.
exampleZh: 苍蝇能在天花板上走。
天花板上面有只苍蝇。

defsEn: a mass of wet air that is difficult to see through
a cloud close to the ground
zh: n. 雾, 迷惑, (割后的)最生草, 苔藓
vi. 被雾笼罩, 变模糊
vt. 使困惑, 以雾笼罩
examples: There was fog at noon yesterday.
The fog began to disappear around ten o'clock.
exampleZh: 昨天中午有雾。
雾在十时左右开始散了。

defsEn: to come or go after
to accept the rule or power of
to obey
zh: vt. 跟随, 沿行, 遵循, 追求
vi. 跟随, 接着
n. 跟随, 追随
examples: Follow your own path and let people talk.
Follow the example of your sister.
exampleZh: 走自己的路，让别人去说吧。
学学你姐姐。

defsEn: that which is taken in by all living things for energy, strength and growth
zh: n. 食物, 养料
examples: Food, clothing and shelter are the basis of life.
This food is enough to feed two people.
exampleZh: 衣食住是生存的基础。
这些食物够两个人吃了。

defsEn: to make someone believe something that is not true
to trick
n. a person who is tricked easily
zh: n. 愚人, 受骗者, 奶油拌水果
vt. 愚弄, 欺骗, 浪费
vi. 干傻事, 开玩笑, 游荡
a. 傻的
examples: A fool and his money are soon parted.
Fools rush in where angels fear to tread.
exampleZh: 笨蛋难聚财。
初生之犊不畏虎。

defsEn: the bottom part of the leg
the part of the body that touches the ground when a person or animal walks
zh: n. 脚, 步调, 英尺, 底部, 末尾, 步兵
vt. 走在...上, 给...换底, 支付
vi. 跳舞, 步行, 总计
examples: At the foot of the hill you'll see a white building.
Which foot do you brake with?
exampleZh: 你会在山脚下看到一栋白色的建筑物。

defsEn: because of (“He is famous for his work.”)
in exchange (“Give me one dollar for the book.”)
through space or time (“They traveled for one hour.”)
representative of (“I speak for all people.”)
to be employed by (“She works for a computer company.”)
zh: prep. 为, 因为, 至于
conj. 因为
examples: For some reason I feel more alive at night.
As for me, I have nothing to say.
exampleZh: 不知道为什么我夜里觉得比较有活力。
以我之见，我无话可说。

defsEn: to make someone do something or make something happen by using power
n. power, strength
strength used against a person or object
military power of a nation
a military group
zh: n. 力量, 武力, 势力, 影响力, 军队, 力, 效力
vt. 强迫, 强夺, 推动, 提高
examples: He forced me to go there.
He forced her to sit down.
exampleZh: 他强迫我到那里去。
他强迫她坐下。

defsEn: of, about or from another nation
not from one’s own place or country
zh: a. 外国的, 外交的, 外省的, 外来的, 不相关的
examples: The Foreign Minister said that war was inevitable.
A foreign language can't be mastered in a year or so.
exampleZh: 外交部长称战争在所难免。
一个外国语言无法在一年左右就被掌握。

defsEn: a place of many trees
zh: n. 森林, 林区
vt. 植树于
examples: A forest fire broke out in this area.
This forest goes on for a while.
exampleZh: 这地区发生了山火。
这树林延续数里。

defsEn: to not remember
zh: vt. 忘记, 忽略, 忘
vi. 忘记
examples: Forget it, let us talk about happy stuff!
I forget where I put my hat.
exampleZh: 算了，我们聊点开心的事吧！
我忘了我把我的帽子放在哪里了。

defsEn: to pardon
to excuse
to remove guilt
zh: vt. 原谅, 宽恕, 免除
examples: Forgive me for being frank. You have erred.
To forgive others is an act of kindness to yourself.
exampleZh: 恕我直言：你犯了一个错。
原谅别人就是善待自己。

defsEn: to make
to start
to shape (“They formed a swim team.”)
n. a kind (“Swimming is a form of exercise.”)
zh: n. 形状, 形体, 类型, 方式, 表格, 形式
v. 形成, 排列, (使)组成
n. 表单
examples: This form looks kind of complicated. Help me fill it out.
Once you've formed a bad habit, you can't get rid of it easily.
exampleZh: 这个表格好像有点复杂，你可以帮我填吗？
坏习惯一旦被养成，便不能简单地改正。

defsEn: earlier in time
not now forest
zh: a. 从前的, 前者的
n. 起形成作用的人(或物), 模型, 样板
examples: When I met my former teacher, he inquired after my parents.
Kyoto is the former capital of Japan.
exampleZh: 我遇见了以前的班主任时，他问候了我的父母。
京都市曾经是日本的首都。

defsEn: the direction in front of
toward the front
zh: a. 向前的, 早的, 迅速的, 在前的, 进步的
vt. 促进...的生长, 转寄, 运送
adv. 向前地
examples: Forward this money to my mother.
The forward of his command should learn to admit defeats.

defsEn: to release
ad. not controlled by another or by outside forces
not in prison
independent
not limited by rules
without cost
zh: a. 自由的, 享受政治权力的, 允许的, 免费的, 丰富的
vt. 释放, 解放, 使自由
adv. 自由地, 免费
examples: You are free to do as you please with your money.
If I were free, I would accept your invitation.
exampleZh: 你可以随你高兴的用你的钱。
如果我当时有空，我一定会应邀的。

defsEn: the condition of being free
zh: n. 自由, 坦率, 特权
examples: Freedom is the center of American democracy.
Freedom of speech is now taken as a matter of course.
exampleZh: 美国民主的中心思想是自由。
现在言论自由被当作是理所当然的事。

defsEn: to cause or to become very cold
to make or to become hard by cold
zh: vi. 冻结, 冷冻, 僵硬, 楞住
vt. 使结冰, 使冻住, 使呆住
n. 结冰, 凝固
examples: He freezed the room over with his cold-as-ice look.
He freezed out the room with his icy stare.

defsEn: newly made or gathered
recent
zh: a. 新鲜的, 新奇的, 另外的, 淡的, 精神饱满的, 冒失的
adv. 最新地, 刚刚
n. 开始, 泛滥
examples: The fresh snow looks beautiful on the hill.
Fresh fruit is good for your health.
exampleZh: 刚从天上降下来的雪，铺满了整个山头，看起来美丽极了。
新鲜水果对身体好。

defsEn: a person one likes and trusts
zh: n. 朋友, 支持者, 赞助者
examples: A friend of mine asked me to send her a postcard.
My friend can speak Chinese and Japanese.
exampleZh: 我的一位朋友要求我寄给她一张明信片。
我朋友会说汉语和日语。

defsEn: to cause great fear
zh: vt. 使惊吓
vi. 惊恐
examples: I was frightened by the sight.
I am not frightened of anything.
exampleZh: 我被这情景吓到了。
我不害怕任何东西。

defsEn: having a person, place or thing as a beginning or cause (“It is a message from the president.”)
at a place distant, not near (“The school is five kilometers from my home.”)
because of (“He is suffering from cancer.”)
zh: prep. 从, 来自, 根据
examples: From here we see the city.
From the look of the sky, it may rain in the afternoon.
exampleZh: 我们从这里看到城市。
从天色看起来，下午可能会下雨。

defsEn: the forward part
the opposite of back
the beginning
the first part
zh: n. 前面, 开头, 前线, 阵线, 态度
vt. 面对, 朝向, 对抗
vi. 朝向
examples: I sat at the front in order to hear the lecture clearly.
In front of the train station there's a bank.
exampleZh: 我想听清楚演讲内容，便坐在了前面。
车站前有个银行。

defsEn: food from trees and plants
zh: n. 水果, 果类, 结果
examples: What fruit do you like the most?
What fruit do you like the best?
exampleZh: 你最喜欢什么水果？
你最喜欢什么水果？

defsEn: any substance burned to create heat or power
zh: n. 燃料, 木炭
vt. 加燃料, 供燃料
vi. 得到燃料
examples: The fuel tank in the car is full.
When did the fuel gauge stop working?
exampleZh: 汽车油箱是满的。
油表是什么时候坏的？

defsEn: containing as much as a person or thing can hold
complete
zh: n. 全部, 完整
a. 充满的, 完全的, 丰富的, 完美的, 丰满的, 详尽的
adv. 完全地, 整整, 十分
vt. 把(衣服等)缝得宽松, 漂洗
examples: She's not a full-time employee of this company.
A full moon can be seen tonight.
exampleZh: 她不是这间公司正式的职员。
今晚能看到满月。

defsEn: anything that is pleasing and causes happiness
zh: n. 乐趣, 玩笑, 娱乐
vi. 开玩笑
a. 供娱乐用的
examples: It's fun to learn a foreign language.
We made fun of him about this.
exampleZh: 学外语很有意思。
我们取笑了他这一点。

defsEn: a ceremony held in connection with the burial or burning of the dead
zh: n. 葬礼, 出殡
examples: Tom's funeral will be this weekend.
I went to three funerals last month.
exampleZh: 汤姆的葬礼订在这周末。
上个月我参加了三场葬礼。

defsEn: a joining together
in atomic fusion, atomic particles are joined together to produce nuclear energy
zh: n. 熔合物, 结合, 熔合
examples: Nuclear fusion could wean the global economy off fossil fuels.
Everyone coming together is an example of fusion.

defsEn: time after now (“We can talk about it in the future.”)
ad. in the time to come (“All future meetings will be held in this room.”)
zh: n. 未来, 将来
a. 将来的, 未来的
examples: In the future, will robots be as common as personal computers?
In the future, people who live in equatorial regions will probably be climate refugees.
exampleZh: 未来，机器人会像个人电脑一样普及吗？
在未来，赤道附近的居民很有可能成为气候难民。

defsEn: to get possession of
to get more
to increase
zh: n. 增益, 获得, 利润, 收获, 增加
vt. 得到, 增进, 赚到
vi. 获利, 增加
examples: You gain more than you spend when you go to college.
He gained the power to summon ghost trains.
exampleZh: 上大学的时候，你得到的比付出的还多。
他获得了召唤幽灵列车的能力。

defsEn: an activity with rules in which people or teams play or compete, usually sports
zh: n. 比赛, 玩耍, 比分, 得胜, 比赛规则, 策略, 游戏, 野味
vi. 赌博
a. 勇敢的, 有胆量的, 关于野味的, 跛的
examples: The game will be played rain or shine.
The game will probably be called off.
exampleZh: 无论刮风还是下雨，比赛都会继续进行下去。
这场比赛将可能被取消。

defsEn: any substance that is not solid or liquid
any substance that burns to provide heat, light or power
zh: n. 气体, 汽油, 瓦斯
examples: The gas gives off a strong, unpleasant smell.
Is there a gas station near here?
exampleZh: 这个气体散发出强烈难闻的气味。
这里附近有没有加油站？

defsEn: to bring or come together into a group or place
to collect
zh: n. 集合, 聚集
vi. 聚集, 集合, 渐增
vt. 使聚集, 搜集, 积聚
examples: We gather here once a week.
I gather that they'll agree with us.
exampleZh: 我们每周在这儿聚一次。
我猜想他们会同意我们的。

defsEn: a high military leader
ad. without details
affecting or including all or almost all
zh: n. 一般, 将军, 大体
a. 全面的, 大体的, 总的, 一般的, 普遍的
n. 常规
examples: In general, children are fond of candy.
In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.
exampleZh: 小孩一般来说都喜欢吃糖果。
一般来说，消费者喜欢数量胜于质量。

defsEn: a group of individuals born and living about the same time. (“The mother and daughter represented two generations.”)
zh: n. 一代, 一世, 产生
examples: It is said that the younger generation today is apathetic.
Generation will stop after finishing this image. Click again to stop immediately.
exampleZh: 有人说新一代的人很冷漠。

defsEn: parts of cells that control the growth and development of living things
genes from the mother and father are passed to the child
genes contain nucleic acid
zh: n. 基因（gene的复数形式）
examples: The function of most genes remains a mystery.
If you could choose the genes for your children, would you?

defsEn: a plan of action to kill or destroy a national, religious, racial or ethnic group
zh: n. 种族灭绝, 灭绝整个种族的大屠杀
examples: Genocide is a crime against humanity.
Genocide is the systematic effort to exterminate an entire people.

defsEn: soft
kind
not rough or violent
zh: a. 温和的, 文雅的
examples: A gentle wind made ripples on the surface of the pond.
Be gentle with your puppy and handle it with care.
exampleZh: 微风在湖面上掀起了一丝丝涟漪。

defsEn: to receive
to gain
to go and bring back
to become
to become the owner of
zh: vt. 得到, 获得, 变成, 使得, 收获, 接通, 抓住, 染上
vi. 到达, 成为, 变得
n. (网球等)救球, 生殖, 幼兽
examples: I get a kick out of her cheerful personality.
When you get there, wait for a while.
exampleZh: 她开朗的个性使我觉得快乐。
你到了以后等一会儿。

defsEn: something given without cost
zh: n. 礼物, 赠予, 天才
vt. 赋予
examples: She meant this gift for you.
He is gifted with perfect wisdom.
exampleZh: 她这礼物是送给你的。
他天生拥有完美的智慧。

defsEn: a young female person
zh: n. 女孩, 少女, 女佣
examples: The girl brought me a red and a white rose.
The girl was afraid to jump down from the roof.
exampleZh: 女孩给了我一枝红玫瑰和一枝白玫瑰。
小女孩害怕从屋顶上跳下来。

defsEn: to present to another to keep without receiving payment
zh: n. 弹性, 适应性
vt. 给, 授予, 供给, 产生, 发表, 付出, 献出, 让出
vi. 捐赠, 支持不住, 让步
examples: Give your best effort in all that you do.
Give your passport number and your date of birth.
exampleZh: 你做任何事都要尽全力。
给你的护照号和你的出生日期。

defsEn: a hard, clear material that is easily broken, used most often for windows or for containers to hold liquids glass
zh: n. 玻璃, 玻璃杯, 透镜
vt. 装玻璃于, 反射, 反映
vi. 成玻璃状
examples: Your glasses fell on the floor.
The glass is full of milk.
exampleZh: 你的眼镜掉在地上了。
玻璃杯内装满了牛奶。

defsEn: to move from one place to another
to leave
zh: vi. 去, 走, 达到, 运转, 查阅, 消失, 结束, 放弃, 花费, 流传, 趋于, 打算, 剩下
vt. 以...打赌, 对付, 忍受, 出产, 为被捕者出(保释金)
n. 去, 尝试, 进行
examples: Go straight on to the end of the road.
Go and help wash up at the sink!
exampleZh: 直走直到这条街道的尽头。
到洗涤槽去帮忙洗碗盘吧！

defsEn: that toward which an effort is directed
that which is aimed at
the end of a trip or race
zh: n. 目标, 终点, 得分, 球门, 守门员
vi. 攻门, 射门得分
examples: Her goal is to become a teacher.
My goal is to become a doctor.
exampleZh: 她的目的是成为教师。
我的目标是成为一个医生。

defsEn: the spirit that is honored as creator of all things (“They believe in God.”)
a spirit or being believed in many religions to have special powers
zh: n. 上帝, 神像, 偶像
vt. 使神化
examples: Whom the gods love die young.
We are but men, not gods.
exampleZh: 英年早逝。
我们是人，不是神。

defsEn: a highly valued yellow metal
zh: n. 黄金, 钱财, 金块, 金色, 宝贵
a. 金的, 似金的, 金色的, 金制的
examples: Gold is similar in color to brass.
He was given a gold watch as a reward.
exampleZh: 金的颜色和黄铜很相似。
他被奖励了一块金表。

defsEn: pleasing
helpful
kind
correct
not bad
zh: n. 善行, 好处, 利益
a. 好的, 优良的, 上等的, 愉快的, 有益的, 好心的, 慈善的, 虔诚的
examples: Good morning, right now I have ice cream.
A good many people have told me to take a holiday.
exampleZh: 早上好、现在我有冰淇淋。
很多人都跟我说要我休假。

defsEn: things owned or made to be sold
zh: n. 货物
examples: Please do not bring unpaid goods into the toilet.
The goods will only be available to buy next weekend.

defsEn: to control
to rule by military or political power
zh: v. 统治, 支配, 管理
examples: To govern a country is not an easy job.
To govern a country is no easy job.
exampleZh: 统治一个国家不是一个简单活。
统治一个国家并不简单。

defsEn: a system of governing
the organization of people that rules a country, city or area
zh: n. 政府, 内阁
examples: The government should invest more money in agriculture.
The government should strengthen their army once and for all!
exampleZh: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。
政府应该彻底加强军队建设！

defsEn: the seed of grass plants used for food, such as wheat, rice and corn
those plants that produce the seeds grain
zh: n. 谷粒, 颗粒, 谷类, 纹理, 本质
v. (使)成谷粒
examples: There isn't a grain of truth in what he says.
A grain of sand fell into my eye.
exampleZh: 他说的话全不可信。

defsEn: a plant with long, narrow, green leaves
zh: n. 草, 草原, 牧场
examples: The grass sprouts all over the garden.
I laid myself on the grass.
exampleZh: 花园里的草发芽了。
我在草地上直躺下来了。

defsEn: the force that pulls things toward the center of the Earth
zh: n. 地心引力, 重力
examples: It's gravity that makes satellites move around the Earth.
Gravity brings everything down to Earth.
exampleZh: 让卫星环绕地球的是重力。
重力将一切带下地球表面。

defsEn: having the color like that made by mixing black and white
zh: n. 灰色, 暗淡
a. 灰色的, 灰白的, 面色苍白的, 年老的, 老练的, 阴沉的
v. (使)变灰色
examples: The gray sweater I like more than the purple.
Gray is a color intermediate between black and white.

defsEn: very large or more than usual in size or number
very good
important
zh: a. 大的, 非常的, 主要的, 重大的, 崇高的, 伟大的
adv. 顺利地, 得意地
n. 全部, 大人物, 大师
examples: It would be great if you could sing.
It'd be great if you could pick up some bread before you come home.
exampleZh: 如果你唱歌的话一定很棒。
这将会是巨大的，如果你可以挑选一些面包，然后再回家。

defsEn: having the color like that made by mixing yellow and blue
having the color like that of growing leaves and grass
zh: n. 绿色, 绿色颜料
a. 绿色的, 未成熟的, 新鲜的, 青春的, 无经验的, 脸色发青的
examples: A green carpet will not go with this blue curtain.
Green plants can make their own food.
exampleZh: 绿色的毯子和这条蓝色的帘子不配。
绿色植物可以食物自给自足。

defsEn: to reduce to small pieces by crushing
zh: n. 磨, 碾, 苦差, 摩擦声, 用功的学生
vt. 磨擦, 磨碎, 磨光, 折磨, 压榨
vi. 磨, 磨碎, 苦干
examples: He grinds his teeth in his sleep.
She grinds her teeth in her sleep.

defsEn: land
the earth’s surface
soil
zh: n. 土地, 战场, 场地, 地面, 范围
a. 土地的, 地面上的
vt. 放在地上, 使搁浅, 打基础, 给...以训练
vi. 搁浅, 落地, 根据, 基于
a. 磨过的
grind的过去式和过去分词
examples: The ground is still wet. As likely as not, the game will be canceled.
The ground is still wet. As likely as not, the game will be cancelled.
exampleZh: 地面仍然很湿滑，看来比赛要被取消了。
地面仍然很湿滑，看来比赛要被取消了。

defsEn: a number of people or things together
a gathering of people working for a common purpose

v. 聚合, 成群
examples: Which group do you want to join?
The group of people came along with us.
exampleZh: 你想加入哪一组？
那帮人也和我们一起来了。

defsEn: to develop or become bigger
to increase in size or amount
zh: vt. 种植, 使长满
vi. 生长, 变成, 发展
examples: When I grow up, I want to be king.
When I grow up, I want to be a king.
exampleZh: 当我长大后，我想当国王。
我长大后想当国王。

defsEn: to promise a result
to promise that something will happen
zh: n. 担保, 抵押品, 保证书
vt. 保证, 担保
examples: They guarantee this clock can be used for a year.
They guarantee this clock for a year.
exampleZh: 他们保证这个时钟可用一年。
他们保证这个时钟可用一年。

defsEn: to watch and protect a person, place or thing (“He guards the president.”)
n. a person or thing that watches or protects (“He is a prison guard.”)
zh: n. 守卫者, 警戒, 护卫队, 防护装置
vt. 保卫, 看守, 当心
vi. 防止, 警惕, 警卫, 看守
examples: Be on your guard. He's not an easy one to fool.
His bike ran into a guard-rail.
exampleZh: 要留神，他不容易受骗。
他的单车撞上了栏杆。

defsEn: a person who fights as part of an unofficial army, usually against an official army or police
zh: n. 游击队
examples: The guerrillas often went to great risks to secure accurate information.

defsEn: to lead to
to show the way
n. one who shows the way

vt. 指导, 支配, 管理, 带领, 操纵

The guide will lead us to the famous park.

responsible for a bad action

Guns don't kill people. People kill people.

枪不会杀人。人才会杀人。

defsEn: the fine material that grows from the skin, especially from the head

她的头发长回原来的长度了。

She gulped down half her tea in one mouthful.
exampleZh: 搭帐篷花了我们半小时。
她一口气喝下半杯多凉茶。

to stop

to kill by hanging

vi. 悬着, 垂下, 被绞死, 悬而不决

I hang the calendar on the wall.
exampleZh: 等一下，我得去趟洗手间。
我把日历挂在墙上。

to take place

We happened to get on the same bus.

我们恰巧上了同一辆公交车。

satisfied
feeling good
not sad happy

My happy schooldays will soon be behind me.

我快乐的校园时光，很快就要离我而去了。

defsEn: not easily cut or broken
solid
difficult to do or understand
needing much effort or force

examples: It's hard to predict what the weather will be like tomorrow.

exampleZh: 很难说明天的天气将会怎样。
很难说明天的天气将会怎样。

to damage
n. damage
hurt

We harvest our summer crop in autumn.

vt. 给...戴帽子

This hat blew away with the wind.
exampleZh: 墙上挂着一顶帽子和一件大衣。
这顶帽子随风飞走了。

defsEn: to have strong emotions against
to consider as an enemy
opposite love
zh: n. 憎恨, 恨, 厌恶
vt. 憎恨, 憎恶
vi. 仇恨
examples: I hate it when my clothes smell of smoke.
I hate rain, but I love its smell.
exampleZh: 我讨厌我的衣服有烟味。
虽然我讨厌雨，但是我喜欢下雨的味道。

defsEn: to possess
to own
to hold
zh: vt. 有, 怀有, 拿, 进行
aux. 已经
examples: I have to buy some new clothes next week.
We have to pick a name for the child.
exampleZh: 下周我必须买一些新衣服。
我们要给孩子起个名字。

defsEn: the boy or man who is being spoken about

defsEn: to lead
to command

chief
the top part of something
the highest position

vt. 为首, 朝向, 前进, 用头顶
vi. 朝特定方向行进, (作物)结穗
a. 头的, 在顶端的, 主要的

She withdrew her head from a window.
exampleZh: 他上下晃了晃头。
她把头从窗户外缩回来。

defsEn: the center from which orders are given
the main offices of a business or organization
zh: n. 总部, 司令部, 总部人员

to cure
to become well
zh: vi. 痊愈

the condition of being free from sickness or disease

Health is more important than gold.
exampleZh: 健康是我唯一的资本。
健康胜于财富。

defsEn: to receive sound through the ears
to receive news about
zh: vt. 听到, 倾听, 听说, 审理
vi. 听见, 听
examples: I hear from my mother once in a while.
I hear you have a new girlfriend.
exampleZh: 我时不时得到母亲的消息。
听说你有新女朋友了。

n. great warmth
that which is produced by burning fuel
energy from the sun
zh: n. 热, 热度, 体温, 高潮
vi. 加热, 激昂, 加剧
vt. 把...加热, 使激动

exampleZh: 把水加热不改变它的化学成分。
这个取暖装置用柴油作为燃料。

defsEn: having much weight
not easy to lift
of great amount or force

adv. 沉重地
n. 重物, 严肃角色
examples: We had a heavy frost this morning.
We had a heavy rain last night.
exampleZh: 今天早上下厚霜了。
昨晚下了一场大雨。

defsEn: a machine without wings that can fly up or down or remain in one place above the ground helicopter

vt. 由直升机运送
vi. 乘直升机
examples: A helicopter will come pick us up.

defsEn: to give support
to assist
to make easier
n. support
aid

Could you help me translate this into French?
exampleZh: 我每天都帮我妈做家务。
你能帮我把这译成法语吗？

defsEn: in, to or at this place
zh: adv. 在这里, 此时, 这里
n. 这里
examples: I'm here, so do you want to chat?
If he were here, what would he say?
exampleZh: 我在这，你想聊天吗？
假若他在这里，他会说什么？

defsEn: a person honored for being brave or wise
zh: n. 英雄, 超越常人者, 男主角
examples: There's a hero, if you look inside your heart.
The hero of the novel has a main role.

defsEn: to prevent from being seen or found
to make secret

vi. 躲藏
examples: Hide it inside the warehouse for now.
Hide not your light under a bushel.
exampleZh: 暂时藏在仓库里好了。
不要把你的灯藏在斗笠下。

defsEn: tall
far up
far above the ground
important
above others
zh: n. 高度, 高处
a. 高的, 高级的, 主要的, 高尚的, 高原的, 高音的, 昂贵的, 傲慢的

examples: How high should a home fence be?
His high salary enabled him to live in comfort.
exampleZh: 住宅围栏应该多高？
他的薪金很高，所以生活也过得很舒适。

defsEn: to seize or take control of a vehicle by force

defsEn: a small mountain
zh: n. 小山, 丘陵, 小土堆
vt. 作成土堆, 堆成小丘
examples: The hills are bathed in sunlight.

defsEn: the written record or description of past events

We had a history quiz this morning.
exampleZh: 新事物取代旧事物推动历史发展。
我们今天早上有历史小考。

defsEn: to strike
to touch with force
zh: n. 打击, 打, 冲撞, 讽刺
vt. 打, 打击, 碰撞, 打中, 袭击, 偶然碰上
vi. 打, 打中, 打击, 碰撞, 偶然碰上
examples: He hit the ball with his racket.
He hit his head against a rock.
exampleZh: 他用他的球拍击球。
他的头撞到了一块岩石。

defsEn: to carry or support, usually in the hands or arms
to keep in one position
to keep as a prisoner
to contain
to possess
to occupy
to organize and be involved in (“The two sides hold talks this week.”)
zh: n. 把握, 把持力, 柄, 控制, 掌握, 监禁
vt. 保存, 握住, 拿住, 占据, 持有, 拥有
vi. 支持, 持续, 有效
n. 保留
examples: We hold a meeting once a month.
He holds an important position in the company.
exampleZh: 我们一个月开会一次。
他在公司里身兼要职。

defsEn: an opening
a torn or broken place in something
zh: n. 孔, 洞, 穴, 漏洞
vt. 挖洞, 掘坑
vi. 进洞, 凿洞
examples: There is a hole in your sock.
There's a hole in my coat.
exampleZh: 你的袜子上有个洞。
我的大衣穿了一个洞。

defsEn: a day when one does not work
a day on which no work is done to honor or remember a person or event
zh: n. 假日, 假期, 节日
vi. 度假
examples: I am on holiday this week.
The holiday season is almost over.
exampleZh: 我这个星期放假了。
假期快结束了。

defsEn: greatly honored in religion
zh: a. 神圣的, 圣洁的, 至善的
n. 神圣的东西
examples: Jerusalem is the Holy City of the Jews.
Holy Week is the week just before Easter.
exampleZh: 耶路撒冷是犹太人的圣城。

defsEn: the building where a person lives, especially with family
the place where one was born or comes from
the area or country where one lives
zh: n. 家, 避难所, 故乡
a. 家庭的, 国内的, 打中目标的
adv. 在家, 在本国, 打中目标地
examples: At home, we speak only French.
A home without a mother is a sad, sad place.
exampleZh: 在家里，我们只说法语。
一个没有母亲的家是个伤心，伤心的地方。

defsEn: truthful
able to be trusted
zh: a. 诚实的, 坦直的, 可靠的
examples: To be honest, I want to study Japanese too.
To be honest, I've gradually come to dislike the life here.
exampleZh: 其实我也想学日语。
老实说, 我已经渐渐地不喜欢这里的生活。

defsEn: to obey
to show strong, good feelings for (“to honor one’s parents”)
n. an award
an act of giving special recognition (“He received many honors for his efforts to help others.”)
zh: n. 荣誉, 头衔, 信用, 尊敬, 名誉, 阁下, 勋章
vt. 尊敬, 授予荣誉, 承兑, 实践
examples: It is an honor for us.
I felt that my honor was at stake.
exampleZh: 这是我们的荣幸。
我觉得我的名誉受到了威胁。

defsEn: to expect
to believe there is a good chance that something will happen as wanted
to want something to happen
zh: n. 希望, 信心, 期待
v. 希望, 期望, 信赖
examples: I hope that you give this book a read.
I hope I can do that before I die.
exampleZh: 我希望你读读这本书。
我希望我能在死前做到。

defsEn: causing great fear
terrible
zh: a. 可怕的, 遭透的, 极讨厌的
examples: I had a horrible dream last night.
This horrible hot weather is killing me.
exampleZh: 我昨晚做了一个恶梦。
这鬼天气，要把人热死。

defsEn: a large animal often used for racing, riding or farm work
zh: n. 马, 骑兵, 脚架
vi. 骑马, 取笑
vt. 使骑马, 系马于
examples: I rode a horse for the first time yesterday.
The horses and cattle in heat never meet.
exampleZh: 昨天我第一次骑了马。
风马牛不相及。

defsEn: a place where sick or injured people are given medical care hospital
zh: n. 医院
examples: I went to the hospital to see my wife.
I was in the hospital for a week.
exampleZh: 我去医院看了我的老婆。
我住了一个星期的院。

defsEn: a person captured and held as a guarantee that a demand or promise will be honored
zh: n. 人质, 抵押品
examples: The hostages will be released tomorrow.
He held her hostage in a van.
exampleZh: 人质将在明天获释。

defsEn: ready to fight
ready for war
zh: a. 敌人的, 怀敌意的, 敌对的
n. 敌对分子
examples: Are you in a hostile working environment?
The hostile army began to attack.

defsEn: having or feeling great heat or a high temperature
zh: a. 热的, 热心的, 辣的, 热情的, 激动的, 猛烈的, 紧迫的
adv. 热, 紧迫地
examples: A hot bath and then bed.
Hot weather will continue, so please watch out for food poisoning.
exampleZh: 先洗个热水澡，然后上床睡觉。
因为酷暑一直持续着，请谨防食物中毒。

defsEn: a building with rooms, and often food, for travelers
zh: n. 旅馆, 客栈
examples: They got to the hotel after dark.
Is the hotel close to the airport?
exampleZh: 天暗后他们到了酒店。
酒店离机场远不远？

defsEn: a measure of time
sixty minutes
zh: n. 小时, 钟头, 时间, ...点钟, 课时
examples: Why are you out at this hour?
At what hour was she born?
exampleZh: 为什么这个时间在外面呢？
她几点出生的？

defsEn: a building in which people live
a country’s parliament or lawmaking group (“House of Representatives”)
zh: n. 房子, 住宅, 机构, 议院, 家族, 家庭
vt. 给...房子住, 收藏
vi. 住, 躲藏
examples: At my house, I have nowhere to study - it's too noisy there.
This is the house in which she used to live.
exampleZh: 我在自己家中哪里都不能读书，那里太吵了。
这是她曾经住过的房子。

defsEn: in what way
to what amount
zh: adv. 如何, 怎样, 多少, 多么
n. 方式

defsEn: yet
but
zh: adv. 然而, 无论如何, 究竟怎样
conj. 然而, 可是
examples: However you do it, the result will be the same.
However hard I try, I can't do it any better than she can.
exampleZh: 你无论用什么方法，结果都是一样。
无论我多么努力尝试，我都无法做到比她更好。

defsEn: very big
of great size
zh: a. 极大的, 巨大的, 无限的
examples: A huge tanker cast off just now.
I dug a huge pit with my shovel in just one day.
exampleZh: 一艘巨大的液货船刚刚启航。
我只用一天就用铲子挖了一个大坑。

defsEn: of or about people
zh: n. 人, 人类
a. 人类的, 似人类的, 人性的, 有同情心的
examples: Human beings differ from animals in that they can think and speak.
If human life is convex, we can optimize it.
exampleZh: 人类有思考和说话的能力，动物却没有。这就是人和动物的分别。
如果人生是凸的，那我们可以优化它。

defsEn: the ability to understand, enjoy or express what makes people laugh
zh: 液；体液, 体液
examples: She was in no humor for lunch.
With humor, he could cover his sadness.
exampleZh: 她不想吃午饭。

defsEn: the need for food
zh: n. 饥饿, 渴望, 饥荒
vt. 使挨饿
vi. 挨饿, 渴望
examples: To him, hunger was an abstract concept; he always had enough to eat.
Hunger will drive a wolf out of a forest.
exampleZh: 对他来说，「肚子饿」是个抽象的概念，因为他从来就没有饿过。

defsEn: to search for animals to capture or kill them
to seek
to try to find
zh: n. 狩猎, 追捕, 搜寻, 猎区
vt. 狩猎, 打猎, 搜索
vi. 打猎, 猎食, 搜寻
examples: Damiano said he would hunt that strange creature down at down.
Hunting accidents happen more often than most people realize.

defsEn: to do or go fast
zh: n. 匆忙, 急忙, 急促
vt. 急派, 催促
vi. 匆忙, 赶快
examples: If you hurry you can still make the train.
Hurry up, or you will miss the last train.
exampleZh: 如果你抓紧，你还能赶上火车。
再不快点你就要赶不上末班车了。

defsEn: to cause pain, injury or damage
zh: n. 伤害, 创伤, 损害
v. 伤害, (使)伤心, 危害, 刺痛
examples: He hurt his left foot when he fell.
She hurt her foot when she fell off her bicycle.
exampleZh: 当他跌倒时，他伤了他的左脚。
她在从自行车上摔下来时伤到了脚。

defsEn: a man who is married
zh: n. 丈夫, 管理人, 节俭的人
vt. 节俭, 使成丈夫, 持有
examples: She said to her husband: "Stop!".
Her husband intends to bring out a new monthly magazine.
exampleZh: 她对丈夫说：“停下！”
他丈夫打算办月刊。

defsEn: the person speaking
zh: pron. 我

defsEn: frozen water
zh: n. 冰, 冰淇淋, 糖衣, 冷若冰霜, 矜持, 贿赂
vt. 使结冰, 冰镇, 覆以糖衣
vi. 结冰
examples: The ice-cream will melt, so I put it in the fridge.
The ice on the lake is too thin to bear your weight.
exampleZh: 冰淇淋会融化所以我把它放在冰箱里。
湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。

defsEn: a thought or picture in the mind
a belief
zh: n. 主意, 办法, 理想, 思想, 概念, 意见
examples: I had no idea it would put you to so much trouble.
The idea of perpetual motion is an absurd hypothesis.
exampleZh: 我一点都不知道这会给你带来那么多问题。
永动机这个概念是个荒唐的假说。

defsEn: to recognize someone or something and to say who or what they are
zh: vt. 识别, 认为...等同于, 确定, 使参与
vi. 一致, 认同
examples: She identified him as the murderer.
To identify and verify your YubiKey, please enter a token in the field below.
exampleZh: 她确认他是杀人凶手。

defsEn: on condition
provided that (“I will go if you go.”)
zh: conj. 如果, 是否, 无论何时, 假设, 即使
n. 条件

defsEn: to pay no attention to or refuse to consider (“The president ignored the protesters outside his office.”)
zh: vt. 不理睬, 忽视, 驳回, 忽略
examples: If I were you, I would ignore it.
Were I you, I would ignore it.
exampleZh: 如果我是你，我就忽略它。
如果我是你，我就忽略它。

defsEn: not legal
in violation of a law
zh: a. 违法的, 不合规定的
examples: It's illegal to park your car here.
It is illegal for bicycles to ride on the right side of cars.
exampleZh: 把车停在这里是违法的。
自行车在汽车的右侧行驶是不合法的。

defsEn: a reproduction of the appearance of a person or thing
zh: n. 影像, 肖像, 想象, 图像, 形象, 翻版
vt. 作...的像, 反映, 想象, 象征
n. 图像
examples: What image did you have in mind as you painted this picture?
The image quality is really bad - the resolution is so low.
exampleZh: 画这幅画的时候你脑海中浮现出了什么图像？
画质真的很差 - 分辨率那么低。

defsEn: to make a picture in the mind
to form an idea
zh: vt. 想像, 设想, 猜测
vi. 想像起来
examples: Imagine that you have a time machine.
Imagine what it would be like if you had a time machine.
exampleZh: 如果你有一台时光机⋯⋯
想象一下，假如你有一台时光机。

defsEn: without delay
very near in time or place
zh: a. 立即的, 直接的, 接近的
examples: It is not in the immediate vicinity, but not far away either.
The immediate cause of his failure was lack of study.

defsEn: a person who arrives in a country to live there
zh: n. 移民
a. 移入的, 移民的
examples: The immigrants entered the country in a steady flow.
The immigrant came to see his children.
exampleZh: 移民川流不息地进入这个国家。

defsEn: to bring from another country
n. something brought from another country, usually for sale
zh: n. 进口货, 进口, 输入, 含义, 重要性
vt. 输入, 引入, 进口, 含...的意思, 重要
vi. 有关系
examples: Imported cars account for less than eight percent.
Japan imports various raw materials from abroad.
exampleZh: 进口车占了不到百分之八。
日本从国外进口各种原料。

defsEn: having great meaning, value or power
zh: a. 重要的, 有地位的, 大量的, 显要的, 自负的
examples: She told me that there is an important meeting tomorrow.
It's important to me that you receive an education.
exampleZh: 她告诉我明天有一个重要的会议。
你能受到教育，对我来说很重要。

defsEn: to make better
to become better
zh: vt. 改良, 提高...的价值, 改善, 利用
vi. 变得更好, 增加
examples: Your English has improved a lot.
If we improve it little by little, it will become a great weapon.
exampleZh: 你的英语进步了很多。

defsEn: inside
held by
contained by
surrounded by
during
zh: prep. 在...期间, 在...之内, 处于...之中, 从事于, 按照, 穿着
adv. 进入, 朝里, 在里面, 在屋里
a. 在里面的, 在朝的
n. 执政者, 交情

defsEn: an event or something that happens
zh: n. 事件, 事变, 小事
a. 附带的, 易于发生的, 外来的, 入射的
examples: This incident has made a great impact on the progress of the project.
The incident sowed the seeds of the war.
exampleZh: 这个事件极大影响了项目进度。
该事件播下了战争的种子。

defsEn: to urge or cause an action or emotion, usually something bad or violent
zh: vt. 刺激, 激励, 引诱
examples: They incited my son to bully this boy.
They incited him to commit the crime.

defsEn: to have
to make a part of
zh: vt. 包括, 把...算入, 包住
examples: Don't include multiple alternative words inside the same sentence.
He is included among my friends.
exampleZh: 在同一句中不要包含多个可选单词。
他是我的朋友之一。

defsEn: to make more in size or amount
zh: n. 增加, 增进, 利益
vt. 增加, 加大
vi. 增加, 繁殖
examples: An increase in the number of cars will affect the urban environment.
An increase in customer complaints could signal a decline in business.
exampleZh: 车辆增多会影响到城市的环境。
顾客投诉量增加，可能代表生意正在走下坡。

defsEn: not influenced by or controlled by another or others
free
separate
zh: n. 独立自主者, 无党派者
a. 独立的, 有主见的, 不须依赖的, 不受约束的
examples: He is independent of his parents.
The independent pronoun can be a subject.
exampleZh: 他独立于他的父母。

defsEn: one person
zh: n. 人, 个人, 个体
a. 个别的, 个人的, 独特的
examples: Individual freedom is the soul of democracy.
She had an individual style of speaking.
exampleZh: 个人自由是民主的精髓。
她说话有自己的风格。

defsEn: any business that produces goods or provides services
the work and related activity in factories and offices
all organizations involved in manufacturing
zh: n. 勤劳, 工业, 企业, 产业, 有组织的劳动
examples: Industry as we know it today didn't exist in those days.
The industry is heavily dependent on government funding.
exampleZh: 我们今天所认识的工业在那个时代不存在。

defsEn: to make sick with something that causes disease
zh: vt. 传染, 感染
examples: Be infected with the evil ways of the world.
The infected people will be isolated from the uninfected ones.

defsEn: a continuing rise in prices while the value of money goes down
zh: n. 胀大, 夸张, 通货膨胀
examples: The inflation issue split the party.
Did inflation influence the price of milk a lot?

defsEn: to have an effect on someone or something
to cause change
zh: n. 影响力, 权力, 势力
vt. 影响, 改变
examples: His influence extends all over the country.
The influence of this crime on society was great.
exampleZh: 他的影响遍及全国。

defsEn: to tell
to give knowledge to
zh: vt. 通知, 使了解, 使充满
vi. 提供资料, 告发
examples: We are informed by newspapers of the major events that take place every day.
Could you inform me where to look for water?
exampleZh: 我们从报纸中获知每天发生的重大事件。

defsEn: knowledge
facts
zh: n. 消息, 知识, 通知, 情报, 信息, 问讯处, 起诉
examples: I got the information from him directly.
The information is very important to us.
exampleZh: 我直接从他那里得到讯息。
这些信息对我们非常重要。

defsEn: to force a fluid into, such as putting medicine or drugs into the body through the skin
zh: vt. 注射, 注入, 使入轨
examples: What did they inject you with?
Bruno injected Rima with that drug to relieve the pain.

defsEn: to cause harm or damage to a person or animal
zh: vt. 伤害, 损害, 使受冤屈
examples: The injured bird struggled with all its might on the grass.
I got injured in the traffic accident.
exampleZh: 那只受伤的小鸟在草地上尽力挣扎。
我在这场交通意外中受了伤。

defsEn: not guilty of a crime
not responsible for a bad action
zh: a. 无罪的, 不懂事的, 无知的
n. 天真的人, 笨蛋
examples: If he is innocent, then his wife is guilty.
If he is innocent, it follows that his wife is guilty.
exampleZh: 如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。
如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。

defsEn: mentally sick
zh: a. 患精神病的, 极愚蠢的
examples: What an insane world we live in.
That is insane. Only a fool would believe that.

defsEn: a very small creature, usually with many legs and sometimes with wings insect
zh: n. 昆虫, 卑鄙的人
examples: The insect grew out of a pupa into an imago.
This insect is tiny, but very dangerous.
exampleZh: 昆虫破蛹而出变成成虫。

defsEn: to look at something carefully
to examine, especially by an expert
zh: vt. 检查, 检阅, 检验
vi. 检查
examples: Inspect your tires for wear and tear, and replace them if necessary.
He inspected his saddle for damage.

defsEn: in the place of
taking the place of
zh: adv. 作为替代, 反而
examples: Instead of drinking cola, why not drink champagne?
He went there instead of his father.
exampleZh: 与其喝可乐，倒不如喝香槟。
他代替他的父亲去。

defsEn: a tool or device designed to do something or to make something
zh: n. 工具, 手段, 仪器
examples: This instrument needs to be calibrated.
What instruments do you know how to play?
exampleZh: 该仪器需要校准。

defsEn: to say something or to do something that makes another person angry or dishonored
zh: n. 侮辱, 无礼, 损害
vt. 损害, 侮辱, 攻击
examples: There is no greater insult to life than premature ejaculation.
They insulted the baby to ward off the evil eye.
exampleZh: 没有什么比早泄更糟蹋生活的了

defsEn: the ability to think or learn
information gathered by spying
zh: n. 智力, 情报, 信息
examples: His intelligence and experience enabled him to deal with the trouble.
Your intelligence is as vast as the distance between Bombay and Mumbai.
exampleZh: 他的智慧和经验使他能处理这个麻烦。
你的智慧广大的有如孟买和孟买之间的距离。

defsEn: quick to understand or learn
zh: a. 聪明的, 智能的, 了解的
examples: He is not as intelligent as his brother.
He was an intelligent and practical man.
exampleZh: 他没有他弟弟聪明。
他是聪明能干的人。

defsEn: very strong
extremely serious
zh: a. 非常的, 强烈的, 紧张的, 热情的
examples: There was an intense pain in my head.
I had an intense pain in the head.

defsEn: what is important to someone (“He acted to protect his interests.” “She had a great interest in painting.”)
a share in owning a business
money paid for the use of money borrowed
zh: n. 兴趣, 嗜好, 利息, 利益, 爱好, 趣味, 势力
vt. 使感兴趣, 与...有关系
examples: He told us an interesting story.
He told me an interesting story.
exampleZh: 他告诉了我们一个有趣的故事。
他告诉了我一个有趣的故事。

defsEn: to get in the way of
to work against
to take part in the activities of others, especially when not asked to do so
zh: vi. 妨碍, 冲突, 干涉, 抵触
examples: Why did you interfere in an affair that did not concern you at all?
Don't interfere with matters that do not concern you!
exampleZh: 为什么你要干涉一件跟你完全不相干的事呢？
不要干预不关你的事！

defsEn: of or about more than one nation or many nations
of the whole world
zh: a. 国际的
n. 国别设定
examples: International rescue teams are at the ready to fly to Japan.
International problems must be solved by diplomacy, not war.
exampleZh: 国际救难队伍随时待命准备前往日本。
国际问题必须靠外交而非战争解决。

defsEn: the extensive communications system that connects computers around the world
zh: 因特网, 国际互连网, 网际网络, 互连网络, 广域网
examples: It's in the internet, so it must be true.
The Internet is an invaluable source of information.
exampleZh: 它在网际网路上，所以它一定是真实的。
互联网是一种无法估量的信息资源。

defsEn: to come between
to come between in order to settle or solve
zh: vi. 插入, 调停, 干涉
examples: If you intervene, they will also intervene.
He intervened between them and helped them to make peace.

defsEn: to enter an area or country by force with an army
zh: vt. 侵入, 拥入, 侵略, 侵袭
examples: The Vandals invaded North Africa in the fifth century A.D.
Hitler invaded the USSR through the North European Plain.

defsEn: to plan and make something never made before
to create a new thing or way of doing something
zh: vt. 发明, 创作, 虚构
examples: He invented an excuse for being late.
Thomas Edison invented the light bulb.
exampleZh: 他为他的迟到制造了一个借口。
爱迪生发明了电灯炮。

defsEn: to give money to a business or organization with the hope of making more money
zh: vt. 投资, 花费, 笼罩, 授予
vi. 投资, 利用
examples: He invested his money in stocks.
I invest time in personal development.
exampleZh: 他把钱投资于股票。

defsEn: to study or examine all information about an event, situation or charge
to search for the truth
zh: v. 调查, 审查
examples: Investigate thoroughly the bushes where the enemy may be hiding.
He has investigated the possibility of cooperation.
exampleZh: 仔细搜寻敌人可能藏身的灌木丛。
他调查了两方合作的可能性。

defsEn: to ask someone to take part in or join an event, organization or gathering
zh: vt. 邀请, 请求, 引起, 招致
n. 邀请
examples: Invite us to dinner at a restaurant.
I invited a Chinese friend over to my apartment.
exampleZh: 请我们去饭店吃晚饭。
我请了一位中国朋友来我的公寓。

defsEn: to take part in
to become a part of
to include
zh: vt. 包括, 使陷于, 潜心于, 包围
examples: We got involved in a traffic accident.
He was involved in the trouble.
exampleZh: 我们被卷入了一场交通事故。
他被卷进了是非中。

defsEn: a strong, hard metal used to make machines and tools
zh: n. 铁, 熨斗, 铁器, 坚强, 烙铁, 镣铐
vt. 烫平, 熨, 用铁包
vi. 烫平
examples: I cannot iron my clothes. I have no iron.
Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
exampleZh: 我没法烫我的衣服，我没有熨斗。
先熨烫领子的里面，然后是外面。

defsEn: a land area with water all around it
zh: n. 岛, 岛屿, 孤立地区, 安全岛
vt. 使成岛状, 孤立
examples: The island is a paradise for children.
The island lies to the west of Japan.
exampleZh: 这个岛是孩子们的天堂。
这个岛屿位于日本的西边。

defsEn: an important problem or subject that people are discussing or arguing about
zh: n. 发行, 问题, 后果, 流出, 出口, 争端
vi. 发行, 流出, 造成...结果, 传下
vt. 使流出, 放出, 发行, 发布, 发给
examples: This issue has nothing to do with you.
Don't dodge the issue, I want you to answer my question.
exampleZh: 这件事与你无关。
不要逃避，我要你回答我的问题。

defsEn: a thing, place, event or idea that is being spoken about (“The sky is blue, but it also has a few white clouds.”)
zh: pron. 它

defsEn: a prison for those waiting to be tried for a crime or for those serving sentences for crimes that are not serious
zh: n. 监牢, 监狱, 拘留所
vt. 监禁, 下狱
examples: In jail, you never know what the next day holds.
He's in jail for a different case.

defsEn: a valuable stone, such as a diamond or emerald
zh: n. 珠宝, 贵重物, 镶珠宝的饰物
vt. 饰以珠宝, 镶以宝石
examples: The jewel was found in an unlikely place.
She took the jewel to her manager.

defsEn: the work that one does to earn money
zh: n. 工作, 零活, 职业, 事情
vi. 做零工, 打杂, 做股票经纪, 假公济私
vt. 代客买卖, 批发, 承包, 欺骗
examples: What job experience do you have?
My job is to forgive you, which I do.
exampleZh: 你有从事什么工作的经验?
我的工作是原谅你，我做到了。

defsEn: to put together or come together
to become part of or a member of
zh: vi. 参加, 结合, 加入
vt. 连接, 结合, 参加, 加入
n. 连接, 结合, 接合点
examples: I willingly join the Chinese Communist Party.
He joined the Army during the war.
exampleZh: 我自愿加入中国共产党。
他在战时参军。

defsEn: shared by two or more
zh: n. 连接处, 接合, 关节
a. 共同的, 联合的, 连接的, 合办的
vt. 连接, 接合, 使有接头
vi. 贴合, 长节
examples: My joints ache when it gets cold.
The joint-venture between the American and Japanese companies fell through.
exampleZh: 当天气变冷的时候，我的关节疼痛。

defsEn: something done or said to cause others to laugh
zh: n. 笑话, 玩笑, 笑柄
v. 开玩笑, 取笑, 作弄
examples: That was a joke, of course.
That is the funniest joke that I have ever heard.
exampleZh: 当然，这只是个玩笑。
这是我听过最好笑的笑话。

defsEn: to form an opinion about
to decide a question, especially a legal one
n. a public official who decides problems of law in a court
zh: n. 法官, 裁判员, 审判官, 鉴定人
vt. 审理, 鉴定, 判断, 判决, 裁定
vi. 下判断, 作评价
examples: He judges other people time and again.
You shouldn't judge a man by his appearance.
exampleZh: 他三番五次评判别人。
你不应该以貌取人。

defsEn: to push down on the feet and move up quickly into the air
zh: n. 跳跃, 跳动, 暴涨, 惊跳
vt. 跳跃, 跃过, 突升, 使跳跃
vi. 跳跃, 跳, 跳动, 暴涨
examples: Jump as high as you can.
Jump down! There is nothing else you can do!
exampleZh: 你会跳多高，就跳多高。
跳下来！没有任何别的可作的！
