defsEn: a group of people chosen to decide what is true in a trial
zh: n. 陪审团, 评判委员会
a. 应急的
examples: The jury's guilty verdict gave rise to widespread debate.
We, the jury, find the defendant guilty of murder.
exampleZh: 陪审团作出的犯罪判决激起了很大的争论。

defsEn: only (“Help me for just a minute.”)
very shortly before or after the present (“He just left.”)
at the same time (“He left just as I came in.”)
what is right or fair (“The law is just, in my opinion.”)
zh: a. 正直的, 合理的, 正确的, 应得的
adv. 刚刚, 正好, 仅仅
examples: I just wish we could leave this horrible place.
You just put a toy down on the table.
exampleZh: 我只是希望我们能离开这个可怕的地方。
你刚才把一个玩意儿落在桌上了。

defsEn: the quality of being right, fair or lawful
zh: n. 正义, 公平, 公正, 正确, 司法, 审判
examples: Justice will prevail in the end.
It is justice, not charity, that is wanting in the world.
exampleZh: 正义终将胜利。
世界需要的是公正，不是施舍。

defsEn: to possess
to have for oneself
zh: n. 生计, 维持, 保持
vt. 保持, 保存, 遵守, 看守, 整理, 维持, 履行, 经营, 拘留, 记帐
vi. 保持, 继续不断
examples: I keep the master copy under lock and key.
Keep a good heart and go on writing.
exampleZh: 我妥善保管原版拷贝。
别气馁，继续写作吧。

defsEn: to hit with the foot
zh: n. 踢, 反冲, 后座力, 凹底
vi. 踢, 反抗, 反冲
vt. 踢, 反冲
examples: He kicked the ball into the goal.
If you did that, they'd kick you out of the bar.
exampleZh: 他把球踢进了球门。
你那么干会被人踢出酒吧的。

defsEn: to seize and take away by force
zh: vt. 绑架, 诱拐, 拐骗
examples: What if someone kidnapped Tom? What would you do?
They kidnapped his son in his sleep.
exampleZh: 要是有人绑架了Tom呢？你会怎么做？

defsEn: to make dead
to cause to die
zh: n. 杀, 杀戮, 小河
vt. 杀, 破坏, 消灭, 使终止, 抵消, 否决
vi. 杀死
examples: I would kill for a plate of polo right now.
You killed my father. Today, I want revenge.
exampleZh: 我现在很想吃一盘抓饭。
你杀了我的父亲，今天我要报仇。

defsEn: sort (“What kind of dog is that?”)
ad. gentle
caring
helpful
zh: n. 种类, 性质, 方式
a. 亲切的, 仁慈的, 和蔼的
examples: There are two kinds of fox spirits: good fox and bad fox.
Those kinds of methods are out of date.
exampleZh: 有两种狐狸精神：好狐狸和坏狐狸。
这种方法早已过时了。

defsEn: to touch with the mouth to show love or honor knife
zh: n. 吻
vt. 吻
vi. 接吻
examples: He kissed his daughter on the forehead.
I kissed her on the forehead.
exampleZh: 他亲了亲他女儿的额头。
我亲了她的额头。

defsEn: a tool or weapon used to cut
zh: n. 小刀, 匕首
vt. 切割, 伤害, 切, 戳
vi. 劈开, 穿过
examples: This knife was very useful to me.
This knife is not at all sharp.
exampleZh: 这把刀对我很有用。
这把刀一点也不快。

defsEn: to understand something as correct
to have the facts about
to recognize someone because you have met and talked together before
zh: v. 知道, 了解, 认识, 确信
examples: But you know, I have nothing aside from this.
I know a good lawyer who can help you.
exampleZh: 但你知道，我除了这些以外一无所有！
我认识一个不错的律师，他可以帮你。

defsEn: that which is known
learning or understanding
zh: n. 知识, 学问, 认识, 知道
examples: My knowledge about Japanese is not that good yet.
My knowledge of Japanese is rather poor.
exampleZh: 我关于日语的知识掌握得还不是很好。
我对日文不大了解。

defsEn: work
workers as a group
zh: 动
examples: Labor is not merely a necessity but a pleasure.
The Labor Day holiday signifies the end of the summer.
exampleZh: 劳动不仅是一种需要，而还是一种愉快。

defsEn: a room or place where experiments in science are done
zh: n. 实验室, 研究室, 化工厂
examples: This laboratory is where we work every day.
His laboratory contains all the deadliest poisons.
exampleZh: 这个实验室是我们每天工作的地方。
他的实验室里有所有最致命的毒。

defsEn: to be without
n. the condition of needing, wanting or not having
zh: n. 缺乏, 无, 不足
vt. 缺乏, 短少, 不足, 需要
vi. 缺乏
examples: By lack of attention, she hit the post with her car.
You lack the most important thing at your age, which is love.
exampleZh: 她心不在焉的把车子撞在了柱子上。
你缺乏你这个年龄最重要的东西，爱。

defsEn: a large area of fresh water surrounded by land
zh: n. 湖, 池, 色淀
v. (使)血球溶解
examples: He went to the lake with her.
The lake was gleaming in the bright sunshine.
exampleZh: 他和她一起去了湖边。
湖水在耀眼的阳光下闪闪发亮。

defsEn: to come to the earth from the air (“Airplanes land at airports.”)
n. the part of the earth not covered by water
the ground
zh: n. 陆地, 地面, 地界, 地产, 国土, 土地
vi. 登陆, 登岸, 到达
vt. 使上岸, 使登陆, 使到达
examples: He bought the land for the purpose of building a house on it.
He bought land for the purpose of building a house.
exampleZh: 他买土地目的是要造房子。
他买土地目的是要造房子。

defsEn: words and their use
what people speak in a country, nation or group
zh: n. 语言, 文字, 措辞
examples: What language do you want to talk in with me?
The language of truth must be, with no doubt, simple and without artifice.
exampleZh: 你想用什么语言和我交谈？
真理的语言必定是朴实无华、毫无矫饰的。

defsEn: big
being of more than usual size, amount or number
opposite small
zh: a. 大的, 大量的, 宽大的, 广博的
adv. 大大地, 夸大地
examples: His large income enables him to travel abroad every year.
A large pillar obstructs the view of the lake.
exampleZh: 他的收入很高，所以每年都能出国旅行。
巨大的柱子遮住了视线，让人看不到湖。

defsEn: an instrument that makes a thin, powerful light
zh: n. 激光
examples: The laser cow in WHAT THE CAR? is both hilarious and terrifying!
Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
exampleZh: 《WHAT THE CAR?》中的雷射奶牛又好笑又吓人！
激光打印机一般比喷墨打印机用起来更省钱。

defsEn: to continue (“The talks will last three days.”)
ad. after all others
the only one remaining (“She is the last person in line.”)
zh: a. 最后的, 末尾的, 最近的
vi. 持续, 支持, 维持
vt. 使维持, 够...用
adv. 最后, 后来
n. 最后, 末尾, 鞋楦头
examples: Last night, I fell into a panic.
At last, she gave in to him and told him the secret.
exampleZh: 昨天晚上，我惊慌失措。
最后，她对他屈服了，并告诉了他这个秘密。

defsEn: after the correct time
near the end
opposite early
zh: a. 迟的, 晚的, 已故的
adv. 很晚, 很迟, 晚
examples: I was late for school on account of an accident.
I was late as a result of the train delay.
exampleZh: 因为一起事故，我上学迟到了。
由于火车延误，我迟到了。

defsEn: to make sounds to express pleasure or happy feelings
zh: n. 笑, 笑声
vi. 笑, 大笑
vt. 以笑表示
examples: She laughed at the sight of his hat.
She laughed to cover her fear.
exampleZh: 看到他的帽子，她笑了。
她笑是为了掩饰自己的恐惧。

defsEn: to put into operation
to begin
to send into the air or space
zh: n. 下水, 汽艇, 发射
vt. 使下水, 发射, 发动
vi. 起飞, 下水, 投入, 开始
examples: The launch was successful. We're now leaving the solar system.
The launch will take place tomorrow.
exampleZh: 发射成功。我们正在离开太阳系。

defsEn: all or any rules made by a government
zh: n. 法律, 法则, 定律, 法律的制约, 法学, 司法界, 诉讼
v. 起诉
examples: This law will deprive us of our basic rights.
The law is not always fair.
exampleZh: 这项法律会剥夺我们的基本权利。
法律并不总是公平的。

defsEn: to show the way
to command
to control
to go first
zh: n. 铅, 铅条, 领导, 超前量, 领引, 榜样, 主角, 导线
vt. 引导, 带领, 领导, 指挥, 致使, 加铅于, 用铅包
vi. 领导, 带头, 导致, 用测深锤测深, 被铅覆盖
a. 带头的, 最重要的
examples: I lead a fast way of living.
We lead a very ordinary life.
exampleZh: 我过着放荡的生活。
我们过着十分平凡的生活。

defsEn: to come out of or to escape through a small opening or hole (usually a gas or liquid)
zh: n. 漏洞, 漏处, 漏出, 泄漏
vi. 漏, 泄漏
vt. 使渗漏
examples: There's a leak in the roof.
There's a leak in that pipe.

defsEn: to get knowledge about
to come to know a fact or facts
zh: vt. 学习；认识到；得知
examples: I learned to use a command block today.
Learning physics can change your way of thinking.
exampleZh: 我今天学会用命令方块了。
学习物理能够改变思维。

defsEn: to go away from
to let something stay where it is
zh: n. 许可, 告别, 请假, 休假
vt. 离开, 剩下, 遗忘, 委托, 丢弃
vi. 出发, 离开, 生叶
examples: Leave me a bit of ice cream.
Would you leave the door open, please?
exampleZh: 给我留点冰激凌。
请你让门开着好吗?

defsEn: on the side that is toward the west when one is facing north
opposite right left
zh: a. 左边的, 左倾的, 左侧的, 左派的
adv. 在左面
n. 左, 左面, 左派
leave的过去式和过去分词
examples: I left the window open all through the night.
I left home early to get a good seat.
exampleZh: 我整晚都开着窗户。
为了弄到一个好位子，我很早就出门了。

defsEn: of or in agreement with the law
zh: a. 法律的, 法定的, 合法的
examples: Seashells were the legal tender in the Shang dynasty.
Legal frameworks exist to hold war criminals accountable.
exampleZh: 在商朝，贝朋为通用货币。
法律架构的存在，使战争罪犯的责任可以追究。

defsEn: a government lawmaking group
zh: n. 立法机关, 议会, 立法院
examples: In a bicameral legislature, both chambers must approve a bill before it becomes law.
The legislature has enacted far-reaching laws.

defsEn: to permit someone to use a thing temporarily
to make a loan of money
zh: vt. 借, 贷款给, 增添, 提供, 出租
vi. 贷款
examples: Lend me your shoulder for me to lean on.
Lend money only to such as will repay it.
exampleZh: 把你的肩膀借给我让我依靠。
只借钱给会还钱的人。

defsEn: smaller in amount
not as much
zh: n. 较少, 较小
a. 少的, 小的
adv. 较少, 较小, 较差
examples: It was less than one kilometer to the village post office.
I chose the less expensive one of the two.
exampleZh: 距离村内的邮政局不到一公里。
我挑了两个中更便宜的那个。

defsEn: to permit to do or to be
to make possible
zh: vt. 让, 假设, 出租, 排放, 妨碍
vi. 出租, 被承包
n. 出租屋, 障碍
examples: Let us think about the worst that could happen.
Let me get you a ticket to the concert.
exampleZh: 考虑一下最坏的情况下会发生什么。
我来帮你弄张演唱会门票吧。

defsEn: a message written on paper
a communication in writing sent to another person letter
zh: n. 信, 字母, 证书, 字面意义, 铅字, 学问, 出租人
vt. 写字母于, 在...上刻字母, 用字母标明
vi. 写印刷体字
examples: The letter will arrive in a week or so.
This letter is the only key to the mystery.
exampleZh: 这封信约一个星期左右到达。
这封信是揭开谜团的唯一线索。

defsEn: the amount or height that something reaches or rises to
the position of something or someone
zh: n. 水平, 水准, 平地
a. 同高的, 平坦的, 齐平的, 水平的
vt. 弄平, 夷平, 使同等, 瞄准, 对准
vi. 变平, 拉平
examples: His level of Spanish should still be improved.
The bookcase is level with the table.
exampleZh: 他的西语水平还应该提高。
书架和桌子齐平。

defsEn: one who usually supports social progress or change
zh: n. 自由主义者
a. 慷慨的, 不拘泥的, 宽大的, 自由主义的
examples: He isn't a liberal in the classic sense of the word.
Are you a liberal or conservative?

defsEn: to have one’s body on the ground or other surface
to say something that one knows is not true
zh: n. 谎言, 假象, 位置
vi. 躺着, 说谎, 位于, 展现, 存在, 停泊
vt. 谎骗
examples: Lie down and rest for a while.
The lie got him in trouble when his boss found out the truth.
exampleZh: 躺下来休息一会儿。
当他的上司察觉他的谎言，麻烦来了。

defsEn: the time between being born and dying
opposite death
all living things
zh: n. 生活, 生命, 人生, 世事, 生物, 寿命, 一生, 生命力, 灵魂, 无期徒刑
examples: My life would be completely empty without you.
Life being very short, we ought not to waste time.
exampleZh: 如果没有你，我的人生就会变得空白一片。
人生十分短暂，我们不应该浪费时间。

defsEn: to take or bring up to a higher place or level
zh: n. 举起, 帮助, 昂扬, 电梯
vt. 升高, 提高, 鼓舞, 清偿, 空运, 举起, 剽窃
vi. 升起, 消散, 耸立
examples: I took the lift to the second floor.
I took the lift to the third floor.
exampleZh: 我坐电梯去了二楼。
我搭电梯去了四楼。

defsEn: a form of energy that affects the eyes so that one is able to see
anything that produces light
ad. bright
clear
not heavy
zh: n. 光, 光亮, 灯, 日光, 发光体, 光源, 杰出人物, 火花, 眼光
a. 轻的, 少量的, 轻微的, 轻快的, 轻浮的, 明亮的, 淡色的, 容易的
vt. 点燃, 照亮
vi. 点着, 变亮, 突降, 偶然碰到
adv. 轻地
examples: There's no light without shade, and no shade without light.
The light is too dim for me to read easily.
exampleZh: 不存在没有阴影的光明，也不存在没有光明的阴影。
灯光太暗了，我没法阅读。

defsEn: light produced by electricity in the air, usually during a storm lightning
zh: n. 闪电
vi. 闪电
a. 闪电的
examples: Lightning-prone area: please do not climb
The lightning lit up the sky.
exampleZh: 雷雨天气请勿登山
闪电照亮了天空。

defsEn: to be pleased with
to have good feelings for someone or something
ad. in the same way as
similar to
zh: a. 相似的, 同样的
vt. 喜欢, 愿意, 想
vi. 喜欢, 希望
n. 爱好, 同样的人(或物)
prep. 象, 如同
adv. 可能
examples: I would like to introduce you to my wife.
What would you like to do in the future?
exampleZh: 让我向您介绍我的妻子。
以后打算干什么？

defsEn: to restrict to a number or amount
n. the greatest amount or number permitted
zh: n. 界限, 边界, 限度, 极限, 限制
vt. 限制, 限定
examples: Limit the consumption of white sugar and salt.
Limit the number of contacts you have to prevent the spread of the disease.
exampleZh: 限制白糖和盐的摄取量。

defsEn: a long, thin mark on a surface
a number of people or things organized
one after another
the edge of an area protected by military forces
zh: n. 列, 线, 绳, 电线, 线路, 路线, 航线, 作业线, 界线, 战线, 外形, 排, 家系
vt. 排成一行, 顺...排列, 划线于, 加衬里, 使有线条, 使起皱纹
vi. 排队
examples: What line of work are you in?
Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
exampleZh: 你做什么工作？
线条艺术强调形式和轮廓，而不是颜色、阴影和纹理。

defsEn: to connect
to unite one thing or event with another
n. a relation between two or more things, situations or events
zh: n. 环, 连结物, 链接, 火把
vt. 连结, 联合, 挽住
vi. 连接起来
examples: What link could there be between that creature and my wife?
A link can join two pieces of chain together.

defsEn: a substance that is not a solid or gas, and can move freely, like water
zh: n. 液体, 流体, 流音
a. 液体的, 透明的, 明亮的, 流动的, 易变的
examples: This liquid can raise people from the dead.
The liquid gave off a strong smell.

defsEn: to put in writing a number of names of people or things
n. a written series of names or things
zh: n. 目录, 名单, 明细表, 布条, 条纹, 列表, 序列, 数据清单
vt. 列出, 列于表上, 记入名单内, 装布条
vi. 列于表上
examples: She went over the list to see if her name was there.
Could you rearrange this list so it's in alphabetical order?
exampleZh: 她走过去看看她的名字是否在清单上。
你能把这清单按字母顺序排列吗？

defsEn: to try to hear
zh: vi. 听, 倾听, 听从
n. 听, 倾听
examples: I listen to the radio every night.
I listen to the radio after dinner.
exampleZh: 我每晚都听收音机。
晚饭后我听收音机。

defsEn: all the poems, stories and writings of a period of time or of a country
zh: n. 文学, 文艺, 著作
examples: Literature is the future of a nation.
My literature course interests me a lot.

defsEn: not tall or big
a small amount
zh: n. 一点点, 少许, 一会儿, 短时间
a. 小的, 很少的, 幼小的, 琐碎的, 短暂的, 矮小的
adv. 很少, 稍微, 完全不
examples: A little fresh air will do me good.
He told me a little secret about her.
exampleZh: 呼吸点新鲜空气会让我好些。
他告诉我她的小秘密。

defsEn: to have life
to exist
ad. having life
alive
zh: a. 活的, 生动的, 精力充沛的, 实况转播的
vi. 活, 生存, 居住
vt. 过着, 度过, 经历
adv. 实况地
examples: They live on the other side of the road.
We live in the vicinity of the school.
exampleZh: 他们住在路对面。
我们住在学校附近。

defsEn: to put objects on or into a vehicle or container
n. that which is carried
zh: n. 负荷, 担子, 重担, 装载量, 负载, 工作量, 加载
vt. 装载, 装填, 使担负
vi. 装货, 上客, 装料
examples: We loaded a lot of luggage into the car.
The load of the truck was in excess of three tons.
exampleZh: 我们往车里装了很多行李。
货车的载货量超过了三吨。

defsEn: money borrowed that usually must be returned with interest payments
something borrowed
zh: n. 贷款, 借出
v. 借, 供应货款, 借给
examples: He got a loan from the bank.
Sami took a loan from the bank.
exampleZh: 他从银行得到了贷款。
莎米向银行贷款。

defsEn: about or having to do with one place
zh: a. 地方性的, 当地的, 局部的, 乡土的, 本地的
n. 当地居民, 本地新闻, 局部
examples: Local people can give appropriate advice.
The locals call this river the man-eating river and fear it.
exampleZh: 当地人可以给予适切的建议。
当地人叫这条河"食人川"并且惧怕着它。

defsEn: feeling alone
zh: a. 孤单的, 孤寂的, 荒凉的
examples: Lonely people perpetuate their own loneliness through their fear of others.
This lonely patient takes pleasure from sewing.
exampleZh: 孤独的人会孤独，是因为他畏惧他人。
这个孤独的病人从缝纫中得到乐趣。

defsEn: not short
measuring from beginning to end
measuring much
for much time
zh: a. 长的, 长久的, 冗长的, 做多头的
vi. 渴望, 热望, 极想
adv. 长久, 始终
n. 长时间, 长信号, 长整型
examples: As long as good people do nothing, evil will triumph.
How long would it take to swim across the river?
exampleZh: 只要好人袖手旁观，恶人就会得胜。
游过这条河要多久？

defsEn: to turn the eyes toward so as to see
to search or hunt for
to seem to be
zh: n. 一看, 神色, 样子, 面容
vi. 看, 注意, 朝着, 显得
vt. 打量, 看上去与...一样, 以眼色(或脸色)显示, 期待
examples: You look tired. You should rest a little.
Look at me when I talk to you!
exampleZh: 你看起来累了。你该歇息一会儿了。
我跟你说话的时候看着我！

defsEn: to have no longer
to not find
to fail to keep
to be defeated
zh: vt. 遗失, 损失, 丢失, 使失去, 错过, 浪费, 迷失, 使迷路, 输去, 使沉溺于
vi. 受损失, 失败
examples: If you lose your way, ask a policeman.
The proletarians lose nothing in this revolution but their chains.
exampleZh: 如果你迷路了，请向警察询问。
无产者在这个革命中失去的只是锁链。

defsEn: having a strong sound
full of sound or noise
zh: a. 大声的, 不断的, 喧吵的
adv. 高声地, 大声地
examples: A loud noise jolted me awake from a deep sleep.
There's a loud noise on this street.

defsEn: to like very much
to feel a strong, kind emotion (sometimes involving sex)
n. a strong, kind emotion for someone or something
opposite hate
zh: n. 爱, 恋爱, 爱情, 爱好, 性爱
vt. 爱, 爱好, 爱慕
vi. 爱
examples: I love her so much I could die.
I love you more than you love me.
exampleZh: 我爱她爱得要命。
我爱你胜过你爱我。

defsEn: not high or tall
below the normal height
close to the ground
zh: n. 低点, 低价, 低, 牛叫声
a. 低的, 消沉的, 低等的, 浅的, 卑贱的
adv. 低下地, 谦卑地, 低
vi. 牛叫
examples: I got a low score on the test.
Low temperatures turn water into ice.
exampleZh: 测试我考了低分。
低温使水变成冰。

defsEn: showing strong friendship and support for someone or something
zh: a. 忠诚的, 忠实的, 忠贞的
examples: To whom are you loyal: me or the king?
As loyal as a dog. Why not as a man?
exampleZh: 你忠于我还是国王？

defsEn: something that happens by chance
zh: n. 运气, 幸运, 好运, 侥幸
vi. 靠好运成功
examples: He had no luck in finding work.
He is shit out of luck.
exampleZh: 他找工作不走运。
他倒霉极了。

defsEn: a device with moving parts used to do work
zh: n. 机器, 机械装置, 机构, 自动售货机, 机械般工作的人
vt. 以机器制造
examples: This machine is too heavy for me to carry.
This machine was of great use to us all.
exampleZh: 这台机器太重了，我拿不动。
这个机器对我们都很有用。

defsEn: a publication of news, stories, pictures or other information
zh: n. 杂志, 仓库, 弹盒, 胶卷盒
examples: A magazine can tell more about a story than a newspaper.
She laid the magazine on the table.
exampleZh: 杂志比报纸报导得更深入。
她把杂志放在桌上。

defsEn: a piece of iron or other material that has a pulling force
this pulling force is called magnetism magnet
zh: n. 磁铁, 有吸引力之人, 有吸引力之物
examples: A magnet can pick up and hold many nails at a time.
The magnets, of course, have a magnetic field around them.

defsEn: letters, papers and other things sent through an official system, such as a post office
zh: n. 邮件, 邮政, 邮递, 盔甲
vt. 邮寄, 给...穿盔甲
examples: The mail train lost most of its mail in the fire.
She forgot to mail the letter.
exampleZh: 那场火灾把邮车上的邮件烧掉了一大半。
她忘了寄信。

defsEn: the most important or largest
zh: n. 主要部分, 干线, 体力, 力量, 主群组
a. 主要的, 重要的, 全力的
examples: The main duty of a priest is to preach in church.
His main object in life was to become rich.
exampleZh: 牧师的主要职责是在教堂里讲道。
他主要的人生目标就是成为一个有钱人。

defsEn: great in size, importance or amount
zh: n. 主修课, 成年人, 陆军少校
a. 主要的, 较多的, 大部分的, 成年的, 严重的
vi. 主修
examples: I majored in philosophy at my university.
I majored in American literature at college.
exampleZh: 我在大学主修哲学。
我在大学主修美国文学。

defsEn: the greater number
more than half
zh: n. 多数, 大半
examples: The majority of his income goes to pay his rent.
The majority of people marry sooner or later.
exampleZh: 他的大部分收入付了租金。
大部分人迟早要结婚。

defsEn: to produce
to create
to build
to do something or to carry out an action
to cause to be or to become
zh: vt. 制造, 安排, 创造, 构成, 使得, 产生, 造成, 整理, 布置, 引起, 到达, 进行
vi. 开始, 前进, 增大, 被制造, 被处理
n. 制造, 构造, 性情
examples: She told us not to make a noise.
To make a cake, you need egg, butter and sugar.
exampleZh: 她叫我们不要制造噪音。
要做蛋糕，你要用到鸡蛋，黄油和糖。

defsEn: a man or boy
the sex that is the father of children
ad. of or about men
zh: n. 男人, 雄性动物
a. 男性的, 雄性的, 有力的
examples: As a heterosexual male I feel a deep interest in the female body.
A male giraffe may weigh up to one and a half ton.

defsEn: an adult male human
zh: n. 男人, 人类, 人
vt. 为...配备人手, 操纵, 使振奋
examples: No man can resist the lure of a woman.
A man of sense would be ashamed to do so.
exampleZh: 没有男人能够抵挡女人的诱惑。
聪明人会羞于干这种事。

defsEn: to make goods in large amounts
zh: n. 产品, 制造
vt. 制造, 假造
vi. 制造
examples: They began to manufacture the machine on a large scale.
We don't manufacture anything any more.

defsEn: a large number or amount of
zh: n. 多数, 多数人
a. 许多的
pron. 许多
examples: How could so many people go along with this?
Many people drift through life without a purpose.
exampleZh: 怎么会有这么多的人同意呢？
许多人毫无目的地随波逐流。

defsEn: a picture of the earth’s surface or a part of it map
zh: n. 地图, 天体图, 映像
vt. 映射, 绘制...地图, 计划
examples: There is a map on the desk.
There is a map on the wall.
exampleZh: 办公桌上面有一张地图。
墙上有张地图。

defsEn: to walk in a group like soldiers
to walk together in a large group to protest about something
zh: n. 三月, 进行, 行军, 步伐, 长途跋涉, 进行曲, 边界
vi. 进军, 前进, 交界
vt. 使行军, 使行进
examples: In March next year, I will fly to the US.
In March next year, I will take a plane to the USA.
exampleZh: 明年三月我坐飞机去美国。
明年三月我坐飞机去美国。

defsEn: to make a sign or cut on something
zh: n. 标志, 分数, 马克, 痕迹, 斑点, 靶子, 刻度, 记号, 符号, 戳记, 标准, 起跑线
vt. 做标记于, 留意, 打分数, 表明, 标志, 记录
vi. 作记号, 记得分
examples: Mark performed in front of people.
Mark the words that you cannot understand.
exampleZh: 马克在众人面前表演。
你不懂的词做个记号。

defsEn: a place or area where goods are sold, bought or traded
an economic system in which the prices of things are decided by how many there are and how much money people are willing to pay for them
zh: n. 市场, 交易, 集市, 推销地区, 行情, 市面, 销路
vt. 在市场上交易, 使上市, 销售
vi. 在市场上买卖
examples: The market rose half a point.
That market has been rapidly expanding.
exampleZh: 市场上涨了半点。
那个市场一直在急速扩展。

defsEn: to join a man and woman together as husband and wife
to become husband and wife (usually in a religious or civil ceremony)
zh: vt. 与...结婚, 娶, 嫁
vi. 结婚
examples: Marry first and love will follow.
Why would you marry a woman if you like men?
exampleZh: 先结婚，那么爱将随之而来。
喜欢男人，为什么还要和女人结婚？

defsEn: an amount of matter having no special form and usually of a large size
zh: n. 块, 大多数, 质量, 大量, 群众, 弥撒
a. 群众的, 大规模的, 整个的
vt. 使集合, 集中
vi. 聚集
examples: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
There is a mass of dark clouds in the sky.
exampleZh: 大量生产降低许多商品的价格。
空中有一大片乌云。

defsEn: to bring together a male and a female to create another creature
zh: n. 配偶, 对手, 助手, (象棋)将死
vt. 使配对, 使一致, 结伴, (象棋)将死
vi. 成配偶, 紧密配合
examples: If you mate a horse with an ass you will get a mule.
Where is the mate to this sock?

defsEn: the substance, substances or matter of which something is made or from which something can be made, such as wood, cloth or stone
anything that can be made into something else
zh: n. 材料, 物资, 素材, 布料, 资料
a. 物质的, 肉体的, 重要的
examples: Not material, but spiritual things determine our life.
This material will wear very well.
exampleZh: 我们的生活不是由物质，而是由精神来决定的。

defsEn: the science dealing with amounts, sizes and shapes, as explained by numbers and signs
zh: n. 数学
examples: Mathematics is the language that God used to create the universe.
Mathematics is like the logic of physics.
exampleZh: 数学是上帝用来创造宇宙的语言。
数学就像物理的逻辑一样。

defsEn: anything that can be seen or felt
what things are made of
zh: n. 事件, 物质, 原因, 素材, 实体, 重要
vi. 有关系
examples: As a matter of fact, I do speak Spanish.
No matter how old one may be, one can learn.
exampleZh: 事实上，我说西班牙语。
不管一个人有多老，他都能学习。

defsEn: a word used with an action word to mean permit or possible (“May I go?” “They may leave tomorrow.”)
zh: n. 五月
aux. 愿能, 可以, 愿意
examples: I may give up soon and just nap instead.
May I ask you for your name and address?
exampleZh: 也许我会马上放弃然后去打盹。
我能问一下您的姓名和住址吗？

defsEn: the chief official of a city or town government
zh: n. 市长
examples: The mayor's family was harassed with threatening phone calls all day.
The mayor denied having taken a bribe.
exampleZh: 市长一家人一整天不断遭到了恐吓电话的骚扰。
市长否认收受了贿赂。

defsEn: food eaten to satisfy hunger, such as dinner
zh: n. 一餐, 膳食, 粗粉
vi. 进餐
examples: We had a meal after noon.
This meal is adequate for three.
exampleZh: 我们午后吃了顿饭。
这饭足够三个人吃。

defsEn: to want to
to give the idea of
to have the idea of
zh: a. 低劣的, 卑贱的, 简陋的, 吝啬的, 惭愧的, 平均的, 中间的, 普通的
vt. 意谓, 想要, 意欲, 预定
vi. 用意, 有意义
n. 平均数, 中间, 中庸
examples: I mean to break up with her.
That means a lot to me.
exampleZh: 我想和她分手。
对我来说意义重大。

defsEn: to learn the amount, size or distance of something
n. an action taken
a legislative proposal
zh: n. 尺寸, 量度器, 量度标准, 测量, 量具, 程度, 范围, 限度, 分寸, 措施, 方法
vt. 测量, 测度, 估量, 权衡, 调节, 拿(自己或自己的力量等)作较量
vi. 度量
examples: This measure is in accord with our policy.
We measured the depth of the river.
exampleZh: 这个议案合符我们的政策内容。
我们测量了这条河的深度。

defsEn: the part of a dead animal used for food
zh: n. 肉, 餐, 食物
examples: I bought meat buns at the convenience store and ate them.
Meat costs a lot these days.
exampleZh: 我在便利店买了肉包吃了。
如今肉类价格昂贵。

defsEn: all public information organizations, including newspapers, television and radio
zh: n. 媒体
examples: The media stuck a shiv into his reputation.
I had otitis media last year.
exampleZh: 媒体抹黑了他的名誉。
我去年得了中耳炎。

defsEn: a substance or drug used to treat disease or pain
the science or study of treating and curing disease or improving health
zh: n. 药, 医学, 内科
vt. 给...用药
examples: This medicine will cure you of your skin disease.
This medicine will give you some relief.
exampleZh: 这药可以治疗你的皮肤病。
这药会让你舒服些。

defsEn: to come together with someone or something at the same time and place
zh: n. 会, 集会
a. 适宜的, 合适的
vt. 遇见, 引见, 认识, 满足, 对付
vi. 相遇, 接触
examples: We meet here once a week.
The meeting will have broken up by the time you arrive there.
exampleZh: 我们每周在这儿聚一次。
等你到的时候应该已经散会了。

defsEn: to make a solid into a liquid by heating it
zh: n. 熔化, 熔化物, 溶解
v. (使)熔化, (使)溶解, (使)消散, (使)变软
examples: Who could melt that stone heart of yours?
Melting polar icecaps could also contribute to an increase in sea levels.
exampleZh: 谁能融化你的铁石心肠？
融化中的极地冰盖也可以使海平面上涨的势态更加严重。

defsEn: one of a group
zh: n. 成员, 会员
examples: He is a member of the tennis club in our school.
Are you a member of the baseball team?
exampleZh: 他是学校网球具乐部的成员。
你是棒球队的一员吗？

defsEn: something done or made to honor the memory of a person or event
zh: n. 纪念物, 请愿书
a. 记念的, 记忆的
examples: Memorial Day is the unofficial start of the U.S. summer vacation season.
The Verdun Memorial is a museum.

defsEn: a picture in the mind of past events
the ability to remember
a thing remembered
zh: n. 记忆, 记忆力, 回忆, 纪念, 存储
n. 内存
examples: My memory failed me. I just could not remember his name.
Memory is an essential function of our brain.
exampleZh: 我的记性不好。我简直不记得他的名字了。
记忆是我们大脑的一种主要功能。

defsEn: about or having to do with the mind
zh: a. 心智的, 精神病的, 心理的, 颏的
n. 精神病患者
examples: Mental health is as important as physical health.
Mental health is also an important part of your overall health.
exampleZh: 精神的健康和身体的健康一样重要。

defsEn: written or spoken news or information
a note from one person to another person or group
zh: n. 消息, 通讯, 讯息, 教训, 预言, 广告词
vt. 通知
vi. 通报, 报告, 报信
examples: My message is important to young people.
This is a message for Tom.
exampleZh: 我的消息对年轻人很重要。
这段讯息是给汤姆的。

defsEn: a hard substance such as iron, steel or gold
zh: n. 金属, 金属制品, 合金, 本质, 质料
a. 金属制的
vt. 以金属覆盖
examples: She took a metal box from the top of the kitchen cabinet.
He sandblasted the metal to remove the rust.

defsEn: the way something is done
zh: n. 方法, 办法, 条理, 秩序
examples: Your method is different from mine.
This method is sure to work.
exampleZh: 你的方法和我的不一样。
这个方法一定会成功。

defsEn: a device used to make very small things look larger so they can be studied microscope
zh: n. 显微镜
examples: He bought a microscope for her.
She bought a microscope for him.

defsEn: the center
a place or time of equal distance from both sides or ends
ad. in the center middle
zh: n. 中央, 中间, 腰部
a. 中央的, 中庸的, 中间的
examples: My PC is in the middle of an update.
It's the middle of the night. Why aren't you asleep?
exampleZh: 我的电脑正在更新。
三更半夜不睡觉，你在干嘛呢？

defsEn: someone active in trying to cause political change, often by the use of force or violence
zh: a. 好战的
examples: He's really militant about gluten, geez.
Ali Ideflawen is a Kabyle militant singer.

defsEn: the armed forces of a nation or group
ad. of or about the armed forces
zh: n. 军队
a. 军事的, 军人的, 适于战争的
examples: The military power of this country is very advanced.
There is a military base near here.
exampleZh: 这个国家的军事力量很先进。
这附近有一个军事基地。

defsEn: an army of citizens instead of professional soldiers
an armed force or private army
zh: n. 义勇军, 民兵组织, 国民军
examples: The militia was formed to defend citizens in an emergency.
The militia withdrew about three years later.

defsEn: the white liquid produced by female animals to feed their young
zh: n. 奶, 乳状物
vt. 挤乳, 榨取
vi. 产乳
examples: Is the milk cold, or still hot?
There is milk all over the kitchen floor because my wife broke the bottle.
exampleZh: 这牛奶是冷的还是热的？
我老婆把瓶子打破了，把厨房弄得满地都是牛奶。

defsEn: the thinking, feeling part of a person
zh: n. 思想, 愿望, 智力, 记忆, 心理, 情绪, 理智, 主意, 心意
vi. 介意, 注意, 留心
vt. 注意, 留意, 专心于, 照看, 介意
examples: Would you mind if I used your car?
Would you mind my opening the door?
exampleZh: 如果用了你的车，你会介意吗?
你介意我开门吗?

defsEn: to dig useful or valuable substances out of the earth
n. a place in the earth where such substances are found
a bomb placed under the ground or under water so it cannot be seen
zh: n. 矿, 矿藏, 地雷
vt. 挖掘, 开采, 在...布雷, 破坏
vi. 开矿, 埋设地雷
pron. 我的
examples: An uncle of mine gave me some useful advice.
A mine is where you find precious minerals.
exampleZh: 我的一个叔叔给我了一些有用的建议。
矿里能找到宝贵的矿物质。

defsEn: a substance found in nature that is not an animal or a plant, such as coal or salt
zh: n. 矿物, 无机物, 苏打水
a. 矿物的, 似矿物的
examples: The mineral zircon is the most important natural source of zirconium.
Minerals such as quartz and feldspar are common in granite.

defsEn: a member of a cabinet
a high government official (“prime minister,” “foreign minister”)
zh: n. 部长, 牧师, 公使
vi. 服侍, 救助, 主持宗教仪式
examples: The minister did not make a comment until now.
The minister worked hard on behalf of the poor.

defsEn: small in size
of little importance
zh: n. 未成年人, 副修科目
a. 较小的, 二流的, 未成年的
vi. 副修
examples: I had a minor issue with my computer.
There's a minor error in that phrase.

defsEn: the smaller number
opposite majority
zh: n. 少数, 未成年, 少数民族
a. 少数的, 属于少数派的
examples: The minority party made a last-ditch effort to block passage of the bills.
Minority language speakers may learn the dominant language for political purposes.

defsEn: a measure of time
one of the sixty equal parts of an hour
sixty seconds
zh: n. 分, 分钟, 片刻, 备忘录, 笔记
vt. 记录, 摘录, 测定时间
a. 微小的, 详细的
examples: The minute I have something to drink, I turn bright red.
I'll be there in a minute.
exampleZh: 我一喝了酒就立刻变得通红。
我马上就到了。

defsEn: to fail to hit, see, reach or meet
zh: n. 失误, 避免, 失败, 小姐
vt. 未得到, 未达到, 未听到, 未觉察, 逃脱, 遗漏, 错过, 思念
vi. 失败, 击不中
examples: I miss you all the time.
I miss you. I need to see you. Could I come over?
exampleZh: 我从早到晚都想念你。
我想你。我需要见你。我能来吗？

defsEn: any weapon that can be thrown or fired through the air and explodes when it reaches its target
zh: n. 发射物, 导弹, 飞弹, 火箭
a. 可发射的
examples: The missile streaked across the sky like a comet.
The missile attack took a heavy toll of lives.

defsEn: lost
not found
zh: a. 不见的, 缺少的
examples: Let me apologize once again for missing our meeting.
You have no idea how many people go missing here.

defsEn: a wrong action or decision
an action done without the knowledge that it was wrong
zh: n. 错误, 误会
vi. 犯错, 误认
vt. 误解, 弄错
examples: There is a mistake in this sentence.
There is a mistake in the sentence.
exampleZh: 这句话有个错。
句子里有一个错误。

defsEn: to put different things together to make one thing
zh: n. 混合物, 混乱, 糊涂
vt. 使混合, 弄混, 使结合, 混淆
vi. 相混合, 交往, 参与
examples: Mix the rice, egg and soy sauce.
If you mix blue and red, you'll get purple.
exampleZh: 混合米、蛋跟酱油。
如果将蓝色和红色混合，就会得到紫色。

defsEn: a large group of wild or angry people
zh: n. 暴民, 民众, 暴徒
vt. 大举包围, 蜂拥进入, 围攻
vi. 聚众生事
examples: The mob put a price on Tom's head.
The mob gathered round the car like so many flies.
exampleZh: 黑帮悬赏捉拿汤姆。

defsEn: an example
something, usually small, made to show how something will look or work
zh: n. 模型, 模范, 模特儿
a. 模范的, 作模型用的
vi. 做模型, 做模特儿
vt. 使模仿, 塑造
examples: I've memorized the model number of the charger.
Mike has been making a model plane since breakfast.
exampleZh: 我把充电器的型号记下了。
迈克吃完早饭以后一直在做一个模型飞机。

defsEn: not extreme
zh: a. 适度的, 稳健的, 中等的, 节制的
vt. 节制, 减轻, 使缓和
vi. 变缓和, 主持会议
examples: Moderate exercise will refresh both mind and body.
Moderate exercise is necessary for good health.
exampleZh: 适度的运动让身心焕然一新。
适度运动对身体健康是必要的。

defsEn: of the present or very recent time
the most improved
zh: n. 现代人, 有思想的人
a. 现代的, 时髦的
examples: Modern ships only need a small crew.
Modern travel enables us to go around the world in a few days.
exampleZh: 现代船只只需要一小组的船员。
现代交通使我们能在几天内环绕地球。

defsEn: the smallest amount of a chemical substance that can exist
zh: n. 分子, 些微
examples: A molecule of water is made up of one oxygen and two hydrogen atoms.
The molecule's complexity makes its synthesis almost impossible.

defsEn: pieces of metal or paper used to pay for things money
zh: n. 金钱, 一笔款, 财富, 货币, 金额
examples: The money you give them will be put to good use.
If I had the money, I would often go out and have fun.
exampleZh: 你给他们的钱会用到好处。
要是我有钱的话，我将常常出去玩儿。

defsEn: one of the twelve periods of time into which a year is divided
zh: n. 月
examples: You're a month behind in your rent.
This month was kind of difficult.
exampleZh: 你的租金迟交了一个月。
这个月我过得有点艰难。

defsEn: the bright object often seen in the night sky that orbits the earth about every twenty-nine days
zh: n. 月亮, 月球, 月光
vi. 闲荡
vt. 虚度
examples: The Moon is not a planet, but a satellite of the Earth.
The moon is not a good place to live on.
exampleZh: 月球不是一颗行星，而是地球的一颗卫星。
月球不是一个适合居住的地方。

defsEn: concerning what is right or wrong in someone’s actions
zh: n. 道德, 品行, 寓意
a. 道德的, 品性端正的, 精神上的
examples: Moral evil is the result of ignorance.
A moral dilemma can be difficult to solve.
exampleZh: 道德上的恶乃是无知的后果。

defsEn: greater in size or amount
zh: n. 更多
a. 多的, 程度较大的, 更大的
adv. 多, 更多, 进一步
examples: The more you know, the less you understand.
More money for education will spur economic growth.
exampleZh: 人知道的越多，懂的就越少。
更多投资在教育的钱将会刺激经济成长。

defsEn: the early part of the day, from sunrise until noon
zh: n. 早晨, 早上, 初期
examples: In the morning, I write in the park.
In the morning I always drink a cup of coffee.
exampleZh: 我每天早上在公园写作。
在早晨，我总是喝一杯咖啡。

defsEn: greatest in size or amount
zh: n. 最多, 最大
a. 大多数的, 几乎全部的, 最多的
adv. 最, 最多, 极其
examples: Most people only want to hear their own truth.
Most people write about their daily life.
exampleZh: 大部分人只想听到他们自己的真理。
大部分人写的东西是关于他们的日常生活的。

defsEn: the female parent
a woman who has a child or children
zh: n. 母亲, 修女院长
vt. 产生, 照看, 收养
examples: My mother told me to clean the room.
My mother can play golf very well.
exampleZh: 我妈要求我把我的房间收拾好。
我妈妈高尔夫打得很好。

defsEn: a movement
a continuing change of position or place
zh: n. 移动, 手势, 动作, 意向, 请求, 提议
v. 打手势
examples: I motioned for her to sit down.
He motioned to me to go to him.
exampleZh: 我对她做了一个手势，叫她坐下。

defsEn: a part of the earth’s surface that rises high above the area around it mountain
zh: n. 山, 山脉, 大堆
examples: The mountain used to send out clouds of smoke.
The mountain has a beautiful shape.
exampleZh: 这座山过去常常发出烟雾。
这座山有一个美丽的外形。

defsEn: to express or feel sadness
zh: v. 哀悼, 忧伤, 服丧
examples: She mourned the loss of her best friend.
She mourned the death of her only son.

defsEn: to change position
to put or keep in motion
to go
zh: n. 移动, 迁居, 步骤
vt. 移动, 开动, 感动, 搬(家)
vi. 移动, 离开, 运行, 迁移, 摇动, 搬家, 交往, 进展, 脱手
examples: Could you move the chair a bit?
Move up to the front, please.
exampleZh: 你可以移一移那张椅子吗？
请到前面来。

defsEn: the act of moving or a way of moving
a series of acts or efforts to reach a goal
zh: n. 运动, 动作, 运转, 移动, 倾向, 变化, 活动, 乐章
examples: The BDS movement is so important.
The movement of South Africa can no longer suppress the movement for equality.
exampleZh: BDS 运动非常重要。

defsEn: a motion picture
a film
zh: n. 电影
examples: This movie is very popular among young people.
The movie was less funny than the book.
exampleZh: 这部电影在年轻人之间很流行。
电影不如原著好看。

defsEn: great in amount
zh: n. 大量, 许多, 重要的事
a. 很多的, 重要的
adv. 多, 甚, 几乎
examples: How much sugar should I put in your coffee?
How much do you want in terms of salary?
exampleZh: 我应该往你的咖啡里放多少糖呢？
您想要多少工资？

defsEn: to kill another person illegally
n. the crime of killing another person
zh: n. 谋杀
vt. 谋杀, 损毁, 破坏
vi. 犯杀人罪
examples: He avenged the murder of his father.
Murdering elephants, tigers and other endangered species is not just cruel; it's also illegal.
exampleZh: 他对杀父凶手进行了报复。
杀害大象、老虎等濒危物种，不仅是残忍的，也是非法的。

defsEn: the making of sounds by singing or using a musical instrument
zh: n. 音乐, 乐曲
examples: His music and words appeal to young people.
The music carried me back to my childhood.
exampleZh: 他的曲和词都很受年轻人欢迎。
这些音乐勾起了我儿时的回忆。

defsEn: a word used with an action word to mean necessary (“You must go to school.”)
zh: n. 必须, 未发酵葡萄汁, 绝对必要的事物
aux. 必须
examples: You must be careful not to make him angry.
You must put an end to this foolish behavior.
exampleZh: 你要小心别惹他生气。
你该结束这种愚蠢的行为了。

defsEn: something that is not or cannot be explained or understood
a secret
zh: n. 秘密, 神秘, 奥秘
examples: There's a mystery here and I want to get to the bottom of it.
This mystery novel will keep your mother guessing until the end.

defsEn: to appoint
to nominate
to give a name to
n. a word by which a person, animal or thing is known or called
zh: n. 名字, 名称, 姓名, 名义, 名誉, 文件名
vt. 命名, 称呼, 任命, 提名, 列举
a. 姓名的, 据以取名的
examples: She wrote down their name so as not to forget it.
What's the name of your insurance company?
exampleZh: 为了不要忘掉，她把那个人的名字写下来。
你的保险公司叫什么名字？

defsEn: limited in size or amount
not wide
having a short distance from one side to the other
zh: n. 狭窄部分, 隘路
a. 狭窄的, 仔细的, 有限的, 勉强的, 狭隘的, 手紧的
vi. 变窄
vt. 使变狭窄
examples: There's narrow road to the village.
The gate is so narrow that the car can't pass through it.
exampleZh: 到村庄有条窄路。
门太窄了，这辆车通不过。

defsEn: a country, together with its social and political systems
zh: n. 国家, 民族
examples: The two nations have strong trade ties.
A nation need not necessarily be powerful to be great.
exampleZh: 这两个国家有强大的贸易关系。

defsEn: someone who was born in a place, not one who moved there
zh: n. 本地人, 土产, 当地人
a. 本国的, 与生俱来的, 自然的
examples: My native language is the most beautiful gift from my mother.
She is a native speaker of French.
exampleZh: 我的母语是我从我母亲那里得到的最美好的礼物。
她的母语是法语。

defsEn: of or about nature
normal
common to its kind
zh: n. 白痴
a. 自然的, 自然界的, 本能的, 天然的, 物质的, 正常的, 原始的, 自然数的
examples: What is your natural hair color?
What is your natural hair colour?
exampleZh: 你的头发自然发色是什么颜色？
你的头发自然发色是什么颜色？

defsEn: all the plants, animals and other things on earth not created by humans
events or processes not caused by humans
zh: n. 自然, 大自然, 本性, 性格, 性质
examples: Nature plays an important role in our life.
Nature never deceives us; it is always we who deceive ourselves.
exampleZh: 大自然在我们的生活中扮演着重要的角色。
自然从不会欺骗我们，骗我们的永远是我们自己。

defsEn: the part of a country’s military force trained to fight at sea
zh: n. 海军, 海军人员, 海军军力, 烟蒂
examples: We were in the Navy together.
She wore a navy trouser suit and a cream blouse.

defsEn: not far
close to
zh: a. 近的, 近亲的, 近似的
adv. 接近, 亲近
prep. 靠近, 近似于
v. 接近, 走近
examples: In the near future, we may have a big earthquake in Japan.
I grew up near a river.
exampleZh: 在不久的将来，可能有一场大地震将在日本发生。
我在一条河的附近长大。

defsEn: needed to get a result or effect
required
zh: a. 必要的；必然的；必需的
examples: It's necessary that we all work together to complete this assignment.
If necessary, I have no objection to paying a special fee.
exampleZh: 我们必须一起完成这个任务。
如果必要的话，我不反对付特别费用。

defsEn: to require
to want
to be necessary to have or to do
zh: n. 需要, 必须, 缺乏
vt. 需要, 必需
vi. 贫困, 有必要
aux. 需要
examples: We need to turn right at the next junction.
We need to go right at the next junction.
exampleZh: 我们得在下一个路口右拐。
我们得在下一个路口右拐。

defsEn: to talk about a problem or situation to find a common solution
zh: vi. 商议, 谈判, 交涉
vt. 谈妥, 转让, 处理
examples: They negotiate with their employer about their wages.
They would negotiate a peace treaty.

defsEn: a person or country that is next to or near another
zh: 邻近的
examples: My neighbor renovated her house completely.
He is my neighbor, but I don't know him well.
exampleZh: 我的邻居把她的屋子翻新了一遍。
虽然他是我的邻居，但是我对他并不太了解。

defsEn: not one or the other of two
zh: adv. 皆不, 两个都不
a. (两者)都不的
pron. 两者都不
conj. 既非, 既不
examples: Neither team played well in the game.
She is neither in the kitchen nor in the living room.
exampleZh: 两组在比赛中的表现都不太好。
她不在厨房里，也不在客厅里。

defsEn: a thin piece of tissue that sends information through the body to and from the brain
zh: n. 精神, 勇气, 叶脉, 神经
vt. 鼓起勇气
examples: She had the nerve to speak out.
He had the nerve to ask me to help him.
exampleZh: 她竟敢说出来。

defsEn: not supporting one side or the other in a dispute
zh: n. 中立者, 中立国, 非彩色, 空档
a. 中立的, 中性的, 无色的
examples: A neutral country was asked to help settle the dispute.
A neutral work is the work of a coward.

defsEn: at no time
not ever
zh: adv. 从不, 决不, 不曾
examples: I never have an ice cream without feeling happy.
Never trust a woman with a pistol in hand.
exampleZh: 我一吃冰淇淋就高兴。
千万别相信一个手里拿手枪的女人。

defsEn: not existing before
not known before
recently made, built, bought or grown
another
different
zh: a. 新的, 陌生的, 最近的, 不熟悉的
examples: His new novel will come out next month.
This new market may improve the entire industry.
exampleZh: 他的新小说将会在下个月出版。
这个新的市场可能改良全部的工业。

defsEn: information about any r ecent events, especially as reported by the media
zh: n. 新闻, 消息, 报导
examples: I have some good news and some bad news.
The news of their marriage spread throughout the village.

defsEn: coming immediately after
nearest
zh: n. 下一个
a. 下一个的, 其次的, 贴近的
adv. 然后, 下次, 次于
examples: Next time it will be my turn to drive.
Who would be its next victim?
exampleZh: 下次该轮到我开车了。
谁会是下一个受害者?

defsEn: pleasing
good
kind
zh: a. 美好的, 和蔼的, 正派的, 做得好的, 精密的, 细微的, 挑剔的, 谨慎的
examples: It would be nice to have a party.
There is a nice restaurant in front of the station.
exampleZh: 开个聚会很好。
车站前有一家不错的餐厅。

defsEn: the time between when the sun goes down and when it rises, when there is little or no light night
zh: n. 夜, 夜晚, 晚上, 黑暗, 夜晚的工作
examples: At night, she gazed at the moon.
At night, we usually go bowling.
exampleZh: 她在夜晚望着月亮。
我们经常在夜晚打保龄球。

defsEn: used to reject or to refuse
not any
not at all
zh: n. 不, 拒绝, 否决票
a. 没有, 不是, 绝非
adv. 不

defsEn: sound, especially when loud
zh: n. 噪音, 杂音, 响声, 喧闹
vt. 谣传
vi. 喧闹
examples: Noise pollution could be avoided if only people were more sensitive to the environment.
This noise is driving me crazy.
exampleZh: 如果大家都懂得关心环境的话，就不会有噪音污染了。
这个噪声快把我逼疯了。

defsEn: to name someone as a candidate for an election
to propose a person for an office or position
zh: vt. 提名, 任命, 命名
examples: They nominated Calvin Coolidge for vice president.
Who would you nominate for this award?
exampleZh: 他们提名卡尔文•柯立芝为副总统。

defsEn: the middle of the day
twelve o’clock in the daytime
zh: n. 正午, 中午, 全盛期
examples: At noon, I arrived in Tokyo.
At noon they lay down in a forest to rest.
exampleZh: 中午，我抵达东京。

defsEn: the usual condition, amount or form
ad. usual
what is expected
zh: n. 常态, 标准, 正常, 普通
a. 正常的, 正规的, 标准的, 师范的, 正态的
examples: It's normal to be a little afraid.
It's normal to experience workplace crushes, but remember to stay professional.
exampleZh: 有点怕很正常。
在职场中对某人产生好感是很正常的，但记得要保持专业形象。

defsEn: the direction to the left of a person facing the rising sun
zh: n. 北方, 北
a. 北的, 北方的
adv. 向北方, 在北方
examples: The north and south differ greatly from each other.
The north differs greatly from the south.
exampleZh: 南方和北方的差异很大。
南方和北方的差异很大。

defsEn: a word showing that something is denied or untrue (“She is not going.”)
zh: adv. 不, 非, 未

defsEn: to talk about something already known
n. a word or words written to help a person remember
a short letter
zh: n. 笔记, 记录, 注解, 票据, 符号, 显要, 注重, 便笺, 照会
vt. 记录, 注解, 注意
examples: Note that the maximum doesn't always exist.
There was a note on my desk in Tom's handwriting.
exampleZh: 注意，最大值不总是存在的。
我的桌上有一张便条，上面的字是汤姆的。

defsEn: not anything
no thing
zh: n. 无, 不关紧要之事, 零
adv. 毫不, 决不
interj. 什么也没有, 无
examples: Nothing will hinder my malicious plan.
Nothing can be worse than that.
exampleZh: 没有什么能阻碍我邪恶的计划。
没有比这更坏的了。

defsEn: at this time
immediately
zh: adv. 现在, 刚才, 目前
n. 现在
a. 现在的
conj. 由于
examples: Now, get off the boat and swim to shore.
And now you want her to come back?
exampleZh: 现在下船，游到岸边。
然后你现在还想让她回来？

defsEn: not in, to or at any place
zh: adv. 无处, 到处都无
examples: There is nowhere in the whole world without poverty.
He said he had nowhere to go.
exampleZh: 全世界没有一个地方没有贫穷。
他说他无处可去。

defsEn: of or about the energy produced by splitting atoms or bringing them together
of or about weapons that explode by using energy from atoms
zh: a. 核子的, 原子能的, 核的, 中心的
examples: A nuclear war will bring about the destruction of mankind.
Nuclear power plants are dangerous, not to mention nuclear weapons.
exampleZh: 核战争将会为人类带来灭亡。
核电厂具危险性，更不用说核武器了。

defsEn: the center part of an atom or cell
zh: n. 核心, 核子, 原子核, 起点
examples: You two are the nucleus of the team.
The coma and the nucleus together form the comet's head.
exampleZh: 你们俩是团队的核心。

defsEn: a food or substance that makes plants, humans or animals grow
zh: a. 营养的, 滋养的
n. 营养物, 滋养物
examples: Nutrients are absorbed through the wall of the ileum.

defsEn: a word or sign used to show the order or amount of things number
zh: n. 数, 数字, 数目, 号码
vt. 数, 计算, 共计
vi. 计算, 报数
examples: What number bus do I take to get to Waikiki?
Quite a number of people still believe it.
exampleZh: 我乘几路车去怀基基？
还有不少人依然相信呢。

defsEn: to act as one is ordered to act
zh: vt. 服从, 遵从, 顺从
vi. 服从
examples: To obey the law is everyone's duty.
We obey our parents because we honor them and we love them.
exampleZh: 遵守法律是每个人的责任。

defsEn: to show that one does not like or approve
to protest
n. something not alive that can be seen or touched
zh: n. 物体, 目标, 目的, 对象, 宾语, 客体
vi. 反对, 抱反感
vt. 提出...来反对
examples: I object to her going there alone.
He objects to being treated like a child.
exampleZh: 我不同意她一个人去那儿。
他不想被当成孩子看待。

defsEn: to watch
to look at carefully
to celebrate or honor something (“They will observe the anniversary of the day she was born.”)
zh: vt. 觉察到, 遵守, 注意到, 庆祝
vi. 注意, 评论
examples: I observe a chimpanzee peel a banana and eat it.
We observed this plant closely for a few weeks.
exampleZh: 我观察到一只黑猩猩剥了一根香蕉并吃了它。
我们密切地关注这家工厂几个星期了.

defsEn: to take and hold or to control by force
zh: vt. 占领, 占(时间、空间等), 住进, 担任, 使从事, 使全神贯注
examples: We occupy too much space on this planet.
He occupies a prominent position in the firm.

defsEn: the area of salt water that covers almost seventy-five percent of the earth’s surface
any of the five main divisions of this water ocean
zh: n. 海洋, 广阔, 许多, 一大片
examples: Oceans do not so much divide the world as unite it.
The crevice in the boulder on the ocean floor conceals an octopus.
exampleZh: 海洋不是将世界分隔开来，而是将世界连接起来
海底的岩石缝里藏着一只章鱼。

defsEn: made from
belonging to
about
connected to
included among
zh: prep. 的, 属于

defsEn: away
at a distance
condition when something is no longer operating or continuing
not on
not connected
zh: a. 关着的, 不再生效的, 处于...境况的, 休假的, 空闲的
adv. 走开, ...掉, ...下, 休息, 出发, 隔断
prep. 离开, 脱落, 不在从事......, 在...之外
vi. 离开, 滚开
vt. 杀死
n. 关闭状态

defsEn: a military campaign of attack
ad. having to do with attacking
zh: a. 令人不快的, 侮辱的, 攻击性的
examples: They went on the offensive in the first half.
Offensive behaviour can result from an inferiority complex.

defsEn: to present or propose
n. the act of presenting or proposing
that which is presented or proposed
zh: n. 给予(物), 出价, 提议, 意图, 报价
vt. 提供, 出价, 奉献, 试图, 使出现, 演出
vi. 出现, 献祭, 提议, 求婚
examples: He offered his seat to an old woman.
The offer is too good to turn down.
exampleZh: 他把座位让给了一个老婆婆。
此提议好得令人难以拒绝。

defsEn: a room or building where business or work is done
a public position to which one is elected or appointed
zh: n. 办公室, 部, 公职, 职责
examples: His office is past the bank on your left.
His office is near the train station.
exampleZh: 经过银行，左边就是他的办公室了。
他的办公室离车站很近。

defsEn: a person in the military who commands others
any person who is a member of a police force
zh: n. 军官, 主管, 官员, 公务员
vt. 指挥
examples: Officer, I beg you to help me.
An officer will be there soon.

defsEn: a person with power in an organization
a representative of an organization or government
ad. of or about an office
approved by the government or someone in power
zh: n. 官员, 公务员, 职员
a. 公务的, 官方的, 正式的
examples: He made an official visit to the French president the day before yesterday.
Esperanto, an official language of the European Union, now!
exampleZh: 他前天拜会了法国总统。
请立即将世界语订为欧洲联盟的官方语言

defsEn: many times
zh: adv. 时常, 常常
examples: How often do you have to see the dentist?
How often do you wash your car a month?
exampleZh: 你多久看一次牙医？
你每个月洗几次车？

defsEn: a thick liquid that does not mix with water and that burns easily
a black liquid taken from the ground and used as fuel
zh: n. 油, 石油, 油画颜料
vt. 涂油于, 使融化成油状, 加油于
vi. 加燃油, 融化
examples: Oil does not mix with water.
Oil and water won't blend with each other.
exampleZh: 油和水不能混在一起。
油和水不能混合。

defsEn: not young or new
having lived or existed for many years
zh: n. 以前, 往昔
a. 老的, 旧的, 古老的, 年长的, 老练的
examples: The old man set off at a quick trot.
The old woman fell and could not get up.
exampleZh: 老人快步走开了。
那个老太太摔倒了爬不起来。

defsEn: above and held up by
touching the upper surface of (“The book is on the table.”)
supported by (“He is on his feet.”)
about (“The report on the meeting is ready.”)
at the time of (“He left on Wednesday.”)
zh: prep. 在...之上
adv. ...上去
a. 正起作用的

defsEn: one time only
zh: adv. 一次, 曾经, 一旦
conj. 一旦, 一经
n. 一次
a. 从前的

defsEn: being the single one or ones
no more than (“We have only two dollars.”)
zh: a. 唯一的, 仅有的, 最佳的
adv. 只有, 仅仅, 只能
conj. 但是, 不过
examples: If only I read the user manual properly.
If only I can go to the concert!
exampleZh: 要是当时有好好读说明书就好了。
要是我能去音乐会就好了。

defsEn: to start (“They opened talks.”)
ad. not closed
not secret
zh: n. 公开, 户外, 空旷
a. 开着的, 开放的, 开阔的, 营业着的, 公开的, 悬而未决的
vt. 打开, 公开, 开放
vi. 展开, 开始, 展现
examples: Open the door and let me in, please.
She told me to open the window.
exampleZh: 拜托你开门让我进来吧。
她告诉我把窗户打开。

defsEn: to do work or a job
to cut into the body for medical reasons
zh: v. 操作, 运转, 动手术, 活动
examples: They operate in a different way.
We operate on both sides of the border.

defsEn: a belief based on one’s own ideas and thinking
zh: n. 意见, 评价, 主张
examples: In my opinion, it would be difficult to solve this problem.
I am of the opinion that he will never come back.
exampleZh: 在我看来，这个问题很难解决。
我看他永远也不会回来了。

defsEn: to be against
to fight against
zh: vt. 反对, 以...对抗, 抗争
vi. 反对
examples: I'm opposed to any type of war.
Everyone opposed it, but they got married all the same.
exampleZh: 我反对任何形式的战争。
他们不理众人的反对结了婚。

defsEn: different as possible
completely different from
exactly the other way (“North is the opposite direction from south.”)
zh: a. 相对的, 相反的, 对面的
prep. 对面
n. 对立面
examples: What they told you is the opposite of what they told me yesterday.
The opposite of "inconvenient" is "convenient".
exampleZh: 她们跟你说的可和她们昨天跟我说的完全相反。
「不方便」的相反词是「方便」。

defsEn: to make others suffer
to control by the use of unjust and cruel force or power
zh: vt. 压迫, 压抑, 使烦恼
examples: They oppress linguistic minorities, because they see minority languages as a threat.
The oppressed people cried out for their liberty.

defsEn: giving another of two choices
giving the last of several choices
zh: conj. 或, 或者

defsEn: to travel in space around a planet or other object
n. the path or way an object travels in space around another object or planet orbit
zh: n. 轨道, 常轨, 眼眶
vt. 绕...轨道而行
vi. 进入轨道, 盘旋
examples: The orbit of Mars around the Sun is extremely elliptical.
We're in orbit around a gas giant.

defsEn: to give a command
to tell someone what to do
n. a command
the correct or normal way things are organized
a peaceful situation in which people obey laws
zh: n. 次序, 规则, 命令
vi. 命令, 定货
vt. 整理, 命令, 定购
n. 顺序, 阶数
examples: In order to apply, you have to go in person.
In order to make life happy, you must love the everyday trifles.
exampleZh: 要申请的话，你得亲自去。
热爱生活中的日常琐事，人生才会快乐。

defsEn: a part of the body that has a special purpose, such as the heart or brain
zh: n. 风琴, 器官, 元件, 机构, 机关
examples: What is the largest organ in the human body? The answer may surprise you.
There is usually an organ in a church.

defsEn: a living thing, often so small it can be seen only through a microscope
zh: n. 生物, 有机体, 社会组织
examples: This organism can survive in outer space.
This organism can survive at temperatures well below the freezing point of water.

defsEn: to put in order
to put together into a system
zh: vt. 组织, 有机化, 给予生机
vi. 组织起来
examples: I organized a marriage ceremony last month.
He organized a classroom debate on current events.
exampleZh: 我上个月举行了婚礼。
他组织了一场关于时事的课堂辩论。

defsEn: different
of another kind
the remaining one or ones of two or more (“That man is short
the other is tall.”)
zh: a. 其他的, 另外的, 从前的
pron. 其他的, 他人, 另外一个
examples: What other choice do I have?
The other day I went fishing for the first time in my life.
exampleZh: 我有什么别的选择？
前几天人生第一次去钓鱼了。

defsEn: of or belonging to us
zh: pron. 我们的

defsEn: to force to leave
to remove by force
zh: vt. 逐出, 罢黜, 剥夺, 驱逐
examples: Karl was ousted by his partner four years ago.

defsEn: away from the inside
opposite of in
zh: a. 外面的, 熄灭的, 结束的
adv. 在外, 熄灭, 出现
prep. 出自, 离去, 向

defsEn: above
covering
across, in or on every part of (“all over the world”)
zh: adv. 结束, 越过, 从头到尾
prep. 在...之上, 遍于...之上, 越过
a. 上面的
vt. 越过

defsEn: to remove from power
to defeat or end by force
zh: n. 推翻, 瓦解, 倾覆
vt. 打倒, 推翻, 倾覆
examples: The people want to overthrow the regime.
Tom wants to overthrow the government.

defsEn: to pay or have to repay (usually money) in return for something received
zh: vt. 亏欠, 负...债, 归功于, 怀有, 应给予, 感恩
vi. 欠钱
examples: You owe me an apology for that.
I owe my success to his help.
exampleZh: 关于那件事你欠我一个道歉。
我的成功要归功于他。

defsEn: to have or possess for oneself
zh: n. 自己的
a. 自己的, 嫡亲的, 同胞的
vt. 拥有, 支配, 自认, 承认, 顺从于
vi. 承认, 供认
examples: His own survival is more important now.
She woke up on her own.
exampleZh: 他自己的生存现在更重要了。
她自己起床的。

defsEn: a hurt or suffering somewhere in the body
zh: n. 痛苦, 疼痛, 辛苦
vt. 使痛苦, 痛苦
vi. 作痛, 疼
examples: If the pain continues you have to go to the doctor.
What pain are you trying to cover up with alcohol?
exampleZh: 如果持续疼痛, 你必须去看医生。
你借酒浇愁是为了什么事？

defsEn: to cover with a liquid color
to make a picture with liquid colors
n. a colored liquid used to cover or protect a surface
zh: n. 油漆, 颜料, 绘画作品, 涂漆
vt. 油漆, 绘, 画, 描绘, 装饰, 点缀
vi. 绘画, 涂漆
examples: This painting is worth a great deal of money.
I got him to paint the fence.
exampleZh: 这幅画值很多钱。
我让他油漆了这个栅栏。

defsEn: a thin, flat material made from plants or cloth often used for writing
zh: n. 纸, 文件, 文章, 报纸, 证券, 证件
vt. 用纸糊, 贴壁纸于, 用纸包装
vi. 贴壁纸
a. 纸做的, 纸上的
examples: The paper is too big for the envelope.
Paper is very easy to set on fire.
exampleZh: 这张纸太大，塞不进信封里。
纸很容易着火。

defsEn: a device that permits a person or thing to fall slowly from an airplane or helicopter to the ground parachute
zh: n. 降落伞
vi. 跳伞
examples: Where's the parachute? I thought you said pair of shoes!
What if the parachute doesn't open?

defsEn: a group of people and vehicles moving together to celebrate a special event or anniversary
zh: n. 游行, 炫耀, 阅兵
v. 游行, 炫耀, (使)列队行进
examples: There was a parade to mark the occasion.
The parade went through the crowd.

defsEn: to forgive for a crime and release from punishment
zh: n. 原谅, 赦免
vt. 宽恕, 原谅
examples: Pardon me, but that is my racket.
Pardon me, but that's my racket.
exampleZh: 抱歉，这是我的球拍。
抱歉，这是我的球拍。

defsEn: a father or mother
zh: n. 父母, 父母亲, 根源
examples: A parent or teacher should bring home to children the pleasure of reading.
Parents try to impress upon their children the importance of honesty and hard work.
exampleZh: 家长或老师应该让孩子们享受阅读的乐趣。
父母试图将诚实和工作的重要性灌输给孩子。

defsEn: a government lawmaking group
zh: n. 国会, 议会
examples: Parliament must now support the motion.
The parliament declared the country a secular state.

defsEn: something less than the whole
not all of something
zh: n. 部分, 局部, 零件, 要素, 等分, 职责, 角色, 部位
vt. 分开, 分离, 断绝, 区别, 分配
vi. 分开, 断裂, 分手
a. 部分的, 局部的
adv. 部分地, 有些
examples: The saddest part of the story remains to be told.
What part of the movie did you like best?
exampleZh: 这则故事最悲情的部分尚未揭晓。
你最喜欢这部电影的哪一部分呢？

defsEn: a very small piece of matter
zh: n. 颗粒, 粒子, 质点, 极小量
examples: This particle turns a noun into a verb.
We are a particle of the universe.

defsEn: a person who takes part in some activity in common with another or others. (“The two men were business partners.”)
zh: n. 合伙人, 股东, 伙伴, 伴侣
vt. 与...合伙, 组成一对
vi. 做伙伴, 当助手
examples: If your partner asked to marry you, what would you do?
My partner and I work hard.

defsEn: a group of people working together for a political purpose
a group of people or friends gathered together for enjoyment
zh: n. 宴会, 党, 政党, 团体, 当事人, 聚会
v. 举办聚会
examples: The party was put off for a week.
The party was, on the whole, successful.
exampleZh: 派对延期了一周。
这个派对真成功。

defsEn: to go by or move around something
to move along
to cause or permit to go
zh: n. 经过, 要隘, 途径, 通行, 护照, 及格
vt. 经过, 越过, 通过, 批准, 度过, 传递, 忽略
vi. 经过, 变化, 流通, 及格, 宣判, 终止, 消逝, 被忽略, 不叫牌, 传递
examples: If you pass this test, you could graduate next month.
He could pass the examination, could not he?
exampleZh: 如果你通过这个考试，你下个月就可以毕业了。
他能过考试的，是不是？

defsEn: a person traveling by airplane, train, boat or car who is not the pilot or driver passport
zh: n. 乘客, 旅客
examples: The passengers all went aboard the ship.
Passengers became nervous when the plane began to vibrate.
exampleZh: 乘客全都登上了船。
飞机开始震动的时候，乘客们都紧张了起来。

defsEn: an official government document that shows a person’s identity and citizenship and permits a citizen to travel to another country
zh: n. 护照, 手段, 通行证
examples: Is your passport in your jacket?
A passport is usually necessary when you travel overseas.
exampleZh: 你的护照在你的夹克里吗。
海外旅行通常都要用到护照。

defsEn: the time gone by
the time before
ad. recent
immediately before
former
zh: n. 过去, 昔时, 往事, 早年经历, 过去时
a. 过去的, 结束的, 卸任的, 过去时的
prep. 越过, 晚于, 超越, 超出...的可能性(能力、范围等)
pass的过去分词
examples: Tom has spent the past three years in prison.
In the past, he would often go out at night.
exampleZh: 汤姆在监狱里待了三年。

defsEn: a narrow way for walking
a way along which something moves
zh: n. 路径, 小路, 道路, 途径, 路线, 轨道
examples: We hacked a path through the forest.
There is a path through the wood.
exampleZh: 我们开出了一条穿过森林的小路。
有一个穿过树林的小路。

defsEn: a person being treated by a doctor for a health problem
zh: n. 病人, 承受者
a. 忍耐的, 容忍的, 有耐性的, 坚忍的
examples: That patient may die at any time.
Be patient and keep your chin up. Some things just take time.
exampleZh: 病人随时会死。
耐心地坚持下去，有些事急不来。

defsEn: to give money for work done or for something bought
zh: n. 薪资, 付款, 补偿
vt. 支付, 付清, 补偿, 偿还, 对...有利, 为...涂防水物
vi. 付款, 付出代价, 偿还, 得到报应, 获得好处
examples: I'll pay you back as soon as I have money.
I'll pay you back once I receive my salary.
exampleZh: 我一有钱马上就还你。
一领到工资就把钱还给你。

defsEn: the condition of freedom from war, fighting or noise
rest
quiet
zh: n. 和平, 和约, 治安, 和睦, 安宁, 静寂
vi. 安静下来, 不作声
examples: Peace talks will begin next week.
The peace of the Lord Jesus to all.
exampleZh: 和平会谈将在下周开始。

defsEn: any group of persons
all the persons of a group, race, religion or nation (“the American people”)
zh: n. 人, 人民, 民族, 平民
vt. 使住满人, 居住于
examples: People must examine the front and back of a coin.
People can easily tell the difference between them.
exampleZh: 人们必须查看硬币的正反面。
人们可以很容易地看出其中的差别。

defsEn: a part of every hundred (“Ten is ten percent of one hundred.”)
zh: n. 百分比, 百分数, 部分
examples: Over ten percent of them can do the work.
Ninety percent of the time he will come.

defsEn: complete or correct in every way
completely right or good
without mistakes
zh: n. 完成时
a. 完美的, 完好的, 理想的, 熟练的, 精确的, 完成式的
vt. 使完美, 修改, 使精通, 改善, 使熟练
examples: A perfect map would have to be as big as the territory it represents.
To be perfect she lacked just one defect.
exampleZh: 一个完美的地图必须要像它所代表的领土一样大。
要变得完美，她就是少了一个缺点。

defsEn: to speak, dance or sing in front of others
zh: vt. 进行, 履行, 完成, 执行, 表演
vi. 行动, 工作, 执行, 演出
examples: Sami had Layla perform oral sex on him.
I perform my work very well.
exampleZh: 萨米让莱拉帮他口交。

defsEn: an amount of time within events, restrictions or conditions
zh: n. 时期, 节段, 节, 句点, 学时, 周期
a. 当时特有的, 过去某段时期的
interj. 就是这话, 就是这么回事
examples: The registration period is already over.
In the Edo period, moon-viewing parties were very popular.
exampleZh: 报名时间已经过了。
在江户时代赏月的宴会非常受欢迎。

defsEn: never changing
lasting for a very long time or for all time
zh: a. 永久的, 不变的, 固定的, 持久的
n. 烫发
examples: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.
In a permanent exhibition, the museum shows the development of film technology.
exampleZh: 正式工比临时工要好。

defsEn: to let
to make possible
zh: n. 许可证, 许可, 执照, 通行证
vt. 允许, 容许, 可能, 使放手做
vi. 容许, 给以机会, 提供可能
examples: Permit me to do that for you.
Smoking is not permitted on the train.
exampleZh: 请允许我为你做。
不允许在火车上吸烟。

defsEn: a man, woman or child
zh: n. 人, 人身, 人称
examples: That person writing the letter in the classroom is my friend.
This person is new to being an adult.
exampleZh: 那个在教室写信的人是我的朋友。
此人涉世不深。

defsEn: to cause someone to do something by explaining or urging (“The police persuaded the criminal to surrender his weapon.”)
zh: vt. 劝, 使相信, 恳求, 敦促, 说服
vi. 劝服, 被说服
examples: I persuaded him to give up the idea.
I could not persuade him of my honesty.
exampleZh: 我说服他放弃了这个主意。

defsEn: of the body
zh: a. 身体的, 物质的, 自然的, 物理学的, 好色的
n. 体格检查
examples: Your physical body will wear out and die one day.
Physical exercise is the best way to get rid of stress.

defsEn: the study of motion, matter and energy
zh: n. 物理学, 物理过程, 物理现象
examples: Physics is the basic physical science.
Physics is a fundamental natural science.
exampleZh: 物理是基础自然科学。
物理是基础自然科学。

defsEn: something that shows what another thing looks like
an idea or representation of something as seen by the eye
a painting
what is made with a camera
zh: n. 图画, 照片, 景色, 美丽如画的人(或物), 化身, 生动的描述, 想像, 形象思维
vt. 画, 拍摄, 用图说明, 描写, 想像
examples: This picture frame can make the picture rise in value.
This is the picture of his own painting.
exampleZh: 这个画框能让画升值。
这是一幅他自己画的画。

defsEn: a part of something larger
zh: n. 块, 片, 篇, 碎片, 部分, 部件, 标准量
vt. 修补, 修理, 拼合, 接线头
vi. 吃零食
examples: This piece of music is way too difficult for me to play.
That piece of furniture is not suitable for the living room.
exampleZh: 这首曲子对我来说太难演奏了。
那件家具不适合摆在客厅。

defsEn: a farm animal used for its meat
zh: n. 猪, 猪肉, 贪婪的人, 猪一样的人
v. 生小猪, 象猪般地生活
examples: It's not a pig; it's a monkey.
Pigs share certain characteristics with human beings.
exampleZh: 那不是猪，而是猴子。
猪与人类的一些特性相同。

defsEn: one who guides or flies an airplane or helicopter
zh: n. 飞行员, 领航员, 航船者, 导向器, 驾驶仪, 向导, 领导人
vt. 领航, 驾驶, 引导, 试用
a. 引导的, 控制的, 试点的
examples: Pilots communicate with the airport by radio.
The pilot will be put through a drug test.
exampleZh: 飞行员用无线电与机场沟通。

defsEn: a long, round piece of material used to move liquid or gas
zh: n. 管, 导管, 输送管, 管状器官, 声带, 尖细的声音, 烟斗, 笛, 管乐器
vt. 以管输送, 吹哨子, 吹奏, 尖声唱
vi. 吹笛, 尖叫, 吹长哨发令
examples: Something is stuck in the pipe.
The pipe burst due to great pressure.
exampleZh: 有东西卡在管子里。

defsEn: to put something somewhere
n. an area or a part of an area
space where a person or thing is
any room, building, town or country
zh: n. 地方, 地点, 位置, 住所, 座位, 地位, 处境, 特权, 空间, 余地, 职务, 位
vt. 放置, 寄予, 认出, 评定, 任命
vi. 名次列前
examples: What place on Earth could be better than the place your people came from?
If I were in your place, I would lend him a hand.
exampleZh: 世界上有什么地方能比得上你的故乡好啊？
如果我是你，我会帮他一把。

defsEn: to organize or develop an idea or method of acting or doing something (“They plan to have a party.”)
n. an organized or developed idea or method (“The plan will not work.”)
zh: n. 计划, 方案, 策略, 方法, 进度表, 程序表, 平面图, 设计图, 轮廓, 示意图
vt. 计划, 设计, 意欲
vi. 订计划
examples: I plan to stay at home all day tomorrow.
This plan will be very expensive to carry out.
exampleZh: 我打算明天在家里待一天。
这计划执行起来花销会很大。

defsEn: a large object in space that orbits the sun (“Earth is a planet.”)
zh: n. 行星, 命运星辰, 杰出的人, 重大影响的事
examples: The planets revolve around the sun.
Neptune is the eighth planet of the solar system.
exampleZh: 行星绕着太阳转。
海王星是太阳系第八个行星。

defsEn: to put into the ground to grow
n. a living growth from the ground which gets its food from air, water and earth plant
zh: n. 植物, 作物, 工厂, 树枝, 生长, 设施, 成套设备
vt. 种植, 栽培, 播种, 培养, 安置, 殖民于, 使位于
vi. 种植
examples: I planted a peach tree in my yard.
She planted fragrant olives in the garden.
exampleZh: 我在我的院子里种了棵桃树。
她在花园里种了桂花。

defsEn: a material made from chemicals that can be formed and made into things
zh: n. 塑料, 可塑体, 可塑性物质
a. 塑料的, 塑造的, 有可塑性的, 造型的, 易受影响的, 有创造力的
examples: A plastic dish will melt on the stove.
Plastics have taken the place of many conventional materials.
exampleZh: 塑料盘子在烤箱里会化的。
塑料代替了许多传统的原料。

defsEn: to have fun
to not work
to take part in a sport
to make music on an instrument
n. a story acted in a theater
zh: n. 游戏, 游玩, 玩笑, 运动, 比赛, 赌博, 跳动, 表演, 剧本
v. 玩, 游戏, 假装, 开玩笑, 比赛, 扮演, 演奏, 演戏, 传摇曳, (使)跳动
examples: I play tennis once in a while.
I play tennis an hour a day.
exampleZh: 我偶尔打网球。
我每天打一小时网球。

defsEn: to make one happy
to give enjoyment
zh: adv. 请
vt. 使高兴, 合...的心意, 取悦
vi. 使人满意, 讨好, 愿意, 敬请
examples: Please tell me how to get to the airport.
He said to me, "Please, do me a favor."
exampleZh: 请你告诉我机场怎么去。
他对我说：「请你帮我一个忙。」

defsEn: all that is needed
a large enough amount
zh: n. 充分, 很多, 丰富
a. 很多的, 足够的, 丰富的
examples: There is plenty of room under the roof.
He had plenty of fight left in him.
exampleZh: 屋顶下面有足够的地方。
他的胸中还有足够的斗志。

defsEn: to make secret plans
n. a secret plan to do something wrong or illegal
zh: n. 小块土地, 地区图, 图, 阴谋, 情节
vt. 划分, 绘图, 密谋
vi. 密谋, 策划
examples: They are plotting to kill the king.
They're plotting to kill the king.
exampleZh: 他们正密谋要杀害国王。
他们正密谋要杀害国王。

defsEn: words and their sounds organized in a special way to express emotions
zh: n. 诗, 诗般美的事物
examples: This poem was originally written in French.
Tom told her that he had written that poem two years before.
exampleZh: 这首诗本来是用法文写的。
汤姆告诉她那首诗是自己两年前写的。

defsEn: to aim one’s finger toward
to aim
n. the sharp end of something
zh: n. 点, 小数点, 标点, 地点, 要点, 特点, 尖端, 分数, 得分, 穴位
vt. 弄尖, 强调, 指出, 加标点于, 瞄准
vi. 指, 指向, 表明
examples: In point of fact, she had nothing to do with the scandal.
The point is whether she will come or not.
exampleZh: 事实上，她和这个丑闻没有任何关系。
问题是她到底来还是不来。

defsEn: a substance that can destroy life or damage health
zh: n. 毒药, 毒, 毒物, 有毒害的事物
vt. 毒害, 毒杀, 使中毒
vi. 放毒, 下毒
examples: There's no poison in this fish.
This poison is very effective in getting rid of roaches.
exampleZh: 这条鱼没有毒。
这毒药用来治蟑螂很有效。

defsEn: a government agency responsible for guarding the public, keeping order, and making sure people obey the law
members of that agency
zh: n. 警察, 警察当局, 治安
vt. 维持治安, 管辖
examples: The police will pursue her for a long time.
The police will soon arrive on the scene.
exampleZh: 警察会追捕她很长时间。
警方将很快到达现场。

defsEn: an established set of plans or goals used to develop and make decisions in politics, economics or business
zh: n. 政策, 方针, 策略, 保险单
examples: This policy resulted in a great rise in prices.
The policy fluctuated between two opinions.
exampleZh: 这个政策导致物价大幅度的上升。
该政策在两种意见之间摇摆。

defsEn: the activities of government and of those who are in public office
zh: n. 政治, 政治学, 政见, 政治活动
examples: In politics, you have to be ready with an answer.
In politics, the word "never" all too often means "tomorrow".

defsEn: to release dangerous or unpleasant substances into the air, soil or water
zh: vt. 污染, 弄脏, 玷污
examples: There is no polluted air in our city.
In our polluted environment, the air is becoming visible.

defsEn: people with little or no money
ad. lacking money or goods
of bad quality
zh: a. 贫穷的, 贫乏的, 不幸的, 可怜的, 拙劣的, 卑鄙的
examples: The poor people were at the mercy of the cruel dictator.
The poor young man finally became a great artist.
exampleZh: 可怜的人民任凭残暴的独裁者处置。
这个穷小子最后成为了一个了不起的艺术家。

defsEn: liked by many people
generally approved by the public
zh: a. 通俗的, 流行的, 受欢迎的, 大众的, 人民的, 普及的
examples: She's popular, not because she's beautiful, but because she's kind to everyone.
Poinsettias are a popular Christmas flower.
exampleZh: 她受欢迎不是因为她的美丽，而是因为她亲切地对待每个人。
一品红是广受欢迎的圣诞节花卉。

defsEn: all the people in a place, city or country
zh: n. 人口, 人口数
examples: The population of the world will double before long.
An aging population will require more spending on health care.
exampleZh: 世界人口将在不久的将来增加两倍。
老龄化的人口需要更多医疗保健支出。

defsEn: a city where ships load or unload goods
a place on a coast where ships can be safe from a storm
zh: 燃烧器)喷口
examples: Kaohsiung is the largest port city in Taiwan.
Kaohsiung is Taiwan's largest port city.
exampleZh: 高雄是台湾的最大港口城市。
高雄是台湾的最大港口城市。

defsEn: a place
the way of holding the body
the way a thing is set or placed
a job (or level of a job) in an organization
zh: n. 位置, 地位, 身分, 形势, 姿势, 立场, 职位, 状态, 阵地
vt. 安置, 决定...的位置
examples: There is a position available for a secretary.
The position requires applicants to be skilled in spoken English.
exampleZh: 有一个做秘书的空缺职位。
这份职位要求应征者有一定的英语口语表达能力。

defsEn: to have
to own
to control or be controlled by
zh: vt. 持有, 占有, 拥有, 克制, 支配, 迷住
examples: He's unaware of who possesses them.
My uncle is possessed of great wealth.
exampleZh: 他不知道这些东西的归属。
我叔叔拥有很多的财富。

defsEn: able to be done
can happen or is expected to happen
zh: a. 可能的, 潜在的, 合适的
n. 可能性, 可能的事物
examples: If possible, I would like to go home now.
It is possible that you have already read this book.
exampleZh: 如果可以的话, 我现在就想回家。
有可能已经读过这本书了。

defsEn: to delay action until a later time
zh: vt. 延迟, 使延期, 缓办, 搁延
vi. 延缓, 延缓发作
examples: We postponed our departure because of the storm.
He has postponed his departure until tomorrow.
exampleZh: 我们因为风暴推迟了起程。
他把出发推时到明天了。

defsEn: to flow
to cause to flow
zh: n. 流出, 倾泻, 骤雨
vt. 倒, 灌, 注, 倾泻, 诉说, 倾吐
vi. 倾泻, 蜂涌而来, 下大雨
examples: He poured the milk into the glass.
I poured water into the bucket.
exampleZh: 他把牛奶倒到杯子里了。
我将水倒入了桶中。

defsEn: the condition of being poor
zh: n. 贫穷, 贫困, 缺乏
examples: When poverty comes in at the door, love flies out the window.
No poverty can catch up with industry.
exampleZh: 当贫穷降临在门口，爱从窗外飞走。

defsEn: the ability to control or direct others
control
strength
ruling force
force or energy used to do work (“Water power turns the wheel.”)
zh: n. 力, 体力, 力量, 势力, 动力, 权力, 强国, 乘方, 强度, 幂, 功率
vt. 使...有力量, 供以动力, 激励
examples: Is the power cord plugged into a power outlet?
With the power of imagination, we can even travel through space.
exampleZh: 插头插到插座里了吗？

defsEn: to say good things about
to approve
zh: n. 赞美, 称赞, 崇拜
vt. 称赞, 赞美
vi. 赞扬, 表扬
examples: I cannot praise them too highly.
He praised me to the skies.
exampleZh: 我都不知道该怎么夸他们了。
他极力称赞了我。

defsEn: to make a request to a god or spirit
to praise a god or spirit
zh: v. 祈祷, 恳求, 请
examples: We prayed that our children would forgive us.
They knelt down and prayed that the war would end soon.
exampleZh: 我们祈祷孩子们会原谅我们。
他们跪了下来祈祷，希望战争快点结束。

defsEn: to say what one believes will happen in the future. (“The weather scientist predicted a cold winter.”)
zh: v. 预知, 预言, 预报
examples: He predicted there would be rain.
Einstein predicted that the Sun's gravity would bend light.
exampleZh: 他预测会下雨。
爱因斯坦预测太阳的引力会弯曲光线。

defsEn: carrying a child within the body before it is born
expecting to give birth to a baby
zh: a. 怀孕的, 充满的, 思想丰富的, 成果丰硕的
examples: I got pregnant from the Finnish harpist that I told you about last night.
Dad, I am pregnant. Here is the list of the suspects...
exampleZh: 我跟那个芬兰竖琴手怀孕了，他就是我昨晚告诉你的那个人。
爸爸，我怀孕了。这是我男朋友们的名单……

defsEn: to offer for consideration (“We will present our idea to the committee.”)
n. a gift (“I gave them a present for their anniversary.”)
ad now (“The present time is a good time.”)
ad. to be at a place (“I was present at school yesterday.”)
zh: n. 现在, 礼品, 瞄准
a. 现在的, 出席的
vt. 介绍, 引见, 赠送, 提出, 呈现, 上演
vi. 举枪瞄准
examples: A present? For me? Thank you!
The present time is a good time.
exampleZh: 礼物？给我的？多谢多谢！
现在正是好时候。

defsEn: the chief official of a country that is a republic
the leader of an organization
zh: n. 总统, 总裁, 董事长, (学院)院长, (大学)校长, 主管人, 主持人
examples: The President is to speak on television this evening.
Mr Johnson, president of the club, will soon come.
exampleZh: 总统今晚将会在电视上发表演说。
具乐部会长Johnson先生很快就要来了。

defsEn: to urge strongly
n. newspapers, magazines and other publications
zh: n. 压, 揿, 按, 人群, 印刷机, 压力, 出版社, 记者, 报刊, 新闻舆论, 紧迫
vt. 压, 压榨, 紧抱, 逼迫, 推进, 强迫征募, 催逼
vi. 压, 重压, 催促, 拥挤, 奋力前进, 受压
examples: Press this red button in case of an accident.
If you press this button the window opens automatically.
exampleZh: 发生意外的话按这个红按钮。
按下这个按钮, 窗口会自动打开。

defsEn: the force produced when something is pushed down or against something else
zh: n. 压, 榨, 按, 强制, 压力, 压迫, 压强
vt. 迫使, 使增压, 密封
examples: When the pressure is lower, the boiling point is lower.
Pressure would build up whenever I had her in my field of view.
exampleZh: 压力越低，沸点越低。

defsEn: to keep or stop from going or happening
zh: v. 预防, 防止, 阻止, 妨碍
examples: What prevented her from coming yesterday?
What prevented you from coming yesterday?
exampleZh: 她昨天为什么不来？
是什么原因导致你昨天没来。

defsEn: the amount of money for which anything is bought, sold or offered for sale
zh: n. 价格, 代价, 价值
vt. 定...的价格
examples: The price should fit my budget.
The price of gold varies from day to day.
exampleZh: 价格应该符合预算。
金价每天都在变动。

defsEn: a place where a person is kept as punishment for a crime
zh: n. 监狱, 监禁, 拘留所
vt. 监禁
examples: He was in prison on a charge of robbery.
What were you in prison for?
exampleZh: 他以偷窃罪入狱。
你是为什么入狱的？

defsEn: of or about a person or group that is secret
opposite public
zh: a. 私人的, 秘密的, 私立的, 隐蔽的
n. 士兵, 隐士, 阴部
examples: Private detectives were hired to look into the strange case.
If everything private is searched through by secret services, is that democracy?
exampleZh: 私家侦探们受雇调查这桩奇怪的案件。
如果所有私人资讯都要经过秘密机构的搜查，那还能算是民主吗？

defsEn: something offered or won in a competition
something of value that one must work hard for prize
zh: n. 奖赏, 奖金, 奖品, 战利品, 捕获
a. 得奖的
vt. 珍视, 估价, 捕获, 撬, 撬动
examples: He won the Nobel Prize for Literature.
There is no Nobel Prize in mathematics.
exampleZh: 他获得了诺贝尔文学奖。
不存在诺贝尔数学奖。

defsEn: a good chance of taking place
a little more than possible
zh: adv. 大概, 或许
examples: She probably can get along well with her mother-in-law.
He said that it would probably rain.
exampleZh: 她应该能跟我奶奶相处得来。
他说很可能会下雨。

defsEn: a difficult question or situation with an unknown or unclear answer
zh: n. 问题, 难题
a. 成问题的, 难处理的
examples: This problem is too difficult for primary school children to solve.
There's a problem under the Christmas tree.
exampleZh: 这个问题让小学生解决太难了。
圣诞树下有问题。

defsEn: an operation or series of changes leading to a desired result
zh: （技术）处理
examples: Once this process is started, we can get the result within one hour.
This process must be stopped immediately, otherwise the server will break down.
exampleZh: 这个进程一旦开始，我们能在一小时内得到结果。
这个进程必须立即停止，否则服务器会故障。

defsEn: to make
to create
to cause something to be
to manufacture
zh: n. 生产品, 物产, 后代
vt. 产生, 生产, 提出, 出示
vi. 生产, 制造
examples: Japan produces a lot of good cameras.
Apples are produced in this district.
exampleZh: 日本生产很多好相机。
这是一个产苹果的地区。

defsEn: a job that requires special training
zh: n. 职业, 表白, 声明
examples: In my profession, I always expect trouble.
I chose this profession because I don't like to deal with people.

defsEn: a teacher at a college or university
zh: n. 教授
examples: This is Professor Oak, the director of this experiment.
The professor spoke too fast for anyone to understand.
exampleZh: 这位是奥克教授，他是这项实验的负责人。
那个教授讲得太快了，没有一个人听得懂。

defsEn: money gained from a business activity after paying all costs of that activity
zh: n. 利润, 赢利, 利益
vi. 有益, 获利, 赚钱
vt. 有益于
examples: Someone else profits from the situation.
It was to his profit to do so.
exampleZh: 渔人得利。

defsEn: a plan of action
the different events or parts of a meeting or show
zh: n. 节目, 节目单, 程序, 纲要, 大纲, 计划
vt. 规划, 拟...计划
vi. 安排节目, 编程序
examples: That program is now being broadcast.
The program is on the air.
exampleZh: 那个节目现在正在播出。
那个节目现在正在播出。

defsEn: movement forward or toward improvement or a goal
zh: n. 进步, 发展, 前进
vi. 进步, 进行
examples: He made no progress in his speaking ability.
The progress of science has brought about great change in our lives.
exampleZh: 他说话的能力没有任何的进步。
科技的进步为我们的生活带来了巨大的转变。

defsEn: a planned effort to do something
zh: n. 计划, 设计, 事业
vt. 计划, 设计, 投掷, 发射, 使凸出, 放映
vi. 凸出
examples: Your project needs a large amount of money.
The project was a complete failure.
exampleZh: 你的项目需要一大笔钱。
这个计划彻底的失败了。

defsEn: to say one will do something
n. a spoken or written agreement to do something
zh: n. 诺言, 约定的事情, 有指望
vt. 允诺, 约定, 预示
vi. 允诺, 有前途, 有指望
examples: I promise to return this videotape within a week.
I promise that I will send you to prison.
exampleZh: 我保证在一个星期内把这盘录影带还给你。
我保证我会把你送进牢里。

defsEn: ideas or information used to influence opinions
zh: n. 宣传, 宣传活动
examples: The "anti-woke" propaganda being imported into your country's media comes straight from actual fascists.
Your making propaganda seems to indicate that you care greatly what other people think.
exampleZh: 你们国家媒体中输入的「反觉醒」宣传，是直接来自真正的法西斯的。

defsEn: anything owned by someone such as land, buildings or goods
zh: n. 财产, 所有权, 性质, 属性
examples: I entrusted my property to him.
At this property, they make excellent vinegar.
exampleZh: 我把我的财产托付给他。

defsEn: to present or offer for consideration
zh: vt. 计划, 打算, 建议, 提议, 求(婚)
vi. 打算, 求婚
examples: He proposed a reform in the educational system.
She had been proposed to five times by the time she was twenty.
exampleZh: 他提议对教育系统进行改革。
她二十岁的时候，就已经有五个人向她求过婚了。

defsEn: to guard
to defend
to prevent from being harmed or damaged
zh: vt. 防卫, 保护, 警戒
examples: I'll protect her with my life.
Spacesuits protect astronauts from being injured from impacts of small bits of space dust.
exampleZh: 我会用生命保护她。
宇航服保护宇航员们不会因和微小宇宙尘埃碰撞而受伤。

defsEn: substances responsible for the growth of tissue and for fixing damaged tissue
zh: n. 蛋白质( protein的复数形式 )
examples: Proteins have many functions in the human body.
The animal cell has a greater percentage of proteins than the plant cell.

defsEn: to speak against
to object
zh: n. 抗议, 反对, 抗议书, 断言
v. 反对, 抗议, 断言
examples: I protest against this stupid reform!
The protest demanded a public and quality education.

defsEn: to show to be true
zh: vt. 证明, 查验, 检验, 勘探, 显示
vi. 证明是
examples: He proved to be an ideal husband.
It proved the truth of the rumor.
exampleZh: 他被证实是个理想丈夫。
它揭示了谣言的真相。

defsEn: to give something needed or wanted
zh: vt. 提供, 供应, 规定, 预备
vi. 作准备, 抚养, 规定
examples: We provided food and clothes for them.
I'll provide you with all the necessary information.
exampleZh: 我们为他们提供了食物和衣服。
我会给你所有必要的信息。

defsEn: of or about all the people in a community or country
opposite private
zh: n. 公众, 民众
a. 公众的, 公共的, 公立的, 公用的
examples: Public feeling against air pollution has at last become vocal.
I went to the public swimming pool to apply for a lifeguard position.
exampleZh: 公众终于对关于空气污染的意见直言不讳了。
我去了公共游泳池应征当救生员。

defsEn: something that is published such as a book, newspaper or magazine publication
zh: n. 出版物, 出版, 公布
examples: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
This publication disseminates important information regarding the state of this country's politics.
exampleZh: 文章的发表被预定在教授生日那天。

defsEn: to make public something that is written
to include something in a book, newspaper or magazine
zh: vt. 出版, 发行, 公开, 发表, 宣传, 公布
vi. 出版, 发行
examples: She published the book at her own expense.
He published the book this past year.

defsEn: to use force to move something toward the person or thing using the force
opposite push
zh: vt. 拉, 拖, 拔, 牵, 撕开, 吸引
vi. 拉, 拖, 拔, 有吸引力
n. 拉, 拖, 拔, 拉力, 牵引力, 划船, 吸引
examples: He pulled with all his strength, but the rock would not move.
She pulled a thorn out of the tyre.
exampleZh: 他用尽全力地拉，但那块大石还是纹丝不动。
她拔出了一根儿扎在轮胎里的刺。

defsEn: to force a gas or liquid up, into or through
zh: n. 抽水机, 打气筒, 泵, 抽吸
vt. 用唧筒抽水, 打气, 盘问, 倾注, 使疲惫
vi. 抽水, 上下(或往复)运动
examples: The pump did not act as it should have.
If you pump air into a tire, it expands.

defsEn: to cause pain, suffering or loss for doing something bad or illegal
zh: vt. 处罚, 惩罚, 严厉对待
vi. 惩罚
examples: You'll be punished if you break the law.
What are you punishing them for?
exampleZh: 如果你违反了法律, 你将受到惩罚。
您为什么惩罚他们？

defsEn: to buy with money or with something of equal value
n. that which is bought
zh: n. 购买, 购买品, 紧握, 绞辘
vt. 购买, 赢得, 努力取得, 用滑轮起(锚等)
examples: To purchase a ticket, you need to enter your personal details.
You cannot purchase this medicine without a prescription.
exampleZh: 你要先输入好个人资料，然后才能买票。
那个药的话没有处方是买不到的。

defsEn: free from anything that is different or that reduces value
clean
zh: a. 纯的, 纯净的, 纯洁的, 清白的, 完美的, 无瑕的, 抽象的
examples: With pure logic you can prove the biggest nonsense.
Pure water is necessary to our daily life.

defsEn: the reason or desired effect for doing something
goal
zh: n. 目的, 意向, 决心, 用途, 效果, 论题
vt. 意欲, 企图, 计划
examples: The purpose of criticism is to construct, not to destroy.
What is the purpose of your visit?
exampleZh: 批评的目的是建设而不是破坏。
你此行的目的是什么？

defsEn: to use force to move something away from the person or thing using the force
opposite pull push
zh: n. 推, 推动, 奋斗, 攻击, 进取心
vt. 推, 推动, 使伸出, 推行, 逼迫, 增加
vi. 推, 推进, 增加, 努力争取
examples: I had to push my bicycle because it had a flat tyre.
I had to push my bicycle because I had a flat tire.
