exampleZh: 我得推我的自行车，因为有个轮胎漏气了。
我得推我的自行车，因为有个轮胎漏气了。

defsEn: to place
to set in position
zh: vt. 放, 摆, 安置, 移动, 发射, 投掷, 写上, 表达, 使从事, 使受到, 驱使, 赋予
vi. 出发, 航行, 发芽
n. 掷, 股票出售权, 笨蛋
a. 固定不动的
examples: He put the key on the desk as usual.
Could you put this report into Italian for me?
exampleZh: 他跟平时一样把钥匙放在书桌上。
你可以为我把这份报告翻译成意大利文吗？

defsEn: that which something is known to have or be (“An important quality of steel is its strength.”)
amount of value or excellence (“Their goods are of the highest quality.”)
zh: n. 品质, 特性, 才能, 质量
a. 优质的
examples: Quality is more important than quantity.
The quality of salmon being sold here is the best.
exampleZh: 数量不如质量。
这里卖的鲑鱼是品质最好的。

defsEn: to ask
to express wonder or disbelief
n. a sentence or word used in asking for information
a problem
an issue to be discussed
zh: n. 问题, 询问
v. 询问, 审问, 怀疑
examples: This question must be discussed separately from that one.
The question was impossible for us to answer.
exampleZh: 这两个问题必须分开讨论。
我们没办法回答这个问题。

defsEn: fast
zh: a. 快的, 迅速的, 敏捷的, 灵敏的, 急速的
adv. 快
n. 新长出的肉, 要害, 核心, 感觉敏锐部位
examples: Be quick, or you will miss the train.
His quick temper will get him in trouble one day.
exampleZh: 快点，不然要赶不上火车了。
他的急脾气迟早会惹祸上身。

defsEn: with little or no noise
having little or no movement
calm
zh: n. 安静, 闲适, 平静
a. 安静的, 静止的, 寂静的, 朴素的, 从容的, 暗中的
vi. 平静下来
vt. 使平静, 使平息, 使安心, 安慰
examples: Be quiet, he might hear us.
He's a quiet man, a little bald on top.
exampleZh: 轻一点，他会听见我们的。
他是个很安静的人，头顶有点秃。

defsEn: to run
to take part in a competition to decide who or what can move fastest
to take part in a campaign for political office
n. one of the major groups that humans can be divided into because of a common physical similarity, such as skin color
zh: n. 种族, 人种, 赛跑, 比赛, 急流, 人类, 同道, 姜根
vi. 赛跑, 竞赛, 疾走
vt. 与...赛跑, 使疾走, 使猛转
examples: I ran a race with him.
It was a race to get to the station on time.
exampleZh: 我和他比赛跑步。

defsEn: a device that uses radio signals to learn the position or speed of objects that may be too far away to be seen
zh: n. 雷达, 无线电探测器
examples: That it be with the off-the-radar Sue of all people!
The radar detected a mysterious signal.

defsEn: waves of energy from something that produces heat or light
energy from a nuclear substance, which can be dangerous
zh: (电磁)放射
examples: Chemotherapy and radiation cause hair loss, because they prevent cell division.
The radiation may be deadly for Lukas.

defsEn: the system of sending and receiving signals or sounds through the air without wires
zh: n. 无线电, 收音机, 无线电报, 无线电广播, 无线电台
v. 用无线电发送
examples: The radio is too loud. Can't you turn it down a little?
My radio has broken down again.
exampleZh: 收音机太响了。你不能把音量调低一点吗？
我的收音机又坏掉了。

defsEn: to make a sudden attack
n. a sudden attack carried out as an act of war, or for the purpose of seizing or stealing something
zh: n. 袭击, 突袭, 搜捕
v. 奇袭, 搜捕
examples: The RAID negotiator specializes in mediation during high-stakes critical events.
Why did the FBI raid Tom's house?

defsEn: a road for trains
a company that operates such a road and its stations and equipment railroad
zh: n. 铁路, 铁路公司
vt. 铺设铁路, 用铁路运输
vi. 在铁路工作
examples: The railroad is parallel to the road.
A railroad has connected the two cities.
exampleZh: 铁路与公路平行。
铁路连通了两个城市。

defsEn: water falling from the sky
zh: n. 雨, 下雨, 雨天
vi. 下雨
vt. 使大量落下
examples: If it rains tomorrow, we will go there by car.
The rain soaked me on my way home.
exampleZh: 如果明天下雨，我们就坐车去那儿。
我回家路上被雨淋得湿透了。

defsEn: to lift up
to move to a higher position
to cause to grow
to increase
zh: n. 上升, 高地, 增高
vt. 升起, 举起, 唤起, 提高, 使出现, 使复活, 提出, 筹集, 饲养
examples: Raise your hand when I call your name.
He would not raise my salary.
exampleZh: 我叫你的名字的时候，请你把手举起来。
他不肯给我涨工资。

defsEn: to carry out a sexual attack by force against a person
zh: n. 抢夺, 掠夺, 强奸, 葡萄渣, 芸苔
vt. 掠夺, 抢夺, 强奸
examples: Rape blossoms... Moon in the East. Sun in the West.
Rape is a shame for her and her family.

defsEn: not common
not usual
not often
zh: a. 稀罕的, 罕有的, 珍奇的, 稀薄的, 半熟的, 非常好的
adv. 非常
examples: It's rare to meet nice people like you.
It's rare to find big yards in Japan.
exampleZh: 很少能见到像你那么好的人。
能在日本找到这样的大的院子实属罕见。

defsEn: speed
a measure of how quickly or how often something happens
the price of any thing or service that is bought or sold
zh: n. 比率, 率, 速度, 价格, 费用, 等级
vt. 估价, 认为, 鉴定等级, 责骂
vi. 被评价, 责骂
examples: At that rate it would take her all night.
Rate the quality of this translation.

defsEn: to put a hand toward
to arrive at
to come to
zh: n. 伸出, 延伸, 区域, 范围, 流域, 岬
vt. 到达, 达到, 伸出, 延伸, 影响
vi. 达到, 延伸, 伸出手, 传到
examples: To reach the North Pole is not easy.
We reached the top of the mountain.
exampleZh: 到北极可不容易。
我们到达了山顶。

defsEn: to act as a result of or in answer to
zh: vi. 起反应, 起作用, 反攻
examples: And who would not react the same way?
How would you react if your wife told you that?

defsEn: to look at and understand the meaning of written words or numbers
zh: v. 读, 阅读, 理解
a. 有学问的
n. 读取, 阅读
examples: I read the book from cover to cover.
I read the book from beginning to end.
exampleZh: 那本书我从头到尾看完了。
我把这本书从头到尾读了一遍。

defsEn: prepared
completed
organized
willing
zh: n. 预备好的状态, 现款
a. 准备好的, 备用的, 可以使用的
adv. 预先, 迅速
vt. 使准备好
examples: I'll be ready in a moment.
We're ready for the next step.
exampleZh: 我马上准备好。
我们准备好走下一步了。

defsEn: true
truly existing
not false
zh: a. 真的, 真实的, 实际的, 实在的, 不动(产)的, 实数的
n. 实数, 现实
adv. 真正地
examples: A real friend is like a rare bird.
But that's not the real problem.
exampleZh: 知己难求。
可那不是真正的问题所在。

defsEn: in agreement with the way things are
zh: a. 现实的, 逼真的, 现实主义的, 实在论的
examples: That's not a realistic way of going about this.
A realistic man is one who stays at a distance from his ideas.

defsEn: the cause for a belief or act
purpose
something that explains
zh: n. 理由, 原因, 理智, 道理, 前提, 理性
vt. 说服, 推论, 辩论
vi. 推论, 劝说, 思考
examples: There is no reason that I should give up my plan.
He lost his reason when he saw his house burn down.
exampleZh: 没有理由让我放弃计划。
看着自己的房子被烧得精光，他顿时丧失了理智。

defsEn: ready to listen to reasons or ideas
not extreme
ready or willing to compromise
zh: a. 合理的, 明理的, 适当的
examples: It's reasonable that you should do that.
He is reasonable in his demands.
exampleZh: 你那样做是合理的。
他的要求很合理。

defsEn: to act against a government or power, often with force
to refuse to obey
n. one who opposes or fights against the government of his or her country
zh: n. 叛徒, 反叛者
vi. 造反, 反抗, 抵抗, 反感
a. 造反的, 反抗的
examples: The rebel concealed his ambition to destroy the regime.
The rebels have left the city.

defsEn: to get or accept something given, offered or sent
zh: vt. 收到, 接到, 得到, 接待, 迎接, 承受
vi. 收到, 会客
examples: He received a golden watch as a prize.
He received a grant to study in Germany.
exampleZh: 他被奖励了一块金表。
他获得了一份去德国留学的奖学金。

defsEn: a short time ago
zh: a. 最近的, 近代的, 最新的
examples: The recent shortage of coffee has given rise to a lot of problems.
The recent coffee shortage brought about many problems.
exampleZh: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。
近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。

defsEn: a temporary reduction in economic activity, when industries produce less and many workers lose their jobs
zh: n. 后退, 凹处, 衰退, 归还
examples: A recession is bound to come next year.
In a recession, people usually only buy what they really need, like food.

defsEn: to know or remember something or someone that was known, known about or seen before
to accept another nation as independent and establish diplomatic ties with its government
zh: vt. 认出, 认可, 承认, 公认, 识别, 赏识
vi. 承认, 具结
examples: I recognize that what he says is the truth.
I recognized your voice right away.
exampleZh: 我承认他说的是事实。
我立刻认出了你的声音。

defsEn: to write something in order to have it for future use
to put sound or pictures in a form that can be kept and heard or seen again
n a writing that shows proof or facts about something
zh: n. 记录, 履历, 档案, 审判记录, 最高纪录, 唱片
vt. 记录, 记载, 标明, 将...录音
vi. 记录, 录音, 可被录音
a. 创纪录的
examples: She told me that she has bought a record.
He recorded a documentary and gave it to me.
exampleZh: 她跟我说她买了唱片。
他录了一个纪录片给我。

defsEn: to get again something that was lost, stolen or taken away (“The police recovered the stolen money.”)
to return to normal health or normal conditions (“She is expected to recover from the operation.”)
zh: vt. 重新获得, 恢复, 复原, 拯救
vi. 痊愈, 复原, 胜诉
examples: She recovered from her long illness.
He has recovered from his bad cold.
exampleZh: 她大病初愈。
他从重感冒中恢复了过来。

defsEn: having the color like that of blood
zh: a. 红的, 红色的, 红肿的, 流血的
n. 红色, 红颜料, 赤字
examples: Red and blue - which one do you like?
That red car hit the blue van.
exampleZh: 红色和蓝色，你喜欢那一个?
那辆红色汽车撞到了蓝色面包车。

defsEn: to make less or smaller in number, size or amount
to cut
zh: vt. 减少, 分解, 降低, 使衰退, 把...分解, 把...归纳
vi. 减少, 减肥, 缩小
examples: Could you reduce the price a little?
If you reduce the price, I'll buy it.

defsEn: to make better by changing
to improve
n. a change to a better condition
zh: n. 改革, 改正, 改造
vt. 改革, 改过, 革新, 重整
vi. 革新, 改过
examples: The reform of both entrance examination system and curriculum makes slow progress.
The reform of the Chinese healthcare system is an acknowledgement of its failure.

defsEn: a person who has been forced to flee because of unjust treatment, danger or war
zh: n. 难民, 流亡者
examples: The refugee crisis could shake up the political landscape in Germany.
The refugee crossed the line safely.

defsEn: to reject
to not accept, give or do something
zh: vt. 拒绝, 谢绝
vi. 拒绝
n. 废物
a. 扔掉的, 无用的
examples: I refuse to answer your question.
You refuse a toast, only to be forced to drink a forfeit.
exampleZh: 我拒绝回答你的问题。
敬酒不吃吃罚酒。

defsEn: to have one’s name officially placed on a list of people permitted to vote in an election or take part in an educational program
zh: n. 寄存器, 记录, 登记簿, 注册
vt. 记录, 注册, 提示, 表达, 把...挂号
vi. 登记, 注册, 挂号
examples: Register is also an important aspect of translation.
They went to the register to pay.

defsEn: a feeling of sadness or sorrow about something that is done or that happens
zh: n. 遗憾, 后悔, 悔恨, 抱歉, 歉意
vt. 为...感到遗憾, 后悔, 惋惜, 懊悔, 抱歉
vi. 感到抱歉
examples: I regret missing the chance to meet her.
I regret having said that to him.
exampleZh: 我很后悔当时没有把握机会认识她。
我很后悔和他说了那番话。

defsEn: to refuse to accept, use or believe
zh: n. 被拒之人, 被弃之物, 不合格品, 次品
vt. 拒绝, 抵制, 否决, 驳回, 丢弃, 呕出
examples: Reject humanity and return to being monkeys.
Those who reject criticism will not develop.

defsEn: understandings or ties between nations
members of the same family
people connected by marriage or family ties
zh: n. 交往, 关系, 事务
examples: Try to construct good relations whenever possible at work.
We have no business relations with the firm.

defsEn: to free
to permit to go
to permit to be known or made public
zh: n. 释放, 发泄, 豁免, 发行, 释放证书
vt. 释放, 解除, 放松, 豁免, 免除, 发布, 放弃, 让与
n. 发布
examples: With the release of Skype, studying languages has become easier.
Release a new video every day.
exampleZh: 学习语言随着Skype的发行而变得更容易。

defsEn: a belief in, or the honoring of, a god or gods
zh: n. 宗教, 信仰
examples: Religion is the opium of the people.
The religion was in its glory in those days.
exampleZh: 宗教是人民的鸦片。
这个宗教当时处于全盛时期。

defsEn: to stay in a place after others leave
to stay the same
zh: vi. 保持, 逗留, 剩余
examples: He remained single all his life.
She remained single all her life.
exampleZh: 他一生独身。
她终生未婚。

defsEn: a dead body
zh: n. 剩余物, 废墟, 残余
examples: If the box remains open, the food will perish.
He remains popular with the party rank and file.

defsEn: to think about the past
opposite forget
zh: vt. 记得, 回忆起, 记住, 铭记, 纪念
vi. 记得
examples: I remember my mother teaching me the alphabet.
I remember the way you used to dance.
exampleZh: 我记得我母亲教我认字。
我记得你以前跳舞的方式。

defsEn: to take away or take off
to put an end to
to take out of a position or office
zh: vt. 移动, 调动, 除去, 迁移, 开除, 移交
vi. 迁移, 移动, 搬家
n. 班级, 升级, 移动, 搬家, 间距
examples: The rioters were forcibly removed from the plaza.
Remove your hat when you go inside.
exampleZh: 广场的暴徒被强制驱离。

defsEn: work done to fix something
zh: n. 修理, 补救, 修复
vt. 修理, 修补, 补救, 恢复, 补偿
vi. 修理, 修补, 补救, 恢复, 去, 常去, 集合
examples: The repair for the system malfunction lasted for an entire night.
I got him to repair my car.
exampleZh: 系统故障的修复工作持续了一整个晚上。
我让他修理我的车子。

defsEn: to say or do again
zh: n. 重复, 反复
vt. 重做, 重复, 复述, 使再现, 复制
vi. 重复
examples: I'm repeating it for you one last time.
I repeated the word several times for her.
exampleZh: 我再给你重复最后一遍。
我为她重复念这个字很多遍。

defsEn: to tell about
to give the results of a study or investigation
n. the story about an event
the results of a study or investigation
a statement in which the facts may not be confirmed report
zh: n. 报告, 报道, 传说, 案情报告, 爆炸声, 成绩单
vt. 报告, 汇报, 转述, 报道, 揭发, 使报到
vi. 报告, 写报道, 报到
examples: The report proved true as a result of their investigation.
The report is not to be depended upon.
exampleZh: 他们的调查结果显示这篇报导是真实的。
那篇报导不可靠。

defsEn: to act in the place of someone else
to substitute for
to serve as an example
zh: vt. 表现, 表示, 描绘, 讲述, 代表, 象征, 回忆, 再赠送, 再上演
vi. 提出异议
examples: He represented our company at the conference.
They represent not only themselves but this institution as well.
exampleZh: 他代表我们公司出席了会议。

defsEn: to control or to restrict freedoms by force
zh: vt. 镇压, 抑制, 压制
vi. 压制
examples: Repressing what I feel for you is now impossible for me.
Jekyll repressed a lot of violence impulses.

defsEn: to ask for
n. the act of asking for
zh: n. 请求, 需要, 申请书
vt. 请求, 要求, 邀请
examples: He requested me to keep it secret.
They requested the mayor to resign.
exampleZh: 他要求我保存秘密。
他们要求市长辞职。

defsEn: to need or demand as necessary
zh: vt. 需要, 命令, 要求
examples: I require a few clothes hangers.
They require me to work harder.
exampleZh: 我需要几个衣架。
他们要求我更努力地工作。

defsEn: to free from danger or evil
zh: n. 援救, 解救, 营救
vt. 援救, 救出, 营救
examples: He rescued the dog at the risk of his own life.
He rescued the child from the fire.
exampleZh: 他冒着生命危险救了那条狗。
他从火场中救了这个孩子。

defsEn: a careful study to discover correct information
zh: n. 研究, 调查, 考察
vi. 研究, 调查
examples: He researched British tea culture in great detail.
Research on the causes of cancer is very expensive.
exampleZh: 他对英国茶文化很有研究。
有关癌症成因的研究耗费颇巨。

defsEn: to leave a position, job or office
zh: vt. 辞职, 放弃, 使顺从
vi. 辞职, 屈从
examples: He resigned from the job to take the responsibility for the loss.
I resigned from my position as club treasurer.
exampleZh: 为了这次的损失，他扛起责任，辞职了。
我辞去了具乐部司库的职位。

defsEn: to oppose
to fight to prevent
zh: v. 抵抗, 耐得住, 抵制, 反抗
n. 防染材料
examples: We could not resist the force of his logic.
Who could resist an offer like that?

defsEn: an official statement of agreement by a group of people, usually reached by voting
zh: n. 解析, 决心, 坚定, 决定, 决议, 消除, 解答, 分解
n. 图形分辨率
examples: My resolution dissolved at the last moment.
He made a resolution to write in his diary every day.
exampleZh: 到了最后的一刻，我的决心突然动摇了。

defsEn: anything of value that can be used or sold
zh: n. 资源, 财力, 办法, 策略, 急智, 消遣
examples: What resources or tools do you find most helpful for language learning?
What resources are in place to encourage employee development?

defsEn: to feel or show honor to a person or thing (“All citizens should respect the law.”)
zh: n. 尊敬, 尊重, 问候
vt. 尊敬, 注意, 遵守
examples: I respect him as a writer and as a man.
Respect your parents. They pay for the internet.
exampleZh: 我尊重他这位作家，也尊重他这个人。
尊重你的父母，网钱是他们付的。

defsEn: having a duty or job to do (“He is responsible for preparing the report.”)
being the cause of (“They were responsible for the accident.”)
zh: a. 有责任的, 负责的, 责任重大的
examples: We are responsible for your protection from now on.
You are responsible for the result.
exampleZh: 从此起我们为您的安全负责。
你要对结果负责。

defsEn: to sit, lie down or sleep to regain strength
n. that which remains
the others
zh: n. 休息, 睡眠, 安息, 稍息, 静止, 支架, 休息处, 其余者, 剩余部分
vi. 休息, 睡, 长眠, 安心, 静止, 停止, 安置, 依赖
vt. 使休息, 使支撑, 把...寄托于
examples: We had a rest in the shade.
They had a rest for a while.
exampleZh: 我们在树荫下休息。
他们休息了一会儿。

defsEn: a place where people can buy and eat meals
zh: n. 餐馆, 饭店
examples: That restaurant is in front of the train station.
Our restaurant is near the southern bus station.
exampleZh: 那个饭馆在火车站前面。
我们的饭店在汽车南站的附近。

defsEn: to keep controlled
to limit action by a person or group
zh: vt. 抑制, 阻止, 束缚
examples: He could not restrain his excitement.
I told Jim to restrain himself from drinking too much.

defsEn: to limit
to prevent from increasing or becoming larger
zh: vt. 限制, 限定, 约束
examples: He restricted his drinking to one beer a day.
Mary restricts the amount of meat in her diet.

defsEn: to happen from a cause
n that which follows or is produced by a cause
effect
zh: n. 结果, 成绩, 答案
vi. 产生, 结果, 致使
examples: As a result of the war, many people died.
The result is opposite to what we expected.
exampleZh: 那场战争死了很多人。
结果与我们预期的相反。

defsEn: to leave a job or position because one is old or in poor health
zh: n. 隐居
vi. 引退, 退役, 退休, 退去, 撤退, 退却
vt. 使...撤退, 辞退
examples: When he retired, his son took over the business.
When he retired, his son took over his business.
exampleZh: 他退休的时候，他儿子接手了他的生意。
他退休的时候，他儿子接手了他的生意。

defsEn: to go or come back
to bring, give, take or send back
zh: n. 回来, 返回, 来回票, 归还, 报答, 利润率, 报告书
a. 返回的, 回程的, 报答的, 反向的, 重现的, 复原的
vi. 返回, 归还, 回来
vt. 归还, 还, 回报, 产生, 反射, 报告, 申报, 退回
examples: I'll return her to you tomorrow, safe and sound.
I returned the book to the library.
exampleZh: 我明天会把她完好无缺地还给你。
我把书还给图书馆。

defsEn: to protest violently
to fight for a change, especially of government
zh: n. 叛乱, 反抗, 反感
vi. 叛乱, 反抗, 起义, 厌恶, 反感
vt. 使反感, 使恶心
examples: The revolt happened day by day.
The revolt was put down with little trouble.
exampleZh: 叛乱一天天发生。

defsEn: a food grain
zh: n. 米, 米饭, 稻
vt. 将...压成米粒状
examples: Rice is sold by the kilogram.
We ate curry rice last night.
exampleZh: 米以公斤为单位来出售。
我们昨晚吃了咖哩饭。

defsEn: having much money or goods
having plenty of something
zh: a. 富裕的, 富饶的, 浓厚的, 贵重的
examples: Rich people can do what they want.
She became rich by virtue of hard work and good business sense.
exampleZh: 有钱人可以做他们想做的事。
她凭着努力和生意头脑成了富翁。

defsEn: to sit on or in and be carried along
to travel by animal, wheeled vehicle, airplane or boat
zh: n. 骑马, 乘坐, 乘车, 搭便车
vt. 骑, 乘坐, 压迫, 控制
vi. 骑马, 乘车, 漂游
examples: I usually ride my bike to school. I mean to the office.
Tom hitched a ride to Boston.
exampleZh: 我通常踏单车上学⋯⋯啊，说错了，应该是上班才对。
汤姆搭便车去波士顿了。

defsEn: what a person legally and morally should be able to do or have (“It is their right to vote.”)
ad. agreeing with the facts
good
correct
opposite wrong
on the side that is toward the east when one is facing north
opposite left
zh: n. 权利, 右边, 正义, 右派, 公正
a. 正确的, 对的, 恰当的, 正常的, 正直的, 正面的, 右方的
adv. 正确地, 以有利结果, 一直, 直接, 向右
vt. 扶直, 整理, 纠正, 伸冤, 使昭雪
vi. 恢复平衡
examples: You could be right, I suppose.
Who gave you the right to do such a thing?
exampleZh: 我猜想你可能是对的。
是谁允许你做这样的事的？

defsEn: to act with many others in a violent way in a public place
n. a violent action by a large group of people
zh: n. 暴动, 喧闹, 放纵
vi. 发动, 暴动, 纵情, 放荡
vt. 浪费, 挥霍
examples: The riot spread across the city.
The riot was soon put down by the police.

defsEn: to go up
to go higher
to increase
to go from a position of sitting or lying to a position of standing
zh: n. 上升, 增加, 上涨, 高地, 升高, 出现
vi. 升起, 起身, 起立, 上升, 上涨, 增长, 高耸, 起义, 浮现
vt. 使飞起
examples: Rise early and your luck will rise with you.
They rise, not with force, but with quiet determination.

defsEn: the chance of loss, damage or injury
zh: n. 冒险, 危险, 保险额
vt. 冒...的危险, 冒险干
examples: It's a risk that Tom and I aren't willing to take.
He risked losing all his fortune.
exampleZh: 我和汤姆都不愿意冒这个险。
他冒着失去所有财产的危险。

defsEn: a large amount of water that flows across land into another river, a lake or an ocean
zh: n. 河, 江
examples: The river's on the other side of the hill.
This river is dangerous for children to swim in.
exampleZh: 河在山丘的另一端。
孩子在这条河里游泳太危险了。

defsEn: a long piece of hard ground built between two places so people can walk, drive or ride easily from one place to the other road
zh: n. 路, 道路, 公路, 途径, 方法
examples: This road will take you to the museum.
This road will lead you to the airport.
exampleZh: 这条路会引你去博物馆。
这条路是去机场的。

defsEn: to take money or property secretly or by force
to steal
zh: v. 抢夺, 抢掠, 剥夺
examples: He robbed me of all my money.
A mugger robbed him of all of his money.
exampleZh: 他把我所有的钱都抢走了。
他身上的钱全被强盗抢走了。

defsEn: a machine that moves and performs work
zh: n. 机械人, 自动机械, 机械般工作的人
examples: The robot went out of control.
How could I be a robot? Robots can't dream.
exampleZh: 这个机器人失控了。
我怎么可能是机器人呢？机器人不会做梦。

defsEn: a hard piece of mineral matter
zh: n. 岩石, 岩礁, 石头, 基石, 暗礁, 摇动, 摇滚乐
vt. 摇摆, 摇动, 使摇晃, 使动摇
vi. 摇, 摇动
examples: He threw a rock into the pond.
Yanni has a rock chip on his windshield.
exampleZh: 他扔一块石头到池塘里。
雅尼的挡风玻璃上有一块石头碎片。

defsEn: a device shaped like a tube that moves through air or space by burning gases and letting them escape from the back or bottom, sometimes used as a weapon
zh: n. 火箭, 烟火
vi. 急升, 猛涨, 飞驰
vt. 用火箭运载
examples: The rocket travels at a tremendous speed.
The rocket was launched into space.
exampleZh: 火箭飞得极快。
火箭发射进入太空。

defsEn: to turn over and over
to move like a ball
zh: n. 卷, 滚动, 名单, 案卷, 压路机
vi. 滚, 滚动, 飘流, 起伏, 卷, 绕
vt. 使滚动, 卷, 绕
examples: Roll the pastry into a rectangle.
Roll the dough into a rectangle.
exampleZh: 把面团擀成方形。
把面团擀成方形。

defsEn: a separate area within a building with its own walls
zh: n. 房间, 空位, 场所
vi. 住宿, 居住
vt. 留宿
examples: What room would you like to reserve?
There is a room where children play. You can take your child there.
exampleZh: 您想订什么房间？
这里有间供儿童玩耍的房间。你可以把你的小孩带到那里。

defsEn: the part of a plant that is under the ground and takes nutrients from the soil root
zh: n. 根, 根本, 根源, 基础, 底部
vt. 使扎根, 使固定, 根除, 肃清, 搜出, 用鼻拱
vi. 生根, 固定, 源于, 用鼻拱土, 寻找, 捧场, 支持
examples: The root cause of any divorce is marriage.
Root beer is considered a classic American carbonated soft drink.
exampleZh: 结婚是所有离婚的主要原因。
麦根沙士被视为一种经典的美式碳酸饮品。

defsEn: a long, thick piece of material made from thinner pieces of material, used for tying
zh: n. 绳, 索, 粗绳, 绞索, 决窍
vt. 捆, 缚, 绑, 圈起, 以绳将...系住
vi. 拧成绳状
examples: The rope broke under the strain.
The rope wasn't strong enough to support him.
exampleZh: 绳子被拉断了。
绳子不够牢固，撑不住他。

defsEn: not flat or smooth
having an uneven surface
violent
not made well
zh: n. 粗糙的东西, 毛坯, 未加工品, 梗概, 草图, 暴徒, 艰难
a. 粗糙的, 粗暴的, 蓬乱的, 草率的, 大致的, 简陋的, 暴风雨的, 艰难的
vt. 使粗糙, 使不平, 使蓬乱, 粗制, 草拟, 粗暴对待, 对...动粗
vi. 变粗糙
adv. 粗糙地, 粗暴地
examples: At a rough estimate, I would say the job will take two weeks.
They were made of rough brown leather.
exampleZh: 我想这工作粗略估计得花上两个星期的时间。
它们是用粗糙的褐色皮革制成的。

defsEn: having the shape of a ball or circle
zh: n. 圆, 圆形物, 巡回, 循环, 一轮, 一回合, 一局, 范围, 轮唱
a. 圆的, 球形的, 丰满的, 肥胖的, 完全的, 大概的, 完美的, 圆润的
prep. 围着, 附近, 绕过, 在...周围
adv. 围绕着, 在周围, 迂回地, 挨个, 朝反方向
vt. 弄圆, 使成圆形, 绕行, 完成, 围捕, 把...四舍五入
vi. 变圆, 发胖, 环行, 拐弯, 进展
examples: We gave the performer a round of applause.
Round-trip fares to each destination are as follows.
exampleZh: 我们为表演者鼓掌。
往返各地的收费如下。

defsEn: to move something over the surface of another thing
zh: n. 摩擦, 困难, 障碍, 磨损处
vt. 擦, 搓, 摩擦, 惹怒
vi. 摩擦, 擦破
examples: Rub out these words with your eraser.
Rub that off your face immediately.
exampleZh: 用你的橡皮把这些字擦掉。

defsEn: a substance made from the liquid of trees with the same name, or a similar substance made from chemicals
zh: n. 橡皮, 橡胶, 做摩擦动作的人, 按摩师, 决胜盘
vt. 用橡胶制造, 涂橡胶于
examples: Rubber is not hard: it gives way to pressure.
The rubber band broke with a vicious snap.
exampleZh: 橡皮不硬：它在压力下会变形。

defsEn: to damage severely
to destroy
zh: n. 毁灭, 推翻, 废墟
vi. 毁灭, 衰败, 破坏, 破产, 堕落
vt. 使毁灭, 毁坏, 使破产
examples: I'm sorry that I ruined your wedding.
I'm sorry I ruined your wedding.
exampleZh: 对不起，我毁了你的婚礼。
对不起，我毁了你的婚礼。

defsEn: to govern or control
to decide
n. a statement or an order that says how something must be done
zh: n. 规则, 统治, 控制, 支配, 规律, 标准, 章程, 破折号, 铅线
vt. 规定, 统治, 管理, 控制, 支配, 裁决
vi. 统治, 管辖, 裁定
examples: The rule of the road must be strictly observed.
To rule a country is no easy task.
exampleZh: 道路法规必须被严格遵守。
统治一个国家不是一件简单的工作。

defsEn: to move quickly by steps faster than those used for walking run
zh: n. 跑, 赛跑, 奔跑, 奔跑的路程, 趋向, 流出, 运转时间, 连续
vi. 跑, 奔跑, 跑步, 赛跑, 竞赛, 行驶, 运转, 进行, 蔓延
vt. 使跑, 参赛, 追究, 驾驶, 开动, 管理, 经营, 使流出, 运行
a. 熔化的, 融化的, 浇铸的
run的过去式和过去分词
examples: Run hot water into the bath.
If you run after two hares, you will catch neither.
exampleZh: 往浴缸里放热水。
脚踏两条船，必定落空。

defsEn: describing areas away from cities which may include farms, small towns and unpopulated areas.
zh: a. 乡下的, 田园的, 乡村风味的
examples: Rural life appeals to me very much.
It is in a rural area.

defsEn: to damage or destroy as an act against an organization or nation
zh: n. 怠工, 破坏活动, 破坏
vi. 从事破坏活动
vt. 妨害, 破坏
examples: They sabotaged my effort to make our class enjoyable.
You sabotaged your own chances for success.

defsEn: to do without something or to suffer a loss for a belief, idea, goal or another person
zh: n. 牺牲, 供奉, 祭品
vt. 牺牲, 祭祀, 贱卖
vi. 献祭
examples: He did not sacrifice his life, nor did he sell out his organization.
He sacrificed his life and betrayed the organization.
exampleZh: 他没有牺牲生命，也没有出卖组织。
他牺牲生命，出卖组织。

defsEn: not happy
zh: a. 忧愁的, 悲哀的
examples: His sad story touched my heart.
She got really sad because of what he said.
exampleZh: 他悲伤的故事触动了我的心。
因为他的话，她非常伤心。

defsEn: away from harm or danger
zh: n. 保险箱, 冷藏室
a. 安全的, 可靠的, 平安的, 稳健的, 有把握的
examples: Is it safe to skate on this lake?
Is it safe to drink this water?
exampleZh: 在这个湖上滑冰安全吗？
这水能喝吗？

defsEn: to travel by boat or ship sail
zh: n. 帆, 篷, 帆船, 航程, 帆状物
vi. 航行, 启航, 张帆而行
vt. 航行于, 驾船
examples: They sailed along the west coast of Africa.
Columbus sailed farther west to look for a new continent.
exampleZh: 他们沿着非洲西岸航行了。
哥伦布航行至遥远的西方，去寻找一个新大陆。

defsEn: a person involved in sailing a boat or ship
zh: n. 水手, 船员, 海员
examples: A sailor saw his fellow sailor sink from exhaustion.
A sailor saw his friend drown from exhaustion.

defsEn: a white substance found in sea water and in the ground, used to affect the taste of food
zh: n. 盐, 风趣, 刺激
a. 含盐的, 咸的, 风趣的, 辛辣的
vt. 加盐于, 用盐腌
examples: Salt helps to preserve food from decay.
The salt cellar will be on the table.
exampleZh: 盐可以帮助保存食物避免腐烂。

defsEn: not different
not changed
like another or others
zh: a. 相同的, 同样的
pron. 相同的人(或事物)
adv. 同样地
examples: She and I were in the same class in middle school.
We were on the same train by chance.
exampleZh: 我和她在中学是一个班的。
我们偶然间乘了同一列列车。

defsEn: extremely small pieces of crushed rock found in large amounts in deserts and on coasts
zh: n. 沙, 沙子, 沙滩, 光阴, 生涯
vt. 撒沙, 以沙掩盖
examples: There is sand at the bottom of the ocean.
It's sand as far as the eye can see.
exampleZh: 海洋底部有沙子。

defsEn: a small object in space that moves around a larger object
an object placed in orbit around the earth
zh: n. 人造卫星
examples: A satellite was launched in Russia last year.
The satellite came flying over Hanoi.
exampleZh: 俄罗斯去年发射了一个卫星。
人造卫星从河内上空飞过。

defsEn: to give or provide what is desired, needed or demanded
zh: vt. 使满意, 满足, 符合, 使确信, 赔偿
vi. 令人满意, 替人赎罪
examples: I am not satisfied with the result at all.
I am not satisfied with my performance today.
exampleZh: 我对这个结果一点儿也不满意。
我对我今天的表演不满意。

defsEn: to make safe
to remove from harm
to keep for future use
zh: n. 救球
vt. 解救, 挽救, 储蓄, 保存, 节省, 保留
vi. 挽救, 节省, 救球
prep. 除...之外
examples: Save it on the external hard drive.
Could you save this dress for me?
exampleZh: 把它保存在外接式硬碟。
你能帮我保留这件洋装吗？

defsEn: to speak
to express in words
zh: vt. 说, 讲, 念, 说明, 指明
vi. 说, 讲
n. 意见, 发言权
examples: You say one thing and then act just the opposite.
They say that they like to do that.
exampleZh: 你说一套做一套。
他们表示喜欢那样做。

defsEn: a place for education
a place where people go to learn
zh: n. 学校, 鱼群, 门派, 学派
vt. 教育, 训练, 培养
vi. 成群地游
examples: School will soon be over for summer vacation.
Our school is in the center of the town.
exampleZh: 学校很快就要放暑假了。
我们学校在市中心。

defsEn: the study of nature and the actions of natural things, and the knowledge gained about them
zh: n. 科学, 学科, 学问, 自然科学
examples: Science begins when you ask why and how.
This is a science fiction book.
exampleZh: 为何如何？你疑问的当下就是科学的开端。
这是一部科学幻想小说。

defsEn: a large area of salt water, usually part of an ocean
zh: n. 海, 海洋, 海浪, 大量
examples: The sea can be heard from here.
Sea turtles have a long lifespan.
exampleZh: 我们从这里可以听到海的声音。
海龟的寿命很长。

defsEn: to look for carefully
zh: n. 搜寻, 查究
v. 搜寻, 搜查, 探求, 调查, 搜索
examples: The policemen searched one house after another in looking for the thief.
The rescuers searched the surroundings in hopes of finding the child.
exampleZh: 为了把小偷抓住，警察逐家逐户搜查。
援救人员为了找到孩子，仔细搜索了那个区域。

defsEn: one of the four periods of the year that is based on the earth’s position toward the sun (spring, summer, autumn, winter)
a period of time based on different weather conditions (“dry season”, “rainy season”)
a period during the year when something usually happens (“baseball season”) seasons
zh: n. 季节, 时节, 当令期, 时期
vt. 给...调味, 使成熟, 使老练, 缓和
vi. 变干燥
examples: Which season do you like best, spring or autumn?
What season do you like the best?
exampleZh: 春天和秋天，你更喜欢哪个？
你最喜欢哪个季节？

defsEn: a thing to sit on
a place to sit or the right to sit there (“a seat in parliament”)
zh: n. 座, 座位, 位子, 席位, 所在地
vt. 使坐下, 使就座, 为...设座于, 使就职
vi. 安装在底座上
examples: He gave his seat to the old man.
She gave her seat to a senior citizen.
exampleZh: 他把座位让给了老人。
她把她的座位让给了一个老人。

defsEn: the one that comes after the first
zh: n. 秒, 瞬间, 第二名, 支持者, 助手
a. 第二的, 其次的, 次要的, 附加的, 辅助的
num. 第二
vt. 当...助手, 支持
examples: I was the second to last person to hear the bad news.
The Second World War was not yet over.
exampleZh: 我是倒数第二个得知这个坏消息的。
第二次世界大战尚未结束。

defsEn: something known only to a few and kept from general knowledge
ad. hidden from others
known only to a few
zh: n. 秘密, 机密, 秘诀, 秘方
a. 秘密的, 极机密的, 隐蔽的, 暗中的, 神秘的, 偏僻的
examples: In this secret code, each number stands for a letter of the alphabet.
There's a secret path on the left.
exampleZh: 在这个密码里，每个数字取代了一个字母。
在左边有一条秘密通道。

defsEn: freedom from danger or harm
protection
measures necessary to protect a person or place (“Security was increased in the city.”)
zh: n. 安全, 安全性, 防护物, 保安, 可靠性, 担保人, 抵押品, 保证金
examples: The security level, as established by the Department of Homeland Security, is orange.
I told security to give her the boot.
exampleZh: 根据国土安全部的规定，目前的安全水准是橙色等级。

defsEn: to know or sense through the eyes
to understand or know see
zh: vt. 看见, 查看, 参观, 游览, 理解, 知道, 同意
vi. 看, 观看, 注意, 知道, 考虑
n. 主教的职位
examples: If you see a mistake, then please correct it.
I see him in the library now and then.
exampleZh: 如果你发现有错的话请帮忙改正。
有时我会在图书馆看见他。

defsEn: the part of a plant from which new plants grow
zh: n. 种子, 籽, 萌芽, 子孙, 精液
vt. 在...播种, 催...发育, 脱...籽
vi. 结实, 播种
examples: She seeded vegetables in her garden.
Who seeds wind, shall harvest storm.
exampleZh: 她在花园里种了一些菜。
播种风，收成暴风。

defsEn: to search for (“They are seeking a cure for cancer.”)
to try to get (“She is seeking election to public office.”)
to plan to do (“Electric power companies are seeking to reduce their use of coal.”)
zh: vt. 寻求, 寻找, 探索, 追求, 搜索, 请求
vi. 寻找, 搜索
examples: They went out to Australia seeking gold.
We seek beauty not in perfection, but in truth.
exampleZh: 他们为了找到黄金而前往澳大利亚。

defsEn: to appear to be (“She seems to be in good health.”)
zh: vi. 象是, 似乎
examples: You seem to be a little under the weather.
You seem to be an honest man.
exampleZh: 你看上去不太好。
你看起来像个老实人。

defsEn: to take quickly by force
to take control of quickly
to arrest
zh: vt. 抓住, 逮捕, 俘获, 没收, 扣押, 掌握
vi. 突然抓住, 利用
examples: He seized me by the neck.
The policeman seized the boy by the arm.
exampleZh: 他抓住了我的脖子。
警察抓住了那个男孩的手臂。

defsEn: all that which makes one person different from others
zh: n. 自己, 自我, 本性, 本质, 私心, 本人
vt. 使近亲繁殖, 使自花授精
vi. 自花授精
a. 同一的
examples: Self-confidence is the principal element of any great endeavor.
Self-care is essential for mental and physical well-being.
exampleZh: 自信是伟大事业的第一要素。

defsEn: to give something in exchange for money
zh: vt. 卖, 背叛, 销售, 出卖
vi. 卖, 销售
n. 卖, 推销术, 失望
examples: I wouldn't sell that at any price.
I won't sell this tree shade.
exampleZh: 任何价格我都不会卖。
我不会卖这个树影的。

defsEn: the smaller of the two groups in the governments of some countries, such as in the United States Congress
zh: n. 参议院, 立法机构, 评议会
examples: The Senate passed the bill yesterday.
The senate disapproved of the minister.

defsEn: to cause to go
to permit to go
to cause to be carried, taken or directed to or away from a place
zh: vt. 发送, 使进入, 寄, 派遣, 发射, 使陷于
vi. 寄信, 派人, 播送
n. (船的)上升运动
examples: They send their child to a part-time nursery.
I told them to send me another ticket.
exampleZh: 他们送孩子去了幼儿园的半托班。
我请他们再寄给我一张票。

defsEn: to come to know about by feeling, believing or understanding
n. any of the abilities to see, hear, taste, smell or feel
zh: n. 感应, 感觉, 感官, 意识, 观念, 情理, 知觉, 理智
vt. 感觉, 觉察, 检测
examples: He has no sense of reading the room.
She has no sense of reading the room.
exampleZh: 真没眼力见儿。
真没眼力见儿。

defsEn: to declare the punishment for a crime
n. the punishment for a crime
zh: n. 句子, 命题, 宣判
vt. 宣判, 判决
examples: A sentence normally has a subject and a verb.
Translating this sentence will be very easy.
exampleZh: 句子通常有主词和动词。
翻译这个句子会很容易。

defsEn: to set or keep people, things or ideas away from or independent from others
ad. not together or connected
different
zh: n. 独立件, 抽印本
a. 分开的, 各别的, 单独的, 分隔的
vi. 分开, 隔开, 分居
vt. 使分离, 使分开, 区分, 使分居
examples: You cannot separate the milk from the coffee once you put it in.
They are separated by a great distance.
exampleZh: 你一把它放进去，就不能把牛奶和咖啡分开了。
他们之间隔着很远的距离。

defsEn: a number of similar things or events that follow one after another in time, position or order
zh: n. 串联, 序列, 连续, 系列, 丛书, 套, 级数, 组
examples: Why are series about time travel so popular at the moment?
She made a series of medical discoveries.
exampleZh: 现在穿越剧为什么这么火？
她提出了一连串的医学发现。

defsEn: important
needing careful consideration
dangerous
zh: a. 严肃的, 认真的, 重要的, 严重的
examples: I'm a serious office lady and a good wife and mother at home.
I was serious when I said I love you.
exampleZh: 我是一个认真的文员，在家里，我是一个好妻子兼好母亲。
我说我爱你时是认真的。

defsEn: to work as an official
to be employed by the government
to assist or help
zh: vt. 可作...用, 服务, 经历, 招待, 供应, 送交, 对待
vi. 服务, 服役, 侍应, 适合, 有用, 开球
n. 发球, 轮到发球
examples: My uncle made me serve as interpreter.
The takoyaki served at this restaurant is a delight.
exampleZh: 我叔叔让我担任翻译。
这家餐厅的章鱼烧非常好吃。

defsEn: an organization or system that provides something for the public (“Schools and roads are services paid for by taxes.”)
a job that an organization or business can do for money
military organizations such as an army, navy or air force
a religious ceremony
zh: n. 服务, 贡献, 雇佣, 公职, 服役, 功劳, 仪式, 送达, 行政部门
vt. 保养, 维修
a. 武装部队的, 服务性的, 仆人的, 耐用的
examples: The service is excellent in this hotel.
Is there a service charge for that?
exampleZh: 这家酒店服务很好。
要收服务费吗?

defsEn: to put in place or position
to establish a time, price or limit
zh: n. 日落, 同伙, 组合, 集合, 装置
vt. 放, 安置, 放置, 设定, 使凝结, 点燃, 确定, 点缀, 使就位, 树立, 分配, 调整
vi. 日落, 凝固, 定型, 搁住, 结果, 适合
a. 决心的, 规定的, 故意的, 持久的, 固定的, 老套的, 准备好的
examples: We set a trap to catch a fox.
She set the bird free from the cage.
exampleZh: 我们设了个陷阱来抓狐狸。
她把小鸟从笼子里释放出来。

defsEn: to end (a dispute)
to agree about (a problem)
to make a home in a new place
zh: n. 有背长椅
vt. 决定, 整理, 安放, 使定居, 使平静, 支付, 安排, 解决, 结算
vi. 停留, 下陷, 沉淀, 澄清, 安下心来, 结清, 定居, 安家
examples: They said to him they would settle there.
She said to them she would settle there.

defsEn: three or more, but not many
zh: a. 几个的, 一些的, 各自的
pron. 几个
examples: Several dozen young people participated in the demonstration.
Several classic, family-friendly games will also join the service next month.
exampleZh: 几十个年轻人参加了示威游行。
多款经典家庭游戏也将于下个月同步上架。

defsEn: not gentle
causing much pain, sadness or damage
zh: a. 严格的, 尖锐的, 严肃的, 严重的, 严厉的, 朴素的
examples: In severe weather, it's best to stay indoors.
He was severe with his children.
exampleZh: 天气恶劣的时候尽量不要外出。
他对自己的孩子很严格。

defsEn: either the male or the female group into which all people and animals are divided because of their actions in producing young
the physical activity by which humans and animals can produce young.
zh: n. 性别, 性欲
vt. 区别...的性别, 引起...的性欲
examples: Our sex life is not completely harmonious.
My boyfriend and I had sex on the first date.
exampleZh: 我们的性生活不是十分和谐。
我和男友第一次约会就发生了性关系。

defsEn: to move or cause to move in short, quick movements
zh: n. 摇动, 震动
vt. 摇动, 动摇, 使震动, 挥舞
vi. 震动, 发抖, 动摇
examples: When you shake hands with somebody, you must look him in the eye.
Where did you shake hands with them?
exampleZh: 和别人握手的时候，一定要有眼神接触。
你在哪里和他们握的手？

defsEn: to give form to
n. the form of something, especially how it looks
zh: n. 形状, 形态, 外形, 形式, 身材
vt. 定形, 使成形, 塑造, 计划, 使符合
vi. 成形, 形成, 成长
examples: That shape could be a horse, for example.
What shape should I cut the crotch for the trousers?

defsEn: to give part of something to another or others
n. a part belonging to, given to or owned by a single person or a group
any one of the equal parts of ownership of a business or company
zh: n. 部分, 参与, 一份, 参股, 份额
vt. 均分, 分担, 分享, 分配, 共有
vi. 分享
文件锁定及检测磁盘更动和对超过32MB硬盘分区的支持
examples: I share a bedroom with my sister.
He shares a room with his brother.
exampleZh: 我跟我姐姐共用同一间卧房。
他和兄弟共用一个房间。

defsEn: having a thin edge or small point that can cut or hurt
causing hurt or pain
zh: n. 半升音调, 利刃, 骗子
a. 锋利的, 明显的, 敏锐的, 急剧的, 尖刻的, 严厉的, 刺耳的, 精明的
adv. 锐利地, 急速地
examples: A sharp crack of thunder split the sky.
Don't be so sharp with the children.
exampleZh: 一道闪电划破天空。
别对孩子们这么凶。

defsEn: the girl or woman who is being spoken about
zh: pron. 她

defsEn: a farm animal used for its meat and hair
zh: 绵羊
examples: Sheep are feeding in the meadow.
The sheep put on a lot of fat.
exampleZh: 羊群在草地上吃着草。

defsEn: to fire artillery
n. a metal container that is fired from a large gun and explodes when it reaches its target
a hard outside cover
zh: n. 贝壳, 壳, 外形, 炮弹
vt. 去壳, 脱落, 炮轰
vi. 剥落, 脱壳
examples: The shell of an egg is easily broken.
He became a shell of his former self.
exampleZh: 蛋壳容易破碎。

defsEn: to protect or give protection to
n. something that gives protection
a place of safety
zh: n. 庇护所, 避难所, 庇护, 隐蔽处, 掩蔽
vt. 庇护, 保护, 隐匿
vi. 躲避
examples: He sought shelter from the rain.
Shelter and safety, I think, I can promise you.
exampleZh: 他四处寻找避雨的地方。

defsEn: to aim a light
to give bright light
to be bright
to clean to make bright
zh: n. 光泽, 阳光
vt. 使发光
vi. 照耀, 发光, 发亮
examples: I shine light in the world.
Shine your shoes before going out.
exampleZh: 我在这个世界散发着自己的光芒。
出门前把你的鞋子擦亮。

defsEn: to transport
n. a large boat ship
zh: n. 船, 舰
vt. 以船运送, 装船, 运送
vi. 上船, 乘船
examples: This ship is too big to pass through the canal.
The ship made slow progress against the strong wind.
exampleZh: 这艘船太大，没法通过运河。
这艘船逆风而行缓慢前进。

defsEn: to cause to feel sudden surprise or fear
n. something that greatly affects the mind or emotions
a powerful shake, as from an earthquake
zh: n. 震动, 冲突, 震惊, 冲击, 突击, 禾束堆, 休克, 长毛狗
vt. 使震动, 使休克, 使受电击, 震惊得
vi. 震动, 吓人
a. 蓬乱浓密的
examples: She got over the shock of her father's death.
What shocked us greatly was his sudden resignation.
exampleZh: 她从她父亲过世的震惊中恢复了。
让我们非常惊讶的是，他突然辞职了。

defsEn: a covering for the foot
zh: n. 鞋, 靴, 外胎
vt. 给...穿鞋, 为马钉蹄铁
examples: Your shoes do not go with the suit.
I took my shoes off and put them under the bed.
exampleZh: 你的鞋子和衣服不合衬。
我把鞋脱了，然后将它们放在床下。

defsEn: to cause a gun or other weapon to send out an object designed to kill
to use a gun
zh: n. 射击, 狩猎, 芽, 射伤, 发射, 发芽, 急流, 推力, 摄影, 急送, 滑运道, 浪费
vt. 射击, 射中, 损毁, 拍摄, 喷出, 投射, 挥出, 飞速行进, 挥霍, 给...注射
vi. 射出, 射击, 发出, 拍电影, 射门, 发芽
examples: Don't shoot the devil in the back. You might miss.
The shooting victim is alive, but just barely.
exampleZh: 别射撒旦的背部。你可能会射不中。
那个中了枪的人还没有死，但却已经奄奄一息了。

defsEn: lasting only for a small period of time
not long
opposite tall
zh: a. 短的, 近的, 矮的, 短期的, 简短的, 少量的
adv. 简短地, 突然
n. 扼要, 短片, 缺乏
vt. 故意少给, 使短路
examples: We are not short of oil in this country.
I'm short of cash at the moment.
exampleZh: 我们国家不缺石油。
此刻我缺少现金。

defsEn: used with another verb (action word) to show responsibility. (“We should study.”), probability (“The talks should begin soon.”), or that something is believed to be a good idea (“Criminals should be punished.”)
zh: aux. 应该, 将要
examples: You should pay more attention to what he says.
You should have told me a long time ago.
exampleZh: 你应该多注意他说的话。
很久以前你就应该告诉我的。

defsEn: to speak very loudly
zh: n. 呼喊, 喊声
vi. 呼喊, 喊叫, 嚷
vt. 高喊
examples: Shouting at your computer will not help.
He shouted at the top of his lungs.
exampleZh: 对你的电脑吼一点帮助也没有。
他放声大喊。

defsEn: to make something be seen
to make known
n. a play or story presented in a theater, or broadcast on radio or television, for enjoyment or education
something organized to be seen by the public show
zh: n. 显示, 表现, 展览, 卖弄, 炫耀, 外观, 演出, 洋相
vt. 表示, 显示, 展现, 陈列, 演出, 表明, 指出, 带领
vi. 露面, 显现, 演出
examples: Could you show me the way to the bus stop?
Could you show me your return ticket?
exampleZh: 请问公车站该怎么去？
麻烦请给我看一下你的回程票。

defsEn: to make or become less in size, weight or value
zh: n. 收缩, 萎缩, 回避
vi. 收缩, 退缩, 萎缩, 缩小, 回避
vt. 使收缩, 使缩小
examples: My shrink says I should relax more.
He had to shrink the budget by over half.

defsEn: suffering physically or mentally with a disease or other problem
not in good health
zh: n. 病人
a. 不舒服, 有病的, 恶心的, 厌恶的, 渴望的, 病态的
vt. 呕吐, 追击, 使(狗)去攻击
examples: I'm sick and tired of being sick and tired.
Being sick in bed, my father can't see you.
exampleZh: 我讨厌厌烦的感觉。
我爸爸病了，正在床上休息，不能见你。

defsEn: the condition of being in bad health
zh: n. 疾病, 不健康, 呕吐
examples: Sickness and health start with the mind.
His sickness made it impossible for him to continue his study.

defsEn: the outer surfaces of an object that are not the top or bottom
parts away from the middle
either the right or left half of the body
zh: n. 旁边, 侧, 方面, 胁, 侧边, 血统
a. 旁的, 侧的, 次要的
vt. 同意, 支持
vi. 支持, 赞助
examples: I am on the side of democracy.
With you by my side, everything is okay now.
exampleZh: 我在民主这一边。
你在我旁边，现在一切都好了。

defsEn: to write one’s name
n. a mark or shape used to mean something
evidence that something exists or will happen
a flat piece of material with writing that gives information
zh: n. 符号, 招牌, 征兆, 正负号, 手势
vt. 签名, 打手势表达
vi. 签名
examples: No sign of the enemy in our surroundings.
They made him sign the contract against his will.
exampleZh: 在我们的周围没有敌人的迹象。
他被强迫签了约。

defsEn: to send a message by signs
n. an action or movement that sends a message
zh: n. 信号, 暗号, 近因, 导火线
vt. 向...作信号, 标志, 用信号通知
vi. 发信号
a. 作为信号的, 显著的
examples: He gave us the signal to begin.
I signalled him to come close to me.
exampleZh: 他给了我们开始的信号。

defsEn: to make quiet
to stop from speaking or making noise
n. a lack of noise or sound
zh: n. 沉默, 无声, 静寂, 湮没, 无声息
vt. 使缄默
interj. 安静
examples: Your silence will encourage them to oppress you.
In silence, we hear the truth.

defsEn: a valued white metal
zh: n. 银, 银币, 银器
a. 银的, 银制的, 银器的
vt. 镀银
vi. 变银白色
examples: There is a silver lining to every dark cloud!
A silver medal was a great result, too.

defsEn: like something else but not exactly the same
zh: a. 相似的, 类似的
n. 相似的东西
examples: He became similar to us, through Jesus Christ, the eternal Son of God.
We are so similar and so different at the same time.

defsEn: easy to understand or do
not difficult or complex
zh: a. 简单的, 普通的, 朴素的, 单纯的, 绝对的, 初级的, 原始的, 迟钝的
n. 出身低微者, 傻子
examples: Lucia is a simple kind of girl.
As it is written in simple English, this book is easy to read.
exampleZh: 留西雅是一个很单纯的姑娘。
由于是用简单的英语所写的，这本书很容易阅读。

defsEn: from a time in the past until now (“I have known her since we went to school together.”)
zh: prep. 自...以后, 自...以来
adv. 自那时以后
conj. 既然, 自...以后, 自...以来
examples: Since you all say that, I must think again.
Since when do you learn Japanese?
exampleZh: 既然你们这么说，那让我再想想。
你从什么时候开始学日文？

defsEn: to make music sounds with the voice
zh: vi. 唱, 唱歌, 演唱, 鸣, 啼
vt. 唱, 歌颂
n. 嗖嗖声
examples: You sing with a voice as clear as the waters of the Pacific Ocean.
She could sing well when she was a child.
exampleZh: 你的歌声清澈如太平洋的海水。
她小时候唱歌唱得很好。

defsEn: one only
zh: a. 单身的, 单程的, 单一的, 个别的, 孤独的, 专一的
n. 一个, 单打, 单程票
vt. 选出
vi. 击出一垒打
examples: A single step, and you will fall over the cliff.
A single room with bath, please.
exampleZh: 只迈一步，你就会落下悬崖。
我要一个带浴室的单人房。

defsEn: to go down into water or other liquid
zh: n. 藏垢的场所, 沟渠, 污水槽
vi. 下沉, 沉没, 下陷, 减弱, 衰退, 消沉, 堕落, 渗透
vt. 使低落, 使下沉, 陷于, 投入(资金等), 挖掘
examples: The sink let out a low gurgle.
It was sink or swim with me.

defsEn: a female with the same father or mother as another person
zh: n. 姐妹, 姐, 妹, 护士, 修女
vt. 姐妹般对待
examples: My sister can play the piano better than I can.
He had his sister help him paint the wall of his room.
exampleZh: 我妹妹钢琴可以弹得比我好。
他让妹妹帮他涂他房间的墙。

defsEn: to rest on the lower part of the body without the support of the legs
to become seated
zh: vi. 坐, 就座, 坐落
vt. 使就座, 骑
n. 坐, 衣服合身
examples: Sit in the well and look at the sky.
Sit down and rest for a while.
exampleZh: 坐井观天。
您坐下休息休息。

defsEn: the way things are during a period of time
zh: n. 情形, 境遇, 位置
examples: Our situation should improve in the near future.
The situation must be worse than you thought.
exampleZh: 我们近期内的情况应该会好转。
情况比您想的要严重。

defsEn: the space occupied by something
how long, wide or high something is
zh: n. 大小, 尺寸, 规模, 尺码, 能力, 浆料
vt. 上浆, 依大小排列
vi. 可比拟
a. 一定大小的, 一定尺寸的
examples: What size cake do you need?
This size is too large for me.
exampleZh: 你需要多大的蛋糕？
这个码对我来说太大了。

defsEn: all the bones of a human or other animal together in their normal positions skeleton
zh: n. 骨骼, 骨瘦如柴的人, 梗概, 骨干, 残骸
a. 骨骼的, 概略的, 基层的, 骨干的
examples: There is a skeleton in every closet.
There's a skeleton following you everywhere you go.

defsEn: the ability gained from training or experience
zh: n. 技术, 技巧, 技能, 熟练, 熟练工人
examples: Skilled soldiers know how to use their environment as a weapon.
With skill and perseverance you can achieve any goal.
exampleZh: 熟练的士兵知道怎么以他们的环境为武器。

defsEn: the outer covering of humans and most animals
zh: n. 皮肤, 皮
vt. 剥皮, 在...植皮
vi. 长皮, 愈合, 蜕皮
examples: Her skin is as white as snow.
Her skin is more white than snow.
exampleZh: 她的皮肤白得像雪。
她的皮肤比雪还白。

defsEn: the space above the earth
zh: n. 天空, 天色, 天堂
vt. 击向空中, 挂在高处
vi. 高涨
examples: The sky will probably turn clear in the afternoon.
The sky illumined in purple in the evening.
exampleZh: 下午大概天转晴。
傍晚时分，天空泛着紫色的光。

defsEn: a person owned or controlled by another
zh: n. 奴隶, 从动装置, 卑鄙的人
vi. 拼命工作
examples: She is a slave of fashion.
Don't be a slave to money.
exampleZh: 她是潮流的奴隶。
不要成为金钱的奴隶。

defsEn: to rest the body and mind with the eyes closed
zh: n. 睡眠, 静止, 昏迷, 麻木, 长眠, 冬眠
vi. 睡觉, 睡眠, 静止
vt. 睡
examples: If you sleep for a while, you will feel much better.
I did not sleep well last night.
exampleZh: 小睡一会儿，你会好一些。
我昨晚没睡好。

defsEn: to move smoothly over a surface
zh: n. 滑, 滑道, 山崩, 雪崩, 幻灯片
vt. 使滑动, 偷偷放入
vi. 滑动, 滑落, 不知不觉陷入, 偷偷地走
examples: Hasn't Huiru sent the slides yet? The client's pushing.
Slide the box into that empty space.
exampleZh: 慧如那个简报档还没传喔？客户在催。

defsEn: to reduce the speed of
ad. not fast in moving, talking or other activities
zh: a. 慢的, 缓慢的, 迟缓的, 迟钝的, 冷漠的, 落后的
adv. 慢地, 迟缓地
v. (使)慢下来
examples: It's slow to say, but it was quick.
He who is slow to anger has great understanding.
exampleZh: 说时迟，那时快。
不轻易发怒的，大有聪明。

defsEn: little in size or amount
few in number
not important
opposite large
zh: a. 小的, 少的, 小型的, 低微的, 小气的, 细微的
adv. 些微地
n. 狭小部分
examples: The small restaurant of today may be a big hotel tomorrow.
There is a small garden in front of my house.
exampleZh: 今天的小饭馆明天就可以变成大饭店了。
我家前面有个小庭院。

defsEn: to break or be broken into small pieces by force
to hit or move with force
zh: n. 打碎, 粉碎, 打碎时哗啦声, 猛击, 扣球, 杀球, 经营失败, 破产, 硬币, 假硬币
a. 非常轰动的, 了不起的
vt. 打碎, 粉碎, 击溃, 使破产, 使裂变, 使用假硬币
vi. 碎裂, 猛撞, 破产, 扣球, 杀球
adv. 轰隆一声, 哗啦一声
examples: Someone smashed the windshield of my new car.
Smash that like button and subscribe.
exampleZh: 有人把我新车的挡风玻璃砸碎了。

defsEn: to sense through the nose
n. something sensed by the nose (“the smell of food cooking”)
zh: n. 味道, 气味, 嗅觉, 嗅, 臭味, 气息
vt. 闻, 探出, 察觉, 发出...的气味
vi. 嗅, 散发气味, 发臭
examples: I could smell the alcohol on his breath.
This smell might come from the oven!
exampleZh: 我能闻到他呼吸中的酒精味。
这味道可能是微波炉传出来的!

defsEn: to use cigarettes or other tobacco products by burning them and breathing in the smoke
n. that which can be seen rising into the air like a cloud from something burning
zh: n. 烟, 雾气, 烟熏剂, 抽烟, 烟色
vi. 吸烟, 冒烟, 弥漫
vt. 以烟熏, 抽烟而导致...
examples: You smoke far too much. You should cut back.
The smoke went upward through the chimney.
exampleZh: 你吸太多烟了。你应该少抽一点。
烟从烟囱里冒了出来。

defsEn: having a level surface
opposite rough
zh: a. 平滑的, 平稳的, 流畅的, 和蔼的, 安祥的, 圆滑的, 调匀的, 无毛的
vt. 使光滑, 烫平, 使平和, 消除
vi. 变平滑, 变平静
n. 一块平地, 平滑部分
examples: It's as smooth as a baby's bottom.
Smooth skin the whole year round!
exampleZh: 它像婴儿的屁股一样光滑。

defsEn: soft, white pieces of frozen water that fall from the sky, usually in winter or when the air temperature is very cold
zh: n. 雪, 积雪, 下雪, 雪花形干扰
vi. 下雪, 似雪般落下
vt. 使雪白, 用雪覆盖, 使像雪般落下
examples: The snow lay on the ground, frozen into a thick, hard crust.
The snow will melt when the sun comes out.
exampleZh: 地上覆盖着积雪，冻成了又硬又厚的壳。
太阳一出来，雪就会融化。

defsEn: in such a way that (“He held the flag so all could see it.”)
also
too (“She left early, and so did we.”)
very (“I am so sick.”)
as a result (“They were sick, so they could not come.”)
conj. in order that
for the purpose of (“Come early so we can discuss the plans.”)
zh: adv. 如此, 如是, 如...那样
conj. 所以, 因此
pron. 这样

defsEn: of or about people or a group
zh: a. 社会的, 群居的, 社交的
n. 联欢会
examples: Social customs vary from country to country.
Social security? Who do they think they're kidding.
exampleZh: 国家不同，习俗各异。
社会保障吗？他们在说什么笑话？

defsEn: not hard
easily shaped
pleasing to touch
not loud
zh: a. 软的, 温和的, 柔和的, 柔滑的, 温柔的, 软弱的, 坡度小的, 笨的, 纸币的
n. 柔软的东西, 笨人, 纸币
adv. 柔软地, 温和地
examples: But, soft! Methinks I scent the morning air; brief let me be.
A soft answer is a specific cure of anger.

defsEn: earth in which plants grow
zh: n. 土壤, 土地, 国家, 国土, 温床, 污物, 粪便, 水池
vt. 弄脏, 污辱
vi. 变脏
examples: Soil in the Green Dam need to be healthy.
What is the soil food web?

defsEn: a person in the army
zh: n. 军人, 士兵, 兵蚁
vi. 从军, 尽职, 偷懒, 磨洋工
examples: The soldier gave water to me.
The soldiers were ready to die for their country.
exampleZh: 士兵给了我水。
士兵们已经准备好为国牺牲了。

defsEn: having a hard shape with no empty spaces inside
strong
not in the form of a liquid or gas
zh: n. 固体
a. 坚硬的, 稳固的, 固体的, 实心的, 纯质的, 立体的, 立方的
examples: This solid wood table has found a use as a desk.
This solid wood table is being used as a desk.

defsEn: to find an answer
to settle
zh: vt. 解决, 付给, 溶解
vt. 求解
vi. 求解
examples: To solve a problem, you must find the one responsible for it.
You cannot solve this problem with the usual method.
exampleZh: 解铃还须系铃人。
这个问题不能以常规方法解决。

defsEn: of an amount or number or part not stated
not all
zh: pron. 一些, 一部分, 若干
adv. 大约
a. 一些的, 少许的, 某一的
examples: Some of these people look a lot like each other.
Some consider language as a form of knowledge.
exampleZh: 这些人当中有些长得很像。
有些人认为语言是一种知识的形式。

defsEn: a person’s male child
zh: n. 儿子, 女婿, 子孙
examples: Your son took part in the student movement, I hear.
His son cannot so much as write his own name.
exampleZh: 听说你儿子参与了学生运动。
他的儿子连自己的名字也不会写。

defsEn: not long after the present time
quickly
zh: adv. 不久, 早, 快, 宁可
examples: As soon as they return, I will telephone you.
How soon will the meeting begin?
exampleZh: 他们一回来,我就给您打电话。
会议什么时候开始？

defsEn: any group of people or things that are the same or are similar in some way
a kind of something
zh: n. 种类, 方式, 品质, 态度, 举止
vt. 分类, 排序, 挑选
vi. 交往, 协调
对它以行为单位进行排序, 然后在标准输出设备上输出
examples: What sort of work do you do?
What sort of yogurt do you like best?
exampleZh: 你做什么类型的工作？
你最喜欢哪一种酸奶？

defsEn: fast–moving waves of energy that affect the ear and result in hearing
that which is heard
zh: n. 声音, 语音, 吵闹, 声调, 听力范围, 探条, 海峡
a. 健全的, 可靠的, 合理的, 健康的, 彻底的, 资金充实的
adv. 彻底地, 充分地
vi. 发出声音, 回响, 测深, 试探, 听起来
vt. 使发声, 宣告, 听诊, 测...深, 试探
examples: That sounds like a fairly good proposal.
It sounds like a good idea.
exampleZh: 这方案听起来不错。
听着不错。

defsEn: the direction to the right of a person facing the rising sun
zh: n. 南方, 南
a. 南的, 向南的
adv. 在南方
vi. 转向南方
examples: He took off to the south.
In the south of China, the situation is different.
exampleZh: 他飞到南方。
在中国南边的情况不一样。

defsEn: the area outside the earth’s atmosphere where the sun, moon, planets and stars are
the area between or inside things space
zh: n. 位置, 空间, 距离, 太空, 空白, 间隔, (期刊等的)篇幅
vt. 隔开, 分隔
vi. 留间隔
examples: Space travel will be commonplace some time in the future.
Space travel will one day become commonplace.
exampleZh: 太空旅行终有一天会成为平常事。
太空旅行终有一天会成为平常事。

defsEn: to talk
to say words with the mouth
to express one’s thoughts to others and exchange ideas
to give a speech to a group speak
zh: vi. 说, 说话, 演说, 发言
vt. 说, 讲, 说出
examples: Speak more slowly so that we can understand you.
When I speak Chinese, I start to feel at ease.
exampleZh: 请讲慢一点，让我们能听懂。
我说中文的时候，开始感到自在了。

defsEn: of a different or unusual kind
not for general use
better or more important than others of the same kind
zh: n. 专辑, 专车, 号外, 特别的东西, 负有特别任务的人员
a. 特别的, 专门的, 特殊的, 额外的, 附加的, 特别亲密的
examples: What special knowledge do you have?
What's so special about the first sunrise of the year?

defsEn: a talk given to a group of people
zh: n. 演讲, 说话, 谈话, 言语, 引语, 民族语言
examples: His speech won the immediate applause of the audience.
His speech was short and to the point.
exampleZh: 他的演说赢得了观众热烈的掌声。
他的演讲简短且切中要害。

defsEn: to make something go or move faster
n. the rate at which something moves or travels
the rate at which something happens or is done
zh: n. 速率, 速度, 迅速
vi. 加速, 超速, 快进
vt. 快速传送, 促进, 使加速
examples: The speed of light is much greater than that of sound.
Could you speed it up, please?
exampleZh: 光速比音速快很多。

defsEn: to give as payment
to use (“He spends much time studying.”)
zh: vt. 花费, 浪费, 度过, 消耗, 消磨
vi. 花费, 用尽
examples: I spend all my free time reading.
Spending every day like this must be boring!
exampleZh: 我把空闲时间全都花在阅读上。
每天都这样岂不是很无聊！

defsEn: to cause or permit liquid to flow out, usually by accident
zh: n. 溢出, 溅出, 摔下, 溢出量, 木片, 小塞子
vt. 使溢出, 使散落, 洒, 使流出, 倒出, 使摔下
vi. 溢出, 涌流, 摔下
examples: I spilled my coffee on the carpet.
I spilled jam on the electric outlet and there was a short circuit.
exampleZh: 我把咖啡倒翻在地毯上了。
我把果酱撒到电源插座上短路了。

defsEn: the part of a human that is not physical and is connected to thoughts and emotions
the part of a person that is believed to remain alive after death
zh: n. 精神, 心灵, 灵魂, 态度, 志气, 人格, 情绪, 心情, 烈酒
vt. 诱拐, 鼓励, 鼓舞
examples: The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.
Spirits of Heaven and Earth, heed my call; manifest swiftly by divine decree!
exampleZh: 心有余而力不足。
天灵灵，地灵灵；急急如律令！

defsEn: to separate into two or more parts
to divide or break into parts
zh: n. 劈开, 裂片, 裂缝, 分裂, 派系, 派别, 柳条
a. 劈开的
vi. 分离, 分开, 裂开, 被劈开
vt. 劈开, 切开, 使分裂, 使分离
examples: They split up after a year of marriage.
The two of us split up last year.

defsEn: any game or activity of competition involving physical effort or skill
zh: n. 运动, 游戏, 娱乐, 消遣, 玩笑
a. 运动的, 户外穿戴的
vi. 游戏, 参加体育运动, 戏弄, 产生变种
vt. 炫耀, 使产生变种
examples: Sport is good for your health.
The sports world should, at this time, eliminate the collusion with criminal organizations.
exampleZh: 运动有益健康。
在这个时候，体育世界应当减少犯罪组织的勾结。

defsEn: to become longer or wider
to make or become widely known
zh: n. 传播, 散布, 伸展
a. 双唇展开的, 伸展的
vt. 展开, 铺开, 传播, 推广, 伸出, 涂, 敷, 延伸
vi. 展开, 扩大, 传开, 延伸
examples: She spread the butter on the bread.
She spread the clean bedsheet on the bed.
exampleZh: 她把奶油涂在面包上。
她把干净的床单铺在床上。

defsEn: the time of the year between winter and summer
zh: n. 春天, 弹簧, 跳跃, 弹性, 活力, 泉, 源泉
a. 春天的
vi. 跳, 弹跳, 涌出, 生长, 裂开, 高耸
vt. 使跳起, 使爆炸, 突然提出
examples: Spring makes us full of hope about the future.
A spring rain revived the flower.
exampleZh: 春天让我们对未来充满希望。
一场春雨使花朵回复了生气。

defsEn: to steal or get information secretly
n. one who watches others secretly
a person employed by a government to get secret information about another country
zh: n. 间谍, 侦探, 侦察
vt. 侦察, 找出, 发现
vi. 做密探, 侦查
examples: The spy infiltrated the enemy base to gather intelligence on their next target.
I spy with my eye someone who must die!

defsEn: a flat shape having four equal sides
zh: n. 正方形, 街区, 广场, 平方, 直角尺
a. 正方形的, 正直的, 公正的, 平方的, 方正的, 结清的
adv. 成直角地, 对准地
vi. 一致, 符合, 结清
vt. 使成方形, 使平方自乘, 调正, 结清, 使一致
examples: I'll square things with you later.
The square was illuminated by bright lights.
exampleZh: 待会我再和你谈谈。
广场被鲜明的灯火照亮。

defsEn: to cut or push into or through with a pointed weapon
zh: n. 刺, 戳, 剧痛, 尝试, 努力
vt. 刺, 戳, 刺入, 刺痛, 直入, 使伤心
vi. 刺, 刺伤
examples: She stabbed him in the back.
How could you stab me in the back like that?
exampleZh: 她在他的背上戳了一下。

defsEn: to move into or be in a position in which only the feet are on a surface
to be in one position or place
zh: n. 站立, 站住, 停顿, 讲台, 看台, 立场, 法院证人席
vi. 站, 立, 坐落, 停滞, 位于, 坚持, 维持原状
vt. 忍受, 使站立, 抵挡
examples: Stand the ladder against the wall.
If you stand on this stool, you can reach the top of the closet.
exampleZh: 把梯子靠墙放着。
站在这个凳子上的话，你可以摸到衣柜顶。

defsEn: a mass of gas that usually appears as a small light in the sky at night, but is not a planet
a famous person, usually an actor or singer
zh: n. 星, 恒星, 星形物, 运气, 明星
vt. 以星状物装饰, 用星号标, 使成为明星
vi. 变成明星
examples: That star is visible to the naked eye.
He stared at me from head to foot.
exampleZh: 那颗星星可以用裸眼看到。
他把我从头到脚打量了一番。

defsEn: to begin
to make something begin
zh: n. 惊起, 出发, 开端, 起点, 吃惊, 有利条件
vi. 开始, 出发, 启动, 跳起, 吃惊, 出现, 松动, 脱落, 起价, 参赛
vt. 使惊起, 开动, 发动, 启动, 开始, 创办, 提议, 使松动, 使脱落, 起用
examples: Start at once, or you will miss the bus.
I start a new job tomorrow.
exampleZh: 马上出发，不然你就要错过公车了。
明天我要去做一份新工作。

defsEn: to suffer or die from a lack of food
zh: v. (使)饿死, (使)挨饿
examples: I would sooner starve than betray him.
Starve the donkey from straw so that it forgets the oats.

defsEn: to say
to declare
n. a political part of a nation
zh: n. 州, 状态, 情形, 国家, 政府, 领土, 国务, 社会地位
a. 国家的, 正式的, 礼仪用的, 州的
vt. 说明, 陈述, 规定
examples: The two states now live in peace with one another.
Lansing is the state capital of Michigan.
exampleZh: 两国目前和平共处。
兰辛是密西根州的首府。

defsEn: a place of special work or purpose (“a police station”)
a place where passengers get on or off trains or buses
a place for radio or television broadcasts
zh: n. 车站, 站, 局, 驻地, 位置, 身分, 地位
vt. 安置, 配置, 驻扎
examples: She went to the station to see her teacher off.
I went to the station to see my friend off.
exampleZh: 她去车站给她老师送行。
我去车站为我朋友送行。

defsEn: a form of a human, animal or other creature usually made of stone, wood or metal
zh: vt. 以雕像装饰
n. 雕像
examples: This statue is as large as life.
The statue was carved from a block of cherry wood.
exampleZh: 这座雕像和真人的尺寸一样。
这座雕像是由樱木雕刻而成。

defsEn: to continue to be where one is
to remain
to not leave
to live for a time (“They stayed in New York for two years.”)
zh: n. 停留, 逗留, 制止, 延缓, 停止, 支柱, 支撑物, 支索
vt. 制止, 延缓, 坚持, 支持, 支撑, 用支索固定
vi. 停留, 逗留, 暂停, 坚持, 中止
examples: Stay and have a drink with us.
Stay here and wait for her.
exampleZh: 留下来和我们一起喝酒吧。
留在这里等她。

defsEn: to take without permission or paying
zh: vt. 剽窃；偷偷地做；偷窃；vi. 窃取；偷偷地行动；偷垒；n. 偷窃；便宜货；偷垒；断球
examples: The two men were seen to steal into the house.
I caught him stealing the camera.
exampleZh: 那两个人偷偷溜进了房子里，给人看见了。
我抓到他偷相机。

defsEn: the gas that comes from hot water steam
zh: n. 蒸汽, 精力
a. 蒸汽的
vi. 蒸发, 行驶, 发怒
vt. 蒸, 煮, 散发
examples: Steam and smoke come out the chimney.
The steam train came to a sudden halt.

defsEn: iron made harder and stronger by mixing it with other substances
zh: n. 钢, 钢制品, 钢铁, 坚硬, 坚固
a. 钢的, 钢制的, 钢铁业的, 坚强的
vt. 使坚强, 钢化, 使冷酷
examples: A steel ball fell on a glass table and it shattered.
Steel is a widely-used material in civil construction.

defsEn: to move by lifting one foot and placing it in a new position
n. the act of stepping
one of a series of actions designed to reach a goal
zh: n. 步骤, 步, 步幅, 脚步声, 踏级, 步伐, 短距离, 步态, 手段, 等级
vt. 踏, 以步测量, 跨步, 使成阶梯状
vi. 跨步, 轻快地走, 跳舞, 踩, 踏上, 行走
examples: Step out of the car and place your hands behind your back.
He stepped on my foot on purpose.
exampleZh: 下车，把手放在背后。
他故意踩我的脚。

defsEn: to attach something to another thing using a substance that will hold them together
to become fixed in one position so that movement is difficult (“Something is making the door stick.”)
n. a thin piece of wood
zh: n. 棍, 棒, 刺, 枯枝, 茎, 条状物
vt. 插进, 刺入, 钉住, 伸出, 粘贴, 停止
vi. 粘住, 停留, 坚持, 陷住, 伸出
examples: Stick a notice on the board.
Stick with it and you'll succeed.
exampleZh: 把告示贴在在布告板上。
坚持下来，你就能成功。

defsEn: not moving (“The man was standing still.”)
until the present or a stated time (“Was he still there?”)
even so
although (“The job was difficult, but she still wanted to do it.”)
zh: n. 蒸馏室, 寂静, 剧照
v. 蒸馏, (使)平静, (使)静止
a. 静止的, 不动的, 静寂的, 不起泡的, 静物摄影的
adv. 仍然, 更, 静止地
conj. 然而, 但是
examples: We still have a lot of work to do.
We still have a lot more work to do.
exampleZh: 我们还有很多工作要做。
我们还有很多工作要做。

defsEn: a small piece of rock
zh: n. 石头, 宝石, 果核, 纪念碑, 结石
vt. 投扔石子, 铺石头
a. 石的, 石制的, 完全的
examples: He threw a stone at the big dog.
I threw a stone at the bird.
exampleZh: 他朝着大狗扔了块石头。
我扔了块石头打向鸟儿。

defsEn: to prevent any more movement or action
to come or bring to an end
zh: n. 停止, 车站, 逗留, 填塞, 障碍, (风琴的)音栓
vi. 停止, 被塞住
vt. 塞住, 堵塞, 阻止, 击落, 停止, 终止, 断绝
examples: Stop being so arrogant about this.
I'll stop by the post office on the way home.
exampleZh: 不要太炫耀这个了。
我会在回家的路上顺便去邮局。

defsEn: to keep or put away for future use
n. a place where people buy things
zh: n. 商店, 贮藏, 仓库, 备用品, 存储器
vt. 储存, 贮藏, 供给
vi. 贮藏
a. 贮藏的, 现成的
examples: In this store they speak in Esperanto.
I bought a VCR at that store for a low price.
exampleZh: 这个商店里的人讲世界语。
我在那商店花低价买了台录像机。

defsEn: violent weather, including strong winds and rain or snow
zh: n. 暴风雨, 骚动, 风波, 风暴, 猛攻
vi. 起风, 猛冲, 怒吼
vt. 猛攻
examples: The storm caused a lot of damage.
The storm sent the temperature down.
exampleZh: 暴风雨造成了很大的损害。
暴风雨袭来, 气温随之下降。

defsEn: the telling or writing of an event, either real or imagined
zh: n. 故事, 小说, 传奇, 描述, 阅历, 经历, 层
examples: He told me the story of his life.
I told the story that my mom used to tell me to my daughter.
exampleZh: 他给我讲述了他的一生。
我把我妈妈曾经跟我讲过的故事讲给了我的女儿。

defsEn: a heating device used for cooking
zh: n. 火炉, 窑
vt. 用火炉烤
stave的过去式和过去分词
examples: The stove is in the kitchen, to the right of the refrigerator.
The stove is in the kitchen, to the left of the refrigerator.

defsEn: continuing in one direction without turns
zh: n. 直线, 直
a. 直的, 笔直的, 正直的, 直接的, 连续的, 整齐的
adv. 直接地, 立即, 不断地
examples: He drew a straight line on the wall.
Straight golden hair slides over her shoulder.
exampleZh: 他在墙上画了一条直线。
垂直的金发滑过她的肩膀。

defsEn: unusual
not normal
not known
zh: a. 奇怪的, 陌生的, 生疏的, 不熟悉的, 不可思议的, 外行的, 外地的, 异乡的
examples: Strange, why can't I send any mail to your mail box?
Strange to say, no one voted for the candidate.
exampleZh: 你的邮箱为什么发不过去邮件呢，奇怪。
奇怪的是，谁也没有投那候选人一票。

defsEn: a road in a city, town or village
zh: n. 街道, 马路, 街区
a. 街道的
examples: The two streets run parallel to one another.
I met him on the street.
exampleZh: 两条街道互相平行。
我在街上遇到他。

defsEn: to extend for a distance
to pull on to make longer or wider
zh: n. 伸展, 张开, 连绵, 一段路, 一段时间
a. 可伸缩的, 弹性的
vt. 伸展, 张开, 曲解, 使过度伸展
vi. 伸展, 延伸
examples: He stretched out his arm to take the book.
Stretch your body to relieve muscle tension.
exampleZh: 他伸长了手臂为了能拿到书。

defsEn: to hit with force
to stop work as a way to seek better conditions, more pay or to make other demands
zh: n. 罢工, 打击, 殴打
vt. 打, 撞击, 冲击, 侵袭, 取消, 结算, 打掉, 罢工, 刺透, 使生根, 遇见
vi. 打, 打击, 抓, 罢工, 搏动, 触礁, 敲, 响, 穿透, 打动
examples: Strike while the iron is hot.
The strike affected the nation's economy.
exampleZh: 打铁趁热。
罢工妨碍了国家经济。

defsEn: having much power
not easily broken, damaged or destroyed
zh: a. 强壮的, 坚固的, 坚强的, 强烈的, 有力的, 优良的
adv. 强劲地, 有力地, 猛烈地
examples: I'm not as strong as I used to be.
She has a strong wish to work as an interpreter.
exampleZh: 我不跟以前一样壮了。
她非常想当口译。

defsEn: the way something is built, made or organized
a system that is formed or organized in a special way
a building
zh: n. 结构, 构造, 建筑物
vt. 构成, 组织
examples: The structure of the brain is complicated.
The structure of the human body can be thought of in the same way.
exampleZh: 头脑的结构很复杂。

defsEn: to try with much effort
to fight with
n. a great effort
a fight
zh: n. 斗争, 努力, 奋斗
vi. 努力, 奋斗, 挣扎
examples: I struggled to get out of the subway.
In a struggle of power, if you aren't with us, you're against us.
exampleZh: 我挣扎着挤出地铁。
在权利斗争中，非友即敌。

defsEn: to make an effort to gain knowledge by using the mind
to examine carefully
zh: n. 学习, 研究, 学科, 论文, 求学, 书房, 试作
vt. 学习, 读书, 研究, 考虑, 计划
vi. 学习, 思索
examples: I study French after dinner every day.
We study a species of poisonous frog that looks very similar to a stone.
exampleZh: 我每天吃过晚饭后都会学法语。
我们研究一种和石头长得很像的毒青蛙。

defsEn: not able to learn much
not intelligent
zh: a. 愚蠢的, 麻木的
examples: How stupid of me to do so!
It is stupid of you to believe in him.
exampleZh: 我干了件什么傻事啊！
你相信他真是太愚蠢了。

defsEn: the person or thing being discussed, studied or written about
zh: n. 科目, 主题, 臣民, 主语, 题目, (事物的)经受者, 学科, 受治疗者, 原因, 理由
a. 服从的, 易患...的, 隶属的, 受支配的
adv. 在...条件下
vt. 使隶属, 使受到
examples: What subject do you like best?
The subject is out of his sphere.
exampleZh: 你最喜欢哪一个科目?
这个主题超出了他所能接受的范围。

defsEn: an underwater ship submarine
zh: n. 潜水艇, 海底生物
a. 海中的, 生长在海中的
vt. 用潜水艇攻击
vi. 在下疾行, 在下滑动
examples: A submarine can travel over and under the water.
This submarine can dive more than a mile deep.

defsEn: the material of which something is made (a solid, liquid or gas)
zh: n. 物质, 实质, 主旨, 资产, 本质, 牢固
examples: The substance is light enough to float on the water.
There is no substance in his speech.
exampleZh: 这种物质很轻，可以浮在水面上。
他言之无物。

defsEn: to put or use in place of another
n. a person or thing put or used in place of another
zh: n. 代理, 代理人, 代用品, 代替者, 代替物
vt. 代替
vi. 替代, 取代, 代用
a. 代替的, 代用的, 代用品的
examples: The substitute teacher was nice but not too bright.
This substitute can help wean you off heroin.

defsEn: an attempt to weaken or destroy a political system or government, usually secretly
zh: n. 颠覆, 打倒, 破坏
examples: May we never confuse honest dissent with disloyal subversion.

defsEn: to reach a goal or thing desired
to produce a planned result
zh: vi. 成功, 继承, 继续
vt. 继承, 接替
examples: She succeeded in drawing the truth from him.
Did he succeed in the examination?
exampleZh: 她成功地从他口中得知了真相。
他考试通过了吗？

defsEn: of this or that kind
of the same kind as
similar to
zh: a. 如此的, 这样的
examples: Such a teacher may as well retire from his work.
Such being the case, I can not go with you.
exampleZh: 像那样的老师还是别干了比较好。
这样的话我不能和你一起去。

defsEn: not expected
without warning
done or carried out quickly or without preparation
zh: n. 突然, 忽然
a. 突然的, 意外的, 快速的
examples: There was a sudden drop in the temperature last night.
There was a sudden change in her tone.
exampleZh: 昨天晚上气温突然下降
她声调突然变了。

defsEn: to feel pain in the body or mind
to receive or experience hurt or sadness
zh: vt. 遭受, 经历, 忍受
vi. 受痛苦, 受损害
examples: He suffered from a bad accident.
He's suffering from acute pain in his life.
exampleZh: 他遭遇了一场严重的意外。
他一生为急性疼痛所苦。

defsEn: a sweet substance made from liquids taken from plants
zh: n. 糖, 糖块, 甜言蜜语
vt. 加糖于, 使甜蜜, 粉饰, 美化
vi. 制成糖
examples: There is no sugar left in the pot.
There is sugar in that box.
exampleZh: 罐头里没有砂糖了。
那个盒子里有糖。

defsEn: to offer or propose something to think about or consider
zh: vt. 提议, 建议, 促成, 暗示, 启发, 使人想起
examples: I suggest you turn around and go back home.
I suggest that you should write him a thank-you letter.
exampleZh: 我建议你转身回家。
我觉得你应该给他写一封感谢信。

defsEn: the act of killing oneself
zh: n. 自杀, 自杀者
v. 自杀
a. 自杀的
examples: We are a suicide prevention organization.
The trans suicide rate decreases substantially with family and community support.

defsEn: the warmest time of the year, between spring and autumn
zh: n. 夏季, 全盛时期
vi. 避暑, 过夏天
examples: In summer, I take a shower every morning.
In the summer I go to the pool every day.
exampleZh: 在夏季，我每天早上都会洗个澡。
夏天的时候，我每天都去游泳池。

defsEn: the huge star in the sky that provides heat and light to earth
zh: n. 太阳, 日, 日光, 阳光
vt. 晒
vi. 晒太阳
examples: The sun rose from the sea.
The sun rose over the horizon.
exampleZh: 太阳从海上升起了。
太阳升出了地平线。

defsEn: to direct and observe the work of others
zh: v. 监督, 管理, 指导
examples: He supervised a group of students during lunch.
I supervised the people fixing my bathroom.

defsEn: to give
to provide
n. the amount of something that can be given or sold to others
zh: n. 补给, 供给, 供应品
vt. 补给, 供给, 提供, 补充
vi. 替代
examples: They supplied the soldiers with enough food and water.
Brazil supplies the world with coffee beans of quality.
exampleZh: 他们给士兵提供了充足的食物和水。
巴西向世界各地供应优质咖啡豆。

defsEn: to carry the weight of
to hold up or in position
to agree with others and help them reach a goal
to approve
zh: n. 支持, 支撑, 援助, 供养, 支撑物
vt. 支援, 支撑, 帮助, 支持, 忍受, 供养, 证实
examples: He has to support his mother and his sister.
I support the spelling reform of the German language.
exampleZh: 他要供养他的妈妈和妹妹。

defsEn: to believe, think or imagine (“I suppose you are right.”)
to expect (“It is supposed to rain tonight.”)
zh: vt. 推想, 假设, 以为, 想像, 假定
vi. 料想
examples: I suppose he will be back soon.
I suppose it's different when you think about it over the long term.
exampleZh: 我想他会很快回来的。
我认为你考虑久了就会不一样了。

defsEn: to put down or to keep down by force
to prevent information from being known publicly
zh: vt. 镇压, 使止住, 禁止, 抑制, 查禁
examples: When we suppress our anger, we disavow a part of our humanity.
I had to suppress my appetite.

defsEn: very probable
with good reason to believe
true without question
zh: a. 确信, 必然的, 必定的
adv. 当然, 确实地, 无疑地
examples: I sure could go for a cup of coffee.
Be sure to put out the fire before you leave.
exampleZh: 我想要杯咖啡。
一定要熄了火，然后再离开。

defsEn: the outer side or top of something (“The rocket landed on the surface of the moon.”)
zh: n. 面, 表面, 水面, 外表, 平面
a. 表面的, 外观的, 肤浅的, 水面上的
vt. 使成平面, 使浮出水面
vi. 浮出水面, 呈现, 在地面上工作
examples: The surface of the object is fairly rough.
The surface of the earth rose due to the earthquake.
exampleZh: 这件物件的表面颇为粗糙。

defsEn: an amount that is more than is needed
extra
(“That country has a trade surplus. It exports more than it imports.”)
zh: n. 剩余, 过剩, 盈余
a. 过剩的, 剩余的
examples: Our surplus has swelled by nearly ten percent in this quarter.
If there's a surplus, we'll give it to those in need.
exampleZh: 我们公司今季的赤字上涨了差不多一成。

defsEn: to cause a feeling of wonder because something is not expected
n. something not expected
the feeling caused by something not expected
zh: n. 惊奇, 奇袭, 诧异
vt. 使惊奇, 撞见, 奇袭
examples: To my surprise, there were no people in the village.
To my surprise, he easily came up with a plan.
exampleZh: 奇怪的是，村子里竟然一个人也没有。
令我吃惊的是，他很容易就想出了一个方案。

defsEn: to form a circle around
to be in positions all around someone or something
zh: vt. 包围, 环绕, 围绕
n. 围绕物
examples: The surrounding area was very quiet.
He was surrounded by a throng of reporters.
exampleZh: 周围的地区非常安静。
他被一大群记者包围着。

defsEn: to remain alive during or after a dangerous situation
zh: vt. 比...活得长, 生存, 生还, 幸免于
vi. 活下来, 幸存
examples: He survived an accident last year, but still drives recklessly.
She survived her husband by ten years.
exampleZh: 他去年在事故中幸存了，可是他仍然很鲁莽地开车。
她比丈夫多活十年。

defsEn: to imagine or believe that a person is guilty of something bad or illegal
n. a person believed to be guilty
zh: n. 被怀疑者, 嫌疑犯
a. 令人怀疑的, 不可信的, 可疑的
v. 怀疑, 猜想
examples: The suspect told a lie to the inspector.
I suspect that they water down the beer in that pub.
exampleZh: 那嫌疑犯对侦察官撒了个谎。
我怀疑那家酒馆的啤酒兑水了。

defsEn: to cause to stop for a period of time
zh: vt. 悬, 吊, 使悬浮, 暂停, 中止, 推迟
vi. 暂停, 中止, 悬浮, 停止偿付债务
examples: He was suspended from school for a week for bad conduct.
Suspending the trial is out of the question.

defsEn: to take into the stomach through the mouth
zh: n. 燕子, 吞咽, 喉
vt. 咽, 淹没, 吞没, 耗尽, 轻信, 忍受, 抑制
vi. 吞下, 咽下
examples: We could not swallow his story.
We swallow air while we eat.

defsEn: tasting pleasant, like sugar
zh: n. 甜蜜, 糖果, 情人
a. 甜的, 芳香的, 悦耳的, 漂亮的, 和蔼的, 不咸的, 灵活的, 轻快的
examples: The figs of Atush are sweet and juicy.
My sweet darling, I miss you so much.
exampleZh: 阿图什的无花果是甜蜜多汁的。

defsEn: to move through water by making motions with the arms and legs
zh: n. 游泳, 漂浮, 潮流, 眩晕
vi. 游泳, 游, 漂浮, 浸, 覆盖, 充溢, 大量拥有, 旋转, 眩晕
vt. 游过, 使浮起
examples: You swim better than I do.
I would swim through the ocean just to see your smile again.
exampleZh: 你游泳游得比我好。
我愿穿洋过海只为再看到你的笑容。

defsEn: a sharing of feelings or emotions with another person, usually feelings of sadness
zh: n. 同情, 赞同, 怜悯, 慰问, 吊唁
examples: Sympathy is a feeling characteristic of mankind.
He is in sympathy with my opinion.

defsEn: a method of organizing or doing something by following rules or a plan
a group of connected things or parts working together for a common purpose or goal
zh: n. 系统, 体系, 制度, 方式, 秩序, 分类原则
examples: The clan system is a key component of traditional Chinese culture.
This system is bristling with defects and drawbacks.
exampleZh: 宗族制度是中国传统文化的重要组成部分。
这个系统存在着许多缺陷和不尽完善的地方。

defsEn: to put a hand or hands around something and hold it, often to move it to another place
to carry something
to seize
to capture
to begin to be in control (“The president takes office tomorrow.”)
zh: vt. 拿, 取, 抓, 带领, 获得, 就座, 接受, 吃, 吸引, 采取, 乘, 需要, 花费
vi. 吃掉对方棋子, 抓住, 起作用, 依法获得财产
n. 拿, 取, 收成, 奏效
examples: I take a bath every morning in the summer.
Take off your hat when you enter a classroom.
exampleZh: 在夏季，我每天早上都会洗个澡。
进教室时请脱下帽子。

defsEn: to express thoughts in spoken words
n. a meeting for discussion
zh: n. 谈话, 交谈, 会谈, 讲话, 演讲, 空谈, 谣言, 方言, 语言
vi. 讲话, 演讲, 说话, 谈话, 交流, 闲聊, 说闲话
vt. 讲, 说, 讨论, 谈论
examples: I talk to them more than you do.
I told you not to talk about the matter in her presence.
exampleZh: 我比你和他们聊得更多。
我跟你说过她在的时候不要说这件事。

defsEn: higher than others
opposite short
zh: a. 高的, 长的, 夸大的
adv. 夸大地
examples: The tall man left in a hurry.
She was a tall, thin girl with long, soft brown hair.
exampleZh: 高的男人匆匆地走了。
她是个又高又瘦, 留着一头又长又软的褐色头发的女孩。

defsEn: a large container for holding liquids
a heavy military vehicle with guns
zh: n. 槽, 箱, 柜, 罐, 池塘, 储水池, 坦克
vt. 储于箱中
examples: This tank can shoot on the move.
The tank's almost empty. You should go to the petrol station.

defsEn: any person or object aimed at or fired at
zh: n. 目标, 靶子, 指标
vt. 对准, 订指标
examples: Who is the target audience for this book?
The target is large and very worth it.

defsEn: to sense through the mouth (“The fruit tastes sweet.”)
zh: n. 味道, 品味, 味觉, 感受, 体验, 爱好, 审美, 少量
vt. 尝, 察觉...的味道, 体会
vi. 品尝, 察觉味道, 有某种味道
examples: The taste of wine is largely dependent upon the weather.
When you're hungry, anything tastes good.
exampleZh: 葡萄酒的味道很受天气影响。
当你饿的时候，任何东西都好吃。

defsEn: the money a person or business must pay to the government so the government can provide services
zh: n. 税, 税款, 重负, 会费
vt. 课以税, 使负重荷, 斥责
examples: Tax cuts are often used as a major fiscal tool to stimulate the economy.
Beer is taxed according to its malt content, so low-malt beer is cheaper.
exampleZh: 减税常被用作刺激经济的主要财政手段。
因为啤酒会根据麦芽含量去征税，所以发泡酒会比较便宜。

defsEn: a drink made from the plant of the same name
zh: n. 茶, 茶叶
examples: Tea or coffee - which would you like?
What tea do you drink? Is lemon tea okay?
exampleZh: 你想喝咖啡还是喝茶？
你要喝什么茶？泡壶柠檬红茶好吧？

defsEn: to show how to do something
to provide knowledge
to cause to understand
zh: vt. 教, 讲授, 教导, 教育
vi. 教书, 教学, 可以教
examples: Could you teach me how to play the piano?
Teach me how to fold a paper crane. I forgot how to fold it.
exampleZh: 您能教我弹钢琴吗？
教我怎么折纸鹤吧。我忘记怎么折了。

defsEn: a group organized for some purpose, often for sports
zh: n. 队, 组
vt. 把马(牛)套在同一辆车上, 把...编成一组
vi. 驾驶卡车, 协作
examples: Which team do you think will win?
Which team are you a fan of?
exampleZh: 你觉得哪支球队会赢？
你是哪一队的迷?

defsEn: to pull apart, often by force
zh: n. 泪滴, 眼泪, 撕, 扯, 裂缝, 激怒, 飞奔
vi. 流泪, 撕破, 赶快, 飞奔, 被撕破
vt. 撕裂, 戳破, 拉掉, 撕掉, 使分裂, 使精神不安, 折磨
examples: To those who would tear the world down: we will defeat you.
Her tears have already told me what has happened.
exampleZh: 那些想要颠覆这个世界的人们，我们将击败你们。
她的眼泪已经告诉了发生了什么。

defsEn: involving machines, processes and materials in industry, transportation and communications
of or about a very special kind of subject or thing (“You need technical knowledge to understand how this system works.”)
zh: a. 技术上的, 专门的, 工业的, 严格根据法律的
examples: What is the technical name of that paper with a rough texture?
What's the technical term for that?

defsEn: the use of scientific knowledge and methods to produce goods and services
zh: n. 技术, 工业技术, 术语
examples: Technology will make a lot of progress in the nineties.
Technology can both spread and fight fake news.
exampleZh: 科技在 1990 年代会有很大进步吧。

defsEn: a device or system for sending sounds, especially the voice, over distances
zh: n. 电话, 电话机
v. 打电话
examples: I had a telephone call from her.
There's a telephone in the hall.
exampleZh: 她打了一通电话给我。
走廊里有一部电话。

defsEn: a device for making objects that are far away appear closer and larger telescope
zh: n. 望远镜
vi. 叠缩, 嵌进, 缩短
vt. 使叠缩, 使缩短
examples: My telescope can see Jupiter and its six moons.
This telescope must be used with care.
exampleZh: 我的望远镜可以看到木星和它的六个卫星。

defsEn: a device that receives electronic signals and makes them into pictures and sounds
the system of sending pictures and sounds by electronic signals over a distance so others can see and hear them on a receiver
zh: n. 电视
examples: Is there a television set in your bedroom?
There is a television in the room.
exampleZh: 你卧室里有电视吗？
房里有个电视机。

defsEn: to give information
to make known by speaking
to order
to command
zh: vt. 告诉, 说, 吩咐, 断定, 知道
vi. 讲述, 泄密, 告发, 表明
examples: Could you tell me what I should do next?
Could you tell me the way to the station?
exampleZh: 你可以告诉我我下一步该做什么吗？
能否告诉我去车站的路怎么走？

defsEn: the measurement of heat and cold
zh: n. 温度, 发烧, 热度
examples: The temperature in different places can vary greatly at the same time of year.
The temperature at the North Pole is different from at the South Pole.
exampleZh: 不同的地方可以在同一时节有十分不同的温度。
北极与南极的温度不一样。

defsEn: lasting only a short time
zh: a. 暂时的, 临时的
n. 临时工, 临时雇员
examples: How temporary will this situation be?
A temporary stage was set up in the park.

defsEn: having fear or concern
dangerous
opposite calm
zh: a. 紧张的, 拉紧的
v. (使)紧张, (使)拉紧
n. 时态
examples: He was tense with his new business.
There's a tense wait for the outcome of the vote.
exampleZh: 他对他的新业务感到紧张。

defsEn: a limited period of time during which someone does a job or carries out a responsibility (“He served two terms in Congress.”)
the conditions of an agreement that have been accepted by those involved in it
zh: n. 术语, 专有名词, 期限, 学期, 任期, 条件, 价钱, 关系, 地位, 项, 界石
vt. 称, 呼
examples: In terms of appearance, she's not any worse than her sister.
In terms of intellectual hobbies, I really like learning Chinese characters.
exampleZh: 要说容貌，她不比她姐姐难看。
对知识的爱好而言，我真的喜欢学汉字。

defsEn: very bad
causing terror or fear
zh: a. 可怕的, 令人恐惧的, 极坏的
examples: This would be a terrible tragedy.
The terrible scene made him tremble in fear.
exampleZh: 这将是一个可怕的悲剧。
令人震惊的场面让他吓得发抖。

defsEn: a large area of land
zh: n. 领土, 领地, 版图, 地区, 活动范围
examples: China's territory is vast, thus the types of tea vary.
You broke into my territory. Now I must shoot you.
exampleZh: 中国幅员辽阔,因而茶的品种繁多。

defsEn: extreme fear
that which causes great fear
zh: n. 恐怖, 可怕的人
examples: The terror after the revolution scared him away.
Terror seized me by the throat.

defsEn: a person who carries out acts of extreme violence as a protest or a way to influence a government
zh: n. 恐怖分子
examples: That terrorist was to blame for the disaster.
The terrorist group was responsible for the bomb explosion outside the embassy.

defsEn: to attempt to learn or prove what something is like or how it will act by studying or doing (“The scientists will test the new engine soon.”)
n. an attempt to learn or prove what something is like or how it will act by studying or doing (“The test of the new engine takes place today.”)
a group of questions or problems used to find out a person’s knowledge (“The students did well on the language test.”)
zh: n. 测试, 试验, 化验, 检验, 考验, 甲壳
vt. 测试, 试验, 化验
vi. 接受测验, 进行测试
examples: He has a test next week.
The test result showed how much he had studied.
exampleZh: 他下礼拜要考试。
测验结果显示他有多发愤上学。

defsEn: connecting word used to link things that may be similar, but are not equal (“My sister is taller than I am.”)
zh: conj. 比, 除...外
prep. 比

defsEn: to say that one has a good feeling toward another because that person did something kind (“I want to thank you for helping me.”)
zh: n. 谢意, 感谢
vt. 谢谢, 感谢
examples: I thank you from the bottom of my heart.
Thank you for drawing a bird for me.
exampleZh: 我打心底里感激你。
谢谢你为我画鸟。

defsEn: showing the person, place or thing being spoken about (“That man is a soldier.”)
pro. the person, place or thing being spoken about (“The building that I saw was very large.”)
