zh: a. 那, 那个
conj. 以致, 因为
pron. 那
adv. 那么, 那样

defsEn: used in front of a name word to show that it is a person or thing that is known about or is being spoken about
zh: art. 那

defsEn: a place where movies are shown or plays are performed
zh: n. 戏院, 电影院, 剧场, 全体观众, 戏剧, 戏剧效果, 阶梯式讲堂, 场所
examples: The theater used to open on Sundays.
This theater seats several hundred people.
exampleZh: 这家剧院以前星期天也营业。
这家剧院可以坐下几百人。

defsEn: other people being spoken about
zh: pron. 他们, 她们, 它们

defsEn: at that time
existing
and so
zh: adv. 然后, 当时
conj. 然后, 当时
n. 那时

defsEn: a possible explanation of why something exists or how something happens using experiments or ideas, but which is not yet proven (“Other scientists are debating his theory about the disappearance of dinosaurs.”)
zh: n. 理论, 学说, 原理, 意见, 推测
examples: Theory and practice should go hand in hand.
This theory is too difficult for me to comprehend.
exampleZh: 理论得联系实际。
这个理论对我来说太难了，理解不了。

defsEn: in that place or position
to or toward that place
zh: adv. 在那里

defsEn: of or about the people, places or things nearby that have been spoken about already
zh: pron. 这些
examples: Out of these cakes, I like this one the best.
These green leaves turn red or yellow in autumn.
exampleZh: 这些蛋糕中我最喜欢这个。
这些绿叶到秋天变成红色或黄色。

defsEn: those ones being spoken about
zh: pron. 他们, 它们

defsEn: having a large distance between two opposite surfaces (“The wall is two meters thick.”)
having many parts close together (“The forest is very thick.”)
almost solid, such as a liquid that does not flow easily
opposite thin
zh: a. 厚的, 粗壮的, 浓的, 迟钝的, 浑浊的, 多雾的, 过分的, 口齿不清的
adv. 厚地, 密地, 浓浓地
n. 最浓处, 最厚处, 最密集处
examples: The thick fog made it hard to see the road.
A thick blanket of snow covered the city at dawn.
exampleZh: 浓雾使道路很难看清。

defsEn: having a small distance between two opposite surfaces
not fat
not wide
opposite thick
zh: a. 薄的, 细的, 瘦的, 稀疏的, 稀薄的, 淡的, 弱的, 空洞的
vt. 使变薄, 使变细, 使稀少, 使淡
vi. 变薄, 变细, 变少, 变淡
adv. 薄地, 稀疏地, 微弱地
n. 细小部分
examples: The thin man killed the fat man.
Tom is quite thin, isn't he?
exampleZh: 瘦的男人杀死了胖的男人。
汤姆真瘦，不是么？

defsEn: any object
zh: n. 事物, 东西, 物, 用品, 事, 事件, 情况, 行为, 特征
examples: Things change from time to time, and one should change with them.
A thing of beauty is a joy forever.
exampleZh: 世事变幻无常，人不能因循守旧、一成不变。
凡美的事物就是永恒的喜悦。

defsEn: to produce thoughts
to form ideas in the mind
to consider
to believe
zh: vt. 想, 考虑, 想起, 想像, 打算, 认为
vi. 思考, 料想
n. 想法
a. 思想的
examples: I think that you ought to apologize to her.
I think you need to think about the future.
exampleZh: 我认为你应该跟她道歉。
我觉得你应该考虑到未来。

defsEn: coming after two others
zh: num. 第三, 三分之一
examples: It's at the third home in the second row of houses.
A third of the earth's surface is desert.
exampleZh: 在第二排房子的第三家。
地球表面的三分之一是沙漠。

defsEn: of or about the person, place or thing nearby that has been spoken about already
zh: pron. 这, 本
a. 这, 本
adv. 这么

defsEn: to warn that one will do harm or cause damage
zh: vt. 恐吓, 威胁, 预示...的凶兆
vi. 威胁, 恫吓, 可能来临
examples: He threatened to make it public.
Don't threaten me with a good time.
exampleZh: 他威胁要公开。
用这种好事来威胁我？我巴不得呢。

defsEn: in at one end and out at the other
from front to back
from top to bottom
with the help of
by
zh: adv. 穿越, 从头至尾, 到底, 因为
prep. 经过, 穿过
a. 对穿的, 直达的, 完结的
examples: Through genetic modification, we can improve crops.
Through the Internet, we can make many friends.
exampleZh: 通过遗传修饰，我们可以改良农作物。
通过网络，我们可以结交很多朋友。

defsEn: to cause to go through the air by a movement of the arm
zh: vt. 投, 掷, 抛, 发射, 摔下, 匆匆穿上(或脱下), 抛弃, 摆脱
vi. 丢, 掷, 抛
n. 投掷, 掷骰子, 冒险
examples: Throw the ball back to me.
Throw a sprat to catch a whale.
exampleZh: 把球丢还给我。
丢鲱鱼抓鲸鱼。

defsEn: to join or hold together with some material
n. anything that joins or unites
links or connections (“The two nations have strong trade ties.”)
zh: n. 带子, 线, 鞋带, 领带, 领结, 关系, 束缚, 平局, 不分胜负
vt. 系, 打结, 扎, 约束, 与...成平局
vi. 结合, 打结, 不分胜负
examples: This tie and that jacket go well together.
They tied the thief to the tree.
exampleZh: 这条领带和那件上衣很配。
他们把小偷绑到了树上。

defsEn: that which is measured in minutes, hours, days and years
a period that can be identified in hours and minutes and is shown on a clock
a period when an event should or will take place
zh: n. 时间, 时侯, 时机, 时期, 期限, 次数, 节拍, 暂停, 规定时间
vt. 测定...的时间, 记录...的时间, 计时, 定时
a. 时间的, 记时的, 定时的, 定期的, 分期的
examples: The time will come when you will regret it.
What time do you have lunch at home?
exampleZh: 你终有一天会后悔的。
你在家什么时候吃饭？

defsEn: having less strength because of work or exercise
needing sleep or rest
zh: a. 疲累的, 疲乏的, 厌倦的
examples: The long walk through the city tired me out.
You must be tired after such a long trip.
exampleZh: 在这么长程的旅途后你一定很累了。

defsEn: living material
a group of cells that are similar in appearance and do the same thing
zh: n. 薄的织物, 薄纱, 棉纸, 组织, 一套
examples: If there are no tissues, use the inside of your elbow.
The tissue paper sucked away the spilled juice.

defsEn: showing the direction of an action
showing the person or place toward which an action is directed
showing a goal or purpose
zh: prep. 到, 向, 趋于
adv. 向前

defsEn: this day
zh: n. 今天, 当今, 现在
adv. 今天, 当今
examples: Today no one can imagine a life without television.
Today we have a lot of food.
exampleZh: 今天没有人能想像一个没有电视的生活。
我们今天吃了很多饭。

defsEn: in one group
at the same time or place
in cooperation
zh: adv. 一起, 共同, 彼此
examples: Together, you represent the harmony between tradition and progress.
We got together in the park.
exampleZh: 你们共同代表着传统与进步之间的和谐。
我们在公园里聚在一起。

defsEn: the day after today
zh: n. 明天, 未来
adv. 明天, 未来地
examples: Tomorrow, tomorrow, just not today - say all lazy people.
Tomorrow, he will land on the moon.
exampleZh: 明天，明天，只是不是今天-所有的懒惰的人都这么说。
明天，他将登上月球。

defsEn: this night
zh: n. 今晚, 今夜
adv. 今晚, 今夜
examples: Tonight we are planning to go to the concert.
Tonight in the night sky, the stars are shining very brightly.
exampleZh: 今晚我们打算去听音乐会。
今晚的夜空星光非常明亮。

defsEn: also
as well as
more than is necessary
zh: adv. 也, 非常, 太
examples: I too would like to go see it.
I, too, like literature very much.
exampleZh: 我也好想去看喔。
我也很喜欢文学。

defsEn: any instrument or device designed to help one do work tool
zh: n. 工具, 机床, 傀儡
vt. 用工具加工
vi. 使用工具
examples: This tool will come in handy during the trip.
This tool belongs to the man. Please, take it to him.

defsEn: the upper edge or surface
the highest part
the cover of something
zh: n. 顶部, 顶端, 极点, 上面, 上部, 顶篷, 最高地位, 首位, 陀螺
a. 最高的, 顶上的, 头等的
vt. 盖, 加以顶, 高达, 超越
vi. 结束, 达到顶点, 高出
examples: The top of the mountain is covered in snow.
The apple is on top of the book.
exampleZh: 山顶被雪覆盖了。
苹果在书上。

defsEn: to cause severe pain
n. the act of causing severe pain in order to harm, to punish or to get information from
zh: n. 拷问, 苦闷
vt. 拷问, 曲解, 折磨, 使弯曲
examples: It was torture for him to see his girlfriend with another man.
It was torture for me to play the piano.

defsEn: the complete amount
zh: a. 全体的, 总的, 全然的
vt. 计算...的总和, 共计为
vi. 合计
n. 总数, 全体, 合计
adv. 统统
examples: What is the total amount of money you spent?
The total expense for the project amounts to one hundred million yen.
exampleZh: 你一共花了多少钱？
计划的总开支为一亿円。

defsEn: to put the hand or fingers on
zh: n. 触觉, 碰, 触, 机灵, 轻触, 格调, 少许, 缺点, 弹力
vt. 接触, 触摸, 触及, 使接触, 达到, 涉及, 影响到, 使轻度受害, 感动
vi. 触摸, 接近, 涉及, 提到
examples: I am in touch with him.
I've got a touch of the flu.
exampleZh: 我与他联系。
我有点流感。

defsEn: in the direction of
leading to
zh: prep. 向, 对于, 为了
a. 即将来临的, 进行中的
examples: Towards the end of the lesson the teacher said, "Enough for today."
I swam towards the other end of the pool.

defsEn: a center where people live, larger than a village but not as large as a city
zh: n. 城镇, 市, 镇
examples: The town developed into the center of the economy.
This is the town I told you about.
exampleZh: 这座城镇发展成为了一个经济中心。
这就是我跟你说的那个镇。

defsEn: to buy and sell or exchange products or services
n. the activity of buying, selling or exchanging products or services
zh: n. 贸易, 商业, 交易, 生意, 职业, 顾客, 信风
vi. 进行交易, 做买卖, 经商, 对换, 购物
vt. 用...进行交换
examples: I traded in my old car for a new one.
Scott traded a watch for a book, and then traded the book for money.
exampleZh: 我用我的旧车换了一辆新的。
斯科特先用一块手表换了一本书，再把书换成了钱。

defsEn: a ceremony, activity or belief that has existed for a long time
zh: n. 传说, 传统, 交付
examples: That tradition has fallen into desuetude.
This tradition recently became part of our life.
exampleZh: 那习俗已经不再盛行了。

defsEn: the movement of people, vehicles or ships along a street, road or waterway
zh: n. 交通, 通行, 运输, 交通量, 贸易, 交易, 交往, 通信量
vi. 交易, 做买卖
vt. 用...作交换
examples: The traffic accident deprived him of his sight.
How did the traffic accident happen?
exampleZh: 这场交通意外让他失明了。
车祸是怎么发生的？

defsEn: extremely sad
terrible
zh: a. 悲惨的, 悲剧的
examples: She broke the tragic news to her mother.
The tragic news drove his mother mad.

defsEn: to teach or learn how to do something
to prepare for an activity
n. an engine and the cars connected to it that move along a railroad
zh: n. 火车, 列车, 行列, 长队, 一连串的后果, 顺序
vt. 训练, 教育, 对准
vi. 受训练, 锻炼
examples: The train will arrive on time without fail.
The train will probably arrive at the station before noon.
exampleZh: 我保证火车会准时来。
火车大概会在中午前到站。

defsEn: to move goods or people from one place to another
zh: n. 运输, 运输工具, 激动, 狂喜, 流放犯
vt. 传送, 运输, 流放
examples: I transported a bunch of wood on my back.
We transported the computer to the office.

defsEn: the act or business of moving goods or people
zh: n. 运输, 输送, 交通车辆
examples: The transportation in this city is very convenient.
Transportation of goods used to be a nightmare in Algeria.
exampleZh: 这个城市的交通方便得很。

defsEn: to catch or be caught by being tricked
to be unable to move or escape
n. a device used to catch animals
zh: n. 圈套, 陷阱, 诡计, 存水弯
vi. 设圈套, 设陷阱
vt. 诱捕, 诱骗, 抓住, 使受限制
examples: Using a trap, they caught the fox.
He was trapped inside the classroom.
exampleZh: 他们利用陷阱捕捉狐狸。
他被困在教室里了。

defsEn: to go from one place to another, usually for a long distance
zh: n. 旅行, 游历, 行进
vi. 旅行, 行进, 移动, 被传播
vt. 旅行, 通过, 使移动
examples: I travel on the subway every day.
A travel agent will arrange an excursion to Andalusia for you.
exampleZh: 我天天坐地铁出行。
旅行社会为你安排去安达卢西亚的旅行。

defsEn: the act of fighting against one’s own country or of helping its enemies
zh: n. 叛逆, 不忠, 叛国罪
examples: If this be treason, make the most of it.

defsEn: a large collection of money, jewels or other things of great value
zh: n. 宝物, 财富
vt. 珍爱, 重视, 秘藏
examples: There is no treasure more precious than a child.
It is said that treasure is buried in this area.
exampleZh: 孩子是宝中之宝。
据说这个区域埋着财宝。

defsEn: to deal with
to act toward in a special way
to try to cure
zh: n. 宴请, 款待
vt. 视为, 对待, 论述, 治疗, 款待
vi. 讨论, 谈判, 作东
examples: I treat you to a cup of coffee.
They treat me like a child.
exampleZh: 我请你喝杯咖啡。
他们把我当小孩。

defsEn: the act of treating
the use of medicine to try to cure or make better
zh: n. 治疗, 待遇, 处理
examples: A treatment will cure the disease.
What treatment was I likely to get from you in case of detection?

defsEn: a written agreement between two or more nations
zh: n. 条约, 谈判
examples: The treaty was not a success.
The treaty will come into force at midnight.
exampleZh: 谈判没有成功。

defsEn: a very tall plant that is mostly wood, except for its leaves
zh: n. 树, 木料, 树状物
vt. 把...赶上树
examples: The tree fell to the ground.
The tree cast a long shadow.
exampleZh: 树倒在了地上。
树投下长长的影子。

defsEn: an examination in a court of a question or dispute to decide if a charge is true
zh: n. 审判, 试验, 艰苦, 麻烦事, 考验
a. 审讯的, 试验性的
examples: A trial date has yet to be set.
The trial is not open to the public.

defsEn: a group of families ruled by a common chief or leader
zh: n. 宗族, 部落, 一群人
examples: The Zulu tribe in South Africa has its own language.
The Sioux tribe asked the government to enforce the treaty.
exampleZh: 南非的祖鲁族人有着自己独特的语言。

defsEn: to cheat
to fool a person so as to get something or make him or her do something
zh: n. 诡计, 欺诈, 谋略, 恶作剧, 习惯, 决窍
vt. 愚弄, 欺骗, 装饰
vi. 哄骗, 戏弄
a. 有决窍的, 特技的, 欺诈的, 漂亮的, 靠不住的
examples: Tom tricked Mary into doing his work for him.
George was tricked into buying the land.
exampleZh: 汤姆哄玛丽做他的作业。
乔治被骗买了这块土地。

defsEn: a movement from one place to another, usually a long distance
zh: n. 旅行, 绊倒, 摔倒, 失足, 差错, 旅程
vt. 使跌倒, 使犯错, 使失败
vi. 轻快地走, 绊倒, 失误, 犯错, 结巴, 旅行, 远足
examples: The trip will take at least a week.
A trip to America was equivalent to a two-year salary for her.
exampleZh: 这次旅行至少得花一星期时间。
去美国旅行一次相当于她两年的工资。

defsEn: a number of soldiers in a large controlled group
zh: n. 军队, 装甲部队, 骑兵队, 部队
examples: The troops soon put down the rebellion.
The troops easily put down the rebellion.

defsEn: that which causes concern, fear, difficulty or problems
zh: n. 烦恼, 麻烦, 困难, 动乱, 故障
vt. 困扰, 麻烦, 使烦恼, 折磨
vi. 烦恼, 费心
examples: You said you were in trouble. How can I help?
The trouble is that we do not have enough money.
exampleZh: 你说你有困难。我能帮忙吗？
问题是我们钱不够。

defsEn: a temporary halt in fighting agreed to by all sides involved
zh: n. 停战, 休战
vi. 停战, 休止
vt. 以休战结束
examples: A truce if we stay; if we leave or advance, war.
The truce did not last long.

defsEn: a heavy vehicle used to carry goods truck
zh: n. 卡车, 货车, 对...进行交易, 来往, 实物工资, (供应市场的)蔬菜, 废物, 废话
vt. 对...进行交易, 交往, 以卡车运输
vi. 驾驶卡车, 以物易物
examples: A truck was standing in the middle of the road.
A truck ran over our dog.
exampleZh: 路中间有一辆卡车。
一辆卡车辗过一只狗。

defsEn: correct
not false
zh: a. 真实的, 正确的, 忠诚的, 可靠的, 纯粹的, 正式的
n. 真实, 准确
adv. 真实地, 准确地
examples: A true friend would not say such a thing.
A true scientist would not approach the question this way.
exampleZh: 如果真的是朋友的话，是不会说这样的话的吧。
真正的科学家不会这样去思考。

defsEn: to believe that someone is honest and will not cause harm
zh: n. 信任, 信赖, 相信, 受托, 职责, 信心, 托拉斯
a. 信托的, 托拉斯的
vt. 信赖, 信任, 相信, 盼望, 赊卖给
vi. 相信, 信赖, 依靠
examples: I trust that I can see you again.
Trust him. He's an expert on the subject.
exampleZh: 我相信我能再见到你。
相信他。他是这方面的专家

defsEn: to make an effort
to take court action against a person to decide if he or she is guilty or innocent of a crime
zh: n. 尝试, 试验, 审理, 审判
vt. 试, 尝试, 试验, 考验, 审问, 提炼
vi. 尝试, 试图
examples: Try not to think about her all the time.
Try to make the most of your time.
exampleZh: 你最好别总去想她。
尽量试着用好你的时间。

defsEn: a long, round structure through which liquids or gases can flow
a long, thin container in which they can be kept
zh: n. 管, 软管, 隧道
vt. 把...装管, 使通过管子
examples: The tube does not run to a strict timetable during the day.
Then I went down into the tube station.

defsEn: to change direction
to move into a different position
to change color, form or shape
zh: n. 转弯, 转动, 旋转, 翻转, 一圈, 顺次, 改动, 变化, 性格, 特色, 形状, 转折
vt. 使旋转, 转弯, 转动, 使转向, 驱赶, 阻挡, 兑换, 改写, 使作对, 绕过, 使流通
vi. 转动, 转弯, 转向, 翻转, 回转, 改变, 转身, 变成, 变质, 晕眩, 易脱手
examples: Turn off the light before you go to bed.
Turn back if you want to see her.
exampleZh: 上床之前关灯。
如果你想见她就回头。

defsEn: below
below the surface of
less than
as called for by a law, agreement or system (“The river flows under the bridge.” “Such action is not permitted under the law.”)
zh: prep. 在...之下, 低于
a. 下面的, 从属的
adv. 在下面

defsEn: to know what is meant
to have knowledge of
zh: vt. 理解, 了解, 领会, 听说, 懂
vi. 懂得, 认为
examples: You understand best how to use the machine.
If I could understand it, I would tell you so.
exampleZh: 你最会操作这台机器了。
如果我了解这件事, 我就会告诉你。

defsEn: to join together
zh: vi. 联合, 接合, 混合
vt. 使联合, 统一, 使粘合, 使结合
examples: If we unite our efforts, we will be able to finish this.
I would unite with anybody to do right, and with nobody to do wrong.

defsEn: all of space, including planets and stars
zh: n. 宇宙, 星系, (思想等)范围
examples: So in what universe is it normal to just kill a person?
The universe is the body of a single Being.

defsEn: a place of education that usually includes several colleges and research organizations
zh: n. 大学
examples: You met him at the university?
The Geneva University Library has a good reading room.
exampleZh: 你在大学碰到他了？
日内瓦大学有一间很好的阅览室。

defsEn: except if it happens
on condition that (“I will not go, unless the rain stops.”)
zh: conj. 除非
prep. 除...之外
examples: Unless there is reliable evidence for it, we should not believe anything.
Unless you hurry, you will be late for school.
exampleZh: 除非有可靠的证据，不然我们不应该相信任何事。

defsEn: up to a time
before
zh: prep. 直到, 在...以前
conj. 直到...时, 在...以前
examples: Not until this morning did I learn the truth.
Not until the following morning did we see land.
exampleZh: 直到今早我才知道了真相。
直到第二天早晨，我们才看到了大陆。

defsEn: to, in or at a higher position or value
zh: a. 向上的, 起床的, 涨的
adv. 向上, 上涨
prep. 在...上面, 向...的较高处

defsEn: to advise strongly
to make a great effort to get someone to do something
zh: n. 冲动, 推动力, 迫切的要求
vt. 驱策, 力劝, 竭力主张, 推动
vi. 强烈要求
examples: I urge you to tell him the truth.
Jessie urged the little donkey forward.
exampleZh: 我劝你告诉他实话。
杰西鞭策小毛驴前进。

defsEn: needing an immediate decision or action
zh: a. 紧急的, 急迫的, 催逼的
examples: There is an urgent message for you.
If there's anything urgent, you can get in touch with me.
exampleZh: 你有一个紧急的讯息。
紧急情况下，您可以联系我。

defsEn: the form of the word “we” used after a preposition (“He said he would write to us.”) or used as an object of a verb (“They saw us yesterday.”)
zh: pron. 我们

defsEn: to employ for a purpose
to put into action
zh: n. 使用, 习惯, 使用价值, 用法, 使用权
vt. 使用, 利用, 运用, 耗费
vi. 惯常
examples: I used to live not too far from here.
If you use the toilet, flush it afterward.
exampleZh: 我以前住的地方离这里不远。
使用厕所后请冲水。

defsEn: as is normal or common
as is most often done, seen or heard
zh: a. 平常的, 通常的
examples: As usual, he placed the key on the table.
I got up earlier than usual so that I might catch the first train.
exampleZh: 他习惯性地将钥匙放在了桌子上。
我比平时起得早，好赶上第一班车。

defsEn: a holiday
a period of time for travel, pleasure or rest, especially one with pay given to an employee
zh: n. 假期, 休假
examples: The vacation is close to an end.
We had our vacation at the lake.
exampleZh: 假期快要结束了。
在湖边度假。

defsEn: a substance containing killed or weakened organisms given to a person or animal to produce protection against a disease
zh: n. 牛痘苗, 疫苗
a. 疫苗的, 牛痘的
examples: I haven't had the vaccine for Coronavirus.
Vaccines can provide some protection during flu season.
exampleZh: 我没有接种过冠状病毒疫苗。

defsEn: a long area of land between higher areas of land
zh: n. 山谷, 溪谷, 流域, 凹地
examples: We went down to the valley where the village is.
In this valley, the forest is unusually dense and dark.
exampleZh: 我们下到山谷里，那里有个村庄。

defsEn: the quality of being useful, important or desired
the amount of money that could be received if something is sold
zh: n. 价值, 价格, 购买力, 评价, 估价, 计算结果
vt. 评价, 估价, 重视
examples: The value of a coin depends on the weight of the metal used.
The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.
exampleZh: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。
钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。

defsEn: a plant grown for food
zh: n. 蔬菜, 植物, 无精打采之人
a. 蔬菜的, 植物的
examples: What vegetable do you like best?
What vegetables do you want to buy?
exampleZh: 你最喜欢什么蔬菜？
你想买什么蔬菜？

defsEn: anything on or in which a person or thing can travel or be transported, especially anything on wheels
a car or truck
zh: n. 交通工具, 车辆, 传播媒介
examples: Edmundo threw Rima off the vehicle.
Which vehicle do you like the most?
exampleZh: 埃德蒙多把里玛从车上推下去了。

defsEn: the form of something with different details than earlier or later forms
zh: n. 一种描述, 版本, 译文
examples: The modernized version of the qipao is noted for accentuating the female figure.
His version of the story seemed too odd to be true.
exampleZh: 现代版旗袍因能突显女人的身材而闻名。

defsEn: extremely (“He was very late.”)
zh: a. 真正的, 恰好的, 十足的, 特有的
adv. 非常, 完全
examples: I would very much like to go.
It's very important to know how to let off steam, living in this world.
exampleZh: 我非常想离开。
生活在这个世界里，懂得发泄是十分重要的。

defsEn: to reject or refuse to approve
zh: n. 否决权
vt. 否决, 禁止
examples: On July tenth, the veto was announced.

defsEn: someone or something that is injured, killed or made to suffer
someone who is tricked
zh: n. 受害人, 牺牲者, 牺牲品
examples: She is the victim of this incident.
The victim died at a hospital in Boston.
exampleZh: 她是这件事的受害者。
受害者在医院里死去了。

defsEn: a success in a fight or competition
zh: n. 胜利, 战胜, 克服
examples: Victory and defeat aren't solely decided by the size of your army.
The victory was won at the cost of many lives.
exampleZh: 胜败不能单靠兵力多少。
胜利是用许多人的性命换来的。

defsEn: a method of recording images and sound without a traditional film camera to be shown on a television, computer or other device
zh: n. 影像, 电视
a. 图像的, 电视的
examples: I got a video cassette recorder cheap at that shop.
What video game are you playing?
exampleZh: 我在那商店花低价买了台录像机。
你在玩什么电玩？

defsEn: a very small town
zh: n. 村庄
a. 乡村的, 村庄的
examples: In the village we still heat our homes with wood.
There is a village over the mountain.
exampleZh: 在村庄里，我们还是用木头给房子取暖。
在山巅上有一个村庄。

defsEn: to fail to obey or honor
to break (an agreement)
zh: vt. 违犯, 亵渎, 违反, 侵犯, 妨碍
examples: If you violate the terms of service, your account will be suspended.
They violated the terms of the contract.

defsEn: the use of force to cause injury, death or damage
zh: n. 猛烈, 暴力, 暴虐, 暴行
examples: Violence is the cancer of our society.
When violence comes through the door, law and justice go out through the chimney.
exampleZh: 暴力是社会的癌症。

defsEn: a kind of organism that causes disease
zh: n. 病毒, 滤过性病毒, 毒害
examples: The virus is starting to mutate.
The virus spread through the region.
exampleZh: 病毒开始变异了。

defsEn: the official permission given to a person to enter a country where he or she is not a citizen
zh: n. 签证
vt. 签发
examples: If your visa expires, you must leave China.
If your visa expires, you must leave the country.
exampleZh: 如果签证过期，你就必须离开中国。

defsEn: to go to or come to a place for a short time for friendly or business reasons
zh: n. 拜访, 访问, 游览, 视察
vt. 拜访, 访问, 参观, 视察, 降临
vi. 访问, 参观, 闲谈
examples: I visit him every other day.
She said that she would visit Jack with her sisters.
exampleZh: 我每隔一天拜访他。
她说她会和她的姐妹们一起去看望杰克。

defsEn: the sound made by creatures, especially humans, for speaking
zh: n. 声音, 嗓音, 嗓子, 愿望, 发言权, 表达, 喉舌, 语态
vt. 表达, 吐露, 调音
examples: Your voice reminds me of my late grandmother.
His voice is pleasant to listen to.
exampleZh: 我的声音让我想起了我已故的祖母。
他的声音很悦耳。

defsEn: a hill or mountain around a hole in the earth’s surface that can explode, sending hot, melted rock and ash into the air
zh: n. 火山
examples: The volcano has become active again.
We sat, as it were, on a volcano.
exampleZh: 这座火山又开始活动了。
我们如同坐在火山口上。

defsEn: a person who chooses to do something without being asked, usually without being paid
zh: n. 志愿者
a. 志愿的
v. 自愿
examples: Volunteer for a cause you care about.
She volunteered for an entire year for the European Voluntary Service.

defsEn: to choose a candidate in an election
n. a choice or decision expressed by the voice, by hand or by writing
zh: n. 投票, 选举, 选票, 表决, 选举权, 得票数
vi. 投票, 选举
vt. 投票选举, 投票决定, 公认, 使投票
examples: She voted for Mr Nishioka irrespective of party lines.
I vote for the Alternative for Germany.
exampleZh: 她不论党派把票投给了西冈先生。

defsEn: money received for work done
zh: n. 工资, 报酬, 薪金, 工钱, 报应, 报答, 年产额
examples: She asked for an increase in her wages.
Can you get by on your wages?

defsEn: to delay acting
to postpone
zh: n. 等待, 等候
vt. 等候, 期待, 延缓, 伺候, 推迟
vi. 等, 等候, 耽搁, 伺候用餐
examples: Wait for her to return then ask her.
Wait for a bit in the car.
exampleZh: 等她回来的时候问问她。
在车里等一下。

defsEn: to move by putting one foot in front of the other
zh: n. 走, 散步, 步行, 行走的路程, 竞走, 散步场所
vi. 走路, 步行, 处世
vt. 走过, 遛, 使走, 护送...走
examples: I walk my dog in the park every morning.
You walk too fast for me to keep up with you.
exampleZh: 我每天早上到公园里遛狗。
你走得太快我跟不上。

defsEn: the side of a room or building formed by wood, stone or other material
a structure sometimes used to separate areas of land
zh: n. 墙, 墙壁, 垣, 内壁, 分界物, 屏障
a. 墙的
vt. 给...建墙, 禁闭, 用墙围住
examples: He drove me up the wall all morning.
Was this wall built to keep people out or to keep them in?
exampleZh: 他整个早上都让我抓狂。
建造这堵墙是为了把人隔在外面还是把他们留在里面？

defsEn: to desire
to wish for
to need
zh: n. 需要的东西, 缺乏, 贫困, 需要
vt. 要, 希望, 应该, 缺少
vi. 生活困苦, 需要, 缺少
examples: I want to go study at a Canadian university.
I want to leave my name on the encyclopedia.
exampleZh: 我想去加拿大读大学。
我要在百科全书上留名。

defsEn: fighting between nations, or groups in a nation, using weapons
zh: n. 战争, 战争状态, 战术, 军事, 冲突, 斗争, 竞争
vi. 进行战争, 作战, 打仗, 战斗
a. 战争的, 战时用的
examples: War may break out at any moment.
It is said that the war will end soon.
exampleZh: 战争随时可能爆发。
据说战争快要结束了。

defsEn: almost hot
having or feeling some heat
zh: a. 暖和的, 暖的, 温暖的, 热烈的, 兴奋的, 激烈的, 多情的, 色情的
vt. 使温暖, 弄热, 使兴奋, 使充满仇恨
vi. 变暖和, 变温暖, 取暖, 激动, 同情, 爱好
n. 暖, 保暖物
examples: It's warm for this time of year.
It's warm here all the year round.
exampleZh: 对一年的这个时候来说，天气很温暖。
这里一年四季很温暖。

defsEn: to tell of possible danger
to advise or inform about something bad that may happen
zh: vt. 警告, 提醒, 通知
vi. 发出警告
examples: She warned him not to go out at night alone.
I came to warn you not to do that.
exampleZh: 她警告他晚上不要一个人出去。
我来警告你别那样做。

defsEn: to make clean, usually with water
zh: n. 洗, 洗涤, 冲洗, 洗的衣服, 冲积物, 洼地
vt. 洗, 洗涤, 洗清, 用水冲洗, 流过, 弄湿, 粉刷, 镀金属薄层于
vi. 洗涤, 洗澡, 被冲蚀, 漂浮
examples: He told me to wash my face.
I wash my face every morning.
exampleZh: 他叫我洗脸。
我每天早上洗脸。

defsEn: to spend or use without need or care
to make bad use of
n a spending of money, time or effort with no value gained or returned
something thrown away as having no value
the liquid and solid substances that result from body processes and are passed out of the body
zh: n. 浪费, 废物, 损耗, 消耗, 荒地, 垃圾, 地面风化物
a. 废弃的, 荒芜的, 多余的
vt. 浪费, 消耗, 使荒芜
vi. 浪费, 消耗, 变消瘦
examples: Waste not a single grain of rice!
It's a waste of time and money.
exampleZh: 一粒米都不要浪费!
这是在浪费时间和金钱。

defsEn: to look at
to observe closely
to look and wait for
zh: n. 观察, 手表, 看守, 守护, 监视, 值班人
vt. 看, 注视, 照顾, 看守, 守护, 监视
vi. 观看, 注视, 守侯
examples: Watch him and do the same thing.
I watch television in the evening.
exampleZh: 看着他并且跟他做同样的事情。
我在晚上看电视。

defsEn: the liquid that falls from the sky as rain or is found in lakes, rivers and oceans
zh: n. 水, 雨水, 海水, 水位, 水面, 流水
vt. 给...浇水, 供以水, 注入水, 使湿
vi. 流泪, 流口水, 加水
a. 水的, 水上的, 水生的, 含水的
examples: The water there was so deep that I could not touch bottom.
Is the water in the Black Sea actually black?
exampleZh: 那儿的水深到我碰不到底。
黑海里的水事实上是黑的吗？

defsEn: to move or cause to move one way and the other, as a flag in the wind
to signal by moving the hand one way and the other
n. a large mass of water that forms and moves on the surface of a lake or ocean
zh: n. 波, 波浪, 波动, 起伏, 高潮, 潮涌, 挥手致意, (气压)突变
vi. 波动, 飘动, 挥手示意, 起伏
vt. 使波动, 使飘扬, 挥舞, 使成波浪形
examples: She waved her hand until the train was out of sight.
She waved at me before she got on board the plane.
exampleZh: 她挥着她的手，直到火车消失在视线之外。
她上飞机前，给我招了招手。

defsEn: a path on land or sea or in the air
how something is done
method
zh: n. 路, 路线, 路途, 方法, 道路, 情形, 规模, 习惯, 行业, 方面
adv. 远远地, 非常
examples: In this way, we waste a lot of time.
By the way, how many of you keep a diary?
exampleZh: 这样的话我们会浪费很多时间。
对了，你们当中写日记的有几位？

defsEn: two or more people, including the speaker or writer (“He and I will go together, and we will return together.”)
zh: pron. 我们

defsEn: having little power
easily broken, damaged or destroyed
opposite strong
zh: a. 不牢固的, 弱的, 虚弱的, 软弱的, 无力的, 无权力的, (论据等)不充分的
examples: He was a weak and delicate child.
The weak are food for the strong.
exampleZh: 他以前是个柔弱的小孩。
弱肉强食。

defsEn: a large amount of possessions, money or other things of value
zh: n. 财富, 资源, 财产, 丰富, 富裕, 大量
examples: Wealth does not always bring us happiness.
Wealth may be a factor of happiness.
exampleZh: 财富并不总是为我们带来快乐。

defsEn: anything used to cause injury or to kill during an attack, fight or war
zh: n. 武器, 兵器
vt. 武装
examples: Where's the weapon used in the crime?
That weapon is not a toy, boy!

defsEn: to have on the body, as clothes
zh: n. 穿着, 戴, 使用, 耗损, 服装, 耐久性
vt. 穿着, 戴, 留(须、发等), 呈现, 磨损, 磨成, 耗损, 使疲乏, 消磨
vi. 磨损, 变旧, 耐久, 渐变, 渐渐消失
examples: Wear whatever you want to wear.
We wear a uniform at school.
exampleZh: 穿你想穿的。
我们在学校穿制服。

defsEn: the condition of the atmosphere resulting from sun, wind, rain, heat or cold
zh: n. 天气, 气象, 处境
a. 迎风的
vt. 使受风吹雨打, 侵蚀, 使风化, 经受住
vi. 风化, 受侵蚀, 经受风雨
examples: The weather forecast says it will be fine tomorrow.
The weather will delay the start of the race.
exampleZh: 根据气象预报，明天会是晴天。
因为天气的关系，赛跑比赛将会延迟。

defsEn: a period of time equal to seven days
zh: n. 星期, 周
examples: I spent a week in the hospital.
I spent a week in hospital.
exampleZh: 我住了一个星期的院。
我住了一个星期的院。

defsEn: to measure how heavy someone or something is welcome – v. to express happiness or pleasure weigh when someone arrives or something develops
zh: vt. 称...重量, 衡量, 把...压弯, 考虑, 权衡, 起锚
vi. 称分量, 有意义, 重压, 起锚
n. 过秤, 称分量
examples: He weighs a lot more than before.
You don't weigh more than me.
exampleZh: 他比以前重得多。
你不比我重。

defsEn: in a way that is good or pleasing
in good health
n. a hole in the ground where water, gas or oil can be found
zh: n. 井, 泉水, 源泉, 好
v. 涌出
a. 健康的, 良好的, 适宜的, 恰当的
adv. 很好地, 适当地, 好意地, 很, 完全
interj. 好啦
examples: Well, I can cross that off my bucket list.
Well, tell me about it, then!
exampleZh: 太好了，死前心愿又完成了一样。
是吗？那说来听听啊！

defsEn: the direction in which the sun goes down
zh: n. 西方, 西部
a. 西方的, 向西的
adv. 向西, 自西方, 在西方
examples: A Mr West called in your absence.
Mrs. West is busy getting breakfast ready.
exampleZh: 有个West先生在你不在的时候打过电话来。
威斯特夫人正在忙碌地准备早餐。

defsEn: covered with water or other liquid
not dry
zh: n. 湿气, 潮湿, 水分, 雨天
a. 湿的, 潮的, 搞错的, 下雨的, 反对禁酒的
vi. 变湿
vt. 使...湿
examples: The wet vase left a mark on the table.
She got wet to the skin.
exampleZh: 花瓶在桌上留下了水迹。
她浑身湿透了。

defsEn: used to ask about something or to ask for information about something (“What is this?”)
ad which or which kind (“He wants to know what you would like to drink.”)
zh: pron. 什么
interj. 怎么, 多么
a. 什么的
adv. 到什么程度

defsEn: a grain used to make bread
the plant that produces the grain
zh: n. 小麦
examples: There is no wheat that I have not ground.
The wheat crop bears a good harvest every year.

defsEn: a round structure that turns around a center wheel
zh: n. 轮子, 车轮, 轮, 方向盘, 旋转, 机构, 重要人物
vt. 使旋转, 转动, 使转向
vi. 旋转, 转弯, 盘旋
examples: The wheel began to roll slowly.
The wheels of justice turn slowly but grind exceedingly fine.
exampleZh: 轮子开始慢慢转动。

defsEn: at what time
at any time (“When will she come home?”)
conj during or at the time (“I studied hard when I was in school.”)
zh: conj. 当...的时候
adv. 何时, 什么时候
pron. 什么时侯
n. 时间

defsEn: , conj. at, to or in what place (“Where is his house?” “The house where he lives is in the old part of the city.”)
zh: adv. 在哪里
pron. 哪里
n. 地点

defsEn: if it be the case or fact that (“He did not know whether he was right or wrong.”)
zh: conj. 是否, 不论
pron. 两个中的哪一个
examples: Whether you believe it or not, I believe it.
Whether you know him or not, you have to support his opinion.
exampleZh: 至于你信不信，由你，我反正信了。
不管你认不认识他，你都应该支持他的想法。

defsEn: used to ask about what one or what ones of a group of things or people (“Which program do you like best?” “Which students will take the test?”)
zh: pron. 哪一个, 那一个

defsEn: a space of time (“Please come to my house for a while.”)
conj. at or during the same time. (“It may not be a good idea to eat while you are running.”)
zh: n. 一会儿, (一段)时间
conj. 当...的时候, 虽然
vt. 消磨
examples: While walking, I used to feel somewhat in a hurry.
While reading a book, I fell asleep.
exampleZh: 以前，我散步的时候感觉有点匆忙。
我看书的时候睡着了。

defsEn: having the color like that of milk or snow
zh: n. 白色, 洁白, 眼白, 白种人, 蛋白
a. 白色的, 纯洁的, 白种的, 苍白的, 空白的, 幸运的
examples: There's a white dove on the roof.
There is a white dove on the roof.
exampleZh: 屋顶上有只白鸽。
屋顶上有只白鸽。

defsEn: what or which person or persons that (“Who wants to go?”)
the person or persons (“They are the ones who want to go.”)
zh: pron. 谁

defsEn: the complete amount
all together
not divided
not cut into pieces
zh: n. 全部, 全体, 整体, 完全之体系
a. 所有的, 完整的, 完全的, 纯粹的
examples: On the whole, I agree with her.
I spent the whole day in reading the novel.
exampleZh: 我大致上同意她。
我一整天都在看这本小说。

defsEn: for what cause or reason (“Why did she do it?”)
conj. the reason for which (“I do not know why she did it.”)
zh: adv. 为什么
n. 原因, 理由

defsEn: having a great distance from one side to the other
not limited
zh: a. 宽的, 广阔的, 普遍的, 宽阔的, 广泛的, 一般的
adv. 广阔地, 遍及各处地, 广泛地
n. 大千世界
examples: A wide leather belt would look good with that dress.
Wide and straight roads make me want to drive fast.

defsEn: a woman who is married
zh: n. 妻子, 太太, 夫人
examples: He told his wife not to buy on impulse.
My wife asked me to throw this old hat away.
exampleZh: 他叫自己的妻子不要冲动购物。
老婆叫我把这顶旧帽子丢掉。

defsEn: living and growing in natural conditions and not organized or supervised by humans
angry
uncontrolled
zh: n. 荒野, 荒地
a. 野性的, 野蛮的, 野生的, 失控的, 任性的, 杂乱的, 轻率的, 狂热的, 疯狂的
adv. 狂暴地, 失控地
examples: Wild animals live in the forest.
I'm not as wild as I used to be.
exampleZh: 野生动物住在森林里。

defsEn: a word used with action words to show future action (“They will hold talks tomorrow.”)
zh: n. 意志, 决心, 意愿, 意向, 干劲, 遗嘱
vt. 用意志的力量驱使, 决意, 愿意, 立遗嘱
vi. 下决心, 愿意
aux. 将, 愿意, 必须
examples: I will not allow you to use my pen.
You will not be able to catch the train.
exampleZh: 我不允许你用我的钢笔。
你将无法赶上火车。

defsEn: being ready or having a desire to (“They are willing to talk about the problem.”)
zh: a. 乐意的, 自愿的, 甘愿的
examples: Would you be willing to fix it for me?
Would you be willing to do me a favor?

defsEn: to gain a victory
to defeat another or others in a competition, election or battle
zh: vt. 赢得, 打胜, 成功
vi. 获胜, 达到, 影响
n. 胜利, 赢, 收益
examples: The wind blew too hard for them to play in the park.
If I win the lottery, I'll be able to live high on the hog.
exampleZh: 风刮得太猛，他们没法在公园里玩了。
如果我中了彩劵，就一辈子衣食无忧了。

defsEn: a strong movement of air
zh: n. 风, 气息, 气味, 呼吸, 风声, 趋势, 空谈, 卷绕, 弯曲
vt. 使通风, 嗅出, 使喘气, 吹号角, 上发条, 缠绕, 包, 绞起, 吊起, 使弯曲, 使迂回
vi. 嗅出猎物, 吹响号角, 卷曲, 蜿蜒, 迂回, 缠绕
examples: Winds from the sea are moist.
He drove down the winding road.
exampleZh: 从海洋吹来的风感觉湿漉漉的。

defsEn: an opening in a wall to let in light and air, usually filled with glass window
zh: n. 窗户, 窗子, 窗口
vt. 给...开窗
examples: He broke the window on purpose.
She broke the window on purpose.
exampleZh: 他故意打破了窗户。
她故意把窗户弄坏了。

defsEn: the coldest time of year, between autumn and spring
zh: n. 冬季, 萧条期, 衰退期
a. 冬天的
vt. 使度过冬天
vi. 过冬
examples: In winter, I always need to add an extra quilt.
In winter I like to eat chocolate.
exampleZh: 冬天我总是需要多加条被子。
冬天的时候我喜欢吃巧克力。

defsEn: a long, thin piece of metal used to hang objects or to carry electricity or electronic communications from one place to another
zh: n. 电线, 电报, 电信, 铁丝网, 金属丝
vt. 用金属丝捆扎, 拍电报
vi. 打电报
examples: Is the wire live? I can tell just by touching it.
Wires are used to convey electricity.
exampleZh: 电线有没有电？我一摸就知道。
电线被用来运送电力。

defsEn: having much knowledge and understanding
able to use knowledge and understanding to make good or correct decisions
zh: a. 明智的, 慎虑的, 聪明的, 博学的, 狡猾的, 机灵的
vi. 知道
vt. 教导, 告诉, 劝导
n. 方法, 方式
examples: A wise man would not say such a thing.
A wise leader knows when to listen to others.
exampleZh: 一个聪明人不会说这种话。
聪明的领袖知道什么时候要听取他人意见。

defsEn: to want
to express a desire for
zh: n. 希望, 愿望, 祝愿, 命令, 请求
vt. 愿, 想要, 希望, 祝愿
vi. 希望
examples: I wish to become a dentist in the future.
I wish I could see you at the weekend.
exampleZh: 我希望将来成为一名牙医。
真希望能在周末见到你。

defsEn: along or by the side of
together
using (“He fixed it with a tool.”)
having (“the house with the red door”)
zh: prep. 和...在一起, 以, 由于

defsEn: to take or move out, away or back
to remove
zh: vt. 撤回, 取回, 撤消, 使撤退, 拉开, 移开
vi. 撤退, 离开
examples: She had to withdraw her son from the club.
He didn't withdraw money from the bank.

defsEn: with no
not having or using
free from
not doing
zh: prep. 没有, 不, 在...之外
adv. 在外面, 户外
n. 外面, 外部
examples: Without water, no one can survive on Earth.
Without water, nothing could live on this earth.
exampleZh: 如果没有了水，没有人能够在地球上生存。
没有水，没有东西能生活在这个地球上。

defsEn: a person who saw and can tell about an action or event, sometimes in a court of law
zh: n. 证人, 目击者, 证据, 证词
vt. 目击, 作证, 证明, 表明
vi. 作证人, 作为证据
examples: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light.
He witnessed an accident on his way to school.

defsEn: an adult female human
zh: n. 女人, 妇女, 女仆
a. 女用的, 女性的, 妇女的
vt. 贬称...为女人, 使成女人腔
examples: A woman fell from a ship into the sea.
The woman is in front of a big rock.
exampleZh: 有个女人从船上掉进了海里。
女人在大石头前。

defsEn: to ask oneself
to question (“She wonders if it is true.”)
n. a feeling of surprise
zh: n. 奇迹, 惊奇, 惊愕
vt. 惊奇, 想知道
vi. 惊讶, 怀疑
examples: I wonder what the weather will be like tomorrow.
I wonder if I can do it again.
exampleZh: 不知道明天天气会怎么样呢？
我不知道我能不能再做一次。

defsEn: causing wonder
especially good
zh: a. 令人惊奇的, 奇妙的, 极好的
examples: It would be wonderful if you could sing at our wedding.
A wonderful idea floated to his mind.
exampleZh: 你能在我们的婚礼上唱歌就太好了。
一个绝妙的想法浮现在他的脑海。

defsEn: the solid material of which trees are made
zh: n. 木材, 木制品
vt. 植林于, 给...添加木柴
vi. 收集木材
examples: Mrs. Wood was a very good cook.
Mrs. Wood is an excellent cook.
exampleZh: 伍德太太的厨艺非常好。
伍德太太是个非常棒的厨师。

defsEn: one or more connected sounds that form a single part of a language
zh: n. 话, 消息, 词, 诺言, 命令
vt. 用言辞表达
examples: This word means a lot to her.
A word is enough to a wise man.
exampleZh: 这个字对她来说意义重大。
对聪明人说话，一语即足。

defsEn: to use physical or mental effort to make or do something
n. the effort used to make or to do something
that which needs effort
the job one does to earn money
zh: n. 工作, 劳动, 职业, 行为, 功, 作品, 成果, 产品, 工程
vi. 工作, 劳动, 做, 运转, 起作用, 被加工
vt. 使工作, 使转动, 开动, 使用, 经营, 使逐渐变得, 造成
examples: Work hard so that you may earn your living.
Work hard, and you will pass the examination.
exampleZh: 努力工作才能养活自己。
好好努力，你就能通过考试。

defsEn: the earth
the people who live on the earth
zh: n. 世界, 地球, 宇宙, 万物, 世人, 人间, 领域, 世事, 世故, 社会生活, 大量
examples: Our world is only one small part of the universe.
The world today needs to advance its production of food.
exampleZh: 我们的世界只不过是宇宙的一小部分。
当今世界需推进其食物生产。

defsEn: to be concerned
to continue thinking that something, possibly bad, can happen
zh: n. 担心, 烦恼, 忧虑, 苦恼, 撕咬
vt. 使烦恼, 使焦虑, 使苦恼, 困扰, 折磨, 撕咬
vi. 烦恼, 担心, 撕咬
examples: You worry about your weight too much.
You worry too much about your weight.
exampleZh: 你太担心你的体重了。
你太担心你的体重了。

defsEn: more bad than
zh: n. 更坏的事, 更恶劣的事, 败局
a. 更坏的, 更恶劣的
adv. 更坏地, 更恶劣地
examples: Worse things have happened to both of us.
What could be worse than that?
exampleZh: 我们俩都经历过不幸。

defsEn: value measured in money
zh: n. 价值, 财产
a. 值...的, 值得的
examples: If it is worth doing, do it well.
This is worth one million yen.
exampleZh: 如果事情值得做就值得做好。
这值100万日元。

defsEn: to injure
to hurt
to cause physical damage to a person or animal
n. an injury to the body of a human or animal in which the skin is usually cut or broken
zh: n. 创伤, 伤口, 伤疤, 伤害, 痛苦
vt. 伤害, 损害, 使受伤
vi. 打伤, 伤害
wind的过去式和过去分词
examples: He wound a bandage around the wound.
The wound will not stop bleeding.
exampleZh: 他用绷带包扎了伤口。
伤口流血不止。

defsEn: to damage greatly
to destroy
n. anything that has been badly damaged or broken
zh: n. 失事, 残骸, 破坏
vt. 使失事, 拆毁, 破坏
vi. (船)失事, 营救失事船只
examples: There was a wreck on the highway.
The wreck will stay where it is, serving as the sailors' final resting place.

defsEn: what remains of something severely damaged or destroyed
zh: n. 残骸, 失事, 破坏
examples: The wreckage of the plane was found in the desert.
The wreckage is scattered over a large area.

defsEn: to use an instrument to make words appear on a surface, such as paper write
zh: vt. 书写, 著述, 写, 写满, 写信给
vi. 写, 写字, 写信, 写作, 作曲
examples: Who told you to write with your left hand?
Write to me as soon as you get there.
exampleZh: 谁跟你说用左手写字的？
你一到就写信给我。

defsEn: not correct
bad
not legal
opposite right
zh: a. 错误的, 不正当的, 失常的
adv. 错误地
examples: I wrote a wrong address on the envelope.
I wrote the wrong address on the envelope.
exampleZh: 我在信封上写错了地址。
我在信封上写错了地址。

defsEn: a kind of radiation that can pass through most solid material, often used in medicine
zh: a. X射线的
vt. 用X光检查, 照X光
vi. 使用X光

defsEn: a period of time equal to twelve months
zh: n. 年, 年度, 年龄
examples: This year we offer the same language course as last year.
This year is definitely a special year in human history.
exampleZh: 今年我们提供与去年相同的语言课程。
今年肯定是人类历史上特殊的一年。

defsEn: having the color like that of gold or the sun
zh: n. 黄色
a. 黄色的
examples: His teeth are yellow from smoking too much.
Yellow and blue go well together.
exampleZh: 他的牙齿被烟熏黄了。

defsEn: used to express agreement or to permit
zh: adv. 是
n. 是, 同意
v. 同意
examples: Yes. She used to be a very shy girl.
Yes. I have to read it by tomorrow.
exampleZh: 对啊，她以前是一个很害羞的女孩。
是的。我明天必须读完。

defsEn: the day before today
zh: n. 昨天
adv. 昨天
examples: Yesterday I read an article about acid rain.
Yesterday he saw a big man.
exampleZh: 昨天我读了关于酸雨的文章。
昨天他遇到了高大的男人。

defsEn: at some time before now (“Have they arrived yet?”)
now
at this time (“I cannot tell you about it yet.”)
conj. however (“The sun was shining, yet it was cold.”)
zh: adv. 还, 尚, 仍然, 已经, 然而
conj. 然而
examples: And yet, the contrary is always true as well.
And with me, we are yet one more.
exampleZh: 然而，相反的理论往往也是真的。
有了我，我们已经多一个人了。

defsEn: the person or persons being spoken to
zh: pron. 你, 你们

defsEn: in the early years of life
not old
zh: a. 年轻的, 无经验的, 朝气蓬勃的
n. 青年们, 幼小动物, 崽
examples: Young people all like pop music.
Young people must respect the law.
exampleZh: 年轻人都喜欢流行乐。
年轻人必须遵纪守法。

defsEn: the number meaning none or nothing
zh: n. 零, 零点, 零度, 无, 乌有, 最低点
a. 零的, 没有的
vt. 调零, 对(炮火等)作协调校正
examples: Is zero a positive or a negative number?
Zero, ten, one hundred, one thousand, one million, one billion.

defsEn: a place where animals are kept for the public to look at and study
zh: n. 动物园
examples: They went to the zoo by bus yesterday.
Is there a zoo in the park?
exampleZh: 他们昨天乘巴士去了动物园。
公园里有动物园吗？
